/**
 * Deterministic Two-Factor Student Photo Matcher.
 * Matches filenames such as "8_kaustuv_thapa.jpg", "08-kaustuv-thapa.png",
 * "14_aarav_sharma.jpeg", "8.jpg", or "ADM-042.jpg" against active class roster records.
 */

export interface StudentPhotoCandidate {
  student_id: string
  full_name: string
  roll_number: number
  admission_no: string | null
  registration_no: string | null
  photo_url?: string | null
}

export type PhotoMatchConfidence = 'high' | 'medium' | 'unmatched'

export interface ParsedPhotoFilename {
  rawFilename: string
  basename: string
  extension: string
  extractedRoll: number | null
  extractedNameCandidate: string | null
}

export interface MatchedStudentPhoto {
  file: File
  filename: string
  previewUrl: string
  dataUrl?: string
  extractedRoll: number | null
  extractedName: string | null
  matchedStudentId: string | null
  matchedStudentName: string | null
  matchedRollNumber: number | null
  confidence: PhotoMatchConfidence
  matchReason: string
}

/**
 * Normalizes a name string for fuzzy token comparison.
 * "kaustuv_thapa" -> ["kaustuv", "thapa"]
 * "Aarav Sharma (Sci)" -> ["aarav", "sharma", "sci"]
 */
export function tokenizeName(name: string): string[] {
  return name
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[._\-+,/()]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .split(' ')
    .filter(Boolean)
}

/**
 * Checks if two names have significant token overlap or fuzzy similarity.
 */
export function doNamesMatch(nameA: string, nameB: string): boolean {
  const tokensA = tokenizeName(nameA)
  const tokensB = tokenizeName(nameB)
  if (tokensA.length === 0 || tokensB.length === 0) return false

  // Exact token match
  const common = tokensA.filter((t) => tokensB.includes(t))
  if (common.length >= 1 && (common.some((t) => t.length >= 3) || common.length >= Math.min(tokensA.length, tokensB.length))) {
    return true
  }

  // 1-character typo tolerance on tokens of length >= 4 (e.g. kaustuv vs kaustav)
  for (const a of tokensA) {
    for (const b of tokensB) {
      if (a === b) return true
      if (a.length >= 4 && b.length >= 4 && Math.abs(a.length - b.length) <= 1) {
        let diffs = 0
        for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(a.length, b.length); i++) {
          if (a[i] !== b[i]) diffs++
        }
        if (diffs <= 1) return true
      }
    }
  }

  return false
}

/**
 * Parses raw photo filename into roll and name candidates.
 * Supports:
 * - "8_kaustuv_thapa.jpg"
 * - "08-kaustuv-thapa.png"
 * - "14 aarav sharma.jpeg"
 * - "8.jpg", "roll-8.jpg"
 * - "kaustuv_thapa.jpg"
 */
export function parsePhotoFilename(filename: string): ParsedPhotoFilename {
  const lastDot = filename.lastIndexOf('.')
  const basename = lastDot !== -1 ? filename.slice(0, lastDot) : filename
  const extension = lastDot !== -1 ? filename.slice(lastDot + 1).toLowerCase() : ''

  // Pattern 1: Leading roll followed by separator and name: "8_kaustuv_thapa", "08-kaustuv-thapa", "14 aarav sharma"
  const rollAndNameMatch = basename.match(/^(\d+)[\s_\-]+(.+)$/)
  if (rollAndNameMatch) {
    const roll = parseInt(rollAndNameMatch[1], 10)
    const namePart = rollAndNameMatch[2].replace(/[_\-]+/g, ' ').trim()
    return {
      rawFilename: filename,
      basename,
      extension,
      extractedRoll: Number.isFinite(roll) ? roll : null,
      extractedNameCandidate: namePart || null,
    }
  }

  // Pattern 2: Roll number only: "8", "08", "roll-8", "roll_08"
  const rollOnlyMatch = basename.match(/^(?:roll[\s_\-]*)?(\d+)$/i)
  if (rollOnlyMatch) {
    const roll = parseInt(rollOnlyMatch[1], 10)
    return {
      rawFilename: filename,
      basename,
      extension,
      extractedRoll: Number.isFinite(roll) ? roll : null,
      extractedNameCandidate: null,
    }
  }

  // Pattern 3: Name only or alphanumeric ID (e.g. "kaustuv_thapa" or "ADM-042")
  return {
    rawFilename: filename,
    basename,
    extension,
    extractedRoll: null,
    extractedNameCandidate: basename.replace(/[_\-]+/g, ' ').trim(),
  }
}

/**
 * Matches a list of photo files against a class roster using the deterministic 2-factor ladder.
 */
export function matchPhotosToStudents(
  files: File[],
  students: StudentPhotoCandidate[]
): MatchedStudentPhoto[] {
  // Index students by roll number
  const rollMap = new Map<number, StudentPhotoCandidate>()
  // Index students by normalized admission/registration number
  const idMap = new Map<string, StudentPhotoCandidate>()

  for (const s of students) {
    rollMap.set(s.roll_number, s)
    if (s.admission_no) idMap.set(s.admission_no.toLowerCase().trim(), s)
    if (s.registration_no) idMap.set(s.registration_no.toLowerCase().trim(), s)
  }

  return files.map((file) => {
    const parsed = parsePhotoFilename(file.name)
    let previewUrl = ''
    try {
      if (typeof URL !== 'undefined' && typeof URL.createObjectURL === 'function' && typeof Blob !== 'undefined' && file instanceof Blob) {
        previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file)
      }
    } catch {
      previewUrl = ''
    }

    // Strategy 1: Check exact institutional ID match (e.g. "ADM-2083-014.jpg" or "1641052469.jpg")
    const cleanedBase = parsed.basename.toLowerCase().trim()
    const studentById = idMap.get(cleanedBase)
    if (studentById) {
      return {
        file,
        filename: file.name,
        previewUrl,
        extractedRoll: parsed.extractedRoll,
        extractedName: parsed.extractedNameCandidate,
        matchedStudentId: studentById.student_id,
        matchedStudentName: studentById.full_name,
        matchedRollNumber: studentById.roll_number,
        confidence: 'high',
        matchReason: `✓ Matched by Institutional ID (${studentById.admission_no || studentById.registration_no})`,
      }
    }

    // Strategy 2: Two-Factor Roll + Name Ladder
    if (parsed.extractedRoll !== null) {
      const studentByRoll = rollMap.get(parsed.extractedRoll)

      if (studentByRoll) {
        // If we also extracted a candidate name, cross-verify
        if (parsed.extractedNameCandidate) {
          const namesMatch = doNamesMatch(parsed.extractedNameCandidate, studentByRoll.full_name)
          if (namesMatch) {
            return {
              file,
              filename: file.name,
              previewUrl,
              extractedRoll: parsed.extractedRoll,
              extractedName: parsed.extractedNameCandidate,
              matchedStudentId: studentByRoll.student_id,
              matchedStudentName: studentByRoll.full_name,
              matchedRollNumber: studentByRoll.roll_number,
              confidence: 'high',
              matchReason: `✓ Matched (Roll ${studentByRoll.roll_number} + Name Verified)`,
            }
          } else {
            // Roll matched, but name differed (possible roll shift or typo)
            return {
              file,
              filename: file.name,
              previewUrl,
              extractedRoll: parsed.extractedRoll,
              extractedName: parsed.extractedNameCandidate,
              matchedStudentId: studentByRoll.student_id,
              matchedStudentName: studentByRoll.full_name,
              matchedRollNumber: studentByRoll.roll_number,
              confidence: 'medium',
              matchReason: `Roll ${studentByRoll.roll_number} matched, but name differs ("${parsed.extractedNameCandidate}")`,
            }
          }
        }

        // Just roll number provided (e.g. "8.jpg")
        return {
          file,
          filename: file.name,
          previewUrl,
          extractedRoll: parsed.extractedRoll,
          extractedName: null,
          matchedStudentId: studentByRoll.student_id,
          matchedStudentName: studentByRoll.full_name,
          matchedRollNumber: studentByRoll.roll_number,
          confidence: 'high',
          matchReason: `✓ Matched by Roll Number (${studentByRoll.roll_number})`,
        }
      }
    }

    // Strategy 3: Name-only matching if roll was absent or not found in class
    if (parsed.extractedNameCandidate) {
      const candidates = students.filter((s) =>
        doNamesMatch(parsed.extractedNameCandidate!, s.full_name)
      )

      if (candidates.length === 1) {
        const student = candidates[0]
        return {
          file,
          filename: file.name,
          previewUrl,
          extractedRoll: parsed.extractedRoll,
          extractedName: parsed.extractedNameCandidate,
          matchedStudentId: student.student_id,
          matchedStudentName: student.full_name,
          matchedRollNumber: student.roll_number,
          confidence: 'medium',
          matchReason: `Matched by Student Name (Current Roll: ${student.roll_number})`,
        }
      }
    }

    // Fallback: Unmatched
    return {
      file,
      filename: file.name,
      previewUrl,
      extractedRoll: parsed.extractedRoll,
      extractedName: parsed.extractedNameCandidate,
      matchedStudentId: null,
      matchedStudentName: null,
      matchedRollNumber: null,
      confidence: 'unmatched',
      matchReason: 'Unmatched file — select student manually from dropdown',
    }
  })
}

export function isSupabaseConfigured(): boolean {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
  const key = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
  return Boolean(
    url &&
    key &&
    !url.includes('dummy-project') &&
    url.startsWith('https://') &&
    key !== 'dummy-anon-key'
  )
}

import { createServerClient, type CookieOptions } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({
    request: {
      headers: request.headers,
    },
  })

  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
  const supabaseAnonKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY

  if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseAnonKey || supabaseUrl.includes('dummy-project')) {
    return supabaseResponse
  }

  try {
    const supabase = createServerClient(
      supabaseUrl,
      supabaseAnonKey,
      {
        cookies: {
          get(name: string) {
            return request.cookies.get(name)?.value
          },
          set(name: string, value: string, options: CookieOptions) {
            request.cookies.set({
              name,
              value,
              ...options,
            })
            supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({
              request: {
                headers: request.headers,
              },
            })
            supabaseResponse.cookies.set({
              name,
              value,
              ...options,
            })
          },
          remove(name: string, options: CookieOptions) {
            request.cookies.set({
              name,
              value: '',
              ...options,
            })
            supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({
              request: {
                headers: request.headers,
              },
            })
            supabaseResponse.cookies.set({
              name,
              value: '',
              ...options,
            })
          },
        },
      }
    )

    await supabase.auth.getUser()
  } catch (error) {
    // Graceful fallback for unconfigured environments
  }

  return supabaseResponse
}

FILE: lib\supabase\server.ts

import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
import type { Database } from '@/types/database'

export async function createClient() {
  let cookieStore: any = null
  try {
    cookieStore = await cookies()
  } catch {
    // Called outside request scope (e.g. CLI script or background task)
  }

  return createServerClient<Database>(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return cookieStore ? cookieStore.getAll() : []
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          if (!cookieStore) return
          try {
            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
            )
          } catch (error) {
            // The `setAll` method was called from a Server Component.
            // This can be ignored if you have middleware refreshing user sessions.
          }
        },
      },
    }
  )
}

/**
 * Types & Domain Helpers for Fleet Maintenance Operations
 * Used across /maintenance, /computer-lab, and Server Actions.
 */

export type FleetTerminalStatus = 'pending' | 'completed' | 'blocked'

export interface FleetTerminalEntry {
  status: FleetTerminalStatus
  updated_at: string
  technician_name?: string
  technician_id?: string
  notes?: string
}

export type FleetProgressMap = Record<string, FleetTerminalEntry>

export interface FleetProgressSummary {
  total: number
  completed: number
  pending: number
  blocked: number
  percentage: number
}

/**
 * Pure calculation helper: computes summary metrics from machine list and progress map
 */
export function calculateFleetProgressSummary(
  targetMachines: string[],
  progress: FleetProgressMap | null | undefined
): FleetProgressSummary {
  const total = targetMachines.length
  if (total === 0) {
    return {
      total: 0,
      completed: 0,
      pending: 0,
      blocked: 0,
      percentage: 0,
    }
  }

  let completed = 0
  let blocked = 0
  let pending = 0

  const safeMap = progress || {}

  for (const label of targetMachines) {
    const entry = safeMap[label]
    if (!entry || entry.status === 'pending') {
      pending++
    } else if (entry.status === 'completed') {
      completed++
    } else if (entry.status === 'blocked') {
      blocked++
    } else {
      pending++
    }
  }

  const percentage = Math.round((completed / total) * 100)

  return {
    total,
    completed,
    pending,
    blocked,
    percentage,
  }
}

/**
 * Natural sort for workstation labels (PC-01 before PC-10, Teacher Pod at the end or top)
 */
export function sortWorkstationLabels(labels: string[]): string[] {
  return [...labels].sort((a, b) => {
    const aIsTeacher = a.toLowerCase().includes('teacher') || a.toLowerCase().includes('podium')
    const bIsTeacher = b.toLowerCase().includes('teacher') || b.toLowerCase().includes('podium')
    if (aIsTeacher && !bIsTeacher) return 1
    if (!aIsTeacher && bIsTeacher) return -1

    return a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' })
  })
}

/**
 * Group workstation labels by Row (Row A, Row B, etc. or chunks of 10)
 */
export function groupWorkstationLabelsByRow(labels: string[]): Array<{
  rowLabel: string
  items: string[]
}> {
  const sorted = sortWorkstationLabels(labels)
  const map: Map<string, string[]> = new Map()

  for (const label of sorted) {
    // If label starts with PC- and we want to group by chunks or known pattern
    const lower = label.toLowerCase()
    let group = 'Fleet'
    if (lower.includes('teacher') || lower.includes('podium')) {
      group = 'Teacher Pod'
    } else {
      // Check if standard PC-XX number
      const numMatch = label.match(/\d+/)
      if (numMatch) {
        const num = parseInt(numMatch[0], 10)
        if (num <= 10) group = 'Row A (01-10)'
        else if (num <= 20) group = 'Row B (11-20)'
        else if (num <= 30) group = 'Row C (21-30)'
        else if (num <= 40) group = 'Row D (31-40)'
        else if (num <= 50) group = 'Row E (41-50)'
        else group = 'Additional Stations'
      }
    }

    if (!map.has(group)) {
      map.set(group, [])
    }
    map.get(group)!.push(label)
  }

  return Array.from(map.entries()).map(([rowLabel, items]) => ({
    rowLabel,
    items,
  }))
}

/**
 * Pure Mathematical Layout Engine for Laboratory CAD Workstations
 * Conforms to Rule #13: Pure domain calculation decoupled from 'use server' RPCs.
 */

export type LayoutPresetType =
  | 'official_dual_wing'
  | 'rows_2x8'
  | 'rows_3x8'
  | 'rows_4x8'
  | 'rows_5x10'
  | 'rows_6x8'
  | 'dual_islands'
  | 'triple_islands'
  | 'u_perimeter'

export interface WorkstationPositionUpdate {
  id: string
  label: string
  position_id?: string | null
  pos_x: number
  pos_y: number
  row_label: string | null
}

export interface LayoutPresetInfo {
  id: LayoutPresetType
  title: string
  description: string
  capacityHint: string
  recommendedFor: string
}

export const LAYOUT_PRESETS: LayoutPresetInfo[] = [
  {
    id: 'official_dual_wing',
    title: 'Default Lab Layout (48 PCs)',
    description: 'Standard institutional laboratory setup: Left Wing (Rows A–F) and Right Wing (Rows G–L) with central aisle.',
    capacityHint: '48 PCs (2 Wings · 6 Rows · 4 Cols)',
    recommendedFor: 'Computer Lab 01 standard configuration',
  },
]

/**
 * Snaps a coordinate percentage to the nearest grid increment (e.g. 1%, 2%, 4%).
 */
export function snapCoordinate(val: number, snapGrid: number = 2): number {
  if (snapGrid <= 0) return Math.round(val * 10) / 10
  const snapped = Math.round(val / snapGrid) * snapGrid
  return Math.max(2, Math.min(98, Math.round(snapped * 10) / 10))
}

/**
 * Sort workstations naturally by label (PC-01, PC-02, ..., PC-10, Teacher-01 at front)
 */
export function sortWorkstationsByLabel<T extends { label: string }>(items: T[]): {
  teacherNodes: T[]
  studentNodes: T[]
} {
  const teacherNodes: T[] = []
  const studentNodes: T[] = []

  for (const item of items) {
    const lbl = item.label.toLowerCase()
    if (lbl.includes('teacher') || lbl.includes('podium') || lbl.includes('instructor')) {
      teacherNodes.push(item)
    } else {
      studentNodes.push(item)
    }
  }

  // Natural numeric sort for student PCs (PC-01, PC-2, PC-10)
  studentNodes.sort((a, b) => {
    const numA = parseInt(a.label.replace(/\D/g, '') || '0', 10)
    const numB = parseInt(b.label.replace(/\D/g, '') || '0', 10)
    if (numA !== numB) return numA - numB
    return a.label.localeCompare(b.label)
  })

  return { teacherNodes, studentNodes }
}

/**
 * Mathematically generates new workstation coordinates based on the selected layout preset.
 */
export function calculateAutoArrangement<
  T extends { id: string; label: string; row_label?: string | null; position_id?: string | null }
>(
  workstations: T[],
  preset: LayoutPresetType = 'official_dual_wing',
  snapGrid: number = 2
): WorkstationPositionUpdate[] {
  const { teacherNodes, studentNodes } = sortWorkstationsByLabel(workstations)
  const results: WorkstationPositionUpdate[] = []

  // 1. Position Teacher Podium(s)
  teacherNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
    const posX = snapCoordinate(50 + (idx - (teacherNodes.length - 1) / 2) * 15, snapGrid)
    const posY = snapCoordinate(12, snapGrid)
    results.push({
      id: node.id,
      label: node.label,
      pos_x: posX,
      pos_y: posY,
      row_label: 'Teacher Podium',
      position_id: 'PODIUM',
    })
  })

  const N = studentNodes.length
  if (N === 0) return results

  if (preset === 'official_dual_wing') {
    const slots = generateRoomGridSlots(
      {
        sides: 2,
        rows: 6,
        columns: 4,
        rowNaming: 'letters',
        terminalNaming: 'preserve',
      },
      snapGrid
    )

    // Map canonical slots by slot index (1 to 48) and positionId (e.g. A1, C2)
    const slotByNumber = new Map<number, (typeof slots)[0]>()
    const slotByPosId = new Map<string, (typeof slots)[0]>()
    slots.forEach((s) => {
      slotByNumber.set(s.slotIndex + 1, s)
      slotByPosId.set(s.positionId.toUpperCase(), s)
    })

    const unassignedNodes: typeof studentNodes = []
    const occupiedSlotIndices = new Set<number>()

    // Place each PC directly at its corresponding canonical desk number (PC-N -> Slot N)
    // Missing/deleted PCs naturally leave their canonical slot completely empty!
    studentNodes.forEach((node) => {
      const numMatch = node.label.match(/\d+/)
      const pcNum = numMatch ? parseInt(numMatch[0], 10) : null

      let matchedSlot: (typeof slots)[0] | undefined

      if (pcNum && slotByNumber.has(pcNum) && !occupiedSlotIndices.has(pcNum)) {
        matchedSlot = slotByNumber.get(pcNum)
      } else if (
        node.position_id &&
        slotByPosId.has(String(node.position_id).toUpperCase()) &&
        !occupiedSlotIndices.has(slotByPosId.get(String(node.position_id).toUpperCase())!.slotIndex + 1)
      ) {
        matchedSlot = slotByPosId.get(String(node.position_id).toUpperCase())
      }

      if (matchedSlot) {
        occupiedSlotIndices.add(matchedSlot.slotIndex + 1)
        results.push({
          id: node.id,
          label: node.label,
          pos_x: matchedSlot.pos_x,
          pos_y: matchedSlot.pos_y,
          row_label: matchedSlot.rowLabel,
          position_id: matchedSlot.positionId,
        })
      } else {
        unassignedNodes.push(node)
      }
    })

    // For extra or out-of-range PCs (> 48 or unnumbered, e.g. PC-490):
    // NEVER put them into empty canonical 1..48 slots! They belong in extension positions aligned with columns.
    unassignedNodes.forEach((node, extraIdx) => {
      const extCol = extraIdx % 4
      const extSide = Math.floor(extraIdx / 4) % 2 // 0: left wing, 1: right wing
      const extRowIdx = Math.floor(extraIdx / 8)
      const xStart = extSide === 0 ? 6 : 58
      const xStep = 12
      const extX = snapCoordinate(xStart + extCol * xStep, snapGrid)
      const extY = snapCoordinate(100 + extRowIdx * 12, snapGrid)
      const rowName = `Row ${String.fromCharCode(77 + extRowIdx)} (Extension)`
      const posId = `EXT-${extraIdx + 1}`

      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: node.label,
        pos_x: extX,
        pos_y: extY,
        row_label: rowName,
        position_id: posId,
      })
    })

    return results
  }

  if (preset.startsWith('rows_')) {
    // Dynamic row preset parser: rows_2x8, rows_3x8, rows_4x8, rows_5x10, rows_6x8
    const match = preset.match(/^rows_(\d+)x(\d+)$/)
    const rowCount = match ? parseInt(match[1], 10) : 4
    const itemsPerRow = Math.ceil(N / rowCount)
    const rowYStart = rowCount > 4 ? 26 : 30
    const rowYEnd = rowCount > 4 ? 90 : 86
    const rowYStep = rowCount > 1 ? (rowYEnd - rowYStart) / (rowCount - 1) : 0
    const rowNames = Array.from({ length: rowCount }, (_, i) => `Row ${String.fromCharCode(65 + i)}`)

    studentNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
      const rowIndex = Math.min(rowCount - 1, Math.floor(idx / itemsPerRow))
      const colIndex = idx % itemsPerRow
      const countInThisRow = Math.min(itemsPerRow, N - rowIndex * itemsPerRow)

      const xMargin = rowCount >= 5 ? 8 : 12
      const xSpan = 100 - xMargin * 2
      const xStep = countInThisRow > 1 ? xSpan / (countInThisRow - 1) : 0
      const posX = countInThisRow > 1 ? xMargin + colIndex * xStep : 50
      const posY = rowCount > 1 ? rowYStart + rowIndex * rowYStep : 58

      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: node.label,
        pos_x: snapCoordinate(posX, snapGrid),
        pos_y: snapCoordinate(posY, snapGrid),
        row_label: rowNames[rowIndex] || `Row ${rowIndex + 1}`,
      })
    })
  } else if (preset === 'dual_islands') {
    // Dual Islands: Left Pod and Right Pod with central walking aisle
    const rowCount = Math.max(3, Math.ceil(N / 8))
    const halfCount = Math.ceil(N / 2)
    const rowYStart = 28
    const rowYEnd = 88
    const rowYStep = (rowYEnd - rowYStart) / Math.max(1, rowCount - 1)

    studentNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
      const isLeft = idx < halfCount
      const islandIndex = isLeft ? idx : idx - halfCount
      const islandTotal = isLeft ? halfCount : N - halfCount
      const colsPerIsland = Math.ceil(islandTotal / rowCount)

      const rowIndex = Math.min(rowCount - 1, Math.floor(islandIndex / colsPerIsland))
      const colIndex = islandIndex % colsPerIsland

      const xStart = isLeft ? 8 : 62
      const xEnd = isLeft ? 38 : 92
      const xStep = colsPerIsland > 1 ? (xEnd - xStart) / (colsPerIsland - 1) : 0
      const posX = colsPerIsland > 1 ? xStart + colIndex * xStep : (xStart + xEnd) / 2
      const posY = rowYStart + rowIndex * rowYStep

      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: node.label,
        pos_x: snapCoordinate(posX, snapGrid),
        pos_y: snapCoordinate(posY, snapGrid),
        row_label: `${isLeft ? 'Left Pod' : 'Right Pod'} (Row ${rowIndex + 1})`,
      })
    })
  } else if (preset === 'triple_islands') {
    // Triple Islands: Left, Center, Right pods with 2 walking corridors
    const rowCount = Math.max(3, Math.ceil(N / 12))
    const thirdCount = Math.ceil(N / 3)
    const rowYStart = 28
    const rowYEnd = 88
    const rowYStep = (rowYEnd - rowYStart) / Math.max(1, rowCount - 1)

    studentNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
      const podIndex = Math.min(2, Math.floor(idx / thirdCount))
      const localIdx = idx - podIndex * thirdCount
      const podTotal = podIndex === 2 ? N - 2 * thirdCount : thirdCount
      const colsPerPod = Math.ceil(podTotal / rowCount)

      const rowIndex = Math.min(rowCount - 1, Math.floor(localIdx / colsPerPod))
      const colIndex = localIdx % colsPerPod

      const xSpans = [
        { start: 8, end: 28, name: 'Left Pod' },
        { start: 40, end: 60, name: 'Center Pod' },
        { start: 72, end: 92, name: 'Right Pod' },
      ]
      const { start: xStart, end: xEnd, name: podName } = xSpans[podIndex]
      const xStep = colsPerPod > 1 ? (xEnd - xStart) / (colsPerPod - 1) : 0
      const posX = colsPerPod > 1 ? xStart + colIndex * xStep : (xStart + xEnd) / 2
      const posY = rowYStart + rowIndex * rowYStep

      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: node.label,
        pos_x: snapCoordinate(posX, snapGrid),
        pos_y: snapCoordinate(posY, snapGrid),
        row_label: `${podName} (Row ${rowIndex + 1})`,
      })
    })
  } else if (preset === 'u_perimeter') {
    // U-Shape Perimeter (Left wall, Back wall, Right wall)
    const leftCount = Math.floor(N * 0.35)
    const rightCount = Math.floor(N * 0.35)
    const backCount = N - leftCount - rightCount

    studentNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
      let posX = 50
      let posY = 50
      let rowLabel = 'Perimeter'

      if (idx < leftCount) {
        const step = (86 - 28) / Math.max(1, leftCount - 1)
        posX = 12
        posY = 28 + idx * step
        rowLabel = 'West Wall'
      } else if (idx < leftCount + backCount) {
        const backIdx = idx - leftCount
        const step = (88 - 12) / Math.max(1, backCount + 1)
        posX = 12 + (backIdx + 1) * step
        posY = 88
        rowLabel = 'Rear Wall'
      } else {
        const rightIdx = idx - leftCount - backCount
        const step = (86 - 28) / Math.max(1, rightCount - 1)
        posX = 88
        posY = 86 - rightIdx * step
        rowLabel = 'East Wall'
      }

      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: node.label,
        pos_x: snapCoordinate(posX, snapGrid),
        pos_y: snapCoordinate(posY, snapGrid),
        row_label: rowLabel,
      })
    })
  }

  return results
}

export interface CustomRoomGridConfig {
  sides: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4
  rows: number
  columns: number
  rowNaming: 'letters' | 'numbers'
  terminalNaming: 'alphanumeric' | 'sequential_pc' | 'side_prefix' | 'preserve'
  customRowNames?: Record<number, string>
  positions?: WorkstationPositionUpdate[]
}

export interface LabLayoutTemplate {
  id: string
  lab_id: string
  name: string
  description?: string | null
  config: CustomRoomGridConfig
  created_at?: string
  updated_at?: string
}

export interface CustomRoomGridSlot {
  slotIndex: number
  sideIndex: number // 0 to sides - 1
  rowIndex: number
  globalRowIndex: number
  colIndex: number
  rowLabel: string
  positionId: string // e.g. A1, A2, A3, A4, G1, G2, G3, G4...
  suggestedHardwareLabel: string // e.g. PC-01, PC-02...
  suggestedLabel: string // backwards compatibility or positionId
  pos_x: number
  pos_y: number
}

function getSideLayoutSpec(
  sideIndex: number,
  totalSides: number
): { xStart: number; xEnd: number; sideLabel: string; sidePrefix: string } {
  if (totalSides === 1) {
    return { xStart: 10, xEnd: 90, sideLabel: '', sidePrefix: '' }
  }
  if (totalSides === 2) {
    // 2 Sides (Left & Right Wings) optimized for spacious modular cubicles
    // Left Wing: 6% to 42% (12% step for 4 cols: 6%, 18%, 30%, 42%)
    // Central Walking Aisle: 42% to 58% (16% wide unobstructed corridor aligned with Teacher Podium at 50%)
    // Right Wing: 58% to 94% (12% step for 4 cols: 58%, 70%, 82%, 94%)
    if (sideIndex === 0) return { xStart: 6, xEnd: 42, sideLabel: ' (Left)', sidePrefix: 'L-' }
    return { xStart: 58, xEnd: 94, sideLabel: ' (Right)', sidePrefix: 'R-' }
  }
  if (totalSides === 3) {
    // 3 Sections (Triple Pods: Left, Center, Right) with two 12% wide walking aisles
    // Pod width = 20%, Aisles = 12% (10% even spacing between PCs)
    if (sideIndex === 0) return { xStart: 8, xEnd: 28, sideLabel: ' (Left)', sidePrefix: 'L-' }
    if (sideIndex === 1) return { xStart: 40, xEnd: 60, sideLabel: ' (Center)', sidePrefix: 'C-' }
    return { xStart: 72, xEnd: 92, sideLabel: ' (Right)', sidePrefix: 'R-' }
  }
  // totalSides === 4
  // 4 Island Pods (width 14% each) separated by 3 aisles (10% wide each)
  const spans = [
    { xStart: 7, xEnd: 21, sideLabel: ' (Pod 1)', sidePrefix: 'P1-' },
    { xStart: 31, xEnd: 45, sideLabel: ' (Pod 2)', sidePrefix: 'P2-' },
    { xStart: 55, xEnd: 69, sideLabel: ' (Pod 3)', sidePrefix: 'P3-' },
    { xStart: 79, xEnd: 93, sideLabel: ' (Pod 4)', sidePrefix: 'P4-' },
  ]
  return spans[sideIndex] || spans[0]
}

/**
 * Generates coordinate slots and systematic labels for a custom multi-row, multi-column, 1 to 4 sided room.
 * Each side has its own distinct set of rows (e.g. Left has Rows A..F with cols 1..4, Right has Rows G..L with cols 1..4).
 */
export function generateRoomGridSlots(
  config: CustomRoomGridConfig,
  snapGrid: number = 2
): CustomRoomGridSlot[] {
  const slots: CustomRoomGridSlot[] = []
  const { sides = 2, rows, columns, rowNaming, terminalNaming, customRowNames } = config

  const clampedSides = Math.max(1, Math.min(4, sides))
  const clampedRows = Math.max(1, Math.min(16, rows))
  const clampedCols = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, columns))

  const yStart = 28
  const yEnd = 88
  const yStep = clampedRows > 1 ? (yEnd - yStart) / (clampedRows - 1) : 0

  let sequentialPcIndex = 1

  // Traverse side by side so Left Pod is populated first (PC-01..PC-24, Rows A..F),
  // then Right Pod (PC-25..PC-48, Rows G..L)
  for (let s = 0; s < clampedSides; s++) {
    const { xStart, xEnd, sideLabel, sidePrefix } = getSideLayoutSpec(s, clampedSides)
    const xStep = clampedCols > 1 ? (xEnd - xStart) / (clampedCols - 1) : 0

    for (let r = 0; r < clampedRows; r++) {
      // Global row index across sections ensures each side has completely distinct row letters:
      // Side 0 (Left): r=0..5 -> globalRowIndex=0..5 -> 'A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F'
      // Side 1 (Right): r=0..5 -> globalRowIndex=6..11 -> 'G', 'H', 'I', 'J', 'K', 'L'
      const globalRowIndex = s * clampedRows + r
      const defaultRowChar = String.fromCharCode(65 + (globalRowIndex % 26))
      const baseRowName =
        customRowNames?.[globalRowIndex]?.trim() ||
        (rowNaming === 'letters' ? `Row ${defaultRowChar}` : `Row ${globalRowIndex + 1}`)
      const rowChar = rowNaming === 'letters' ? defaultRowChar : `R${globalRowIndex + 1}`
      const posY = snapCoordinate(clampedRows > 1 ? yStart + r * yStep : 58, snapGrid)

      for (let c = 0; c < clampedCols; c++) {
        const posX = snapCoordinate(
          clampedCols > 1 ? xStart + c * xStep : (xStart + xEnd) / 2,
          snapGrid
        )

        // Terminal place / position ID: strictly 1 to columns (e.g. 1 to 4)!
        // Left side row 0: A1, A2, A3, A4
        // Right side row 0: G1, G2, G3, G4
        const positionId = `${rowChar}${c + 1}`
        const hardwarePcLabel = `PC-${String(sequentialPcIndex).padStart(2, '0')}`

        let displayLabel = ''
        if (terminalNaming === 'alphanumeric') {
          displayLabel = positionId
        } else if (terminalNaming === 'side_prefix') {
          displayLabel = `${sidePrefix}${rowChar}${c + 1}`
        } else if (terminalNaming === 'sequential_pc') {
          displayLabel = hardwarePcLabel
        } else {
          displayLabel = hardwarePcLabel
        }

        slots.push({
          slotIndex: slots.length,
          sideIndex: s,
          rowIndex: r,
          globalRowIndex,
          colIndex: c,
          rowLabel: `${baseRowName}${sideLabel}`,
          positionId,
          suggestedHardwareLabel: hardwarePcLabel,
          suggestedLabel: displayLabel,
          pos_x: posX,
          pos_y: posY,
        })
        sequentialPcIndex++
      }
    }
  }

  return slots
}

/**
 * Calculates workstation placement, positioning, and preserves physical hardware asset names.
 */
export function calculateCustomRoomLayout<
  T extends { id: string; label: string; row_label?: string | null; position_id?: string | null }
>(
  workstations: T[],
  config: CustomRoomGridConfig,
  snapGrid: number = 2,
  applySuggestedLabels: boolean = true
): WorkstationPositionUpdate[] {
  const { teacherNodes, studentNodes } = sortWorkstationsByLabel(workstations)
  const results: WorkstationPositionUpdate[] = []

  // 1. Teacher Podium(s)
  teacherNodes.forEach((node, idx) => {
    const posX = snapCoordinate(50 + (idx - (teacherNodes.length - 1) / 2) * 15, snapGrid)
    const posY = snapCoordinate(12, snapGrid)
    results.push({
      id: node.id,
      label: node.label.toLowerCase().includes('teacher') ? node.label : 'Teacher-01',
      position_id: 'PODIUM',
      pos_x: posX,
      pos_y: posY,
      row_label: 'Teacher Podium',
    })
  })

  // 2. If config.positions contains saved explicit coordinates, respect them directly
  if (config.positions && Array.isArray(config.positions) && config.positions.length > 0) {
    const posById = new Map(config.positions.map((p) => [p.id, p]))
    const posByLabel = new Map(config.positions.map((p) => [p.label, p]))

    studentNodes.forEach((node) => {
      const match = posById.get(node.id) || posByLabel.get(node.label)
      if (match) {
        results.push({
          id: node.id,
          label: match.label || node.label,
          position_id: match.position_id || node.position_id || null,
          pos_x: match.pos_x,
          pos_y: match.pos_y,
          row_label: match.row_label || node.row_label || null,
        })
      }
    })

    if (results.length === workstations.length) {
      return results
    }
  }

  // 3. Generate Grid Slots
  const slots = generateRoomGridSlots(config, snapGrid)

  // Map slots by slot index (1 to N) and positionId (e.g. A1, C2)
  const slotByNumber = new Map<number, (typeof slots)[0]>()
  const slotByPosId = new Map<string, (typeof slots)[0]>()
  slots.forEach((s) => {
    slotByNumber.set(s.slotIndex + 1, s)
    slotByPosId.set(s.positionId.toUpperCase(), s)
  })

  const occupiedSlotIndices = new Set<number>()
  const unassignedNodes: typeof studentNodes = []
  const extensionNodes: typeof studentNodes = []

  // 4. Match student nodes with PC numbers or position_id to slots (preserving gaps!)
  studentNodes.forEach((node) => {
    const numMatch = node.label.match(/\d+/)
    const pcNum = numMatch ? parseInt(numMatch[0], 10) : null

    // If terminal number exceeds configured room slots, treat as extension terminal
    if (pcNum && pcNum > slots.length) {
      extensionNodes.push(node)
      return
    }

    let matchedSlot: (typeof slots)[0] | undefined

    if (config.terminalNaming === 'preserve' || !applySuggestedLabels) {
      if (pcNum && slotByNumber.has(pcNum) && !occupiedSlotIndices.has(pcNum)) {
        matchedSlot = slotByNumber.get(pcNum)
      } else if (
        node.position_id &&
        slotByPosId.has(String(node.position_id).toUpperCase()) &&
        !occupiedSlotIndices.has(slotByPosId.get(String(node.position_id).toUpperCase())!.slotIndex + 1)
      ) {
        matchedSlot = slotByPosId.get(String(node.position_id).toUpperCase())
      }
    }

    if (matchedSlot) {
      occupiedSlotIndices.add(matchedSlot.slotIndex + 1)
      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: node.label,
        position_id: matchedSlot.positionId,
        pos_x: matchedSlot.pos_x,
        pos_y: matchedSlot.pos_y,
        row_label: matchedSlot.rowLabel,
      })
    } else {
      unassignedNodes.push(node)
    }
  })

  // 5. Assign unassigned nodes to remaining available slots
  const availableSlots = slots.filter((s) => !occupiedSlotIndices.has(s.slotIndex + 1))
  let availIdx = 0

  unassignedNodes.forEach((node) => {
    if (availIdx < availableSlots.length) {
      const slot = availableSlots[availIdx++]
      occupiedSlotIndices.add(slot.slotIndex + 1)
      let machineLabel = node.label
      const isCoordinateLabel = /^[A-Z]\d+$/i.test(node.label) || /^[LR]-\w+$/i.test(node.label)
      if (isCoordinateLabel || config.terminalNaming === 'sequential_pc') {
        machineLabel = slot.suggestedHardwareLabel
      } else if (applySuggestedLabels && !node.label.startsWith('PC-')) {
        machineLabel = slot.suggestedHardwareLabel
      }

      results.push({
        id: node.id,
        label: machineLabel,
        position_id: slot.positionId,
        pos_x: slot.pos_x,
        pos_y: slot.pos_y,
        row_label: slot.rowLabel,
      })
    } else {
      extensionNodes.push(node)
    }
  })

  // 6. Out-of-range or extension nodes placed into extension positions
  extensionNodes.forEach((node, extraIdx) => {
    const extCol = extraIdx % 4
    const extSide = Math.floor(extraIdx / 4) % 2
    const extRowIdx = Math.floor(extraIdx / 8)
    const xStart = extSide === 0 ? 6 : 58
    const xStep = 12
    const extX = snapCoordinate(xStart + extCol * xStep, snapGrid)
    const extY = snapCoordinate(100 + extRowIdx * 12, snapGrid)
    const rowName = `Row ${String.fromCharCode(77 + extRowIdx)} (Extension)`
    const posId = `EXT-${extraIdx + 1}`

    results.push({
      id: node.id,
      label: node.label,
      pos_x: extX,
      pos_y: extY,
      row_label: rowName,
      position_id: posId,
    })
  })

  return results
}

export interface LabDeskRowStructure {
  id: string
  sideIndex: number
  rowIndex: number
  globalRowIndex: number
  rowName: string
  sideName: string
  xStart: number
  xEnd: number
  y: number
  width: number
}

export interface LabDeskFloorStructure {
  sidesCount: number
  rows: LabDeskRowStructure[]
  wings: Array<{
    sideIndex: number
    title: string
    subtitle: string
    xStart: number
    xEnd: number
  }>
  centralAisle?: {
    xStart: number
    xEnd: number
    xCenter: number
  } | null
}

/**
 * Computes realistic architectural desk table surfaces and wing layouts for top-view rendering.
 */
export function getLabDeskFloorStructure(
  config?: CustomRoomGridConfig
): LabDeskFloorStructure {
  const sides = config?.sides || 2
  const rows = Math.max(1, Math.min(16, config?.rows || 6))
  const cols = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, config?.columns || 4))

  const yStart = 28
  const yEnd = 88
  const yStep = rows > 1 ? (yEnd - yStart) / (rows - 1) : 0

  const rowStructures: LabDeskRowStructure[] = []
  const wings: LabDeskFloorStructure['wings'] = []

  for (let s = 0; s < sides; s++) {
    const { xStart, xEnd } = getSideLayoutSpec(s, sides)
    // Add margin around workstations so desk looks like a real physical table surface
    const deskXStart = Math.max(2, xStart - 3.5)
    const deskXEnd = Math.min(98, xEnd + 3.5)
    const deskWidth = deskXEnd - deskXStart

    const sideName =
      sides === 2
        ? s === 0 ? 'Left Pod • Wing A' : 'Right Pod • Wing B'
        : sides === 3
        ? s === 0 ? 'Left Pod' : s === 1 ? 'Center Pod' : 'Right Pod'
        : sides === 4
        ? `Pod ${s + 1}`
        : 'Main Hall'

    const startLetter = String.fromCharCode(65 + ((s * rows) % 26))
    const endLetter = String.fromCharCode(65 + ((s * rows + rows - 1) % 26))

    wings.push({
      sideIndex: s,
      title: sideName.toUpperCase(),
      subtitle: `Rows ${startLetter}–${endLetter} (${rows * cols} PCs)`,
      xStart: deskXStart,
      xEnd: deskXEnd,
    })

    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      const globalRowIndex = s * rows + r
      const defaultRowChar = String.fromCharCode(65 + (globalRowIndex % 26))
      const rowName =
        config?.customRowNames?.[globalRowIndex]?.trim() ||
        (config?.rowNaming === 'numbers' ? `Row ${globalRowIndex + 1}` : `Row ${defaultRowChar}`)
      const posY = rows > 1 ? yStart + r * yStep : 58

      rowStructures.push({
        id: `desk_s${s}_r${r}`,
        sideIndex: s,
        rowIndex: r,
        globalRowIndex,
        rowName,
        sideName,
        xStart: deskXStart,
        xEnd: deskXEnd,
        y: posY,
        width: deskWidth,
      })
    }
  }

  const centralAisle =
    sides === 2
      ? {
          xStart: 45.5,
          xEnd: 54.5,
          xCenter: 50,
        }
      : null

  return {
    sidesCount: sides,
    rows: rowStructures,
    wings,
    centralAisle,
  }
}

export interface Database {
  public: {
    Tables: {
      profiles: {
        Row: {
          id: string
          email: string | null
          phone: string | null
          full_name: string
          role: 'super_admin' | 'lab_incharge' | 'hod' | 'teacher' | 'admin'
          department: string | null

          avatar_url?: string | null
          honorific?: string | null

          teaching_preferences?: Record<string, any> | null
          is_active: boolean
          approval_status?: 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'suspended' | null
          permissions: Record<string, boolean> | null
          created_at: string
        }
        Insert: {
          id: string
          email?: string | null
          phone?: string | null
          full_name: string
          role?: 'super_admin' | 'lab_incharge' | 'hod' | 'teacher' | 'admin'
          department?: string | null
          photo_url?: string | null
          avatar_url?: string | null
          honorific?: string | null
          bio?: string | null
          teaching_preferences?: Record<string, any> | null
          is_active?: boolean

          permissions?: Record<string, boolean> | null

/**
 * Unified Record Report Specification Architecture
 * Single source of truth for UI Tables, Print Registers, XLSX Workbooks, and CSV Exports.
 */

export type DataClassification = 'structured' | 'narrative' | 'metric' | 'badge'
export type TextAlignment = 'left' | 'center' | 'right'
export type PrintDensityMode = 'detailed' | 'compact'

export interface ColumnSpec<T> {
  id: string
  key: keyof T | string
  label: string
  classification: DataClassification
  align: TextAlignment

  // Content length expectations
  typicalLength: number
  maxLength: number

  // Database mapping & Sorting metadata
  sortable?: boolean
  dbColumn?: string
  foreignTable?: string

  // Column-level filter configuration
  filterType?: 'text' | 'select' | 'none'
  filterOptions?: Array<{ label: string; value: string }>

  // Surface 1: Interactive On-Screen UI Table
  ui: {
    widthClass: string
    truncateChars?: number
  }

  // Surface 2: Certified Print Register
  print: {
    detailed: {
      widthPercent: number
      maxChars: number
    }
    compact: {
      widthPercent: number
      maxChars: number
    }
  }

  // Surfaces 3 & 4: Spreadsheet Exports
  export: {
    xlsxWidth: number
    csvHeader: string
    alwaysFullText: true
  }

  // Canonical Formatter & Accessor
  accessor: (record: T) => {
    raw: any
    displayText: string
    subText?: string | null
    footnoteText?: string | null
  }
}

export interface RecordReportSpec<T> {
  reportId: 'practical_logs' | 'lab_incidents' | 'maintenance_logs'
  title: string
  subtitle: string
  badgeCode: string
  columns: ColumnSpec<T>[]
}

/**
 * Unified Filter Interface consumed across UI, Print, and Exports
 */
export interface UnifiedReportFilters {
  // Coarse scope filters
  academic_year_id?: string
  lab_id?: string
  date_from?: string
  date_to?: string
  date?: string
  status?: string
  search?: string

  // Server-side Pagination
  page?: number
  pageSize?: number

  // Server-side Sorting
  sortKey?: string
  sortDirection?: 'asc' | 'desc'

  // Practical-specific
  batch_group?: string
  subject_name?: string
  teacher_id?: string
  teacher_name?: string
  period_label?: string
  remarks?: string
  groupBy?: string

  // Incident-specific
  severity?: string
  incident_type?: string
  equipment_name?: string
  title?: string

  // Maintenance-specific
  asset_identifier?: string
  plan_category?: string
  technician_id?: string
  maintenance_status?: string

  // Print density preference
  density?: PrintDensityMode

  // WYSIWYG selection and column projection
  cols?: string
  selected?: string
  selKey?: string
  selectedAll?: boolean
}

/**
 * Footnote entry for printed audit register annex
 */
export interface FootnoteEntry {
  index: number
  rowIdentifier: string
  fieldName: string
  fullText: string
}

-- ==============================================================================
-- Migration: Harden Maintenance Engine Row Level Security (RLS)
-- Date: 2026-09-20
-- Description: Replaces legacy role check role in ('super_admin', 'coordinator', 'lab_incharge', 'admin')
--              with public.is_privileged() so super_admin, lab_incharge, hod, and admin
--              share proper authorization to manage maintenance plans, reminders, and logs.
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. Drop existing legacy policies on maintenance_plans
drop policy if exists "Manage Plans" on public.maintenance_plans;
drop policy if exists "Read Maintenance Plans" on public.maintenance_plans;

-- 2. Re-create maintenance_plans policies
create policy "Read Maintenance Plans" 
  on public.maintenance_plans 
  for select

FILE: supabase\migrations\20260921_harden_email_tables_rls.sql
================================================================================
-- ==============================================================================
-- Migration: Harden Email OTPs & Email Dispatch Logs Row Level Security (RLS)
-- Date: 2026-09-21
-- Description: Remediates Supabase Advisor CRITICAL findings on public.email_otps
--              and public.email_dispatch_logs by enabling RLS, revoking unnecessary
--              client grants, and establishing strict deny-all / privileged-only policies.
-- ==============================================================================

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Table: public.email_otps
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Rationale:
-- - All OTP generation (signup & password reset) and verification occurs strictly
--   server-side via direct trusted PostgreSQL connections (lib/db.ts) in app/actions/otp.ts.
-- - Neither anon nor authenticated clients have any legitimate need to read or write
--   this table directly via PostgREST / Supabase JS client.
-- - Enabling RLS with ZERO client policies enforces default deny-all on the PostgREST API,
--   completely preventing client-side enumeration, leakage, or tampering of verification codes.
-- - Superuser server actions (lib/db.ts) bypass RLS and continue functioning unhindered.

ALTER TABLE public.email_otps ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Revoke all table privileges from anon and authenticated roles
REVOKE ALL ON public.email_otps FROM anon, authenticated;

-- Ensure any legacy policies are dropped (zero policies = deny-all for client roles)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Deny all client access to email_otps" ON public.email_otps;


-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Table: public.email_dispatch_logs
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Rationale:
-- - Write operations (recording dispatched daily summary notifications and anti-spam idempotency)
--   occur strictly server-side via trusted PostgreSQL connections (lib/db.ts) in app/actions/notifications.ts.
-- - No client role (anon or authenticated) should ever insert, update, delete, or truncate dispatch logs.
-- - Read access for auditing delivery events in the Admin Console is restricted exclusively to
--   authenticated staff holding privileged roles (super_admin, lab_incharge, hod) via public.is_privileged().

ALTER TABLE public.email_dispatch_logs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Revoke all table privileges from anon and authenticated roles
REVOKE ALL ON public.email_dispatch_logs FROM anon, authenticated;

-- Grant selective read-only permission to authenticated users (subject to RLS policy below)
GRANT SELECT ON public.email_dispatch_logs TO authenticated;

-- Policy: Only privileged institutional staff can view email dispatch logs
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow privileged view email_dispatch_logs" ON public.email_dispatch_logs;
CREATE POLICY "Allow privileged view email_dispatch_logs"
  ON public.email_dispatch_logs
  FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING (public.is_privileged());

-- Migration: Create public.lab_layout_templates for saving named custom room grid layouts
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.lab_layout_templates (
  id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  lab_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.labs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name text NOT NULL,
  description text,
  config jsonb NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT uq_lab_layout_template_name UNIQUE (lab_id, name)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lab_layout_templates_lab_id ON public.lab_layout_templates (lab_id);

-- RLS: Allow authenticated users to view layout templates; lab_incharge / super_admin to insert/update/delete
ALTER TABLE public.lab_layout_templates ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

DO $$ BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies WHERE tablename = 'lab_layout_templates' AND policyname = 'Allow read for all authenticated users'
  ) THEN
    CREATE POLICY "Allow read for all authenticated users"
      ON public.lab_layout_templates
      FOR SELECT
      TO authenticated
      USING (true);
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies WHERE tablename = 'lab_layout_templates' AND policyname = 'Allow write for privileged users'
  ) THEN
    CREATE POLICY "Allow write for privileged users"
      ON public.lab_layout_templates
      FOR ALL
      TO authenticated
      USING (
        EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
          WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid()
          AND profiles.role IN ('super_admin', 'lab_incharge', 'hod')
        )
      );
  END IF;
END $$;

-- Migration: Harden RLS policies on labs, schedules, and student PII
-- Restricts write operations to authenticated staff and protects student biographical records.

-- 1. Hardening `labs`
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow insert/update labs" ON public.labs;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage labs privileged" ON public.labs;

CREATE POLICY "Allow manage labs privileged"
  ON public.labs
  FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (public.is_privileged())
  WITH CHECK (public.is_privileged());

-- 2. Hardening `schedules`
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage schedules" ON public.schedules;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage schedules authenticated" ON public.schedules;

CREATE POLICY "Allow manage schedules authenticated"
  ON public.schedules
  FOR ALL
  TO authenticated
  USING (public.is_privileged() OR public.current_role() = 'teacher')
  WITH CHECK (public.is_privileged() OR public.current_role() = 'teacher');

-- 3. Hardening `students` (Shield PII from anonymous scrapers)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "read_students_scoped" ON public.students;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "read_students_authenticated" ON public.students;

CREATE POLICY "read_students_authenticated"
  ON public.students
  FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING (true);

-- 4. Hardening `student_enrollments` (Shield cohort rosters from anonymous scrapers)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "read_student_enrollments_scoped" ON public.student_enrollments;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "read_student_enrollments_authenticated" ON public.student_enrollments;

CREATE POLICY "read_student_enrollments_authenticated"
  ON public.student_enrollments
  FOR SELECT
  TO authenticated
  USING (true);

FILE: scripts\apply-migration-stage1.mjs
================================================================================
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function run() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('🚀 Applying Phase 4.5 Stage 1 DDL Migration...')
    const sqlPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'scripts/migration-phase4-5-stage1-add-columns.sql')
    const sql = fs.readFileSync(sqlPath, 'utf8')

    await client.query(sql)
    console.log('✅ Stage 1 DDL executed successfully!')

    // Verification of added columns and constraints
    console.log('🔍 Verifying schema changes...')
    const cols = await client.query(`
      SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type, is_nullable
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public'
        AND (
          (table_name = 'class_subjects' AND column_name = 'academic_year_id') OR
          (table_name = 'schedules' AND column_name = 'class_subject_id') OR
          (table_name = 'practical_logs' AND column_name = 'class_subject_id') OR
          (table_name = 'log_attendance' AND column_name = 'enrollment_id') OR
          (table_name = 'lab_incidents' AND column_name IN ('class_id', 'subject_id', 'subject_teacher_id'))
        )
      ORDER BY table_name, column_name;
    `)
    console.log('Verified Columns:', JSON.stringify(cols.rows, null, 2))

    const constraints = await client.query(`
      SELECT tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name, tc.constraint_type
      FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
      WHERE tc.table_schema = 'public'
        AND tc.constraint_name IN (
          'uq_class_subject_teaching_assignment',
          'uq_student_enrollments_id_student',
          'fk_log_attendance_enrollment_student',
          'fk_practical_logs_schedule'
        )
      ORDER BY tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name;
    `)
    console.log('Verified Constraints:', JSON.stringify(constraints.rows, null, 2))

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('❌ Stage 1 Migration Failed:', err)
    process.exit(1)
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

run()

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

if (!dbUrl) {
  console.error('❌ DATABASE_URL not found in .env.local')
  process.exit(1)
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function runStage2Migration() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('🛡️ STEP 10 PRE-FLIGHT: Checking Stop-Gates before Stage 2 enforcement...')

    // 1. Check Step 06 Gates
    const gateRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT 
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.schedules WHERE class_subject_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_schedules,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.practical_logs WHERE class_subject_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_logs,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.class_subjects WHERE academic_year_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_assignments,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.log_attendance WHERE enrollment_id IS NULL OR student_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_attendance;
    `)
    const gate = gateRes.rows[0]
    console.log(`Gate metrics:
  - unlinked_schedules: ${gate.unlinked_schedules}
  - unlinked_logs: ${gate.unlinked_logs}
  - unlinked_assignments: ${gate.unlinked_assignments}
  - unlinked_attendance: ${gate.unlinked_attendance}`)

    if (
      parseInt(gate.unlinked_schedules, 10) > 0 ||
      parseInt(gate.unlinked_logs, 10) > 0 ||
      parseInt(gate.unlinked_assignments, 10) > 0 ||
      parseInt(gate.unlinked_attendance, 10) > 0
    ) {
      console.error('❌ STOP-GATE TRIGGERED: Unlinked rows detected. Aborting Stage 2 migration.')
      process.exit(1)
    }

    console.log('✅ ALL PRE-FLIGHT STOP-GATES PASSED. Applying Stage 2 DDL Migration...')

    const sqlPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'scripts/migration-phase4-5-stage2-enforce-integrity.sql')
    const sql = fs.readFileSync(sqlPath, 'utf8')

    await client.query(sql)

    console.log('✅ STAGE 2 DDL APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!')

    // Verify NOT NULL status
    const verifyRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT 
        table_name, column_name, is_nullable
      FROM information_schema.columns
      WHERE table_schema = 'public'
        AND (
          (table_name = 'class_subjects' AND column_name = 'academic_year_id') OR
          (table_name = 'schedules' AND column_name = 'class_subject_id') OR
          (table_name = 'practical_logs' AND column_name = 'class_subject_id') OR
          (table_name = 'log_attendance' AND column_name IN ('enrollment_id', 'student_id'))
        )
      ORDER BY table_name, column_name;
    `)

    console.log('📋 Verified column nullability status:')
    for (const r of verifyRes.rows) {
      console.log(`  - ${r.table_name}.${r.column_name}: is_nullable = ${r.is_nullable}`)
      if (r.is_nullable !== 'NO') {
        throw new Error(`Column ${r.table_name}.${r.column_name} is still nullable!`)
      }
    }

    console.log('🎉 ALL NOT NULL INVARIANTS CONFIRMED!')
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('❌ Stage 2 migration failed:', err)
    process.exit(1)
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

runStage2Migration()

FILE: scripts\audit-attendance-classification.mjs
================================================================================
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function runAudit() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('🔍 STEP 09: Running Attendance Classification Audit...')

    const query = `
      SELECT 
        la.id,
        la.log_id,
        la.student_id,
        la.roll_number,
        la.enrollment_id,
        pl.date AS session_date,
        pl.batch_group,
        pl.class_subject_id
      FROM public.log_attendance la
      LEFT JOIN public.practical_logs pl ON pl.id = la.log_id;
    `
    const res = await client.query(query)
    const rows = res.rows

    console.log(`📊 Found ${rows.length} rows in public.log_attendance.`)

    const activeEnrollmentsRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT se.id as enrollment_id, se.student_id, se.academic_year_id, se.class_id, se.roll_number
      FROM public.student_enrollments se
      WHERE se.status = 'active';
    `)
    const enrollments = activeEnrollmentsRes.rows

    const classified = {
      valid: [],
      recoverable: [],
      legacySynthetic: [],
      orphaned: [],
    }

    for (const row of rows) {
      if (row.enrollment_id && row.student_id) {
        // Check if student_id matches enrollment
        const match = enrollments.find(e => e.enrollment_id === row.enrollment_id && e.student_id === row.student_id)
        if (match) {
          classified.valid.push(row)
        } else {
          classified.orphaned.push({ ...row, reason: 'enrollment_id and student_id mismatch' })
        }
      } else if (!row.log_id) {
        classified.orphaned.push({ ...row, reason: 'missing log_id' })
      } else if (row.roll_number) {
        // Try to match active enrollment
        // If row has student_id or roll_number matching practical_logs cohort
        const matches = enrollments.filter(e => e.roll_number === row.roll_number)
        if (matches.length === 1) {
          classified.recoverable.push({ ...row, matchedEnrollment: matches[0] })
        } else if (matches.length === 0 && !row.student_id) {
          classified.legacySynthetic.push(row)
        } else {
          classified.orphaned.push({ ...row, reason: `ambiguous roll_number match count: ${matches.length}` })
        }
      } else {
        classified.legacySynthetic.push(row)
      }
    }

    const report = {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      totalRows: rows.length,
      counts: {
        valid: classified.valid.length,
        recoverable: classified.recoverable.length,
        legacySynthetic: classified.legacySynthetic.length,
        orphaned: classified.orphaned.length,
      },
      details: classified,
    }

    const outPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'scratch/attendance-classification-report.json')
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outPath), { recursive: true })
    fs.writeFileSync(outPath, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2))
    console.log(`📝 Classification report saved to ${outPath}`)
    console.log(`Results summary: Valid: ${report.counts.valid}, Recoverable: ${report.counts.recoverable}, Legacy-Synthetic: ${report.counts.legacySynthetic}, Orphaned: ${report.counts.orphaned}`)

    return report
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

runAudit().catch(err => {
  console.error('Audit failed:', err)
  process.exit(1)
})

FILE: scripts\audit_db.mjs
================================================================================
import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';

let dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
if (!dbUrl) {
  try {
    const env = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf8');
    for (const line of env.split('\n')) {
      const [k, ...v] = line.split('=');
      if (k && k.trim() === 'DATABASE_URL') dbUrl = v.join('=').trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
    }
  } catch {}
}

const client = new pg.Client({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function run() {
  await client.connect();

  const tables = await client.query("SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name");

  const profiles = await client.query("SELECT id, full_name, email, role, department, permissions FROM profiles ORDER BY full_name");

  const labs = await client.query("SELECT id, name, type, capacity, is_active FROM labs ORDER BY id");

  const schedules = await client.query("SELECT id, lab_id, teacher_id, subject_name, batch_name, slot_id, day_key, start_time, end_time, status, metadata FROM schedules ORDER BY lab_id, day_key, slot_id");

  const schedulesByTeacher = await client.query(`
    SELECT s.teacher_id, p.full_name, p.role, count(*) as session_count,
           array_agg(DISTINCT s.subject_name) as subjects,
           array_agg(DISTINCT s.batch_name) as batches,
           array_agg(DISTINCT s.lab_id) as labs
    FROM schedules s
    LEFT JOIN profiles p ON s.teacher_id = p.id
    GROUP BY s.teacher_id, p.full_name, p.role
  `);

  const practicalLogs = await client.query("SELECT id, lab_id, teacher_id, date, period_label, subject_name, batch_group, practical_title, total_students, present_students, absent_students, topic_learned, status FROM practical_logs ORDER BY date DESC");

  const incidents = await client.query("SELECT id, lab_id, subject_name, subject_teacher_name, batch_name, title, status, severity, reported_by, reported_by_id, resolved_by_id FROM lab_incidents");

  const dump = {
    tables: tables.rows.map(r => r.table_name),
    profiles: profiles.rows,
    labs: labs.rows,
    schedulesCount: schedules.rows.length,
    teacherAssignments: schedulesByTeacher.rows,
    sampleSchedules: schedules.rows.slice(0, 15),
    practicalLogs: practicalLogs.rows,
    incidents: incidents.rows,
  };

  fs.writeFileSync('scratch_db_dump.json', JSON.stringify(dump, null, 2));
  console.log('Successfully wrote scratch_db_dump.json');

  await client.end();
}

run().catch(console.error);


================================================================================
FILE: scripts\backfill-canonical-classes-subjects.mjs
================================================================================
/**
 * Idempotent SQL migration & backfill script for canonical classes and clean subjects.
 *
 * Runs against PostgreSQL to:
 * 1. Normalize legacy batch/class names in practical_logs and lab_incidents to canonical Admin Panel classes.
 * 2. Strip repeating/stuttered subject code prefixes (e.g. "COMP-12 - COMP-12 — ..." -> "COMP-12 — ...").
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node scripts/backfill-canonical-classes-subjects.mjs [--dry-run]
 */

import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';

let dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
if (!dbUrl) {
  try {
    const env = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf8');
    for (const line of env.split('\n')) {
      const [k, ...v] = line.split('=');
      if (k && k.trim() === 'DATABASE_URL') dbUrl = v.join('=').trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
    }
  } catch {}
}

const isDryRun = process.argv.includes('--dry-run') || !dbUrl;

console.log(`[Migration] Mode: ${isDryRun ? 'DRY RUN (preview only)' : 'LIVE EXECUTION'}`);

const CLASS_NORMALIZATION_RULES = [
  {
    target: '12 Eng',
    patterns: [
      '12C - Tech Stream Sec A',
      '12C - Tech Stream',
      '12C',
      'Class 12',
      '12-Eng',
      '12C-A',
    ],
  },
  {
    target: '11 Eng',
    patterns: [
      '11 Sc - Science Stream Sec B',
      '11 Sc - Science Sec B',
      '11 Sc',
      'Class 11',
      '11-Eng',
      '11Sc-B',
      '11Sc',
    ],
  },
  {
    target: '12 Mgt',
    patterns: [
      '12 Mgt - Mgmt Stream Sec A',
      '12-Mgt',
    ],
  },
  {
    target: '11 Mgt',
    patterns: [
      '11C - Computer Tech Sec A',
      '11C',
      '11-Mgt',
    ],
  },
];

async function run() {
  if (isDryRun && !dbUrl) {
    console.log('[Migration] No DATABASE_URL found or --dry-run specified. Printing generated SQL statements:\n');
  }

  const sqlStatements = [];

  // 1. Practical Logs Class Normalization
  for (const rule of CLASS_NORMALIZATION_RULES) {
    const inList = rule.patterns.map((p) => `'${p.replace(/'/g, "''")}'`).join(', ');
    sqlStatements.push({
      desc: `Normalize practical_logs.batch_group to '${rule.target}'`,
      sql: `UPDATE practical_logs SET batch_group = '${rule.target}' WHERE batch_group IN (${inList});`,
    });
  }

  // 2. Lab Incidents Class Normalization
  for (const rule of CLASS_NORMALIZATION_RULES) {
    const inList = rule.patterns.map((p) => `'${p.replace(/'/g, "''")}'`).join(', ');
    sqlStatements.push({
      desc: `Normalize lab_incidents.batch_name to '${rule.target}'`,
      sql: `UPDATE lab_incidents SET batch_name = '${rule.target}' WHERE batch_name IN (${inList});`,
    });
  }

  // 3. Stuttered Subject Cleaning
  sqlStatements.push({
    desc: `Clean duplicate code prefixes in practical_logs.subject_name`,
    sql: `UPDATE practical_logs 
          SET subject_name = regexp_replace(subject_name, '^([A-Z0-9-]+)\\s*[-–—]\\s*\\1\\s*[-–—]\\s*', '\\1 — ', 'i')
          WHERE subject_name ~* '^([A-Z0-9-]+)\\s*[-–—]\\s*\\1\\s*[-–—]';`,
  });

  sqlStatements.push({
    desc: `Clean duplicate code prefixes in lab_incidents.subject_name`,
    sql: `UPDATE lab_incidents 
          SET subject_name = regexp_replace(subject_name, '^([A-Z0-9-]+)\\s*[-–—]\\s*\\1\\s*[-–—]\\s*', '\\1 — ', 'i')
          WHERE subject_name ~* '^([A-Z0-9-]+)\\s*[-–—]\\s*\\1\\s*[-–—]';`,
  });

  sqlStatements.push({
    desc: `Clean duplicate code prefixes in schedules.subject_name`,
    sql: `UPDATE schedules 
          SET subject_name = regexp_replace(subject_name, '^([A-Z0-9-]+)\\s*[-–—]\\s*\\1\\s*[-–—]\\s*', '\\1 — ', 'i')
          WHERE subject_name ~* '^([A-Z0-9-]+)\\s*[-–—]\\s*\\1\\s*[-–—]';`,
  });

  if (isDryRun && !process.argv.includes('--execute')) {
    for (const stmt of sqlStatements) {
      console.log(`-- ${stmt.desc}`);
      console.log(`${stmt.sql}\n`);
    }
    console.log('[Migration] Dry run completed successfully.');
    return;
  }

  const client = new pg.Client({
    connectionString: dbUrl,
    ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
  });

  try {
    await client.connect();
    console.log('[Migration] Connected to PostgreSQL. Applying updates...');

    for (const stmt of sqlStatements) {
      console.log(`[Executing] ${stmt.desc}...`);
      const res = await client.query(stmt.sql);
      console.log(`  -> Affected rows: ${res.rowCount || 0}`);
    }

    console.log('[Migration] All updates completed successfully.');
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Migration] Failed:', err);
    process.exit(1);
  } finally {
    await client.end();
  }
}

run();

function analyzePdf(pdfPath, totalRows, label) {
  const pdf = fs.readFileSync(pdfPath, 'utf8');
  const mediaBoxes = [...pdf.matchAll(/\/MediaBox\s*\[\s*([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s*\]/g)];
  const pageCount = mediaBoxes.length;
  const isLandscape = mediaBoxes.length > 0 && (parseFloat(mediaBoxes[0][3]) - parseFloat(mediaBoxes[0][1])) > (parseFloat(mediaBoxes[0][4]) - parseFloat(mediaBoxes[0][2]));
  const rowsPerPage = (totalRows / pageCount).toFixed(1);
  console.log(`[${label}] Total Rows: ${totalRows} | Total Pages: ${pageCount} | Rows/Page: ${rowsPerPage} | Orientation: ${isLandscape ? 'A4 LANDSCAPE' : 'PORTRAIT'}`);
  return { pageCount, rowsPerPage, isLandscape };
}

// Helper to count pages and calculate rows per page
function analyzePdf(pdfPath, totalRows, label) {
  const pdf = fs.readFileSync(pdfPath, 'utf8');
  const mediaBoxes = [...pdf.matchAll(/\/MediaBox\s*\[\s*([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s*\]/g)];
  const pageCount = mediaBoxes.length;
  const isLandscape = mediaBoxes.length > 0 && (parseFloat(mediaBoxes[0][3]) - parseFloat(mediaBoxes[0][1])) > (parseFloat(mediaBoxes[0][4]) - parseFloat(mediaBoxes[0][2]));
  const rowsPerPage = (totalRows / pageCount).toFixed(1);
  console.log(`[${label}] Total Rows: ${totalRows} | Total Pages: ${pageCount} | Rows/Page: ${rowsPerPage} | Orientation: ${isLandscape ? 'A4 LANDSCAPE' : 'PORTRAIT'}`);
  return { pageCount, rowsPerPage, isLandscape };
}

================================================================================
FILE: scripts\check-audit-fks.mjs
================================================================================
import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';

const env = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf-8');
let dbUrl = '';
for (const line of env.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.substring('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
  }
}

const { Pool } = pg;
const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function main() {
  try {
    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT tc.table_name, kcu.column_name, ccu.table_name AS foreign_table, tc.constraint_name
      FROM information_schema.table_constraints AS tc
      JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage AS kcu ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
      JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage AS ccu ON ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name
      WHERE tc.table_name = 'audit_logs';
    `);
    console.log('Constraints on audit_logs:', res.rows);
  } finally {
    await pool.end();
  }
}

main();


================================================================================
FILE: scripts\check-enrollment-counts.mjs
================================================================================
import pg from 'pg'
import fs from 'fs'

const env = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf8')
const dbUrl = env.split('\n').find(l => l.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')).split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
const client = new pg.Client({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
await client.connect()

const res = await client.query(`
  SELECT cs.id as cs_id, cs.class_id, cs.subject_id, cs.academic_year_id, count(se.id) as enrollment_count
  FROM class_subjects cs
  LEFT JOIN student_enrollments se ON se.class_id = cs.class_id AND se.academic_year_id = cs.academic_year_id AND se.status = 'active'
  GROUP BY cs.id, cs.class_id, cs.subject_id, cs.academic_year_id
  ORDER BY enrollment_count DESC;
`)
console.table(res.rows.slice(0, 10))
await client.end()


================================================================================
FILE: scripts\check-not-null-fks.mjs
================================================================================
import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';

const env = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf-8');
let dbUrl = '';
for (const line of env.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.substring('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
  }
}

const { Pool } = pg;
const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function main() {
  try {
    const query = `
      SELECT 
        c.table_name, 
        c.column_name, 
        c.is_nullable, 
        rc.delete_rule,
        tc.constraint_name
      FROM information_schema.columns c
      JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu 
        ON c.table_name = kcu.table_name AND c.column_name = kcu.column_name AND c.table_schema = kcu.table_schema
      JOIN information_schema.referential_constraints rc 
        ON kcu.constraint_name = rc.constraint_name
      JOIN information_schema.table_constraints tc 
        ON tc.constraint_name = rc.constraint_name
      WHERE rc.delete_rule = 'SET NULL' AND c.is_nullable = 'NO';
    `;
    const res = await pool.query(query);
    console.log('Columns with SET NULL that are NOT NULL:');
    console.table(res.rows);
  } finally {
    await pool.end();
  }
}

main();

import pg from 'pg'

import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

function loadEnv() {
  for (const file of ['.env.local', '.env']) {
    const fullPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), file);
    if (fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
      for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
        const trimmed = line.trim();
        if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
          const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
          const key = trimmed.substring(0, idx).trim();
          const val = trimmed.substring(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
          if (!process.env[key]) {
            process.env[key] = val;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

loadEnv();

const client = new pg.Client({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function run() {
  await client.connect();

  const cols = await client.query(`
    SELECT column_name, column_default, is_nullable, data_type
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'profiles'
    ORDER BY ordinal_position;
  `);
  console.log('--- PROFILES COLUMNS ---');
  console.table(cols.rows);

  const trig = await client.query(`
    SELECT proname, prosrc FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'handle_new_user';
  `);
  console.log('\n--- HANDLE NEW USER TRIGGER CODE ---');
  console.log(trig.rows[0]?.prosrc);

  const notifCols = await client.query(`
    SELECT column_name, column_default, is_nullable, data_type
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'lab_notifications'
    ORDER BY ordinal_position;
  `);
  console.log('\n--- LAB NOTIFICATIONS COLUMNS ---');
  console.table(notifCols.rows);

  await client.end();
}

run().catch(console.error);

import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';

const env = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf-8');
let dbUrl = '';
for (const line of env.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.substring('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
  }
}

if (dbUrl.includes('db.') && dbUrl.includes('.supabase.co')) {
  const match = dbUrl.match(/postgresql:\/\/([^:]+):(.+)@db\.([a-z0-9]+)\.supabase\.co(?::\d+)?\/(.+)$/)
  if (match) {
    const [, , pass, ref, db] = match
    dbUrl = `postgresql://postgres.${ref}:${encodeURIComponent(pass)}@aws-0-ap-southeast-1.pooler.supabase.com:5432/${db}`
  }
}

const { Pool } = pg;
const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function main() {
  try {
    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT table_name 
      FROM information_schema.tables 
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
      ORDER BY table_name;
    `);
    console.log('--- TABLES IN PUBLIC ---', res.rows.map(r => r.table_name));

    const checkAudit = await pool.query(`
      SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT FROM information_schema.tables 
        WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
        AND table_name = 'audit_logs'
      );
    `);
    console.log('--- AUDIT_LOGS EXISTS? ---', checkAudit.rows[0].exists);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
  } finally {
    await pool.end();
  }
}

main();

FILE: scripts\clean-slate-and-foreign-keys.mjs
