FILE: scripts\migrate-production-hardening-phase1-2.mjs
================================================================================
import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';

// Load connection string from .env.local
const envContent = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf-8');
let dbUrl = '';
for (const line of envContent.split('\n')) {
  if (line.trim().startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.trim().substring('DATABASE_URL='.length).replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
  }
}

if (!dbUrl) {
  console.error('FATAL: DATABASE_URL not found in .env.local');
  process.exit(1);
}

// Convert port 5432 session pooler to 6543 transaction pooler if needed
if (dbUrl.includes('.pooler.supabase.com:5432')) {
  dbUrl = dbUrl.replace('.pooler.supabase.com:5432', '.pooler.supabase.com:6543');
}

const { Pool } = pg;
const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function runMigration() {
  console.log('================================================================');
  console.log('LabSync LIMS — Production Hardening Migration (Phase 1 & Phase 2)');
  console.log('================================================================');

  const client = await pool.connect();
  try {
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // 1. PHASE 1: SECURITY HARDENING
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n[Phase 1.1] Hardening public.profiles against self-role escalation...');
    await client.query(`
      REVOKE UPDATE (role, approval_status, permissions, is_active) ON public.profiles FROM authenticated;
    `);

    await client.query(`
      CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_profile_escalation()
      RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
      BEGIN
        IF (OLD.role IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.role OR OLD.approval_status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.approval_status) THEN
          IF NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles 
            WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'super_admin' AND is_active = true
          ) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access Denied: Only Super Administrators can alter user roles or approval statuses.';
          END IF;
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
      END;
      $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;

      DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_protect_profile_escalation ON public.profiles;
      CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_profile_escalation
        BEFORE UPDATE ON public.profiles
        FOR EACH ROW
        EXECUTE FUNCTION public.protect_profile_escalation();
    `);
    console.log('✓ Profile escalation guard trigger installed and column grants revoked.');

    console.log('\n[Phase 1.5] Hardening RLS policies on labs, schedules, and settings...');
    await client.query(`
      -- Labs
      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow insert/update labs" ON public.labs;
      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage labs" ON public.labs;
      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Privileged manage labs" ON public.labs;
      CREATE POLICY "Privileged manage labs" ON public.labs
        FOR ALL TO authenticated
        USING (public.is_privileged())
        WITH CHECK (public.is_privileged());

      -- Schedules
      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage schedules" ON public.schedules;
      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Privileged manage schedules" ON public.schedules;
      CREATE POLICY "Privileged manage schedules" ON public.schedules
        FOR ALL TO authenticated
        USING (public.is_privileged())
        WITH CHECK (public.is_privileged());

      -- Calendar settings
      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow update calendar settings" ON public.calendar_settings;
      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Privileged manage calendar settings" ON public.calendar_settings;
      CREATE POLICY "Privileged manage calendar settings" ON public.calendar_settings
        FOR ALL TO authenticated
        USING (public.is_privileged())
        WITH CHECK (public.is_privileged());

      -- Audit logs
      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow authenticated users to insert audit logs" ON public.audit_logs;
      REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON public.audit_logs FROM anon, authenticated;

      -- Teacher substitutions
      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage teacher_substitutions" ON public.teacher_substitutions;
      CREATE POLICY "Teacher own or privileged manage substitutions" ON public.teacher_substitutions
        FOR ALL TO authenticated
        USING (original_teacher_id = auth.uid() OR substitute_teacher_id = auth.uid() OR public.is_privileged())
        WITH CHECK (original_teacher_id = auth.uid() OR substitute_teacher_id = auth.uid() OR public.is_privileged());
    `);
    console.log('✓ RLS write access restricted to privileged administrators and authorized teachers.');

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // 2. PHASE 2: DATABASE INDEXING & QUERY PERFORMANCE
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    console.log('\n[Phase 2.2] Applying B-Tree and Composite Indexes...');

    console.log('  -> Creating idx_practical_logs_lookup...');
    await client.query(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_practical_logs_lookup 
        ON public.practical_logs (lab_id, academic_year_id, date DESC);
    `);

    console.log('  -> Creating idx_practical_logs_schedule_date...');
    await client.query(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_practical_logs_schedule_date 
        ON public.practical_logs (schedule_id, date);
    `);

    console.log('  -> Creating idx_practical_logs_teacher...');
    await client.query(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_practical_logs_teacher 
        ON public.practical_logs (teacher_id, date DESC);
    `);

    console.log('  -> Creating idx_log_attendance_log_roll...');
    await client.query(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_log_attendance_log_roll 
        ON public.log_attendance (log_id, roll_number);
    `);

    console.log('  -> Creating idx_log_attendance_enrollment...');
    await client.query(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_log_attendance_enrollment 
        ON public.log_attendance (enrollment_id);
    `);

    console.log('  -> Creating idx_student_enrollments_year_class_status (Pre-flight adjustment)...');
    await client.query(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_enrollments_year_class_status
        ON public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, status, roll_number);
    `);

    console.log('  -> Creating idx_lab_incidents_lookup...');
    await client.query(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lab_incidents_lookup 
        ON public.lab_incidents (lab_id, status, date DESC);
    `);

    console.log('  -> Creating idx_schedules_lab_day with day_key (Pre-flight adjustment)...');
    await client.query(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_schedules_lab_day 
        ON public.schedules (lab_id, day_key);
    `);

    console.log('  -> Creating idx_maintenance_logs_lab with service_date (Pre-flight adjustment)...');
    await client.query(`
      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_maintenance_logs_lab 
        ON public.maintenance_logs (lab_id, service_date DESC);
    `);

    console.log('✓ All database indexes created successfully.');

    console.log('\n================================================================');
    console.log('MIGRATION COMPLETE: All Phase 1 & 2 Database Upgrades Applied!');
    console.log('================================================================');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('\nMIGRATION FAILED:', error);
    process.exit(1);
  } finally {
    client.release();
    await pool.end();
  }
}

runMigration();

import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

function loadEnv() {
  for (const file of ['.env.local', '.env']) {
    const fullPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), file);
    if (fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
      for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
        const trimmed = line.trim();
        if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
          const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
          const key = trimmed.substring(0, idx).trim();
          const val = trimmed.substring(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
          if (!process.env[key]) {
            process.env[key] = val;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

loadEnv();

if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) {
  console.error('❌ DATABASE_URL environment variable is missing.');
  process.exit(1);
}

const client = new pg.Client({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function run() {
  console.log('🚀 Connecting to PostgreSQL database...');
  await client.connect();

  console.log('📦 Applying Upgrade 1: Adding reported_by_id and resolved_by_id to lab_incidents...');
  await client.query(`
    -- Add verified reporter identity to lab_incidents
    ALTER TABLE public.lab_incidents
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reported_by_id uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

    -- Add verified resolver identity
    ALTER TABLE public.lab_incidents
      ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS resolved_by_id uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

    -- Backfill: match existing rows by full_name where possible
    UPDATE public.lab_incidents li
    SET reported_by_id = p.id
    FROM public.profiles p
    WHERE li.reported_by_id IS NULL
      AND lower(trim(li.reported_by)) = lower(trim(p.full_name));
  `);
  console.log('✅ Upgrade 1 applied successfully.');

  console.log('🔒 Applying Upgrade 2: Creating security definer role helpers...');
  await client.query(`
    CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_role()
    RETURNS text
    LANGUAGE sql
    STABLE
    SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path = public
    AS $$
      SELECT role FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid();
    $$;

    CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_privileged()
    RETURNS boolean
    LANGUAGE sql
    STABLE
    SECURITY DEFINER
    SET search_path = public
    AS $$
      SELECT public.current_role() IN ('super_admin', 'lab_incharge', 'hod', 'admin');
    $$;
  `);
  console.log('✅ Helper functions current_role() and is_privileged() created.');

  console.log('🛡️ Applying Upgrade 2: Tightening RLS policies on practical_logs, lab_incidents, and lab_notifications...');
  await client.query(`
    -- Ensure RLS is active
    ALTER TABLE public.practical_logs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
    ALTER TABLE public.lab_incidents ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
    ALTER TABLE public.lab_notifications ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

    -- PRACTICAL LOGS POLICIES
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow read practical logs" ON public.practical_logs;
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow insert practical logs" ON public.practical_logs;
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow update practical logs" ON public.practical_logs;
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow delete practical logs" ON public.practical_logs;
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "read practical logs" ON public.practical_logs;
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "insert practical logs" ON public.practical_logs;
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "update practical logs" ON public.practical_logs;
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "delete practical logs" ON public.practical_logs;

    CREATE POLICY "read practical logs" ON public.practical_logs
      FOR SELECT TO authenticated
      USING ( public.is_privileged() OR teacher_id = auth.uid() );

    CREATE POLICY "insert practical logs" ON public.practical_logs
      FOR INSERT TO authenticated
      WITH CHECK ( public.is_privileged() OR teacher_id = auth.uid() );

    CREATE POLICY "update practical logs" ON public.practical_logs
      FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
      USING ( public.is_privileged() OR teacher_id = auth.uid() );

    CREATE POLICY "delete practical logs" ON public.practical_logs
      FOR DELETE TO authenticated
      USING ( public.is_privileged() );

    -- LAB INCIDENTS POLICIES
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage lab incidents" ON public.lab_incidents;
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "read lab incidents" ON public.lab_incidents;
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "insert lab incidents" ON public.lab_incidents;
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "update lab incidents" ON public.lab_incidents;
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "delete lab incidents" ON public.lab_incidents;

    CREATE POLICY "read lab incidents" ON public.lab_incidents
      FOR SELECT TO authenticated
      USING ( public.is_privileged() OR reported_by_id = auth.uid() );

    CREATE POLICY "insert lab incidents" ON public.lab_incidents
      FOR INSERT TO authenticated
      WITH CHECK ( reported_by_id = auth.uid() OR public.is_privileged() );

    CREATE POLICY "update lab incidents" ON public.lab_incidents
      FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
      USING ( public.is_privileged() );

    CREATE POLICY "delete lab incidents" ON public.lab_incidents
      FOR DELETE TO authenticated
      USING ( public.is_privileged() );

    -- LAB NOTIFICATIONS POLICIES
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage lab notifications" ON public.lab_notifications;
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "read lab notifications" ON public.lab_notifications;
    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "write lab notifications" ON public.lab_notifications;

    CREATE POLICY "read lab notifications" ON public.lab_notifications
      FOR SELECT TO authenticated
      USING ( public.is_privileged() OR target_role = public.current_role() );

    CREATE POLICY "write lab notifications" ON public.lab_notifications
      FOR ALL TO authenticated
      USING ( public.is_privileged() )
      WITH CHECK ( public.is_privileged() );
  `);
  console.log('✅ Tightened RLS policies installed successfully.');

  // Verification inspection
  const columns = await client.query(`
    SELECT column_name, data_type
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'lab_incidents'
      AND column_name IN ('reported_by_id', 'resolved_by_id')
  `);
  console.log('--- LAB_INCIDENTS NEW COLUMNS ---');
  console.table(columns.rows);

  await client.end();
  console.log('🎉 Migration finished successfully.');
}

run().catch((err) => {
  console.error('❌ Migration failed:', err);
  process.exit(1);
});


================================================================================
FILE: scripts\migrate-roster-clean-slate-rpc.mjs
================================================================================
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = ''
for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
  }
}

if (!dbUrl) {
  console.error('DATABASE_URL not found in .env.local')
  process.exit(1)
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

const SQL = `
-- ============================================================================
-- Phase 6: Deferrable Roll Constraint & Clean Slate Roster Ingestion RPC
-- ============================================================================

-- 1. Make unique roll constraint deferrable so roll swaps / shifts do not fail prematurely
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.table_constraints
    WHERE constraint_name = 'uq_enrollment_roll'
      AND table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'student_enrollments'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.student_enrollments DROP CONSTRAINT uq_enrollment_roll;
  END IF;

  ALTER TABLE public.student_enrollments
    ADD CONSTRAINT uq_enrollment_roll
    UNIQUE (academic_year_id, class_id, roll_number)
    DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;
END $$;

-- 2. Drop legacy 3-parameter function signature if needed
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(text, text, jsonb);

-- 3. Create upgraded atomic function supporting both 'sync' and 'clean_slate'
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
  p_academic_year_id text,
  p_class_id text,
  p_rows jsonb,
  p_mode text DEFAULT 'sync'
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_row jsonb;
  v_student_id uuid;
  v_student_id_by_reg uuid;
  v_enrollment_id uuid;
  v_existing_enrollment_id uuid;
  v_existing_roll int;
  v_roll int;
  v_name text;
  v_adm text;
  v_reg text;
  v_created_students int := 0;
  v_matched_students int := 0;
  v_created_enrollments int := 0;
  v_retained_enrollments int := 0;
  v_updated_enrollments int := 0;
  v_rolls_seen int[] := '{}';
  v_attendance_count int := 0;
  v_sample_student_name text := '';
  v_old_student_ids uuid[] := '{}';
BEGIN
  -- 1. Authorization check inside database function
  IF NOT public.is_privileged() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNAUTHORIZED: Administrative role required to commit roster ingestion.';
  END IF;

  -- 2. Validate parameters & structural integrity
  IF p_academic_year_id IS NULL OR trim(p_academic_year_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Target academic year is required.';
  END IF;

  IF p_class_id IS NULL OR trim(p_class_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Target class is required.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.academic_years WHERE id = p_academic_year_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Academic year % does not exist.', p_academic_year_id;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.classes WHERE id = p_class_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Class % does not exist.', p_class_id;
  END IF;

  IF p_rows IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Roster payload must be a non-null JSON array.';
  END IF;

  IF jsonb_array_length(p_rows) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Roster payload contains zero rows.';
  END IF;

  IF p_mode NOT IN ('sync', 'clean_slate') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid ingestion mode %. Must be "sync" or "clean_slate".', p_mode;
  END IF;

  -- 3. Clean Slate Mode: Obliterate cohort dummy data IF AND ONLY IF zero practical attendance exists
  IF p_mode = 'clean_slate' THEN
    -- Check if ANY student in this cohort has attendance recorded in practical logs
    SELECT count(*), coalesce(min(s.full_name), '') INTO v_attendance_count, v_sample_student_name
    FROM public.log_attendance la
    JOIN public.student_enrollments se ON la.enrollment_id = se.id
    JOIN public.students s ON s.id = se.student_id
    WHERE se.academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
      AND se.class_id = p_class_id;

    IF v_attendance_count > 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CANNOT_WIPE_ACTIVE_HISTORY: Student "%" has % attendance record(s) in practical logs. Cannot perform clean slate replacement on a cohort with active practical history.', v_sample_student_name, v_attendance_count;
    END IF;

    -- Collect student IDs currently enrolled in this cohort
    SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT student_id), '{}') INTO v_old_student_ids
    FROM public.student_enrollments
    WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
      AND class_id = p_class_id;

    -- Delete workstation CAD seat plans for this cohort
    DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans
    WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
      AND class_id = p_class_id;

    -- Delete session seat overrides for this cohort
    DELETE FROM public.session_seat_overrides
    WHERE enrollment_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM public.student_enrollments
      WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
        AND class_id = p_class_id
    );

    -- Delete student enrollments for this cohort
    DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments
    WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
      AND class_id = p_class_id;

    -- Delete dummy students who have NO remaining enrollments, NO attendance logs, and NO incident reports
    IF v_old_student_ids IS NOT NULL AND array_length(v_old_student_ids, 1) > 0 THEN
      DELETE FROM public.students s
      WHERE s.id = ANY(v_old_student_ids)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.student_enrollments se WHERE se.student_id = s.id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.log_attendance la WHERE la.student_id = s.id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lab_incidents li WHERE li.reported_by_id = s.id);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 4. Iterate through all incoming rows
  FOR v_row IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)
  LOOP
    -- Extract and sanitize row values
    v_name := trim(coalesce(v_row->>'full_name', ''));
    v_adm := nullif(trim(coalesce(v_row->>'admission_no', '')), '');
    v_reg := nullif(trim(coalesce(v_row->>'registration_no', '')), '');

    -- Check required name
    IF v_name = '' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Student name cannot be empty.';
    END IF;

    -- Check valid roll number
    BEGIN
      v_roll := (v_row->>'roll_number')::int;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid roll number format for student %.', v_name;
    END;

    IF v_roll IS NULL OR v_roll < 1 OR v_roll > 200 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Roll number % for student % is out of valid bounds (1-200).', v_roll, v_name;
    END IF;

    -- Check intra-payload duplicate roll numbers
    IF v_roll = ANY(v_rolls_seen) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Duplicate roll number % detected inside upload payload.', v_roll;
    END IF;
    v_rolls_seen := array_append(v_rolls_seen, v_roll);

    -- 5. Identity Resolution & Strong Identifier Conflict Guard
    v_student_id := NULL;
    v_student_id_by_reg := NULL;

    -- If admission_no was not provided, check if standard synthesized ADM already exists
    -- OR auto-synthesize standard institutional format: ADM-[YEAR]-[CLASS]-[ROLL]
    IF v_adm IS NULL THEN
      v_adm := 'ADM-' || upper(regexp_replace(p_academic_year_id, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) || '-' || upper(regexp_replace(p_class_id, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) || '-' || lpad(v_roll::text, CASE WHEN v_roll < 100 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, '0');
    END IF;

    SELECT id INTO v_student_id FROM public.students WHERE admission_no = v_adm LIMIT 1;

    IF v_reg IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT id INTO v_student_id_by_reg FROM public.students WHERE registration_no = v_reg LIMIT 1;
    END IF;

    -- If both identifiers are provided, verify they resolve to the exact same student
    IF v_student_id IS NOT NULL AND v_student_id_by_reg IS NOT NULL AND v_student_id <> v_student_id_by_reg THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY_CONFLICT: Admission number % (student ID %) and registration number % (student ID %) resolve to two different students.',
        v_adm, v_student_id, v_reg, v_student_id_by_reg;
    END IF;

    IF v_student_id IS NULL THEN
      v_student_id := v_student_id_by_reg;
    END IF;

    -- 6. Create student person record if not found
    IF v_student_id IS NULL THEN
      INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no, registration_no, is_active)
      VALUES (v_name, v_adm, v_reg, true)
      RETURNING id INTO v_student_id;
      v_created_students := v_created_students + 1;
    ELSE
      -- Existing student: keep active and update name if needed
      UPDATE public.students
      SET full_name = v_name,
          registration_no = coalesce(v_reg, registration_no),
          is_active = true
      WHERE id = v_student_id;
      v_matched_students := v_matched_students + 1;
    END IF;

    -- 7. Cohort Enrollment
    v_existing_enrollment_id := NULL;
    v_existing_roll := NULL;

    SELECT id, roll_number INTO v_existing_enrollment_id, v_existing_roll
    FROM public.student_enrollments
    WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
      AND class_id = p_class_id
      AND student_id = v_student_id;

    IF v_existing_enrollment_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      -- Student is already enrolled in this cohort
      IF v_existing_roll = v_roll THEN
        -- Exact same roll -> idempotent retention
        v_retained_enrollments := v_retained_enrollments + 1;
      ELSE
        -- Roll updated in sync mode (deferred constraint ensures no premature collision)
        UPDATE public.student_enrollments
        SET roll_number = v_roll,
            status = 'active'
        WHERE id = v_existing_enrollment_id;
        v_updated_enrollments := v_updated_enrollments + 1;
      END IF;
    ELSE
      -- Clean insert
      INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (
        academic_year_id,
        class_id,
        student_id,
        roll_number,
        status
      ) VALUES (
        p_academic_year_id,
        p_class_id,
        v_student_id,
        v_roll,
        'active'
      )
      RETURNING id INTO v_enrollment_id;
      v_created_enrollments := v_created_enrollments + 1;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'mode', p_mode,
    'processed_rows', jsonb_array_length(p_rows),
    'students_created', v_created_students,
    'students_matched', v_matched_students,
    'enrollments_created', v_created_enrollments,
    'enrollments_retained', v_retained_enrollments,
    'enrollments_updated', v_updated_enrollments
  );
END;
$$;

-- 4. Permissions
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(text, text, jsonb, text) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(text, text, jsonb, text) TO authenticated;
`

async function run() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('Deploying Clean Slate & Deferrable Roll Ingestion RPC...')
    await client.query(SQL)
    console.log('✓ Successfully deployed commit_roster_ingestion_tx and deferrable uq_enrollment_roll!')
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

run().catch((err) => {
  console.error('Migration failed:', err)
  process.exit(1)
})

FILE: scripts\migrate-roster-rpc-v3.mjs

import pg from 'pg'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = ''
for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
  }
}

if (!dbUrl) {
  console.error('DATABASE_URL not found')
  process.exit(1)
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

const sql = `
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
  p_academic_year_id text,
  p_class_id text,
  p_rows jsonb,
  p_mode text DEFAULT 'sync'
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_row jsonb;
  v_name text;
  v_adm text;
  v_reg text;
  v_roll int;
  v_student_id uuid;
  v_student_id_by_reg uuid;
  v_action text;
  v_enrollment_id uuid;
  v_existing_enrollment_id uuid;
  v_existing_roll int;
  v_rolls_seen int[] := '{}';
  v_created_students int := 0;
  v_matched_students int := 0;
  v_created_enrollments int := 0;
  v_retained_enrollments int := 0;
  v_updated_enrollments int := 0;
  v_old_student_ids uuid[];
  v_attendance_count int := 0;
  v_sample_student_name text := '';
  v_old_enrollment_id uuid;
  v_old_occ_student_id uuid;
  v_old_log_count int;
  v_shift_roll int;
BEGIN
  -- 1. Pre-validation checks
  IF p_academic_year_id IS NULL OR p_class_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Academic year and class ID are required.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.academic_years WHERE id = p_academic_year_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Academic year % does not exist.', p_academic_year_id;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.classes WHERE id = p_class_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Class % does not exist.', p_class_id;
  END IF;

  IF jsonb_array_length(p_rows) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Cannot ingest empty roster payload.';
  END IF;

  IF p_mode NOT IN ('sync', 'clean_slate') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid ingestion mode %. Must be "sync" or "clean_slate".', p_mode;
  END IF;

  -- 2. Clean Slate Mode: Obliterate cohort dummy data IF AND ONLY IF zero practical attendance exists
  IF p_mode = 'clean_slate' THEN
    SELECT count(*), coalesce(min(s.full_name), '') INTO v_attendance_count, v_sample_student_name
    FROM public.log_attendance la
    JOIN public.student_enrollments se ON la.enrollment_id = se.id
    JOIN public.students s ON s.id = se.student_id
    WHERE se.academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
      AND se.class_id = p_class_id;

    IF v_attendance_count > 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'CANNOT_WIPE_ACTIVE_HISTORY: Student "%" has % attendance record(s) in practical logs. Cannot perform clean slate replacement on a cohort with active practical history.', v_sample_student_name, v_attendance_count;
    END IF;

    SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT student_id), '{}') INTO v_old_student_ids
    FROM public.student_enrollments
    WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
      AND class_id = p_class_id;

    DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans
    WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
      AND class_id = p_class_id;

    DELETE FROM public.session_seat_overrides
    WHERE enrollment_id IN (
      SELECT id FROM public.student_enrollments
      WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
        AND class_id = p_class_id
    );

    DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments
    WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
      AND class_id = p_class_id;

    IF v_old_student_ids IS NOT NULL AND array_length(v_old_student_ids, 1) > 0 THEN
      DELETE FROM public.students s
      WHERE s.id = ANY(v_old_student_ids)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.student_enrollments se WHERE se.student_id = s.id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.log_attendance la WHERE la.student_id = s.id)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lab_incidents li WHERE li.reported_by_id = s.id);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 3. Iterate through all incoming rows
  FOR v_row IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)
  LOOP
    v_name := trim(coalesce(v_row->>'full_name', ''));
    v_adm := nullif(trim(coalesce(v_row->>'admission_no', '')), '');
    v_reg := nullif(trim(coalesce(v_row->>'registration_no', '')), '');
    v_action := coalesce(v_row->>'action', 'sync');

    IF v_name = '' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Student name cannot be empty.';
    END IF;

    BEGIN
      v_roll := (v_row->>'roll_number')::int;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid roll number format for student %.', v_name;
    END;

    -- If user chose 'assign_next_roll', calculate next available roll number
    IF v_action = 'assign_next_roll' THEN
      SELECT coalesce(max(roll_number), 0) + 1 INTO v_roll
      FROM public.student_enrollments
      WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
        AND class_id = p_class_id
        AND status = 'active';
    END IF;

    IF v_roll IS NULL OR v_roll < 1 OR v_roll > 200 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Roll number % for student % is out of valid bounds (1-200).', v_roll, v_name;
    END IF;

    IF v_roll = ANY(v_rolls_seen) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Duplicate roll number % detected inside upload payload.', v_roll;
    END IF;
    v_rolls_seen := array_append(v_rolls_seen, v_roll);

    -- 4. Identity Resolution
    v_student_id := NULL;
    v_student_id_by_reg := NULL;

    -- Check if explicit student_id was provided (from review resolution)
    IF v_row ? 'student_id' AND nullif(trim(v_row->>'student_id'), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
      BEGIN
        v_student_id := (v_row->>'student_id')::uuid;
      EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        v_student_id := NULL;
      END;
    END IF;

    -- If student_id was not explicitly supplied, resolve via identifiers
    IF v_student_id IS NULL THEN
      IF v_adm IS NULL THEN
        v_adm := 'ADM-' || upper(regexp_replace(p_academic_year_id, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) || '-' || upper(regexp_replace(p_class_id, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) || '-' || lpad(v_roll::text, CASE WHEN v_roll < 100 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, '0');
      END IF;

      SELECT id INTO v_student_id FROM public.students WHERE admission_no = v_adm LIMIT 1;

      IF v_reg IS NOT NULL THEN
        SELECT id INTO v_student_id_by_reg FROM public.students WHERE registration_no = v_reg LIMIT 1;
      END IF;

      IF v_student_id IS NOT NULL AND v_student_id_by_reg IS NOT NULL AND v_student_id <> v_student_id_by_reg THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY_CONFLICT: Admission number % (student ID %) and registration number % (student ID %) resolve to two different students.',
          v_adm, v_student_id, v_reg, v_student_id_by_reg;
      END IF;

      IF v_student_id IS NULL THEN
        v_student_id := v_student_id_by_reg;
      END IF;
    END IF;

    -- 5. Create or update student person entity
    IF v_student_id IS NULL THEN
      INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no, registration_no, is_active)
      VALUES (v_name, v_adm, v_reg, true)
      RETURNING id INTO v_student_id;
      v_created_students := v_created_students + 1;
    ELSE
      UPDATE public.students
      SET full_name = v_name,
          registration_no = coalesce(v_reg, registration_no),
          is_active = true
      WHERE id = v_student_id;
      v_matched_students := v_matched_students + 1;
    END IF;

    -- 6. If action = 'replace_occupant', unseat previous occupant at v_roll
    IF v_action = 'replace_occupant' THEN
      SELECT se.id, se.student_id, count(la.id) INTO v_old_enrollment_id, v_old_occ_student_id, v_old_log_count
      FROM public.student_enrollments se
      LEFT JOIN public.log_attendance la ON la.enrollment_id = se.id
      WHERE se.academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
        AND se.class_id = p_class_id
        AND se.roll_number = v_roll
      GROUP BY se.id, se.student_id;

      IF v_old_enrollment_id IS NOT NULL AND (v_old_occ_student_id <> v_student_id) THEN
        IF v_old_log_count = 0 THEN
          DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans WHERE enrollment_id = v_old_enrollment_id;
          DELETE FROM public.session_seat_overrides WHERE enrollment_id = v_old_enrollment_id;
          DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id = v_old_enrollment_id;
          IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id = v_old_occ_student_id) THEN
            DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id = v_old_occ_student_id;
          END IF;
        ELSE
          -- Shift old occupant out of roll collision space to preserve logs
          SELECT coalesce(max(roll_number), 0) + 1 INTO v_shift_roll
          FROM public.student_enrollments
          WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id AND class_id = p_class_id;

          UPDATE public.student_enrollments
          SET roll_number = v_shift_roll, status = 'archived'
          WHERE id = v_old_enrollment_id;
        END IF;
      END IF;
    END IF;

    -- 7. Cohort Enrollment
    v_existing_enrollment_id := NULL;
    v_existing_roll := NULL;

    SELECT id, roll_number INTO v_existing_enrollment_id, v_existing_roll
    FROM public.student_enrollments
    WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
      AND class_id = p_class_id
      AND student_id = v_student_id;

    IF v_existing_enrollment_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      IF v_existing_roll = v_roll THEN
        v_retained_enrollments := v_retained_enrollments + 1;
      ELSE
        UPDATE public.student_enrollments
        SET roll_number = v_roll,
            status = 'active'
        WHERE id = v_existing_enrollment_id;
        v_updated_enrollments := v_updated_enrollments + 1;
      END IF;
    ELSE
      INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (
        academic_year_id,
        class_id,
        student_id,
        roll_number,
        status
      ) VALUES (
        p_academic_year_id,
        p_class_id,
        v_student_id,
        v_roll,
        'active'
      )
      RETURNING id INTO v_enrollment_id;
      v_created_enrollments := v_created_enrollments + 1;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'mode', p_mode,
    'processed_rows', jsonb_array_length(p_rows),
    'students_created', v_created_students,
    'students_matched', v_matched_students,
    'enrollments_created', v_created_enrollments,
    'enrollments_retained', v_retained_enrollments,
    'enrollments_updated', v_updated_enrollments
  );
END;
$$;
`

async function run() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('Migrating commit_roster_ingestion_tx with human-in-the-loop review enhancements...')
    await client.query(sql)
    console.log('Successfully deployed commit_roster_ingestion_tx')
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

run().catch(console.error)

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = ''
for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
  }
}

if (!dbUrl) {
  console.error('DATABASE_URL not found in .env.local')
  process.exit(1)
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

const SQL = `
-- ============================================================================
-- Phase 4: Atomic Roster Ingestion RPC Function
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
  p_academic_year_id text,
  p_class_id text,
  p_rows jsonb
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_row jsonb;
  v_student_id uuid;
  v_student_id_by_reg uuid;
  v_enrollment_id uuid;
  v_existing_enrollment_id uuid;
  v_existing_roll int;
  v_roll int;
  v_name text;
  v_adm text;
  v_reg text;
  v_created_students int := 0;
  v_matched_students int := 0;
  v_created_enrollments int := 0;
  v_retained_enrollments int := 0;
  v_rolls_seen int[] := '{}';
BEGIN
  -- 1. Authorization check inside database function
  IF NOT public.is_privileged() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'UNAUTHORIZED: Administrative role required to commit roster ingestion.';
  END IF;

  -- 2. Validate parameters & structural integrity of p_rows
  IF p_academic_year_id IS NULL OR trim(p_academic_year_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Target academic year is required.';
  END IF;

  IF p_class_id IS NULL OR trim(p_class_id) = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Target class is required.';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.academic_years WHERE id = p_academic_year_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Academic year % does not exist.', p_academic_year_id;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.classes WHERE id = p_class_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Class % does not exist.', p_class_id;
  END IF;

  IF p_rows IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Roster payload must be a non-null JSON array.';
  END IF;

  IF jsonb_array_length(p_rows) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Roster payload contains zero rows.';
  END IF;

  -- 3. Iterate through all rows with strict invariant validation
  FOR v_row IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)
  LOOP
    -- Extract and sanitize row values
    v_name := trim(coalesce(v_row->>'full_name', ''));
    v_adm := nullif(trim(coalesce(v_row->>'admission_no', '')), '');
    v_reg := nullif(trim(coalesce(v_row->>'registration_no', '')), '');

    -- Check required name
    IF v_name = '' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Student name cannot be empty.';
    END IF;

    -- Check valid roll number
    BEGIN
      v_roll := (v_row->>'roll_number')::int;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid roll number format for student %.', v_name;
    END;

    IF v_roll IS NULL OR v_roll < 1 OR v_roll > 200 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Roll number % for student % is out of valid bounds (1-200).', v_roll, v_name;
    END IF;

    -- Check intra-payload duplicate roll numbers
    IF v_roll = ANY(v_rolls_seen) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'VALIDATION_ERROR: Duplicate roll number % detected inside upload payload.', v_roll;
    END IF;
    v_rolls_seen := array_append(v_rolls_seen, v_roll);

    -- 4. Identity Resolution & Strong Identifier Conflict Guard
    v_student_id := NULL;
    v_student_id_by_reg := NULL;

    IF v_adm IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT id INTO v_student_id FROM public.students WHERE admission_no = v_adm LIMIT 1;
    END IF;

    IF v_reg IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT id INTO v_student_id_by_reg FROM public.students WHERE registration_no = v_reg LIMIT 1;
    END IF;

    -- If both identifiers are provided, verify they resolve to the exact same student
    IF v_student_id IS NOT NULL AND v_student_id_by_reg IS NOT NULL AND v_student_id <> v_student_id_by_reg THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY_CONFLICT: Admission number % (student ID %) and registration number % (student ID %) resolve to two different students.',
        v_adm, v_student_id, v_reg, v_student_id_by_reg;
    END IF;

    -- Consolidate student identity
    IF v_student_id IS NULL THEN
      v_student_id := v_student_id_by_reg;
    END IF;

    -- 5. Create student person record if not found by strong identifiers
    IF v_student_id IS NULL THEN
      -- Auto-synthesize standard institutional admission number if omitted: ADM-[YEAR]-[CLASS]-[ROLL]
      IF v_adm IS NULL THEN
        v_adm := 'ADM-' || upper(regexp_replace(p_academic_year_id, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) || '-' || upper(regexp_replace(p_class_id, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) || '-' || lpad(v_roll::text, CASE WHEN v_roll < 100 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, '0');
      END IF;

      INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no, registration_no, is_active)
      VALUES (v_name, v_adm, v_reg, true)
      RETURNING id INTO v_student_id;
      v_created_students := v_created_students + 1;
    ELSE
      v_matched_students := v_matched_students + 1;
    END IF;

    -- 6. Cohort Enrollment & Roll Mismatch Idempotency Guard
    v_existing_enrollment_id := NULL;
    v_existing_roll := NULL;

    SELECT id, roll_number INTO v_existing_enrollment_id, v_existing_roll
    FROM public.student_enrollments
    WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
      AND class_id = p_class_id
      AND student_id = v_student_id;

    IF v_existing_enrollment_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      -- Student is already enrolled in this cohort
      IF v_existing_roll = v_roll THEN
        -- Exact same roll -> idempotent retention
        v_retained_enrollments := v_retained_enrollments + 1;
      ELSE
        -- Different roll -> explicit conflict error
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'ROLL_MISMATCH_CONFLICT: Student % is already enrolled with roll number %, but spreadsheet specifies roll %. Roll changes require an explicit enrollment management operation.',
          v_name, v_existing_roll, v_roll;
      END IF;
    ELSE
      -- Check if target roll number is already occupied by another student in this cohort
      IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.student_enrollments
        WHERE academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
          AND class_id = p_class_id
          AND roll_number = v_roll
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'ROLL_COLLISION: Roll number % is already occupied in class % by another student.', v_roll, p_class_id;
      END IF;

      INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (
        academic_year_id,
        class_id,
        student_id,
        roll_number,
        status
      ) VALUES (
        p_academic_year_id,
        p_class_id,
        v_student_id,
        v_roll,
        'active'
      )
      RETURNING id INTO v_enrollment_id;
      v_created_enrollments := v_created_enrollments + 1;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'processed_rows', jsonb_array_length(p_rows),
    'students_created', v_created_students,
    'students_matched', v_matched_students,
    'enrollments_created', v_created_enrollments,
    'enrollments_retained', v_retained_enrollments
  );
END;
$$;

-- Security hardening: revoke public execution and grant strictly to authenticated role
REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(text, text, jsonb) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(text, text, jsonb) TO authenticated;
`

async function migrate() {
  console.log('Connecting to PostgreSQL database...')
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN')
    console.log('Deploying public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx...')
    await client.query(SQL)
    await client.query('COMMIT')
    console.log('✓ Successfully deployed and hardened public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx!')
  } catch (err) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK')
    console.error('Migration failed:', err)
    process.exit(1)
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

migrate()

FILE: scripts\migrate-staff-access-hardening.mjs

import pg from 'pg';

const pool = new pg.Pool({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function run() {
  console.log('🚀 Starting Phase 0: Staff Access Hardening & Database Security Migration...');
  const client = await pool.connect();

  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');

    // 1. Structural Schema Updates on public.profiles
    console.log('1. Adding honorific, bio, and teaching_preferences to public.profiles...');
    await client.query(`
      ALTER TABLE public.profiles 
        ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS honorific TEXT,
        ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS bio TEXT,
        ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS teaching_preferences JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb;
    `);

    // 2. Update lifecycle check constraint
    console.log('2. Updating approval_status check constraint to include suspended...');
    await client.query(`
      ALTER TABLE public.profiles 
        DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS profiles_approval_status_check;

      ALTER TABLE public.profiles 
        ADD CONSTRAINT profiles_approval_status_check 
        CHECK (approval_status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'suspended'));
    `);

    // 3. Create BEFORE UPDATE trigger on public.profiles to block self-update privilege escalation
    console.log('3. Installing prevent_profile_privilege_escalation() trigger...');
    await client.query(`
      CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_profile_privilege_escalation()
      RETURNS trigger
      LANGUAGE plpgsql
      SECURITY DEFINER
      SET search_path = public
      AS $$
      BEGIN
        -- If caller is not a super_admin, prevent changes to privileged columns
        IF (SELECT role FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()) != 'super_admin' THEN
          IF NEW.role IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.role OR
             NEW.approval_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approval_status OR
             NEW.is_active IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.is_active OR
             NEW.permissions IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.permissions THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Privilege escalation violation: Only Super Administrators can alter roles, permissions, approval status, or active states.';
          END IF;
        END IF;
        RETURN NEW;
      END;
      $$;

      DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_prevent_profile_privilege_escalation ON public.profiles;
      CREATE TRIGGER trg_prevent_profile_privilege_escalation
        BEFORE UPDATE ON public.profiles
        FOR EACH ROW
        EXECUTE FUNCTION public.prevent_profile_privilege_escalation();
    `);

    // 4. Create Security Definer helper functions
    console.log('4. Creating is_approved_staff, owns_practical_log, and is_assigned_to_class_subject functions...');
    await client.query(`
      CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_approved_staff()
      RETURNS boolean
      LANGUAGE sql
      SECURITY DEFINER
      STABLE
      SET search_path = public
      AS $$
        SELECT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
          WHERE id = auth.uid()
            AND approval_status = 'approved'
            AND is_active = true
        );
      $$;

      CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owns_practical_log(p_log_id text)
      RETURNS boolean
      LANGUAGE sql
      SECURITY DEFINER
      STABLE
      SET search_path = public
      AS $$
        SELECT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.practical_logs
          WHERE id = p_log_id
            AND (teacher_id = auth.uid() OR logged_by = auth.uid())
        );
      $$;

      CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_assigned_to_class_subject(p_class_subject_id text)
      RETURNS boolean
      LANGUAGE sql
      SECURITY DEFINER
      STABLE
      SET search_path = public
      AS $$
        SELECT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.class_subjects
          WHERE id = p_class_subject_id
            AND teacher_id = auth.uid()
        );
      $$;
    `);

    // 5. Update RLS policies on practical_logs
    console.log('5. Hardening RLS policies on practical_logs...');
    await client.query(`
      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "insert practical logs" ON public.practical_logs;
      CREATE POLICY "insert practical logs"
      ON public.practical_logs
      FOR INSERT
      TO authenticated
      WITH CHECK (
        is_privileged() OR (
          is_approved_staff() AND 
          (teacher_id = auth.uid() OR logged_by = auth.uid()) AND
          (class_subject_id IS NULL OR is_assigned_to_class_subject(class_subject_id))
        )
      );

      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "update practical logs" ON public.practical_logs;
      CREATE POLICY "update practical logs"
      ON public.practical_logs
      FOR UPDATE
      TO authenticated
      USING (
        is_privileged() OR (
          is_approved_staff() AND 
          (teacher_id = auth.uid() OR logged_by = auth.uid()) AND
          (created_at > (now() - interval '24 hours'))
        )
      )
      WITH CHECK (
        is_privileged() OR (
          is_approved_staff() AND 
          (teacher_id = auth.uid() OR logged_by = auth.uid()) AND
          (class_subject_id IS NULL OR is_assigned_to_class_subject(class_subject_id)) AND
          (created_at > (now() - interval '24 hours'))
        )
      );

      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "delete practical logs" ON public.practical_logs;
      CREATE POLICY "delete practical logs"
      ON public.practical_logs
      FOR DELETE
      TO authenticated
      USING (is_privileged());
    `);

    // 6. Hardening RLS on schedules, workstations, and lab_incidents
    console.log('6. Hardening RLS on schedules, workstations, and lab_incidents...');
    await client.query(`
      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage schedules authenticated" ON public.schedules;
      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Privileged manage schedules" ON public.schedules;
      CREATE POLICY "Privileged manage schedules"
      ON public.schedules
      FOR ALL
      TO authenticated
      USING (is_privileged())
      WITH CHECK (is_privileged());

      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage workstations" ON public.workstations;
      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Privileged manage workstations" ON public.workstations;
      CREATE POLICY "Privileged manage workstations"
      ON public.workstations
      FOR ALL
      TO authenticated
      USING (is_privileged())
      WITH CHECK (is_privileged());

      DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "insert lab incidents" ON public.lab_incidents;
      CREATE POLICY "insert lab incidents"
      ON public.lab_incidents
      FOR INSERT
      TO authenticated
      WITH CHECK (
        is_privileged() OR (
          is_approved_staff() AND reported_by_id = auth.uid()
        )
      );
    `);

    // 7. Storage RLS on avatars bucket
    console.log('7. Verifying storage bucket policies for avatars...');
    await client.query(`
      DO $$
      BEGIN
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'storage' AND table_name = 'objects') THEN
          DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow user avatar upload" ON storage.objects;
          CREATE POLICY "Allow user avatar upload"
          ON storage.objects
          FOR INSERT
          TO authenticated
          WITH CHECK (
            bucket_id = 'avatars' AND
            (storage.foldername(name))[1] = 'profiles' AND
            name LIKE 'profiles/' || auth.uid()::text || '%'
          );

          DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow user avatar update" ON storage.objects;
          CREATE POLICY "Allow user avatar update"
          ON storage.objects
          FOR UPDATE
          TO authenticated
          USING (
            bucket_id = 'avatars' AND
            (storage.foldername(name))[1] = 'profiles' AND
            name LIKE 'profiles/' || auth.uid()::text || '%'
          );
        END IF;
      END $$;
    `);

    await client.query('COMMIT');
    console.log('✅ Phase 0 Migration completed successfully and committed atomically!');
  } catch (error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK');
    console.error('❌ Phase 0 Migration failed. Rolled back.', error);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    client.release();
    await pool.end();
  }
}

run().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});


================================================================================
FILE: scripts\migrate-students-seat-planning.mjs

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = ''
for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

if (!dbUrl) {
  console.error('DATABASE_URL not found in .env.local')
  process.exit(1)
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
})

const MIGRATION_SQL = `
-- ==============================================================================
-- PHASE 1: ACADEMIC YEARS, STUDENT ROSTER & TWO-TIER SEAT PLANNING DDL
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. ACADEMIC YEARS
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.academic_years (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,                                      -- e.g. '2083'
  name text NOT NULL,                                       -- '2083 B.S. (2026/27 A.D.)'
  start_date date NOT NULL,                                 -- '2026-04-14'
  end_date date NOT NULL,                                   -- '2027-04-13'
  is_current boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  is_archived boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_academic_years_single_current 
  ON public.academic_years (is_current) 
  WHERE (is_current = true);

-- Seed Initial Academic Year
INSERT INTO public.academic_years (id, name, start_date, end_date, is_current, is_archived)
VALUES ('2083', '2083 B.S. (2026/27 A.D.)', '2026-04-14', '2027-04-13', true, false)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  is_current = EXCLUDED.is_current;

-- 2. CANONICAL STUDENTS IDENTITY
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.students (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  admission_no text UNIQUE,                                 -- e.g. 'ADM-2081-0042'
  registration_no text UNIQUE,                              -- institutional / board registration
  full_name text NOT NULL,
  gender text CHECK (gender IN ('male', 'female', 'other')),
  dob_bs text,                                              -- e.g. '2065-03-12'
  dob_ad date,
  guardian_name text,
  guardian_phone text,
  email text,
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  archived_at timestamptz,
  archive_reason text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_students_active ON public.students (is_active);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_students_name ON public.students (lower(full_name));

-- 3. STUDENT ENROLLMENTS (Year <-> Cohort <-> Student <-> Roll)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.student_enrollments (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  academic_year_id text REFERENCES public.academic_years(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT NULL,
  class_id text REFERENCES public.classes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT NULL,
  student_id uuid REFERENCES public.students(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT NULL,
  roll_number integer NOT NULL CHECK (roll_number > 0 AND roll_number <= 200),
  section text,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'transferred', 'graduated', 'archived')),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  
  CONSTRAINT uq_enrollment_roll UNIQUE (academic_year_id, class_id, roll_number),
  CONSTRAINT uq_enrollment_student UNIQUE (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_enrollments_cohort ON public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_enrollments_student ON public.student_enrollments (student_id);

-- 4. TIER 1: DEFAULT WORKSTATION SEAT PLANS
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.workstation_seat_plans (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  lab_id text REFERENCES public.labs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
  academic_year_id text REFERENCES public.academic_years(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT NULL,
  class_id text REFERENCES public.classes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT NULL,
  workstation_id uuid REFERENCES public.workstations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT NULL,
  enrollment_id uuid REFERENCES public.student_enrollments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT NULL,
  notes text,                                               -- e.g. 'Requires accessibility seat', 'Left-handed'
  assigned_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  
  CONSTRAINT uq_seat_plan_workstation UNIQUE (lab_id, academic_year_id, class_id, workstation_id),
  CONSTRAINT uq_seat_plan_enrollment UNIQUE (lab_id, academic_year_id, class_id, enrollment_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_seat_plans_lookup ON public.workstation_seat_plans (lab_id, academic_year_id, class_id);

-- 5. TIER 2: SESSION SEAT OVERRIDES (Temporary Fault / Swap Reallocations)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.session_seat_overrides (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  schedule_id text REFERENCES public.schedules(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  session_date date NOT NULL,
  practical_log_id text REFERENCES public.practical_logs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  enrollment_id uuid REFERENCES public.student_enrollments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT NULL,
  workstation_id uuid REFERENCES public.workstations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT NULL,
  original_workstation_id uuid REFERENCES public.workstations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  reason text,                                              -- e.g. 'PC-04 PSU burning smell', 'Monitor flickering'
  created_by uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  
  CONSTRAINT uq_session_override_student UNIQUE (schedule_id, session_date, enrollment_id),
  CONSTRAINT uq_session_override_workstation UNIQUE (schedule_id, session_date, workstation_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_session_overrides_date ON public.session_seat_overrides (session_date, schedule_id);

-- 6. EXTENSIBLE LAB FLOOR ELEMENTS (Landmarks, Doors, Desks)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.lab_floor_elements (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  lab_id text REFERENCES public.labs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
  element_type text NOT NULL,                               -- extensible: 'teacher_desk', 'whiteboard', 'door', etc.
  label text NOT NULL,                                      -- e.g. 'Teacher Podium', 'Main Lab Entrance'
  pos_x double precision NOT NULL CHECK (pos_x >= 0 AND pos_x <= 100),
  pos_y double precision NOT NULL CHECK (pos_y >= 0 AND pos_y <= 100),
  width double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 12.0 CHECK (width > 0 AND width <= 100),
  height double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 4.0 CHECK (height > 0 AND height <= 100),
  rotation integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (rotation IN (0, 90, 180, 270)),
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,              -- colors, custom icons, remarks
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_floor_elements_lab ON public.lab_floor_elements (lab_id) WHERE (is_active = true);

-- Seed Default Floor Elements for Computer Lab 01 ('comp')
INSERT INTO public.lab_floor_elements (lab_id, element_type, label, pos_x, pos_y, width, height, rotation)
VALUES
  ('comp', 'teacher_desk', 'Teacher Podium / Master Console', 12.0, 8.0, 16.0, 6.0, 0),
  ('comp', 'whiteboard', 'Interactive Whiteboard & Projector Screen', 48.0, 4.0, 32.0, 3.0, 0),
  ('comp', 'door', 'Main Corridor Entrance', 92.0, 88.0, 6.0, 10.0, 0)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

-- 7. ATTENDANCE BRIDGE COLUMN (Nullable, Non-destructive)
ALTER TABLE public.log_attendance 
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS student_id uuid REFERENCES public.students(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_log_attendance_student ON public.log_attendance (student_id);

-- 8. CONTEXT FK COLUMNS ON SCHEDULES & PRACTICAL LOGS
ALTER TABLE public.schedules
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS academic_year_id text REFERENCES public.academic_years(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFAULT '2083';

ALTER TABLE public.practical_logs
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS academic_year_id text REFERENCES public.academic_years(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFAULT '2083';

-- 9. ROW LEVEL SECURITY (RLS) POLICIES
ALTER TABLE public.academic_years ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.students ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.student_enrollments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.workstation_seat_plans ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.session_seat_overrides ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.lab_floor_elements ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Read policies: all authenticated users can read academic context
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow read academic_years" ON public.academic_years;
CREATE POLICY "Allow read academic_years" ON public.academic_years FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow read students" ON public.students;
CREATE POLICY "Allow read students" ON public.students FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow read student_enrollments" ON public.student_enrollments;
CREATE POLICY "Allow read student_enrollments" ON public.student_enrollments FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow read workstation_seat_plans" ON public.workstation_seat_plans;
CREATE POLICY "Allow read workstation_seat_plans" ON public.workstation_seat_plans FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow read session_seat_overrides" ON public.session_seat_overrides;
CREATE POLICY "Allow read session_seat_overrides" ON public.session_seat_overrides FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow read lab_floor_elements" ON public.lab_floor_elements;
CREATE POLICY "Allow read lab_floor_elements" ON public.lab_floor_elements FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

-- Privileged management policies: super_admin, lab_incharge, hod
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage academic_years" ON public.academic_years;
CREATE POLICY "Allow manage academic_years" ON public.academic_years FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (public.is_privileged());

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage students" ON public.students;
CREATE POLICY "Allow manage students" ON public.students FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (public.is_privileged());

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage student_enrollments" ON public.student_enrollments;
CREATE POLICY "Allow manage student_enrollments" ON public.student_enrollments FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (public.is_privileged());

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage lab_floor_elements" ON public.lab_floor_elements;
CREATE POLICY "Allow manage lab_floor_elements" ON public.lab_floor_elements FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (public.is_privileged());

-- Workstation seat plans: Admins manage all; Teachers manage their assigned classes
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage workstation_seat_plans" ON public.workstation_seat_plans;
CREATE POLICY "Allow manage workstation_seat_plans" ON public.workstation_seat_plans FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (
    public.is_privileged() OR 
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.class_subjects cs
      WHERE cs.class_id = workstation_seat_plans.class_id AND cs.teacher_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- Session seat overrides: Admins manage all; Teachers manage their own session overrides
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage session_seat_overrides" ON public.session_seat_overrides;
CREATE POLICY "Allow manage session_seat_overrides" ON public.session_seat_overrides FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (
    public.is_privileged() OR 
    created_by = auth.uid() OR
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.schedules s
      WHERE s.id = session_seat_overrides.schedule_id AND s.teacher_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- 10. REALTIME SUBSCRIPTIONS
DO $$ BEGIN
  BEGIN ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.academic_years; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
  BEGIN ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.students; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
  BEGIN ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.student_enrollments; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
  BEGIN ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.workstation_seat_plans; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
  BEGIN ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.session_seat_overrides; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
  BEGIN ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.lab_floor_elements; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
END $$;
`

async function run() {
  console.log('Running Phase 1 migration...')
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN')
    await client.query(MIGRATION_SQL)
    await client.query('COMMIT')
    console.log('Phase 1 migration executed successfully!')

    // Verification queries
    const tablesRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT table_name 
      FROM information_schema.tables 
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
        AND table_name IN (
          'academic_years', 
          'students', 
          'student_enrollments', 
          'workstation_seat_plans', 
          'session_seat_overrides', 
          'lab_floor_elements'
        )
      ORDER BY table_name;
    `)
    console.log('Verified tables in DB:', tablesRes.rows.map(r => r.table_name))

    const yearsRes = await client.query('SELECT * FROM public.academic_years;')
    console.log('Seeded academic years:', yearsRes.rows)

    const floorRes = await client.query('SELECT lab_id, element_type, label FROM public.lab_floor_elements;')
    console.log('Seeded floor elements count:', floorRes.rows.length)
  } catch (err) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK')
    console.error('Migration failed:', err)
    process.exit(1)
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

run()

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = ''
for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
})

const MIGRATION_SQL = `
-- ==============================================================================
-- Workstation Floor Management & Issue Tracking Schema
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. ISSUE CATEGORIES (Granular PC Hardware, Software, Network taxonomy)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.issue_categories (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name text NOT NULL,
  type text NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('hardware', 'software', 'network', 'peripheral', 'other')),
  color text NOT NULL DEFAULT '#6366F1',
  icon text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AlertTriangle',
  default_severity text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium' CHECK (default_severity IN ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical')),
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  sort_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_issue_categories_active ON public.issue_categories(is_active, sort_order);

-- 2. WORKSTATIONS (Normalized 2D Floor Plan Nodes)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.workstations (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  lab_id text REFERENCES public.labs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
  label text NOT NULL,                                          -- e.g. 'PC-01'
  pos_x double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 50.0,                 -- 0.0 to 100.0 percentage
  pos_y double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 50.0,                 -- 0.0 to 100.0 percentage
  device_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'desktop' 
    CHECK (device_type IN ('desktop', 'aio', 'laptop', 'server')),
  row_label text,                                               -- e.g. 'Row A', 'Teacher Station'
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT uq_workstation_lab_label UNIQUE (lab_id, label)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_workstations_lab ON public.workstations(lab_id) WHERE is_active = true;

-- 3. WORKSTATION ISSUES (Problem Reports & Lifecycle)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.workstation_issues (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  workstation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.workstations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  category_id uuid REFERENCES public.issue_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  title text NOT NULL,
  description text,
  severity text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium' CHECK (severity IN ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical')),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open', 'acknowledged', 'in_progress', 'resolved')),
  reported_by_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  reported_by_name text NOT NULL,
  photos jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  resolved_by_id uuid REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  resolved_by_name text,
  resolution_notes text,
  resolved_at timestamptz,
  linked_maintenance_log_id uuid REFERENCES public.maintenance_logs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_workstation_issues_ws ON public.workstation_issues(workstation_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_workstation_issues_status ON public.workstation_issues(status);

-- 4. ROW LEVEL SECURITY (RLS)
ALTER TABLE public.issue_categories ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow read categories" ON public.issue_categories;
CREATE POLICY "Allow read categories" ON public.issue_categories FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage categories" ON public.issue_categories;
CREATE POLICY "Allow manage categories" ON public.issue_categories FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (public.is_privileged());

ALTER TABLE public.workstations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow read workstations" ON public.workstations;
CREATE POLICY "Allow read workstations" ON public.workstations FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow manage workstations" ON public.workstations;
CREATE POLICY "Allow manage workstations" ON public.workstations FOR ALL TO authenticated USING (public.is_privileged());

ALTER TABLE public.workstation_issues ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow read issues" ON public.workstation_issues;
CREATE POLICY "Allow read issues" ON public.workstation_issues FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow report issues" ON public.workstation_issues;
CREATE POLICY "Allow report issues" ON public.workstation_issues FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = reported_by_id OR public.is_privileged());
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow resolve issues" ON public.workstation_issues;
CREATE POLICY "Allow resolve issues" ON public.workstation_issues FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (public.is_privileged());
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow delete issues" ON public.workstation_issues;
CREATE POLICY "Allow delete issues" ON public.workstation_issues FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (public.is_privileged());

-- 5. REALTIME PUBLICATION
DO $$ BEGIN
  BEGIN ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.workstations; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
  BEGIN ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.workstation_issues; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
  BEGIN ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.issue_categories; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END;
END $$;
`;

const SEED_CATEGORIES = [
  { name: 'OS Boot Failure', type: 'software', color: '#EF4444', icon: 'MonitorX', default_severity: 'high', sort_order: 1 },
  { name: 'Blue Screen / Kernel Panic', type: 'software', color: '#3B82F6', icon: 'AlertOctagon', default_severity: 'high', sort_order: 2 },
  { name: 'No Display / Black Screen', type: 'hardware', color: '#F59E0B', icon: 'Tv2', default_severity: 'medium', sort_order: 3 },
  { name: 'LAN / Internet Disconnected', type: 'network', color: '#6366F1', icon: 'WifiOff', default_severity: 'medium', sort_order: 4 },
  { name: 'Keyboard / Mouse Fault', type: 'peripheral', color: '#10B981', icon: 'Mouse', default_severity: 'low', sort_order: 5 },
  { name: 'Power Supply / Won\'t Turn On', type: 'hardware', color: '#DC2626', icon: 'ZapOff', default_severity: 'critical', sort_order: 6 },
  { name: 'Overheating / Fan Noise', type: 'hardware', color: '#EA580C', icon: 'Flame', default_severity: 'medium', sort_order: 7 },
  { name: 'Software Missing / Expired License', type: 'software', color: '#8B5CF6', icon: 'FileCode2', default_severity: 'low', sort_order: 8 },
  { name: 'Audio / Headphone Jack Defect', type: 'peripheral', color: '#06B6D4', icon: 'Headphones', default_severity: 'low', sort_order: 9 },
  { name: 'Other Workstation Issue', type: 'other', color: '#64748B', icon: 'HelpCircle', default_severity: 'medium', sort_order: 10 },
]

async function run() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('--- Applying Workstation Migration Schema ---')
    await client.query(MIGRATION_SQL)
    console.log('✓ Tables, indexes, RLS policies, and realtime publications created!')

    console.log('--- Seeding Default Issue Categories ---')
    for (const cat of SEED_CATEGORIES) {
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.issue_categories (name, type, color, icon, default_severity, sort_order)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
        ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
      `, [cat.name, cat.type, cat.color, cat.icon, cat.default_severity, cat.sort_order])
    }
    console.log(`✓ Seeded ${SEED_CATEGORIES.length} default issue categories.`)

    console.log('--- Seeding Workstations for Computer Lab (comp) ---')
    // Check if comp already has workstations
    const existingWs = await client.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.workstations WHERE lab_id = 'comp';`)
    const count = parseInt(existingWs.rows[0].count, 10)
    if (count === 0) {
      // Teacher Desk: top center
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.workstations (lab_id, label, pos_x, pos_y, device_type, row_label)
        VALUES ('comp', 'Teacher-01', 50.0, 14.0, 'desktop', 'Teacher Station');
      `)

      // Rows A, B, C, D (8 computers each across X: 12% to 88%)
      const rows = [
        { label: 'Row A', y: 32.0, startNum: 1 },
        { label: 'Row B', y: 50.0, startNum: 9 },
        { label: 'Row C', y: 68.0, startNum: 17 },
        { label: 'Row D', y: 86.0, startNum: 25 },
      ]

      const xPositions = [12.0, 22.8, 33.6, 44.4, 55.6, 66.4, 77.2, 88.0]

      let seededCount = 1
      for (const row of rows) {
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
          const num = row.startNum + i
          const label = `PC-${String(num).padStart(2, '0')}`
          const posX = xPositions[i]
          const posY = row.y
          await client.query(`
            INSERT INTO public.workstations (lab_id, label, pos_x, pos_y, device_type, row_label)
            VALUES ('comp', $1, $2, $3, 'desktop', $4);
          `, [label, posX, posY, row.label])
          seededCount++
        }
      }
      console.log(`✓ Seeded ${seededCount} workstations for lab 'comp' in 4 rows + teacher podium!`)
    } else {
      console.log(`✓ Workstations for lab 'comp' already exist (${count} stations). Skipping seed.`)
    }

    console.log('--- Verifying Created Data ---')
    const catRes = await client.query(`SELECT id, name, type, color, default_severity FROM public.issue_categories ORDER BY sort_order;`)
    console.log(`Active categories (${catRes.rows.length}):`, catRes.rows.map(r => `${r.name} (${r.type})`))

    const wsRes = await client.query(`SELECT id, label, row_label, pos_x, pos_y FROM public.workstations WHERE lab_id = 'comp' ORDER BY label LIMIT 5;`)
    console.log('Sample workstations in comp:', wsRes.rows)

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Migration error:', err)
    throw err
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

run().catch(() => process.exit(1))
