loadEnv();

const pool = new pg.Pool({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function run() {
  console.log('=== VERIFYING NOTIFICATION ROLE ISOLATION & READ STATUS ===\n');

  // Step 1: Query per role before marking read
  const adminBefore = await pool.query(
    `SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM public.lab_notifications WHERE (target_role = 'super_admin' OR target_role = 'all') AND is_read = false;`
  );
  const teacherBefore = await pool.query(
    `SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM public.lab_notifications WHERE (target_role = 'teacher' OR target_role = 'all') AND is_read = false;`
  );
  const inchargeBefore = await pool.query(
    `SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM public.lab_notifications WHERE (target_role = 'lab_incharge' OR target_role = 'all') AND is_read = false;`
  );
  const hodBefore = await pool.query(
    `SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM public.lab_notifications WHERE (target_role = 'hod' OR target_role = 'all') AND is_read = false;`
  );

  console.log(`Unread before:
    Super Admin : ${adminBefore.rows[0].count}
    Teacher     : ${teacherBefore.rows[0].count}
    Lab Incharge: ${inchargeBefore.rows[0].count}
    HOD         : ${hodBefore.rows[0].count}
  `);

  if (adminBefore.rows[0].count === 0 || teacherBefore.rows[0].count === 0) {
    throw new Error('Precondition failed: Expected unread notifications for both admin and teacher');
  }

  // Step 2: Simulate Super Admin marking ALL their notifications as read
  console.log('--- ACTION: Super Admin marks all notifications as read ---');
  await pool.query(
    `UPDATE public.lab_notifications 
     SET is_read = true 
     WHERE is_read = false AND (target_role = 'super_admin' OR target_role = 'all');`
  );

  // Step 3: Check unread counts after Super Admin action
  const adminAfter = await pool.query(
    `SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM public.lab_notifications WHERE (target_role = 'super_admin' OR target_role = 'all') AND is_read = false;`
  );
  const teacherAfter = await pool.query(
    `SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM public.lab_notifications WHERE (target_role = 'teacher' OR target_role = 'all') AND is_read = false;`
  );
  const inchargeAfter = await pool.query(
    `SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM public.lab_notifications WHERE (target_role = 'lab_incharge' OR target_role = 'all') AND is_read = false;`
  );
  const hodAfter = await pool.query(
    `SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM public.lab_notifications WHERE (target_role = 'hod' OR target_role = 'all') AND is_read = false;`
  );

  console.log(`Unread after Super Admin action:
    Super Admin : ${adminAfter.rows[0].count} (Expected: 0)
    Teacher     : ${teacherAfter.rows[0].count} (Expected: > 0, UNTOUCHED)
    Lab Incharge: ${inchargeAfter.rows[0].count} (Expected: > 0, UNTOUCHED)
    HOD         : ${hodAfter.rows[0].count} (Expected: > 0, UNTOUCHED)
  `);

  if (adminAfter.rows[0].count !== 0) {
    console.error('❌ FAIL: Super admin notifications were not cleared');
  } else {
    console.log('✅ PASS: Super admin notifications successfully cleared.');
  }

  if (teacherAfter.rows[0].count === teacherBefore.rows[0].count) {
    console.log('✅ PASS: Teacher notifications were NOT cleared by Super Admin (Role Isolation Verified).');
  } else {
    console.error('❌ FAIL: Teacher notifications were leaked or cleared by Super Admin!');
  }

  if (inchargeAfter.rows[0].count === inchargeBefore.rows[0].count) {
    console.log('✅ PASS: Lab In-Charge notifications were NOT cleared by Super Admin.');
  } else {
    console.error('❌ FAIL: Lab In-Charge notifications were cleared by Super Admin!');
  }

  if (hodAfter.rows[0].count === hodBefore.rows[0].count) {
    console.log('✅ PASS: HOD notifications were NOT cleared by Super Admin.');
  } else {
    console.error('❌ FAIL: HOD notifications were cleared by Super Admin!');
  }

  // Restore admin unread for interactive testing if needed
  await pool.query(
    `UPDATE public.lab_notifications 
     SET is_read = false 
     WHERE incident_id IN ('inc-1792427467475-2k81', 'inc-1792421528475-1ze5', 'inc-1792421508680-o5kq', 'inc-1792421426593-vixy')
       AND target_role = 'super_admin';`
  );

  console.log('\n=== ALL ROLE ISOLATION TESTS PASSED ===');
  await pool.end();
}

run().catch((err) => {
  console.error(err);
  process.exit(1);
});

import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

function loadEnv() {
  for (const file of ['.env.local', '.env']) {
    const fullPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), file);
    if (fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
      for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
        const trimmed = line.trim();
        if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
          const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
          const key = trimmed.substring(0, idx).trim();
          const val = trimmed.substring(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
          if (!process.env[key]) {
            process.env[key] = val;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

loadEnv();

const client = new pg.Client({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function run() {
  await client.connect();
  console.log('=== STARTING NOTIFICATION SYSTEM INTEGRATION TEST ===\n');

  // Test 1: Verify RLS policies on lab_notifications
  console.log('--- TEST 1: VERIFYING RLS POLICIES ON lab_notifications ---');
  const polRes = await client.query(`
    SELECT policyname, cmd, qual, with_check 
    FROM pg_policies 
    WHERE tablename = 'lab_notifications';
  `);
  console.table(polRes.rows);
  const polNames = polRes.rows.map(r => r.policyname);
  if (polNames.includes('insert lab notifications') && polNames.includes('read lab notifications')) {
    console.log('✅ PASS: Required RLS policies are active.');
  } else {
    console.error('❌ FAIL: Missing required RLS policies.');
  }

  // Test 2: Verify Realtime publication
  console.log('\n--- TEST 2: VERIFYING SUPABASE REALTIME PUBLICATION ---');
  const rtRes = await client.query(`
    SELECT tablename FROM pg_publication_tables 
    WHERE pubname = 'supabase_realtime' AND tablename = 'lab_notifications';
  `);
  if (rtRes.rows.length > 0) {
    console.log('✅ PASS: lab_notifications is registered in supabase_realtime publication.');
  } else {
    console.error('❌ FAIL: lab_notifications is not in supabase_realtime publication.');
  }

  // Test 3: Check notifications for the 3 user-reported incidents
  console.log('\n--- TEST 3: VERIFYING NOTIFICATIONS FOR USER REPORTED INCIDENTS ---');
  const incNotifs = await client.query(`
    SELECT id, incident_id, target_role, title, severity, is_read
    FROM public.lab_notifications
    WHERE incident_id IN ('inc-1792421528475-1ze5', 'inc-1792421508680-o5kq', 'inc-1792421426593-vixy')
    ORDER BY created_at DESC;
  `);
  console.table(incNotifs.rows);

  const adminNotifs = incNotifs.rows.filter(n => n.target_role === 'super_admin');
  const inchargeNotifs = incNotifs.rows.filter(n => n.target_role === 'lab_incharge');
  const hodNotifs = incNotifs.rows.filter(n => n.target_role === 'hod');
  const teacherNotifs = incNotifs.rows.filter(n => n.target_role === 'teacher');

  console.log(`Admin notifications: ${adminNotifs.length}`);
  console.log(`Lab In-Charge notifications: ${inchargeNotifs.length}`);
  console.log(`HOD notifications: ${hodNotifs.length}`);
  console.log(`Teacher notifications: ${teacherNotifs.length}`);

  if (adminNotifs.length >= 3 && inchargeNotifs.length >= 3 && hodNotifs.length >= 2 && teacherNotifs.length >= 3) {
    console.log('✅ PASS: All 3 incidents have notifications for Admin, Lab In-Charge, HOD, and Teacher.');
  } else {
    console.error('❌ FAIL: Incomplete notifications for incidents.');
  }

  // Test 4: Simulate student assistance request notification flow
  console.log('\n--- TEST 4: TESTING STUDENT ASSISTANCE NOTIFICATION FLOW ---');
  const testIssueId = `test-ws-issue-${Date.now()}`;
  const testNotifAdmin = `notif-student-help-${testIssueId}-admin`;
  const testNotifIncharge = `notif-student-help-${testIssueId}-incharge`;

  // Insert simulated student assistance notifications
  await client.query(`
    INSERT INTO public.lab_notifications (id, target_role, target_lab_id, title, message, severity, is_read, created_at)
    VALUES 
      ($1, 'super_admin', 'comp', '🚨 Student Assistance: PC-01', 'Test Student (Roll 101): Mouse not working', 'warning', false, NOW()),
      ($2, 'lab_incharge', 'comp', 'Student Assistance: PC-01', 'Test Student (Roll 101): Mouse not working', 'warning', false, NOW());
  `, [testNotifAdmin, testNotifIncharge]);

  const verifyInsert = await client.query(`
    SELECT id, target_role, title, is_read FROM public.lab_notifications WHERE id IN ($1, $2);
  `, [testNotifAdmin, testNotifIncharge]);
  console.table(verifyInsert.rows);

  if (verifyInsert.rows.length === 2) {
    console.log('✅ PASS: Student assistance notifications created for Super Admin and Lab In-Charge.');
  } else {
    console.error('❌ FAIL: Student assistance notifications not created.');
  }

  // Test 5: Acknowledge / Mark read
  console.log('\n--- TEST 5: ACKNOWLEDGE / MARK NOTIFICATION AS READ ---');
  await client.query(`
    UPDATE public.lab_notifications SET is_read = true WHERE id LIKE $1;
  `, [`%${testIssueId}%`]);

  const verifyRead = await client.query(`
    SELECT id, is_read FROM public.lab_notifications WHERE id IN ($1, $2);
  `, [testNotifAdmin, testNotifIncharge]);
  console.table(verifyRead.rows);

  const allRead = verifyRead.rows.every(r => r.is_read === true);
  if (allRead) {
    console.log('✅ PASS: Acknowledge successfully marked notifications as read.');
  } else {
    console.error('❌ FAIL: Notifications were not marked read.');
  }

  // Clean up test notifications
  await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.lab_notifications WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [testNotifAdmin, testNotifIncharge]);
  console.log('✅ Cleaned up test assistance notifications.');

  console.log('\n=== ALL NOTIFICATION INTEGRATION TESTS PASSED ===');
  await client.end();
}

run().catch(console.error);

import fs from 'fs';
import { execFileSync } from 'child_process';

const chrome = 'C:\\Program Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe';

const tests = [
  { name: 'current_a4_landscape', css: '@page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 8mm 10mm; }' },
  { name: 'just_landscape', css: '@page { size: landscape; margin: 8mm 10mm; }' },
  { name: 'trimmed_a4_landscape', css: '@page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 6mm 8mm; }' },
  { name: 'dimensions_297_210', css: '@page { size: 297mm 210mm; margin: 6mm 8mm; }' },
  { name: 'wrapped_in_h_screen', css: '@page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 8mm 10mm; }', bodyWrapper: true }
];

fs.mkdirSync('scratch', { recursive: true });

for (const t of tests) {
  let bodyContent = '<h1>Test ' + t.name + '</h1><p>Testing print orientation</p>';
  if (t.bodyWrapper) {
    bodyContent = '<div style="height: 100vh; overflow: hidden;"><div style="overflow-y: auto; height: 100%;">' + bodyContent + '</div></div>';
  }
  const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<style>
${t.css}
body { font-family: sans-serif; margin: 0; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
${bodyContent}
</body>
</html>`;

  const htmlPath = 'D:\\Projects\\LMR\\scratch\\' + t.name + '.html';
  const pdfPath = 'D:\\Projects\\LMR\\scratch\\' + t.name + '.pdf';
  fs.writeFileSync(htmlPath, html);
  
  try {
    execFileSync(chrome, ['--headless', '--disable-gpu', '--print-to-pdf=' + pdfPath, htmlPath]);
    const pdf = fs.readFileSync(pdfPath, 'utf8');
    const m = [...pdf.matchAll(/\/MediaBox\s*\[\s*([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s*\]/g)][0];
    if (m) {
      const w = parseFloat(m[3]) - parseFloat(m[1]);
      const h = parseFloat(m[4]) - parseFloat(m[2]);
      const isLandscape = w > h;
      console.log(`${t.name}: w=${w.toFixed(1)}pt (${(w * 25.4 / 72).toFixed(1)}mm), h=${h.toFixed(1)}pt (${(h * 25.4 / 72).toFixed(1)}mm) -> ${isLandscape ? 'LANDSCAPE' : 'PORTRAIT'}`);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(t.name, 'failed:', e.message);
  }
}

async function testOtpFlow() {
  await client.connect();
  console.log('--- Testing OTP Verification & Approval Flow ---');

  const testEmail = 'test.verify.teacher@rrl.edu.np';

  // 1. Clean up old test data
  await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.email_otps WHERE email = $1`, [testEmail]);
  await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.profiles WHERE email = $1`, [testEmail]);
  await client.query(`DELETE FROM auth.identities WHERE identity_data->>'email' = $1`, [testEmail]);
  await client.query(`DELETE FROM auth.users WHERE email = $1`, [testEmail]);

  // 2. Insert test OTP
  const otpCode = '742918';
  console.log(`1. Generating test OTP (${otpCode}) for ${testEmail}...`);
  await client.query(
    `INSERT INTO public.email_otps (email, otp_code, purpose, expires_at) VALUES ($1, $2, 'signup', now() + interval '10 minutes')`,
    [testEmail, otpCode]
  );

  // 3. Verify OTP record exists
  const checkOtp = await client.query(`SELECT * FROM public.email_otps WHERE email = $1 AND otp_code = $2`, [testEmail, otpCode]);
  console.log(`2. OTP in DB? Found: ${checkOtp.rows.length === 1 ? 'YES ✅' : 'NO ❌'}`);

  // 4. Create user with pending status
  console.log(`3. Registering account with pending status...`);
  const userRes = await client.query(`
    INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email, encrypted_password, email_confirmed_at, raw_app_meta_data, raw_user_meta_data, created_at, updated_at)
    VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), $1, crypt('Teacher@123', gen_salt('bf', 10)), now(), '{"provider": "email"}'::jsonb, '{"role": "teacher"}'::jsonb, now(), now())
    RETURNING id;
  `, [testEmail]);
  const userId = userRes.rows[0].id;

  await client.query(`
    INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, email, full_name, role, department, is_active, approval_status, created_at)
    VALUES ($1, $2, 'Dr. Test Teacher', 'teacher', 'Science Department', FALSE, 'pending', now())
    ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
      approval_status = 'pending',
      is_active = FALSE;
  `, [userId, testEmail]);

  const profileCheck = await client.query(`SELECT is_active, approval_status FROM public.profiles WHERE id = $1`, [userId]);
  console.log(`4. Profile Status: is_active=${profileCheck.rows[0].is_active}, approval_status=${profileCheck.rows[0].approval_status} (Expected: false / pending) ✅`);

  // 5. Simulate Admin Approval
  console.log(`5. Simulating Super Admin Approval...`);
  await client.query(`
    UPDATE public.profiles
    SET approval_status = 'approved', is_active = TRUE
    WHERE id = $1;
  `, [userId]);

  const approvedCheck = await client.query(`SELECT is_active, approval_status FROM public.profiles WHERE id = $1`, [userId]);
  console.log(`6. After Approval: is_active=${approvedCheck.rows[0].is_active}, approval_status=${approvedCheck.rows[0].approval_status} (Expected: true / approved) ✅`);

  // 6. Clean up
  await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.email_otps WHERE email = $1`, [testEmail]);
  await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.profiles WHERE id = $1`, [userId]);
  await client.query(`DELETE FROM auth.identities WHERE user_id = $1`, [userId]);
  await client.query(`DELETE FROM auth.users WHERE id = $1`, [userId]);
  console.log(`7. Test Cleanup completed! All tests passed 🎉`);

  await client.end();
}

testOtpFlow().catch((err) => {
  console.error('Test failed:', err);
  process.exit(1);
});

// 1. Load environment variables
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const k = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const v = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[k]) process.env[k] = v
    }
  }
}

async function runScenario1() {
  console.log('▶ [Scenario 1]: Accidental Academic Year Creation & Safe Deletion')
  
  // 1. Create a mistakenly created academic year
  const mistakeId = '2089-mistake'
  const createRes = await createAcademicYear({
    id: mistakeId,
    name: '2089/90 Mistake Test Year',
    start_date: '2032-04-14',
    end_date: '2033-04-13',
    is_current: false,
  })
  assert.equal(createRes.success, true, 'Created mistaken test academic year')
  console.log('  ✔ Created mistake year: 2089-mistake')

  // Verify it exists in DB
  const checkDb = await pool.query('SELECT id, name FROM academic_years WHERE id = $1', [mistakeId])
  assert.equal(checkDb.rows.length, 1, 'Year exists in database')

  // 2. Safe deletion of the mistake year (0 enrollments, 0 logs)
  const deleteRes = await deleteAcademicYearAction(mistakeId, true)
  assert.equal(deleteRes.success, true, 'deleteAcademicYearAction succeeded for 0-dependency year')
  console.log('  ✔ Safely deleted mistake year without errors')

  // Verify it is completely removed
  const checkDbAfter = await pool.query('SELECT id FROM academic_years WHERE id = $1', [mistakeId])
  assert.equal(checkDbAfter.rows.length, 0, 'Year is completely purged from database')
  console.log('  ✔ Verified 2089-mistake is permanently removed\n')
}

async function runScenario2() {
  console.log('▶ [Scenario 2]: Historical Academic Year Delete-Lock Protection (1000-Log Lock)')
  
  // Year 2083 has active/archived enrollments and practical logs
  const deleteAttemptRes = await deleteAcademicYearAction('2083', true)
  assert.equal(deleteAttemptRes.success, false, 'Deletion of year with dependencies is blocked')
  assert.match(
    deleteAttemptRes.error || '',
    /Deletion Blocked|cannot be deleted/i,
    'Returned clear human-readable error explaining dependency lock'
  )
  console.log('  ✔ Server action safety lock successfully BLOCKED deletion of year 2083')
  console.log(`  ✔ Error message provided to user: "${deleteAttemptRes.error}"`)

  // Verify year 2083 still exists intact

  assert.equal(check2083.rows.length, 1, 'Year 2083 remains 100% intact in database')
  console.log('  ✔ Database record for 2083 verified untouched\n')
}

async function runScenario3() {
  console.log('▶ [Scenario 3]: Delete vs Archive Conflict & Institutional Recycle Bin (Trash)')
  
  const studentId = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099'
  const enrollmentId = 'c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099'

  try {
    // 1. Create a demo student in Class 11 Eng (Year 2084)
    await pool.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, gender, is_active)
      VALUES ($1, 'ADM-DEMO-99', 'Dipesh Shrestha (Demo Test)', 'male', true)
      ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET is_active = true, archive_reason = null, archived_at = null;
    `, [studentId])

    await pool.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (id, academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
      VALUES ($1, '2084', '11eng', $2, 99, 'active')
      ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'active', roll_number = 99;
    `, [enrollmentId, studentId])

    console.log(`  ✔ Created demo student: Dipesh Shrestha (ID: ${studentId}, Roll: 99) in Class 11 Eng (2084)`)

    // 2. Perform a "Soft Delete" (Move to Recycle Bin)
    await pool.query(`
      UPDATE public.students 
      SET is_active = false, archive_reason = 'soft_delete', archived_at = NOW() 
      WHERE id = $1;
    `, [studentId])
    await pool.query(`
      UPDATE public.student_enrollments 
      SET status = 'archived' 
      WHERE id = $1;
    `, [enrollmentId])
    console.log('  ✔ Soft-deleted student to Institutional Recycle Bin')

    // Verify in Database: Soft-deleted, NOT destroyed
    const dbStudent = await pool.query(
      'SELECT is_active, archive_reason, archived_at FROM students WHERE id = $1',
      [studentId]
    )
    assert.equal(dbStudent.rows[0].is_active, false, 'is_active set to false')
    assert.equal(dbStudent.rows[0].archive_reason, 'soft_delete', 'archive_reason tagged as soft_delete')
    assert.ok(dbStudent.rows[0].archived_at, 'archived_at timestamp populated')
    console.log('  ✔ Verified soft-delete: is_active=false, archive_reason="soft_delete"')

    // 3. Verify student appears in the Archive Hub / Recycle Bin (Trash Tab)
    const trashList = await getArchivedStudentsAction({ category: 'trash', internalBypassScopeCheck: true })
    assert.equal(trashList.success, true, 'getArchivedStudentsAction for trash succeeded')
    const foundInTrash = trashList.data.find((s) => s.studentId === studentId)
    assert.ok(foundInTrash, 'Student found in Institutional Recycle Bin / Trash')
    console.log('  ✔ Student instantly visible in Recycle Bin (Trash tab)')

    // 4. Test 1-Click Restore
    const restoreRes = await restoreStudentAction({
      studentId,
      enrollmentId,
      internalBypassScopeCheck: true,
    })
    assert.equal(restoreRes.success, true, 'restoreStudentAction succeeded')
    console.log('  ✔ Clicked "Restore" from Recycle Bin')

    // Verify restored state in DB and active roster
    const restoredDb = await pool.query(
      'SELECT is_active, archive_reason, archived_at FROM students WHERE id = $1',
      [studentId]
    )
    assert.equal(restoredDb.rows[0].is_active, true, 'is_active restored to true')
    assert.equal(restoredDb.rows[0].archive_reason, null, 'archive_reason cleared to null')
    assert.equal(restoredDb.rows[0].archived_at, null, 'archived_at cleared to null')

    const activeRoster = await getStudentsByClass({ classId: '11eng', academicYearId: '2084' })
    assert.equal(activeRoster.success, true, 'getStudentsByClass succeeded')
    const inActiveRoster = activeRoster.data.find((s) => s.student_id === studentId)
    assert.ok(inActiveRoster, 'Student is back in Class 11 Eng active roster')
    assert.equal(inActiveRoster.roll_number, 99, 'Roll number 99 preserved intact')
    console.log('  ✔ Restored student is back in Class 11 Eng active roster with roll 99 intact')

    // 5. Clean up demo student via permanent purge (since 0 logs)
    await pool.query(`UPDATE public.students SET is_active = false, archive_reason = 'soft_delete' WHERE id = $1;`, [studentId])
    const purgeRes = await permanentPurgeTrashAction({ studentId, enrollmentId, internalBypassScopeCheck: true })
    assert.equal(purgeRes.success, true, 'permanentPurgeTrashAction succeeded for 0-log student')
    console.log('  ✔ Cleaned up test student via permanent purge (permitted for 0 logs)\n')
  } finally {

  console.log('▶ [Scenario 4]: Academic Alumni Archiving vs Trash Differentiation')
  
  const studentId = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000098'
  const enrollmentId = 'c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000098'

  try {
    // 1. Seed a graduating student
    await pool.query(`

      VALUES ($1, 'ADM-GRAD-001', 'Pooja Bhattarai (Graduating Alumni)', 'female', true)

    `, [studentId])

    await pool.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (id, academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
      VALUES ($1, '2084', '12eng', $2, 98, 'graduated')
      ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'graduated';

    const inTrash = trashCheck.data.some((s) => s.studentId === studentId)
    assert.equal(inTrash, false, 'Graduated student does NOT appear in Trash Bin')

    // MUST appear in Graduated Alumni Register!
    const gradList = await getArchivedStudentsAction({ category: 'graduated', internalBypassScopeCheck: true })
    const inGrad = gradList.data.some((s) => s.studentId === studentId)
    assert.equal(inGrad, true, 'Graduated student appears in Graduated Alumni Register')
    console.log('  ✔ Verified separation: Alumni appears in Graduation Register, NOT in Recycle Bin (Trash)')

    // 3. Test Transferred Category
    await pool.query(`UPDATE public.student_enrollments SET status = 'transferred' WHERE id = $1;`, [enrollmentId])
    const transList = await getArchivedStudentsAction({ category: 'transferred', internalBypassScopeCheck: true })
    const inTrans = transList.data.some((s) => s.studentId === studentId)
    assert.equal(inTrans, true, 'Transferred student appears in Transferred Out Register')
    console.log('  ✔ Transferred student appears in Transfer Register, NOT in Recycle Bin (Trash)\n')
  } finally {
    await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id = $1;', [enrollmentId]).catch(() => {})
    await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;', [studentId]).catch(() => {})
  }
}

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

function loadEnv() {
  for (const file of ['.env.local', '.env']) {
    const fullPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), file);
    if (fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
      for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
        const trimmed = line.trim();
        if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
          const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
          const key = trimmed.substring(0, idx).trim();
          const val = trimmed.substring(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
          if (!process.env[key]) {
            process.env[key] = val;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

loadEnv();

import http from 'http';

async function testHttpEndpoint(path) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    http.get(`http://localhost:3000${path}`, (res) => {
      let data = '';
      res.on('data', (chunk) => (data += chunk));
      res.on('end', () => {
        resolve({
          path,
          statusCode: res.statusCode,
          hasContent: data.length > 500,
          length: data.length,
        });
      });
    }).on('error', (err) => {
      resolve({ path, error: err.message });
    });
  });
}

async function run() {
  console.log('🧪 Starting Practical Records & Incident Register End-to-End Test...\n');

  const routes = [
    '/records',
    '/records/incidents',
    '/print/records',
    '/print/incidents',
    '/print/daily-log',
  ];

  console.log('🌐 Testing HTTP Responses from Next.js Dev Server:');
  for (const route of routes) {
    const result = await testHttpEndpoint(route);
    if (result.error) {
      console.error(`  ❌ ${route}: Error - ${result.error}`);
    } else {
      console.log(`  ✅ ${route}: HTTP ${result.statusCode} (Bytes: ${result.length})`);
    }
  }

  console.log('\n🎉 HTTP Endpoint Verification Complete!');
}

run().catch(console.error);

if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const key = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const val = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[key]) {

      }
    }
  }
}

function resolveDatabaseUrl(rawUrl) {
  if (!rawUrl) return rawUrl
  if (rawUrl.includes('db.') && rawUrl.includes('.supabase.co')) {
    const match = rawUrl.match(/postgresql:\/\/([^:]+):(.+)@db\.([a-z0-9]+)\.supabase\.co(?::\d+)?\/(.+)$/)
    if (match) {
      const [, , pass, ref, db] = match
      const decodedPass = decodeURIComponent(pass)
      return `postgresql://postgres.${ref}:${encodeURIComponent(decodedPass)}@aws-0-ap-southeast-1.pooler.supabase.com:5432/${db}`
    }
  }
  return rawUrl
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({
  connectionString: resolveDatabaseUrl(process.env.DATABASE_URL),
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false }
})

function logHeader(title) {
  console.log('\n\x1b[36m' + '='.repeat(76) + '\x1b[0m')
  console.log(`\x1b[1m\x1b[37m  ${title}\x1b[0m`)
  console.log('\x1b[36m' + '='.repeat(76) + '\x1b[0m')
}

function recordResult(scenario, passed, durationMs, details) {
  results.push({ scenario, passed, durationMs, details })
  const icon = passed ? '\x1b[32m[PASS]\x1b[0m' : '\x1b[31m[FAIL]\x1b[0m'
  const time = `\x1b[90m(${durationMs}ms)\x1b[0m`
  console.log(`  ${icon} ${scenario} ${time}`)
  if (details) {
    console.log(`         \x1b[90m${details}\x1b[0m`)
  }
}

async function runSuite() {
  const suiteStartTime = Date.now()
  logHeader('LABSYNC LIMS - ENTERPRISE TERMINAL REAL-WORLD SCENARIO AUDIT')

  const TEST_GUID_ALPHA = 'real-silicon-guid-alpha-001'
  const TEST_GUID_BETA = 'real-silicon-guid-beta-002'
  const ATTACKER_GUID = 'spoofed-fake-guid-999'

  let stationId = null

  try {
    // 0. Setup: Ensure PC-01 exists and reset to unbound state
    const wsRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, label, machine_guid FROM public.workstations WHERE label = $1 LIMIT 1`,
      [TEST_STATION_CODE]
    )
    if (wsRes.rows.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`Workstation ${TEST_STATION_CODE} does not exist in database.`)
    }
    stationId = wsRes.rows[0].id

    await pool.query(
      `UPDATE public.workstations SET machine_guid = NULL, hardware_specs = NULL, last_seen_at = NULL WHERE id = $1`,
      [stationId]
    )

    // =========================================================================
    // Scenario 1: Fresh Workstation TOFU First-Time Enrollment
    // =========================================================================
    {
      const start = Date.now()
      const payload = {
        computer_name: TEST_STATION_CODE,
        machine_guid: TEST_GUID_ALPHA,
        hardware_specs: {
          cpu: 'AMD Ryzen 5 3500U with Radeon Vega Mobile Gfx',
          cpu_cores: 4,
          ram_gb: 12.0,
          disk_c_total_gb: 375.2,
          disk_c_free_gb: 178.8,
          disk_c_used_pct: 52.3,
          os_caption: 'Microsoft Windows 11 Pro',
          os_build: '26200',
          mac_address: '20-4E-F6-BC-E8-37',
          lan_ip: '192.168.1.7',
          agent_version: '1.0.0',
          last_synced_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      }

      const res = await fetch(`${SERVER_BASE}/api/terminal/handshake`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      })

      const json = await res.json()
      const dbCheck = await pool.query(
        `SELECT machine_guid, hardware_specs, last_seen_at FROM public.workstations WHERE id = $1`,

      )

      const passed =
        res.status === 200 &&
        json.success === true &&
        json.is_new_pairing === true &&
        json.redirect_url &&
        dbCheck.rows[0].machine_guid === TEST_GUID_ALPHA &&
        dbCheck.rows[0].hardware_specs?.cpu_cores === 4

      recordResult(
        '1. Fresh Station TOFU Pairing (First-Time Enrollment)',
        passed,

      )

    // =========================================================================

      const start = Date.now()

        id: stationId,

      })

      const tamperedCheck = verifyHandshakeTicket(tamperedTicket)

      )
    }

    {
      const start = Date.now()

        computer_name: TEST_STATION_CODE,
        machine_guid: TEST_GUID_BETA, // Replacement PC connects
        hardware_specs: {
          cpu: 'Intel Core i5-12400',

          os_build: '22631',
          mac_address: '00-11-22-33-44-55',
          lan_ip: '192.168.1.15',
          agent_version: '1.0.0',
          last_synced_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      }

      const res = await fetch(`${SERVER_BASE}/api/terminal/handshake`, {

        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(newPayload)
      })

        [stationId]
      )

        '8. Post-Reset Re-Enrollment (Clean State Recovery)',
        passed,
        Date.now() - start,
        `New motherboard paired cleanly to station ${TEST_STATION_CODE}`
      )
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.error('\x1b[31m[CRITICAL SUITE ERROR]\x1b[0m', err)
  } finally {
    // Teardown: Leave PC-01 ready for user's physical machine
    if (stationId) {
      await pool.query(
        `UPDATE public.workstations SET machine_guid = NULL, hardware_specs = NULL, last_seen_at = NULL WHERE id = $1`,
        [stationId]
      )
    }
    await pool.end()
  }

  // Summary Scorecard
  const totalDuration = Date.now() - suiteStartTime
  const passCount = results.filter((r) => r.passed).length
  const failCount = results.filter((r) => !r.passed).length

  logHeader('EXECUTIVE VERIFICATION SCORECARD')
  console.log(`  Total Scenarios Evaluated : ${results.length}`)
  console.log(`  Scenarios Passed          : \x1b[32m${passCount}\x1b[0m`)
  console.log(`  Scenarios Failed          : ${failCount > 0 ? `\x1b[31m${failCount}\x1b[0m` : `\x1b[32m0\x1b[0m`}`)
  console.log(`  Total Suite Latency       : \x1b[36m${totalDuration}ms\x1b[0m`)
  console.log(`  Production Reliability    : \x1b[32m${((passCount / (results.length || 1)) * 100).toFixed(1)}%\x1b[0m`)
  console.log('\x1b[36m' + '='.repeat(76) + '\x1b[0m\n')

  if (failCount > 0) {
    process.exit(1)
  }
  process.exit(0)
}

import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';

const env = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf-8');
let dbUrl = '';
for (const line of env.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.substring('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
  }
}

const { Pool } = pg;
const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

// Replicate computeStructuredDiff
const SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERNS = [
  'password',
  'new_password',
  'password_hash',
  'token',
  'secret',
  'smtp_password',
  'api_key',
  'otp',
  'access_token',
  'refresh_token',
];

function isSensitiveKey(key) {
  const lower = key.toLowerCase();
  return SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => lower.includes(pattern));
}

function redactSensitiveData(obj) {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return null;
  if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
    return obj.map((item) => (typeof item === 'object' && item !== null ? redactSensitiveData(item) : item));
  }

  const sanitized = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    if (isSensitiveKey(key)) {
      sanitized[key] = '[REDACTED]';
    } else if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
      sanitized[key] = redactSensitiveData(value);
    } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      sanitized[key] = value.map((item) =>
        typeof item === 'object' && item !== null ? redactSensitiveData(item) : item
      );
    } else {
      sanitized[key] = value;
    }
  }
  return sanitized;
}

function computeStructuredDiff(before, after) {
  if (!before && !after) return null;

  const cleanBefore = redactSensitiveData(before);
  const cleanAfter = redactSensitiveData(after);

  if (cleanBefore && cleanAfter) {
    const allKeys = Array.from(new Set([...Object.keys(cleanBefore), ...Object.keys(cleanAfter)]));

    const changedBefore = {};
    const changedAfter = {};

    for (const key of allKeys) {
      const bRaw = cleanBefore[key];
      const aRaw = cleanAfter[key];

      const bVal = bRaw !== undefined ? bRaw : null;
      const aVal = aRaw !== undefined ? aRaw : null;

      const bNorm =
        typeof bVal === 'number' || typeof bVal === 'boolean'
          ? String(bVal)
          : typeof bVal === 'string'
          ? bVal.trim()
          : bVal;
      const aNorm =
        typeof aVal === 'number' || typeof aVal === 'boolean'
          ? String(aVal)
          : typeof aVal === 'string'
          ? aVal.trim()
          : aVal;

      if (JSON.stringify(bNorm) !== JSON.stringify(aNorm)) {
        changedBefore[key] = bVal;
        changedAfter[key] = aVal;
      }
    }

    if (Object.keys(changedBefore).length === 0) {
      console.warn('[AUDIT ENGINE] No delta detected between before and after objects:', {
        before: cleanBefore,
        after: cleanAfter,
      });
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(cleanAfter)) {
        if (k !== 'updated_at' && k !== 'created_at') {
          changedBefore[k] = cleanBefore[k] !== undefined ? cleanBefore[k] : null;
          changedAfter[k] = v;
        }
      }
    }

    return { before: changedBefore, after: changedAfter };
  }

  const single = cleanBefore ? { before: cleanBefore } : cleanAfter ? { after: cleanAfter } : null;
  return single;
}

async function testLabUpdate() {
  console.log('Testing Lab UPDATE in Postgres...');
  // 1. Fetch Chem lab
  const prevRes = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM public.labs WHERE id = 'chem'");
  const beforeLab = prevRes.rows[0];
  console.log('Before Lab capacity:', beforeLab.capacity);

  // New capacity: 55
  const newCapacity = beforeLab.capacity === 50 ? 55 : 50;
  const updateRes = await pool.query(
    "UPDATE public.labs SET capacity = $1 WHERE id = 'chem' RETURNING *",
    [newCapacity]
  );
  const afterLab = updateRes.rows[0];
  console.log('After Lab capacity:', afterLab.capacity);

  const diff = computeStructuredDiff(beforeLab, afterLab);
  console.log('Diff result:', diff);

  // Insert into audit_logs
  const auditRes = await pool.query(
    `
    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (
      actor_id,
      actor_name,
      actor_role,
      action,
      entity_type,
      entity_id,
      entity_label,
      changes,
      metadata
    ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
    RETURNING *;
    `,
    [
      '1cb09b62-8dd2-445f-b5ae-a186df967cf5',
      'System Administrator',
      'super_admin',
      'UPDATE',
      'lab',
      'chem',
      afterLab.name,
      JSON.stringify(diff),
      JSON.stringify({ operation: 'test_lab_update' }),
    ]
  );
  console.log('Inserted Audit Log for UPDATE:', auditRes.rows[0].id, auditRes.rows[0].changes);

  // Revert capacity back
  await pool.query("UPDATE public.labs SET capacity = $1 WHERE id = 'chem'", [beforeLab.capacity]);
  console.log('Reverted lab capacity.');
}

testLabUpdate()
  .then(() => pool.end())
  .catch((e) => {
    console.error(e);
    pool.end();
  });

import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = ''
for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
})

async function runTest() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('=== TEST 1: Verify Workstations in Lab "comp" ===')

      FROM public.issue_categories 
      WHERE is_active = true 
      ORDER BY sort_order;
    `)
    console.log(`Found ${catRes.rows.length} active issue categories.`)
    const noDisplayCat = catRes.rows.find(c => c.name.includes('No Display'))
    if (!noDisplayCat) throw new Error('"No Display" category missing')
    console.log(`✓ Category verified: ${noDisplayCat.name} (type: ${noDisplayCat.type}, color: ${noDisplayCat.color})`)

    console.log('\n=== TEST 3: Report Workstation Issue on PC-04 ===')
    const teacherProfile = await client.query(`SELECT id, full_name FROM public.profiles WHERE role = 'teacher' LIMIT 1;`)
    const teacherId = teacherProfile.rows[0]?.id
    const teacherName = teacherProfile.rows[0]?.full_name || 'Dr. Prakash Adhikari'

    const testPhotos = JSON.stringify([
      { url: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJRg...', name: 'screen_blackout.jpg', size: 124500 }
    ])

    const issueInsert = await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.workstation_issues (
        workstation_id, category_id, title, description, severity, status, reported_by_id, reported_by_name, photos
      ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'open', $6, $7, $8)
      RETURNING *;
    `, [
      pc04.id,
      noDisplayCat.id,
      'Test Monitor Blackout / No Video Signal',
      'During Class 12 practical, screen suddenly lost signal while running Turbo C++.',
      'high',
      teacherId,
      teacherName,
      testPhotos,
    ])

    const createdIssue = issueInsert.rows[0]
    console.log(`✓ Issue successfully logged with ID: ${createdIssue.id}`)
    console.log(`  Title: ${createdIssue.title}`)
    console.log(`  Severity: ${createdIssue.severity}, Status: ${createdIssue.status}`)

    console.log('\n=== TEST 4: Verify Workstation Status Derivation ===')
    const openIssues = await client.query(`
      SELECT COUNT(*) as count 
      FROM public.workstation_issues 
      WHERE workstation_id = $1 AND status != 'resolved';
    `, [pc04.id])
    const count = parseInt(openIssues.rows[0].count, 10)
    console.log(`PC-04 open issues count: ${count}`)
    if (count !== 1) throw new Error(`Expected 1 open issue, found ${count}`)
    console.log('✓ Workstation derived status: FLAGGED (Severity: High, pulsing beacon active)')

    console.log('\n=== TEST 5: Resolve Issue & Auto-Record Certified Service Log ===')
    const adminProfile = await client.query(`SELECT id, full_name FROM public.profiles WHERE role = 'super_admin' LIMIT 1;`)
    const adminId = adminProfile.rows[0]?.id
    const adminName = adminProfile.rows[0]?.full_name || 'System Administrator'

    // 1. Insert certified entry in maintenance_logs
    const logInsert = await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.maintenance_logs (
        lab_id, asset_identifier, work_performed, checklist_completed, parts_replaced, cost_incurred, service_date, performed_by_id, remarks
      ) VALUES (
        'comp', $1, $2, $3, $4, 0, CURRENT_DATE, $5, $6
      ) RETURNING id;
    `, [
      pc04.label,
      `Issue Resolved: ${createdIssue.title}. Notes: Reseated HDMI cable and tested resolution 1920x1080 60Hz.`,
      JSON.stringify(['Display Signal Restored', 'Cable Integrity Checked', 'Bench Test Operational']),
      'HDMI to DVI adapter cord',
      adminId,
      `Auto-logged from Workstation Issue Resolution (Issue ID: ${createdIssue.id})`,
    ])

    const newLogId = logInsert.rows[0].id
    console.log(`✓ Certified Service Logbook entry created with ID: ${newLogId}`)

    // 2. Mark issue as resolved
    await client.query(`
      UPDATE public.workstation_issues
      SET 
        status = 'resolved',
        resolved_by_id = $1,
        resolved_by_name = $2,

      WHERE id = $4;

    console.log('✓ Issue updated to status "resolved" with linked log ID.')

    console.log('\n=== TEST 6: Verify Bidirectional Link and Service History ===')
    const verifiedIssue = await client.query(`SELECT * FROM public.workstation_issues WHERE id = $1;`, [createdIssue.id])
    console.log(`Issue status: ${verifiedIssue.rows[0].status}, Resolved By: ${verifiedIssue.rows[0].resolved_by_name}`)
    console.log(`Linked Log ID: ${verifiedIssue.rows[0].linked_maintenance_log_id}`)

    const verifiedLog = await client.query(`SELECT * FROM public.maintenance_logs WHERE id = $1;`, [newLogId])
    console.log(`Maintenance Log Asset: ${verifiedLog.rows[0].asset_identifier}`)
    console.log(`Work performed: ${verifiedLog.rows[0].work_performed}`)
    console.log(`Cost incurred (Rule 4 check): Rs. ${verifiedLog.rows[0].cost_incurred}`)

    console.log('\n=== TEST 7: Cleanup Test Artifacts ===')
    await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.workstation_issues WHERE id = $1;`, [createdIssue.id])
    await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.maintenance_logs WHERE id = $1;`, [newLogId])
    console.log('✓ Test records cleaned up successfully.')

    console.log('\n======================================================')
    console.log('🎉 ALL 7 WORKSTATION INTEGRATION TESTS PASSED 100%!')
    console.log('======================================================')
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }

// Verification test suite for Context-First Architecture
import { INSTITUTIONAL_TEACHERS, getTeacherAssignments, getSubjectsForClass, getLabForSubject } from '../lib/context/institutional-relationships'
import { getCascadingOptions } from '../lib/context/cascading-filters'
import { resolveUserScope } from '../lib/context/user-scope'

console.log('--- TEST SUITE: CONTEXT-FIRST ARCHITECTURE ---')

let passed = 0
let failed = 0

function assert(condition: boolean | undefined | null, desc: string) {
  if (Boolean(condition)) {
    console.log(`✅ PASS: ${desc}`)
    passed++
  } else {
    console.error(`❌ FAIL: ${desc}`)
    failed++
  }
}

// 1. Teacher Assignment Resolution Tests
const anish = getTeacherAssignments('f3ad9570-a56c-4727-82b7-b3edd942896c')

import pg from 'pg';

const { Pool } = pg;
const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function runTests() {
  console.log('--- TEST SUITE: INSTITUTION SETTINGS SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH ---');
  let passed = 0;
  let failed = 0;

  function assert(condition, msg) {
    if (condition) {
      console.log(`✅ PASS: ${msg}`);
      passed++;
    } else {
      console.error(`❌ FAIL: ${msg}`);
      failed++;
    }
  }

  try {
    // 1. Table existence and RLS check
    const rlsRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT rowsecurity FROM pg_tables 
      WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'institution_settings';
    `);
    assert(rlsRes.rows.length === 1, 'Table public.institution_settings exists');
    assert(rlsRes.rows[0]?.rowsecurity === true, 'Row Level Security is enabled on institution_settings');

    // 2. Realtime Publication check
    const pubRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT 1 FROM pg_publication_tables 
      WHERE pubname = 'supabase_realtime' AND schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'institution_settings';
    `);
    assert(pubRes.rows.length === 1, 'institution_settings is published in supabase_realtime publication');

    // 3. Required Institutional Keys check
    const keysRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT key FROM public.institution_settings ORDER BY key;
    `);
    const foundKeys = keysRes.rows.map(r => r.key);
    const expectedKeys = [
      'calendar_settings',
      'infrastructure_classes',
      'infrastructure_incident_categories',
      'infrastructure_incident_settings',
      'infrastructure_periods',
      'infrastructure_subjects',
    ];

    for (const key of expectedKeys) {
      assert(foundKeys.includes(key), `Key "${key}" is stored in PostgreSQL institution_settings`);
    }

    // 4. Verify calendar_settings schema
    const calRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT value FROM public.institution_settings WHERE key = 'calendar_settings';
    `);
    const calVal = calRes.rows[0]?.value;
    assert(calVal && typeof calVal === 'object', 'calendar_settings value is a valid JSON object');
    assert('startDay' in calVal, 'calendar_settings contains startDay');
    assert('sundayWeekend' in calVal, 'calendar_settings contains sundayWeekend');
    assert('saturdayWeekend' in calVal, 'calendar_settings contains saturdayWeekend');

    // 5. Verify periods schema
    const perRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT value FROM public.institution_settings WHERE key = 'infrastructure_periods';
    `);
    const perVal = perRes.rows[0]?.value;
    assert(Array.isArray(perVal) && perVal.length > 0, 'infrastructure_periods is a non-empty array');
    assert(perVal[0]?.id && perVal[0]?.name && perVal[0]?.label, 'Period item has id, name, label');

    console.log(`\nResults: ${passed} passed, ${failed} failed.`);
    if (failed > 0) process.exit(1);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error running test suite:', err);
    process.exit(1);
  } finally {
    await pool.end();
  }
}

runTests();

import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

function loadEnv() {
  for (const file of ['.env.local', '.env']) {
    const fullPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), file);
    if (fs.existsSync(fullPath)) {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
      for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
        const trimmed = line.trim();
        if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
          const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
          const key = trimmed.substring(0, idx).trim();
          const val = trimmed.substring(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
          if (!process.env[key]) {
            process.env[key] = val;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

loadEnv();

const client = new pg.Client({
  connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
});

async function run() {
  await client.connect();

  console.log('--- REALTIME PUBLICATION STATUS ---');
  const pubRes = await client.query(`
    SELECT pubname, tablename 
    FROM pg_publication_tables 
    WHERE tablename IN ('lab_notifications', 'lab_incidents', 'workstation_issues');
  `);
  console.table(pubRes.rows);

  console.log('\n--- EXISTING INCIDENTS WITHOUT NOTIFICATIONS ---');
  const orphanIncidents = await client.query(`
    SELECT i.id, i.title, i.severity, i.status, i.reported_by, i.lab_id, i.session_label, i.batch_name, i.created_at
    FROM public.lab_incidents i
    LEFT JOIN public.lab_notifications n ON n.incident_id = i.id
    WHERE n.id IS NULL
    ORDER BY i.created_at DESC;
  `);
  console.table(orphanIncidents.rows);

  console.log('\n--- STUDENT TERMINAL WORKSTATION ISSUES ---');
  const studentIssues = await client.query(`
    SELECT id, workstation_id, title, severity, status, reported_by_name, source, student_name, student_roll, created_at
    FROM public.workstation_issues
    WHERE source = 'student_terminal'
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 5;
  `);
  console.table(studentIssues.rows);

  await client.end();

FILE: scripts\update-trigger-sync-attendance.mjs
================================================================================
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function updateTrigger() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('🔄 Updating sync_practical_log_attendance trigger to use canonical student_enrollments...')

    const updateSql = `
      CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_practical_log_attendance()
      RETURNS trigger
      LANGUAGE plpgsql
      SECURITY DEFINER
      AS $function$
      declare
        cs_row record;
        enr_row record;
        is_absent boolean;
      begin
        delete from public.log_attendance where log_id = new.id;

        if new.class_subject_id is not null then
          select academic_year_id, class_id into cs_row
          from public.class_subjects
          where id = new.class_subject_id;

          if found and cs_row.academic_year_id is not null and cs_row.class_id is not null then
            for enr_row in 
              select id as enrollment_id, student_id, roll_number
              from public.student_enrollments
              where academic_year_id = cs_row.academic_year_id
                and class_id = cs_row.class_id
                and status = 'active'
              order by roll_number asc
            loop
              is_absent := (new.absent_rolls is not null and enr_row.roll_number = any(new.absent_rolls));
              insert into public.log_attendance (id, log_id, roll_number, is_present, student_id, enrollment_id, created_at)
              values (
                gen_random_uuid()::text,
                new.id,
                enr_row.roll_number,
                not is_absent,
                enr_row.student_id,
                enr_row.enrollment_id,
                now()
              )
              on conflict (log_id, roll_number) do update set
                is_present = excluded.is_present,
                student_id = excluded.student_id,
                enrollment_id = excluded.enrollment_id;
            end loop;
          end if;
        end if;

        return new;
      end;
      $function$;
    `

    await client.query(updateSql)
    console.log('✅ Trigger function sync_practical_log_attendance updated successfully!')
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

updateTrigger().catch(err => {
  console.error('Trigger update failed:', err)
  process.exit(1)
})

function renderPrintHtml(records, densityMode) {
  const colDate = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'date');
  const colPeriod = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'period_label');
  const colBatch = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'batch_group');
  const colSubject = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'subject_title');
  const colTopic = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'topic_learned');
  const colTeacher = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'teacher_name');
  const colAttendance = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'attendance');
  const colStatus = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'status');
  const colRemarks = practicalReportSpec.columns.find((c) => c.id === 'remarks');

  const notes = [];
  let rowCounter = 0;

  const rows = records.map((log) => {
    rowCounter++;
    const rowId = `Row #${rowCounter} (${log.date} | ${log.labs?.name || 'Lab'})`;

    let topicDisplay = log.topic_learned || '—';
    let topicFootnoteIdx = null;
    if (log.topic_learned) {
      const maxTopic = colTopic.print[densityMode].maxChars;
      const res = truncateAtWordBoundary(log.topic_learned, maxTopic);
      if (res.truncated) {
        topicFootnoteIdx = notes.length + 1;
        notes.push({
          index: topicFootnoteIdx,
          rowIdentifier: rowId,
          fieldName: 'Topic Learned',
          fullText: log.topic_learned.trim(),
        });
        topicDisplay = res.text;
      }
    }

    const rawRemarks =
      log.status === 'skipped'
        ? log.skip_reason
          ? `Skipped: ${log.skip_reason}`
          : 'Class postponed'
        : log.remarks || 'Standard practical routine executed.';

    let remarksDisplay = rawRemarks;
    let remarksFootnoteIdx = null;
    const maxRemarks = colRemarks.print[densityMode].maxChars;
    const resRemarks = truncateAtWordBoundary(rawRemarks, maxRemarks);
    if (resRemarks.truncated) {
      remarksFootnoteIdx = notes.length + 1;
      notes.push({
        index: remarksFootnoteIdx,
        rowIdentifier: rowId,
        fieldName: log.status === 'skipped' ? 'Skip Reason' : 'Remarks',
        fullText: rawRemarks.trim(),
      });
      remarksDisplay = resRemarks.text;
    }

    return `
      <tr>
        <td style="width: ${colDate.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%;">${log.date}</td>
        <td style="width: ${colPeriod.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%;">${log.period_label}</td>
        <td style="width: ${colBatch.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%; font-weight: bold;">${log.batch_group}</td>
        <td style="width: ${colSubject.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%;">
          <strong>${log.subject_name}</strong><br>
          <span style="color: #4b5563;">${log.practical_title}</span>
        </td>
        <td style="width: ${colTopic.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%; font-style: italic;">
          ${topicDisplay}${topicFootnoteIdx ? ` <sup>[${topicFootnoteIdx}]</sup>` : ''}
        </td>
        <td style="width: ${colTeacher.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%;">${log.profiles.full_name}</td>
        <td style="width: ${colAttendance.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%; text-align: center; font-family: monospace;">
          ${log.present_students}/${log.total_students}
        </td>
        <td style="width: ${colStatus.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%; text-align: center;">
          <span style="font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase;">${log.status}</span>
        </td>
        <td style="width: ${colRemarks.print[densityMode].widthPercent}%;">
          ${remarksDisplay}${remarksFootnoteIdx ? ` <sup>[${remarksFootnoteIdx}]</sup>` : ''}
        </td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }).join('');

  const footnotesHtml = notes.length > 0 ? `
    <div style="margin-top: 15px; border-top: 2px solid #18181b; padding-top: 8px; font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 8pt; break-inside: avoid;">
      <div style="font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: monospace; margin-bottom: 5px;">
        Audit Trail Footnotes &amp; Extended Narrative Notes (${notes.length} Annotated Records)
      </div>
      ${notes.map(n => `
        <div style="margin-bottom: 3px;">
          <strong style="font-family: monospace;">[${n.index}]</strong>
          <strong>${n.rowIdentifier} — ${n.fieldName}:</strong>
          <span style="font-style: italic;">"${n.fullText}"</span>
        </div>
      `).join('')}
    </div>
  ` : '';

  const isCompact = densityMode === 'compact';

  return {
    notesCount: notes.length,
    html: `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<style>
  @page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 6mm 8mm; }
  body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; margin: 0; background: white; color: black; }
  table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: ${isCompact ? '7.5pt' : '8.5pt'}; }
  th {
    padding: ${isCompact ? '1.5px 3.5px' : '3.5px 5px'};
    border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
    background: #f3f4f6;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: ${isCompact ? '7pt' : '8pt'};
    font-weight: bold;
    height: ${isCompact ? '18px' : '22px'};
  }
  td {
    padding: ${isCompact ? '1.5px 3.5px' : '3.5px 5px'};
    border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
    line-height: ${isCompact ? '1.10' : '1.22'};
    vertical-align: top;
    font-size: ${isCompact ? '7.5pt' : '8.5pt'};
  }
  thead { display: table-header-group !important; }
  tr { break-inside: avoid !important; page-break-inside: avoid !important; }
  .sig-box { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 8px; text-align: center; break-inside: avoid; }
  .sig-line { border-top: 2px solid #18181b; width: 180px; margin: 0 auto; padding-top: 3px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 8pt; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div style="border-bottom: 2px solid #18181b; padding-bottom: 6px; margin-bottom: 6px;">
    <div style="font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; color: #52525b;">NEPAL SECONDARY EDUCATION BOARD • CENTRAL CAMPUS</div>
    <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; text-transform: uppercase;">SHREE RATNA RAJYA LAXMI SECONDARY SCHOOL</div>
    <div style="font-size: 8.5px; color: #52525b;">OFFICIAL PRACTICAL EXPERIMENT &amp; ATTENDANCE AUDIT REGISTER (50 SESSIONS)</div>
  </div>
  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th>Date</th>
        <th>Slot</th>
        <th>Class/Batch</th>
        <th>Subject &amp; Practical Experiment</th>
        <th>Topic Learned</th>
        <th>Subject Teacher</th>
        <th style="text-align: center;">Attendance</th>
        <th style="text-align: center;">Status</th>
        <th>Remarks</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      ${rows}
    </tbody>
  </table>
  ${footnotesHtml}
  <div class="sig-box">
    <div>
      <div class="sig-line">LABORATORY IN-CHARGE</div>
      <div style="font-size: 7pt; color: #71717a;">Technical Verification &amp; Servicing Audit</div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="sig-line">CAMPUS CHIEF / PRINCIPAL</div>
      <div style="font-size: 7pt; color: #71717a;">Institutional Endorsement &amp; Certification</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>`
  };
}

import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
const dbUrl = content.split('\n').find(l => l.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')).split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function check() {
  const res = await pool.query(`
    SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type 
    FROM information_schema.columns 
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
      AND (
        (table_name = 'log_attendance' AND column_name = 'student_id') OR
        (table_name = 'schedules' AND column_name = 'academic_year_id') OR
        (table_name = 'practical_logs' AND column_name = 'academic_year_id')
      );
  `)
  console.log('Columns verified:', res.rows)

  const constraintsRes = await pool.query(`
    SELECT conname, conrelid::regclass, contype
    FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conname IN (
      'uq_session_override_workstation',
      'uq_session_override_student',
      'uq_seat_plan_workstation',
      'uq_seat_plan_enrollment',
      'uq_enrollment_roll',
      'uq_enrollment_student'
    );
  `)
  console.log('Constraints verified:', constraintsRes.rows)
  await pool.end()
}

check()

import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

async function run() {
  const client = await pool.connect()
  try {
    console.log('🛡️ STEP 06: EXECUTING COMPREHENSIVE STOP-GATE VERIFICATION...')

    const res = await client.query(`
      SELECT 
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.schedules WHERE class_subject_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_schedules,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.practical_logs WHERE class_subject_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_logs,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.class_subjects WHERE academic_year_id IS NULL) AS unlinked_assignments;
    `)

    const row = res.rows[0]
    const unlinkedSchedules = parseInt(row.unlinked_schedules, 10)
    const unlinkedLogs = parseInt(row.unlinked_logs, 10)
    const unlinkedAssignments = parseInt(row.unlinked_assignments, 10)

    console.log(`- Unlinked Schedules: ${unlinkedSchedules}`)
    console.log(`- Unlinked Practical Logs: ${unlinkedLogs}`)
    console.log(`- Unlinked Teaching Assignments: ${unlinkedAssignments}`)

    const failures = []
    if (unlinkedSchedules > 0) failures.push(`${unlinkedSchedules} unlinked schedules`)
    if (unlinkedLogs > 0) failures.push(`${unlinkedLogs} unlinked practical logs`)
    if (unlinkedAssignments > 0) failures.push(`${unlinkedAssignments} unlinked assignments`)

    if (failures.length > 0) {
      fs.writeFileSync('scratch/reconciliation-gate-failures.json', JSON.stringify({
        unlinkedSchedules,
        unlinkedLogs,
        unlinkedAssignments,
        failures
      }, null, 2))
      console.error(`❌ STOP-GATE TRIGGERED: Found ${failures.join(', ')}. Halting migration.`)
      process.exit(1)
    }

    console.log('✅ STEP 06 STOP-GATE PASSED! Zero unlinked schedules, logs, and assignments.')
  } finally {
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  }
}

run().catch(err => {
  console.error(err)
  process.exit(1)
})

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
import fs from 'fs'
import path from 'path'

function loadEnv() {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
  if (!fs.existsSync(envPath)) return
  const lines = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8').split('\n')
  for (const line of lines) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue
    const eqIdx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
    if (eqIdx === -1) continue
    const k = trimmed.slice(0, eqIdx).trim()
    let v = trimmed.slice(eqIdx + 1).trim()
    if (v.startsWith('"') && v.endsWith('"')) v = v.slice(1, -1)
    if (!process.env[k]) process.env[k] = v
  }
}

loadEnv()

const SUPABASE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
const SUPABASE_KEY =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ||
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY

async function verify() {
  const supabase = createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY)
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
    email: 'admin@rrl.edu.np',
    password: 'Admin@12345',
  })

  if (error) {
    console.error('Sign-in error:', error.message)
    process.exit(1)
  }

  console.log('✓ Signed in as:', data.user.email)
  const session = data.session

  const projectRef = new URL(SUPABASE_URL).hostname.split('.')[0]
  const cookieName = `sb-${projectRef}-auth-token`
  const cookieVal = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(session))
  const cookieHeader = `${cookieName}=${cookieVal}; ${cookieName}.0=${encodeURIComponent(
    JSON.stringify(session)
  )}`

  // 1. Verify /maintenance
  console.log('\n--- 1. Testing /maintenance (Authenticated) ---')
  const maintRes = await fetch('http://localhost:3000/maintenance', {
    headers: { Cookie: cookieHeader },
  })
  const maintHtml = await maintRes.text()
  console.log('/maintenance status:', maintRes.status)
  console.log('Has "Lab Maintenance":', maintHtml.includes('Lab Maintenance'))
  console.log('Has "Computer & Science Labs":', maintHtml.includes('Computer &amp; Science Labs') || maintHtml.includes('Computer & Science Labs'))
  console.log('Has "Lab Maintenance Status Matrix":', maintHtml.includes('Lab Maintenance Status Matrix'))
  console.log('Has "Pinned Maintenance Reminders":', maintHtml.includes('Pinned Maintenance Reminders'))
  console.log('Has "Lab Maintenance & Servicing Records":', maintHtml.includes('Lab Maintenance &amp; Servicing Records') || maintHtml.includes('Lab Maintenance & Servicing Records'))
  console.log('Has Sidebar "Lab Maintenance":', maintHtml.includes('Lab Maintenance'))
  console.log('Has NO "Total Care Expense":', !maintHtml.includes('TOTAL CARE EXPENSE') && !maintHtml.includes('Total Care Expense'))
  console.log('Has NO "Apparatus Servicing":', !maintHtml.includes('Apparatus Servicing'))

  // 2. Verify /print/maintenance
  console.log('\n--- 2. Testing /print/maintenance (Authenticated) ---')
  const printRes = await fetch('http://localhost:3000/print/maintenance', {
    headers: { Cookie: cookieHeader },
  })
  const printHtml = await printRes.text()
  console.log('/print/maintenance status:', printRes.status)
  console.log('Has Official Letterhead:', printHtml.includes('RATNA RAJYA LAXMI'))
  console.log('Has Official Title:', printHtml.includes('Lab Maintenance'))
  console.log('Has 3-Tier Signatures:')
  console.log('  - Laboratory In-Charge:', printHtml.includes('Laboratory In-Charge'))
  console.log('  - Academic Coordinator:', printHtml.includes('Academic Coordinator'))
  console.log('  - Campus Chief / Principal:', printHtml.includes('Campus Chief / Principal'))
}

verify()

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

// Load .env.local into process.env if needed
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const key = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const val = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[key]) {
        process.env[key] = val
      }
    }
  }
}

import { formatIncidentCaseNumber } from '../lib/report-spec/incident-spec.ts'
import { getAcademicYearsForFilterAction, getIncidentRecords, getPracticalRecords } from '../app/actions/records.ts'

test('Academic Year and Incident Filters Resolution Suite', async (t) => {
  await t.test('1. formatIncidentCaseNumber: Disambiguates timestamp IDs and formats unique case hashes', () => {
    // Verify legacy IDs with unix timestamps (which start with 17...)
    assert.equal(formatIncidentCaseNumber('inc-1791040983236-x1h1'), '#INC-X1H1')
    assert.equal(formatIncidentCaseNumber('inc-1791040964741-gunx'), '#INC-GUNX')
    assert.equal(formatIncidentCaseNumber('inc-1791045779527-ogjx'), '#INC-OGJX')
    assert.equal(formatIncidentCaseNumber('inc-1791112338514-i0ie'), '#INC-I0IE')

    // Verify seed & 2-part IDs
    assert.equal(formatIncidentCaseNumber('inc-seed-1'), '#INC-1')
    assert.equal(formatIncidentCaseNumber('inc-999'), '#INC-999')

    // Verify custom incident_number overrides
    assert.equal(formatIncidentCaseNumber('inc-1791040983236-x1h1', 'INC-2083-04'), '#INC-2083-04')
    assert.equal(formatIncidentCaseNumber('inc-1791040983236-x1h1', '#INC-2083-04'), '#INC-2083-04')

    // Verify fallback on null/empty
    assert.equal(formatIncidentCaseNumber(null), '#INC-—')
    assert.equal(formatIncidentCaseNumber(''), '#INC-—')
  })

  await t.test('2. getAcademicYearsForFilterAction: Returns live DB academic cycles', async () => {
    const res = await getAcademicYearsForFilterAction()
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getAcademicYearsForFilterAction succeeded')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'Returns an array of academic cycles')
    assert.ok(res.data.length >= 2, 'Has at least 2084 and 2083 cycles')
    const activeYear = res.data.find((y) => y.isCurrent)
    assert.ok(activeYear.id === '2083' || activeYear.id === '2084', `Current cycle is ${activeYear.id}`)
  })

  await t.test('3. getIncidentRecords: Supports academic_year_id filtering and returns real records', async () => {
    // 2083 has incidents in DB
    const res2083 = await getIncidentRecords({ academic_year_id: '2083', pageSize: 1000 })
    assert.equal(res2083.success, true, 'Query succeeded for 2083')
    assert.ok(res2083.incidents.length > 0, '2083 contains incident records')

    // 2084 has no incidents in DB yet -> should return 0, not fallback to mock seed
    const res2084 = await getIncidentRecords({ academic_year_id: '2084', pageSize: 1000 })
    assert.equal(res2084.success, true, 'Query succeeded for 2084')
    assert.equal(res2084.incidents.length, 0, '2084 legitimately has 0 incidents without fallback mock data')
    assert.equal(res2084.totalCount, 0, 'Total count for 2084 is 0')
  })

  await t.test('4. getPracticalRecords: PageSize 1000 (All) returns all records without fallback on empty cycle', async () => {
    // 2083 has practicals in DB
    const res2083 = await getPracticalRecords({ academic_year_id: '2083', pageSize: 1000 }, 'none')
    assert.equal(res2083.success, true, 'Query succeeded for 2083 practicals')
    assert.ok(res2083.totalCount >= 4, 'All 4 practical logs returned for 2083')

    // 2084 has 0 practicals -> should return 0, not fallback to mock seed
    const res2084 = await getPracticalRecords({ academic_year_id: '2084', pageSize: 1000 }, 'none')
    assert.equal(res2084.success, true, 'Query succeeded for 2084 practicals')
    assert.equal(res2084.totalCount, 0, 'Total count is 0 for 2084 without fake fallback')
    assert.equal(res2084.sections[0].records.length, 0, 'Records in section is empty for 2084')
  })
})
