test('Academic Year Lifecycle & Cohort Governance Test Suite', async (t) => {
  const { getClassEnrollmentStats } = await import('../app/actions/classes.ts')
  const { getAcademicYears, getCurrentAcademicYear } = await import('../app/actions/academic-years.ts')

  await t.test('1. getClassEnrollmentStats: Single query aggregation returns active student counts', async () => {
    const res = await getClassEnrollmentStats('2083')
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'Action executed successfully')
    assert.ok(res.data, 'Data object is defined')

    // In 2083, Class 12 Eng has active students (34 computer lab workstations)
    assert.ok(res.data['12eng'] >= 30, 'Class 12 Eng has at least 30 enrolled students')
    
    // Other classes without enrolled students should either be 0 or undefined in map
    assert.ok(
      res.data['12mgt'] === undefined || res.data['12mgt'] === 0,
      'Class 12 Mgt has 0 active enrolled students'
    )
  })

  await t.test('2. getAcademicYears: Returns configured academic cycles', async () => {
    const res = await getAcademicYears()
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getAcademicYears succeeded')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'Returns an array of academic years')
    assert.ok(res.data.length >= 2, 'Has at least 2083 and 2084 academic years')

    const currentYear = res.data.find((y) => y.is_current)
    assert.ok(currentYear, 'An active/current academic year is flagged')
    assert.equal(currentYear.id, '2083', 'Current active academic year is 2083 B.S.')
  })

  await t.test('3. getCurrentAcademicYear: Fetches single active operational cycle', async () => {
    const res = await getCurrentAcademicYear()
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getCurrentAcademicYear succeeded')
    assert.ok(res.data, 'Current year record is present')
    assert.equal(res.data.id, '2083', 'Matches current active year 2083')
    assert.equal(res.data.is_current, true, 'is_current flag is true')
  })

  await t.test('4. promoteCohortAction: Access control rejects unprivileged calls', async () => {
    const { promoteCohortAction } = await import('../app/actions/academic-years.ts')
    const res = await promoteCohortAction({
      fromClassId: '12eng',
      toClassId: '12eng',
      fromAcademicYearId: '2083',
      toAcademicYearId: '2084',
    })

    assert.equal(res.success, false, 'Unprivileged request rejected')
    assert.match(res.error || '', /Access denied: Only administrators can promote cohorts/i)
  })

  await t.test('5. promoteCohortAction: Validation rejects identical source and destination cohort', async () => {
    const { promoteCohortAction } = await import('../app/actions/academic-years.ts')
    const res = await promoteCohortAction({
      fromClassId: '12eng',
      toClassId: '12eng',
      fromAcademicYearId: '2083',
      toAcademicYearId: '2083',
      internalBypassScopeCheck: true,
    })

    assert.equal(res.success, false, 'Rejects promotion to exact same class and year')
    assert.match(res.error || '', /Cannot promote a cohort to the exact same class and academic year/i)
  })

  await t.test('6. promoteCohortAction: Rejects empty source cohort gracefully without mutating data', async () => {
    const { promoteCohortAction } = await import('../app/actions/academic-years.ts')
    const res = await promoteCohortAction({
      fromClassId: 'nonexistent-class-id',
      toClassId: '12eng',
      fromAcademicYearId: '2083',
      toAcademicYearId: '2084',
      internalBypassScopeCheck: true,
    })

    assert.equal(res.success, false, 'Rejects when no active student enrollments found')
    assert.match(res.error || '', /No active student enrollments found/i)
  })

  await t.test('7. promoteCohortAction: Promotes cohort successfully and updates status without constraint violations', async () => {
    const { promoteCohortAction } = await import('../app/actions/academic-years.ts')
    const { getPgPool } = await import('../lib/db.ts')
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const client = await pool.connect()

    const testStudentId1 = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
    const testStudentId2 = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'
    const testStudentId3 = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'

    try {
      // Setup test students
      for (const sid of [testStudentId1, testStudentId2, testStudentId3]) {
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, is_active)
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3, true)
          ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name;
        `, [sid, `ADM-${sid}`, `Student ${sid}`])
      }

      // Cleanup any leftover enrollments
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id IN ($1, $2, $3) OR (academic_year_id IN ('2083', '2084') AND class_id IN ('7b', '8a'));`, [testStudentId1, testStudentId2, testStudentId3])

      // Seed 2083 enrollments in 7b
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, section, status)
        VALUES 
          ('2083', '7b', $1, 1, 'A', 'active'),
          ('2083', '7b', $2, 2, 'A', 'active'),
          ('2083', '7b', $3, 3, 'A', 'active');
      `, [testStudentId1, testStudentId2, testStudentId3])

      // Execute promotion:
      // student 1: promote to 8a in 2084
      // student 2: repeat in 7b in 2084
      // student 3: archive / left school
      const promoRes = await promoteCohortAction({
        fromClassId: '7b',
        toClassId: '8a',
        fromAcademicYearId: '2083',
        toAcademicYearId: '2084',
        exceptions: [
          { studentId: testStudentId2, action: 'repeat' },
          { studentId: testStudentId3, action: 'archive' },
        ],
        internalBypassScopeCheck: true,
      })

      assert.equal(promoRes.success, true, `Cohort promotion should succeed: ${promoRes.error}`)

      // Verify student 1: prior enrollment is archived, new enrollment is active in 8a
      const s1Old = await client.query(`SELECT status FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND student_id = $1;`, [testStudentId1])
      assert.equal(s1Old.rows[0]?.status, 'archived', 'Promoted student prior enrollment should be archived')

      const s1New = await client.query(`SELECT status, class_id FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2084' AND student_id = $1;`, [testStudentId1])
      assert.equal(s1New.rows[0]?.status, 'active', 'Promoted student new enrollment should be active')
      assert.equal(s1New.rows[0]?.class_id, '8a', 'Promoted student new class should be 8a')

      // Verify student 2: prior enrollment is archived, new enrollment is active in 7b
      const s2Old = await client.query(`SELECT status FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND student_id = $1;`, [testStudentId2])
      assert.equal(s2Old.rows[0]?.status, 'archived', 'Repeating student prior enrollment should be archived')

      const s2New = await client.query(`SELECT status, class_id FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2084' AND student_id = $1;`, [testStudentId2])
      assert.equal(s2New.rows[0]?.status, 'active', 'Repeating student new enrollment should be active')
      assert.equal(s2New.rows[0]?.class_id, '7b', 'Repeating student should remain in 7b')

      // Verify student 3: marked transferred, no 2084 enrollment
      const s3Old = await client.query(`SELECT status FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND student_id = $1;`, [testStudentId3])
      assert.equal(s3Old.rows[0]?.status, 'transferred', 'Archived student prior enrollment should be transferred')

      const s3New = await client.query(`SELECT * FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2084' AND student_id = $1;`, [testStudentId3])
      assert.equal(s3New.rows.length, 0, 'Archived student should have no new enrollment')

    } finally {
      // Clean up test data
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id IN ($1, $2, $3) OR (academic_year_id IN ('2083', '2084') AND class_id IN ('7b', '8a'));`, [testStudentId1, testStudentId2, testStudentId3])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2, $3);`, [testStudentId1, testStudentId2, testStudentId3])
      client.release()
    }
  })

  await t.test('8. updateAcademicYearAction: Safely updates display label and dates without altering ID or hampering linked records', async () => {
    const { updateAcademicYearAction } = await import('../app/actions/academic-years.ts')
    const { getPgPool } = await import('../lib/db.ts')
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const client = await pool.connect()

    try {
      // 1. Fetch current 2083 name & dates
      const origRes = await client.query(`SELECT id, name, start_date, end_date FROM public.academic_years WHERE id = '2083';`)
      assert.equal(origRes.rows.length, 1, '2083 exists in database')
      const orig = origRes.rows[0]

      // Count existing linked practical logs & enrollments before edit
      const logsBefore = await client.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.practical_logs WHERE academic_year_id = '2083';`)
      const enrollBefore = await client.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083';`)

      // 2. Perform safe update
      const updateRes = await updateAcademicYearAction({
        id: '2083',
        name: '2083/84 B.S. (Amended)',
        start_date: '2083-01-01',
        end_date: '2083-12-30',
        internalBypassScopeCheck: true,
      })

      assert.equal(updateRes.success, true, 'updateAcademicYearAction should succeed')
      assert.equal(updateRes.data?.id, '2083', 'Primary key ID remains 2083')
      assert.equal(updateRes.data?.name, '2083/84 B.S. (Amended)', 'Display label updated')

      // Verify linked practical logs & enrollments are completely intact (0 data hampered)
      const logsAfter = await client.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.practical_logs WHERE academic_year_id = '2083';`)
      const enrollAfter = await client.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083';`)
      assert.equal(logsAfter.rows[0].count, logsBefore.rows[0].count, 'Practical log count untouched')
      assert.equal(enrollAfter.rows[0].count, enrollBefore.rows[0].count, 'Student enrollment count untouched')

      // 3. Restore original name
      await client.query(`UPDATE public.academic_years SET name = $1, start_date = $2, end_date = $3 WHERE id = '2083';`, [
        orig.name,
        orig.start_date,
        orig.end_date,
      ])
    } finally {
      client.release()
    }
  })

  await t.test('9. checkAcademicYearDependenciesAction: Detects live operational records and blocks deletion', async () => {
    const { checkAcademicYearDependenciesAction } = await import('../app/actions/academic-years.ts')

    const res = await checkAcademicYearDependenciesAction('2083')
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'checkAcademicYearDependenciesAction succeeded')
    assert.ok(res.data, 'Returns dependency report')
    assert.equal(res.data.yearId, '2083', 'Target year is 2083')
    assert.equal(res.data.isCurrent, true, '2083 is marked current')
    assert.equal(res.data.canDelete, false, 'Deletion is strictly prohibited')
    assert.ok(res.data.totalDependencies > 0, 'Has active linked operational records')
    assert.match(res.data.blockReason || '', /Cannot delete the current active academic year cycle/i)
  })

  await t.test('10. deleteAcademicYearAction: Hard-blocks deletion of academic year with historical records', async () => {
    const { deleteAcademicYearAction } = await import('../app/actions/academic-years.ts')

    // Attempting to delete active/populated 2083
    const res = await deleteAcademicYearAction('2083', true)
    assert.equal(res.success, false, 'Deletion of 2083 should be rejected')
    assert.ok(res.error, 'Returns clear rejection reason')
    assert.match(res.error || '', /Cannot delete the current active academic year cycle/i)
  })

  await t.test('11. deleteAcademicYearAction: Safely deletes empty/accidental academic cycle with 0 records', async () => {
    const { checkAcademicYearDependenciesAction, deleteAcademicYearAction } = await import('../app/actions/academic-years.ts')
    const { getPgPool } = await import('../lib/db.ts')
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const client = await pool.connect()

    const dummyYearId = '2099-accidental'
    try {
      // 1. Create an accidental/empty year
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.academic_years (id, name, start_date, end_date, is_current)
        VALUES ($1, 'Accidental Year 2099', '2099-01-01', '2099-12-30', false)
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
      `, [dummyYearId])

      // 2. Pre-flight dependency check confirms 0 records and canDelete = true
      const checkRes = await checkAcademicYearDependenciesAction(dummyYearId)
      assert.equal(checkRes.success, true, 'Pre-flight check succeeded')
      assert.equal(checkRes.data?.canDelete, true, 'canDelete is true for empty year')
      assert.equal(checkRes.data?.totalDependencies, 0, 'Total dependencies is 0')

      // 3. Execute safe delete
      const delRes = await deleteAcademicYearAction(dummyYearId, true)
      assert.equal(delRes.success, true, 'deleteAcademicYearAction succeeded for empty year')

      // 4. Verify year is deleted from DB
      const afterRes = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.academic_years WHERE id = $1;`, [dummyYearId])
      assert.equal(afterRes.rows.length, 0, 'Accidental year was permanently removed')

    } finally {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.academic_years WHERE id = $1;`, [dummyYearId])
      client.release()
    }
  })
})

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

// Native environment variables loader
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const k = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const v = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[k]) process.env[k] = v
    }
  }
}
process.env.LABSYNC_TEST_RUNNER = 'true'

test('Admin Console Configurable Options Management Test Suite', async (t) => {
  const {
    getMaintenanceRoutineTemplates,
    saveMaintenanceRoutineTemplate,
    deleteMaintenanceRoutineTemplate,
    reorderMaintenanceRoutineTemplates,
  } = await import('../app/actions/maintenance-templates.ts')

  const {
    getIssueCategories,
    manageIssueCategory,
    reorderIssueCategories,
  } = await import('../app/actions/workstations.ts')

  let createdTemplateId = null
  let createdCategoryId = null

  await t.test('1. getMaintenanceRoutineTemplates: Retrieves seeded institutional templates with parsed checklists', async () => {
    const res = await getMaintenanceRoutineTemplates()
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'Querying routine templates should succeed')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'Templates should be returned as an array')
    assert.ok(res.data.length >= 6, 'Should have at least 6 seeded templates')

    const biosTemplate = res.data.find((t) => t.title.toLowerCase().includes('bios'))
    assert.ok(biosTemplate, 'Should contain BIOS update template')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(biosTemplate.checklist), 'Checklist should be an array')
    assert.ok(biosTemplate.checklist.length > 0, 'Checklist should contain steps')
  })

  await t.test('2. getMaintenanceRoutineTemplates: Filters templates by laboratory facility code', async () => {
    const compRes = await getMaintenanceRoutineTemplates('comp')
    assert.equal(compRes.success, true)
    assert.ok(compRes.data.every((t) => t.lab_id === 'comp' || t.lab_id === 'all'))
  })

  await t.test('3. saveMaintenanceRoutineTemplate: Creates new template with jsonb checklist', async () => {
    const newTemplate = {
      title: 'Network Switch Air Filter Clean',
      lab_id: 'comp',
      cadence: 'biweekly',
      interval_days: 14,
      severity: 'routine',
      category: 'Network Infrastructure',
      checklist: ['Power off switch auxiliary fans', 'Vacuum intake mesh', 'Inspect RJ45 patch cables'],
      sort_order: 99,
    }

    const createRes = await saveMaintenanceRoutineTemplate(newTemplate)
    assert.equal(createRes.success, true, `Failed to create template: ${createRes.error}`)
    assert.ok(createRes.data?.id, 'Created template should have a UUID')
    createdTemplateId = createRes.data.id
    assert.equal(createRes.data.title, newTemplate.title)
    assert.equal(createRes.data.interval_days, 14)
  })

  await t.test('4. saveMaintenanceRoutineTemplate: Updates existing template attributes', async () => {
    assert.ok(createdTemplateId, 'Template ID must exist for update test')

    const updateRes = await saveMaintenanceRoutineTemplate({
      id: createdTemplateId,
      title: 'Network Switch Air Filter & Cable Tidy',
      lab_id: 'comp',
      cadence: 'monthly',
      interval_days: 30,
      severity: 'critical',
      category: 'Network Care',
      checklist: ['Updated step 1', 'Updated step 2'],
    })

    assert.equal(updateRes.success, true, `Failed to update template: ${updateRes.error}`)
    assert.equal(updateRes.data?.title, 'Network Switch Air Filter & Cable Tidy')
    assert.equal(updateRes.data?.interval_days, 30)
    assert.equal(updateRes.data?.severity, 'critical')
  })

  await t.test('5. reorderMaintenanceRoutineTemplates: Updates sort order sequence', async () => {
    assert.ok(createdTemplateId, 'Template ID must exist for reorder test')

    const reorderRes = await reorderMaintenanceRoutineTemplates([
      { id: createdTemplateId, sort_order: 1 },
    ])
    assert.equal(reorderRes.success, true, `Failed to reorder templates: ${reorderRes.error}`)

    const listRes = await getMaintenanceRoutineTemplates()
    const updated = listRes.data.find((t) => t.id === createdTemplateId)
    assert.equal(updated?.sort_order, 1, 'Sort order should be updated to 1')
  })

  await t.test('6. deleteMaintenanceRoutineTemplate: Soft-deletes template (is_active = false)', async () => {
    assert.ok(createdTemplateId, 'Template ID must exist for delete test')

    const deleteRes = await deleteMaintenanceRoutineTemplate(createdTemplateId)
    assert.equal(deleteRes.success, true, `Failed to delete template: ${deleteRes.error}`)

    const listRes = await getMaintenanceRoutineTemplates()
    const found = listRes.data.find((t) => t.id === createdTemplateId)
    assert.equal(found, undefined, 'Soft-deleted template should not be returned in active list')
  })

  await t.test('7. getIssueCategories: Retrieves active fault categories with default_severity', async () => {
    const res = await getIssueCategories()
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'Querying issue categories should succeed')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'Categories should be an array')
    assert.ok(res.data.length >= 5, 'Should have initial active fault categories')

    const bootCategory = res.data.find((c) => c.name.toLowerCase().includes('boot'))
    assert.ok(bootCategory, 'Should contain OS boot failure category')
    assert.ok(bootCategory.default_severity, 'Category must have default_severity')
  })

  await t.test('8. manageIssueCategory: Creates and updates issue category', async () => {
    const createRes = await manageIssueCategory('create', {
      name: 'GPU Driver Artifacting',
      type: 'hardware',
      color: '#8b5cf6',
      icon: 'Monitor',
      default_severity: 'high',
      sort_order: 88,
    })

    assert.equal(createRes.success, true, `Failed to create issue category: ${createRes.error}`)
    assert.ok(createRes.data?.id, 'Category should have an ID')
    createdCategoryId = createRes.data.id

    // Update the category
    const updateRes = await manageIssueCategory('update', {
      id: createdCategoryId,
      name: 'GPU Thermal Throttling / Artifacting',
      color: '#ec4899',
      default_severity: 'critical',
    })

    assert.equal(updateRes.success, true, `Failed to update category: ${updateRes.error}`)
    assert.equal(updateRes.data?.name, 'GPU Thermal Throttling / Artifacting')
    assert.equal(updateRes.data?.default_severity, 'critical')
  })

  await t.test('9. reorderIssueCategories: Updates category sort ordering', async () => {
    assert.ok(createdCategoryId, 'Category ID must exist for reorder test')

    const reorderRes = await reorderIssueCategories([
      { id: createdCategoryId, sort_order: 1 },
    ])
    assert.equal(reorderRes.success, true, `Failed to reorder categories: ${reorderRes.error}`)

    const listRes = await getIssueCategories()
    const updated = listRes.data.find((c) => c.id === createdCategoryId)
    assert.equal(updated?.sort_order, 1, 'Sort order should be updated')
  })

  await t.test('10. manageIssueCategory (deactivate): Soft-archives issue category', async () => {
    assert.ok(createdCategoryId, 'Category ID must exist for deactivate test')

    const deleteRes = await manageIssueCategory('delete', {
      id: createdCategoryId,
    })
    assert.equal(deleteRes.success, true, `Failed to deactivate category: ${deleteRes.error}`)

    const activeList = await getIssueCategories()
    const found = activeList.data.find((c) => c.id === createdCategoryId)
    assert.equal(found, undefined, 'Deactivated category should not appear in active category list')
  })

  await t.test('11. Rule #1 Compliance: Zero literal "+" in button text across managers', () => {
    const filesToCheck = [
      'components/admin/maintenance-template-manager.tsx',
      'components/admin/workstation-fault-categories-manager.tsx',
      'components/admin/maintenance-routines-manager.tsx',
      'components/maintenance/create-plan-modal.tsx',
      'components/computer-lab/station-quick-popover.tsx',
    ]

    for (const relPath of filesToCheck) {
      const fullPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), relPath)
      const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8')

      const literalPlusMatches = content.match(/>\s*\+\s*[A-Za-z]/g)
      assert.equal(
        literalPlusMatches,
        null,
        `File ${relPath} contains prohibited literal '+' in button/action label: ${literalPlusMatches}`
      )
    }
  })

  await t.test('12. Rule #3 Compliance: Precaution Active safety lock guards mutations', () => {
    const templateMgrContent = fs.readFileSync(
      path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'components/admin/maintenance-template-manager.tsx'),

    )
    assert.ok(
      templateMgrContent.includes('isEditModeUnlocked') &&

      'MaintenanceTemplateManager must enforce Precaution Active safety lock'
    )

    const faultMgrContent = fs.readFileSync(

      faultMgrContent.includes('isEditModeUnlocked') &&

      'WorkstationFaultCategoriesManager must enforce Precaution Active safety lock'

  await t.test('13. Dynamic Options Architecture: Dynamic props & queries wired into UI components', () => {

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

test('Super Admin Precaution Lock & Governance Logic Suite', async (t) => {
  // 1. Holiday Deduplication by Composite Key (dateStr + trimmed title)
  await t.test('Holiday deduplication collapses duplicate entries across multiple syncs', () => {
    const rawHolidays = [
      { id: 'hol-1', dateStr: '2024-09-19', title: 'Constitution Day', type: 'state' },
      { id: 'hol-1-dup', dateStr: '2024-09-19', title: 'Constitution Day ', type: 'state' },
      { id: 'hol-2', dateStr: '2024-08-26', title: 'Gaura Parba', type: 'cultural' },
      { id: 'hol-2-dup', dateStr: '2024-08-26', title: 'Gaura Parba', type: 'cultural' },
      { id: 'hol-3', dateStr: '2024-10-03', title: 'Ghatasthapana', type: 'cultural' },
    ];

    const dedupMap = new Map();
    rawHolidays.forEach((h) => {
      if (!h || !h.title || !h.dateStr) return;
      const compositeKey = `${h.dateStr}_${h.title.trim()}`;
      if (!dedupMap.has(compositeKey)) {
        dedupMap.set(compositeKey, h);
      }
    });

    const uniqueHolidays = Array.from(dedupMap.values());
    assert.equal(uniqueHolidays.length, 3, 'Duplicate holidays must be collapsed to exactly 3 unique events');
    assert.equal(uniqueHolidays.filter((h) => h.title.trim() === 'Constitution Day').length, 1);
    assert.equal(uniqueHolidays.filter((h) => h.title.trim() === 'Gaura Parba').length, 1);
  });

  // 2. Precaution Lock Scope: Creation (Unguarded) vs Destructive/Reset (Guarded)
  await t.test('Precaution Lock correctly permits creation while guarding destructive resets', () => {
    function evaluateActionPermitted(actionType, isEditModeUnlocked) {
      const CREATION_ACTIONS = new Set([
        'add_subject',
        'add_period',
        'add_lab',
        'add_class',
        'add_teacher',
      ]);

      const GUARDED_DESTRUCTIVE_ACTIONS = new Set([
        'delete_subject',
        'delete_period',
        'delete_lab',
        'delete_class',
        'delete_user',
        'delete_holiday',
        'reset_routine',
        'reset_periods',
        'restore_snapshot',
      ]);

      if (CREATION_ACTIONS.has(actionType)) {
        return { allowed: true, requiresLock: false };
      }

      if (GUARDED_DESTRUCTIVE_ACTIONS.has(actionType)) {
        return {
          allowed: isEditModeUnlocked,
          requiresLock: true,
          reason: isEditModeUnlocked ? null : 'Precaution Active: Unlock edit mode to perform modifications',
        };
      }

      throw new Error(`Unknown actionType: ${actionType}`);
    }

    // When locked (default state)
    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('add_subject', false).allowed, true);
    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('add_period', false).allowed, true);
    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('add_lab', false).allowed, true);
    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('add_class', false).allowed, true);
    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('add_teacher', false).allowed, true);

    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('delete_subject', false).allowed, false);
    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('delete_period', false).allowed, false);
    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('delete_lab', false).allowed, false);
    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('reset_routine', false).allowed, false);
    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('reset_periods', false).allowed, false);
    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('restore_snapshot', false).allowed, false);

    // When unlocked
    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('delete_subject', true).allowed, true);
    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('reset_routine', true).allowed, true);
    assert.equal(evaluateActionPermitted('restore_snapshot', true).allowed, true);
  });

  // 3. Bidirectional Calendar Recess Confirmation Copy
  await t.test('Recess and Saturday Off policy transitions have direction-appropriate impact messaging', () => {
    function getRecessPolicyModalContent(policyType, targetChecked) {
      if (policyType === 'sunday_recess') {
        return {
          title: targetChecked
            ? 'Declare Sunday as Institutional Week Off?'
            : 'Reactivate Sunday Practical Sessions?',
          description: targetChecked
            ? 'This marks Sunday as a weekly off and automatically suspends practical sessions across all laboratories.'
            : 'This marks Sunday as an active academic day and resumes timetable scheduling across all laboratories.',
          confirmLabel: targetChecked ? 'Declare Sunday Week Off' : 'Reactivate Sunday Sessions',
        };
      }
      if (policyType === 'saturday_holiday') {
        return {
          title: targetChecked
            ? 'Enforce Saturday Statutory Holiday?'
            : 'Enable Saturday Laboratory Operations?',
          description: targetChecked
            ? 'This marks Saturday as an official holiday and suspends laboratory operations.'
            : 'This permits practical sessions and bookings to take place on Saturdays.',
          confirmLabel: targetChecked ? 'Enforce Saturday Holiday' : 'Enable Saturday Operations',
        };
      }
      throw new Error(`Unknown policyType: ${policyType}`);
    }

    const sundayOn = getRecessPolicyModalContent('sunday_recess', true);
    assert.match(sundayOn.title, /Declare Sunday as Institutional Week Off\?/);
    assert.match(sundayOn.confirmLabel, /Declare Sunday Week Off/);

    const sundayOff = getRecessPolicyModalContent('sunday_recess', false);
    assert.match(sundayOff.title, /Reactivate Sunday Practical Sessions\?/);
    assert.match(sundayOff.confirmLabel, /Reactivate Sunday Sessions/);

    const saturdayOn = getRecessPolicyModalContent('saturday_holiday', true);
    assert.match(saturdayOn.title, /Enforce Saturday Statutory Holiday\?/);

    const saturdayOff = getRecessPolicyModalContent('saturday_holiday', false);
    assert.match(saturdayOff.title, /Enable Saturday Laboratory Operations\?/);
  });

  // 4. Role Badges: Pure Category Semantics (Zero Color)
  await t.test('Role badges adhere to Category vs State separation', () => {
    function getRoleBadgeConfig(role) {
      const neutralClass = 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700';
      return {
        className: neutralClass,
        hasShieldIcon: role === 'super_admin',
        isRainbowColor: false,
      };
    }

    const teacher = getRoleBadgeConfig('teacher');
    const incharge = getRoleBadgeConfig('lab_incharge');
    const hod = getRoleBadgeConfig('hod');
    const superAdmin = getRoleBadgeConfig('super_admin');

    assert.equal(teacher.className, incharge.className);
    assert.equal(incharge.className, hod.className);
    assert.equal(hod.className, superAdmin.className);

    assert.equal(superAdmin.hasShieldIcon, true);
    assert.equal(teacher.hasShieldIcon, false);
    assert.equal(teacher.isRainbowColor, false);
  });

  // 5. Dual-Facility Practical & Multi-Lab Conflict Detection
  await t.test('Dual-Facility Practical properly occupies both laboratories and prevents collisions', () => {
    const mockSessions = [
      {
        id: 'sess-101',
        dayKey: 'wed',
        slotId: 't3',
        labKey: 'comp',
        secondaryLabKey: 'phys',
        isDualLab: true,
        teacher: 'Dr. Rajesh Sharma',
        coTeacher: 'Dr. Rajesh Sharma',
        subjectCode: 'DDMP-10',
        grade: 'Class 10',
      },
      {
        id: 'sess-102',
        dayKey: 'wed',
        slotId: 't4',
        labKey: 'comp',
        teacher: 'Er. Sandeep B.',
        subjectCode: 'OOP-12',
        grade: 'Class 12',
      },
    ];

    function isLabBusyInSlot(allRoutines, dayKey, slotId, labKey, excludeId) {
      return allRoutines.some(
        (r) =>
          r.id !== excludeId &&
          r.dayKey === dayKey &&
          r.slotId === slotId &&
          (r.labKey === labKey || r.secondaryLabKey === labKey)
      );
    }

    function getOccupiedLabsInSlot(allRoutines, dayKey, slotId, excludeId) {
      const occupied = new Set();
      for (const r of allRoutines) {
        if (r.id === excludeId) continue;
        if (r.dayKey === dayKey && r.slotId === slotId) {
          if (r.labKey) occupied.add(r.labKey);
          if (r.secondaryLabKey) occupied.add(r.secondaryLabKey);
        }
      }
      return occupied;
    }

    // Period t3: Computer Lab and Physics Lab are both occupied by the dual-lab session
    assert.equal(isLabBusyInSlot(mockSessions, 'wed', 't3', 'comp'), true, 'Computer Lab must be busy in t3');
    assert.equal(isLabBusyInSlot(mockSessions, 'wed', 't3', 'phys'), true, 'Physics Lab must be busy in t3');
    assert.equal(isLabBusyInSlot(mockSessions, 'wed', 't3', 'chem'), false, 'Chemistry Lab must be free in t3');

    // Period t4: only Computer Lab is busy
    assert.equal(isLabBusyInSlot(mockSessions, 'wed', 't4', 'comp'), true, 'Computer Lab must be busy in t4');
    assert.equal(isLabBusyInSlot(mockSessions, 'wed', 't4', 'phys'), false, 'Physics Lab must be free in t4');

    const occupiedInT3 = getOccupiedLabsInSlot(mockSessions, 'wed', 't3');
    assert.equal(occupiedInT3.has('comp'), true);
    assert.equal(occupiedInT3.has('phys'), true);
    assert.equal(occupiedInT3.size, 2);

    // Primary and secondary cannot be the same
    function validateDualLabBooking(primaryLab, secondaryLab, isDual) {
      if (!isDual) return { valid: true };
      if (primaryLab === secondaryLab) {
        return { valid: false, error: 'Primary and secondary laboratories cannot be the same facility.' };
      }
      return { valid: true };
    }

    assert.equal(validateDualLabBooking('comp', 'comp', true).valid, false);
    assert.equal(validateDualLabBooking('comp', 'phys', true).valid, true);

    // Dual Lab badge must use neutral category styling (never indigo accent)
    const dualLabBadgeClass = 'bg-zinc-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-300 border-zinc-200 dark:border-zinc-700';
    assert.equal(dualLabBadgeClass.includes('indigo'), false, 'Dual Lab badge must not use reserved indigo accent');
  });
});

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

// Load environment variables for database connection
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const k = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const v = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[k]) process.env[k] = v
    }
  }
}

test('Institutional Recycle Bin & Archive Hub Test Suite', async (t) => {
  const {
    getArchiveHubTelemetryAction,
    getArchivedStudentsAction,
    getArchivedAcademicYearsAction,
    getArchivedInfrastructureAction,
    restoreStudentAction,
    permanentPurgeTrashAction,
    restoreInfrastructureItemAction,
  } = await import('../app/actions/archive-hub.ts')
  const { getPgPool } = await import('../lib/db.ts')
  const pool = getPgPool()

  await t.test('1. getArchiveHubTelemetryAction: Returns valid operational telemetry counts', async () => {
    const res = await getArchiveHubTelemetryAction(true)
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getArchiveHubTelemetryAction succeeded')
    assert.ok(res.data, 'Telemetry data object is returned')
    assert.equal(typeof res.data.trashCount, 'number', 'trashCount is a number')
    assert.equal(typeof res.data.graduatedCount, 'number', 'graduatedCount is a number')
    assert.equal(typeof res.data.transferredCount, 'number', 'transferredCount is a number')
    assert.equal(typeof res.data.archivedYearsCount, 'number', 'archivedYearsCount is a number')
    assert.equal(typeof res.data.inactiveLabsCount, 'number', 'inactiveLabsCount is a number')
    assert.equal(typeof res.data.archivedCategoriesCount, 'number', 'archivedCategoriesCount is a number')
  })

  await t.test('2. getArchivedStudentsAction: Returns records for trash, graduated, and transferred', async () => {
    const trashRes = await getArchivedStudentsAction({ category: 'trash', internalBypassScopeCheck: true })
    assert.equal(trashRes.success, true, 'Querying trash succeeded')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(trashRes.data), 'Returns array of trash students')

    const gradRes = await getArchivedStudentsAction({ category: 'graduated', internalBypassScopeCheck: true })
    assert.equal(gradRes.success, true, 'Querying graduated succeeded')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(gradRes.data), 'Returns array of graduated alumni')

    const transRes = await getArchivedStudentsAction({ category: 'transferred', internalBypassScopeCheck: true })
    assert.equal(transRes.success, true, 'Querying transferred succeeded')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(transRes.data), 'Returns array of transferred students')
  })

  await t.test('3. getArchivedAcademicYearsAction: Returns past non-current academic cycles', async () => {
    const res = await getArchivedAcademicYearsAction(true)
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getArchivedAcademicYearsAction succeeded')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'Returns array of past academic cycles')
    for (const yr of res.data) {
      assert.equal(yr.isCurrent, false, 'All returned cycles must be non-current')
      assert.ok(typeof yr.totalLogs === 'number', 'Includes total practical logs count')
      assert.ok(typeof yr.totalEnrollments === 'number', 'Includes total enrollments count')
    }
  })

  await t.test('4. getArchivedInfrastructureAction: Returns inactive labs or categories', async () => {
    const res = await getArchivedInfrastructureAction(true)
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getArchivedInfrastructureAction succeeded')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'Returns array of infrastructure items')
  })

  await t.test('5. restoreStudentAction: Restores soft-deleted student to active status', async () => {
    const client = await pool.connect()
    const testStudentId = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'

    try {
      // 1. Seed soft-deleted student
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, is_active, archived_at, archive_reason)
        VALUES ($1, 'TEST-ARCHIVE-01', 'Soft Deleted Test Student', false, NOW(), 'Accidental soft-delete')
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET is_active = false, archived_at = NOW(), archive_reason = 'Accidental soft-delete';
      `, [testStudentId])

      // 2. Call restore
      const restoreRes = await restoreStudentAction({
        studentId: testStudentId,
        internalBypassScopeCheck: true,
      })

      assert.equal(restoreRes.success, true, 'restoreStudentAction succeeded')
      assert.equal(restoreRes.restoredStudentName, 'Soft Deleted Test Student', 'Returns restored student name')

      // 3. Verify in database
      const checkRes = await client.query(`SELECT is_active, archived_at, archive_reason FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [testStudentId])
      assert.equal(checkRes.rows[0]?.is_active, true, 'Student is active in DB')
      assert.equal(checkRes.rows[0]?.archived_at, null, 'archived_at is cleared to null')
      assert.equal(checkRes.rows[0]?.archive_reason, null, 'archive_reason is cleared to null')

    } finally {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [testStudentId])
      client.release()
    }
  })

  await t.test('6. restoreStudentAction: Auto-resolves roll collision when restoring enrollment', async () => {
    const client = await pool.connect()
    const testStudent1 = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010'
    const testStudent2 = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020'
    const testEnroll1 = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000011'
    const testEnroll2 = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000022'

    try {
      // 1. Seed two students
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, is_active)
        VALUES 
          ($1, 'TEST-ACT-10', 'Active Student Roll 1', true),
          ($2, 'TEST-ARC-20', 'Archived Student Prior Roll 1', false)
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name;
      `, [testStudent1, testStudent2])

      // Clean up previous test enrollments and test roll numbers
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' AND roll_number IN (191, 192, 193);`)
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [testEnroll1, testEnroll2])

      // Student 1 is active with Roll 191 in 2083 Class 12eng
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (id, academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, '2083', '12eng', $2, 191, 'active');
      `, [testEnroll1, testStudent1])

      // Student 2 is archived with Roll 192 in 2083 Class 12eng
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (id, academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, '2083', '12eng', $2, 192, 'archived');
      `, [testEnroll2, testStudent2])

      // 2. Restore Student 2: Desired Roll 191 is taken by Student 1
      const restoreRes = await restoreStudentAction({
        studentId: testStudent2,
        enrollmentId: testEnroll2,
        targetRollNumber: 191, // Requests occupied Roll 191
        internalBypassScopeCheck: true,
      })

      assert.equal(restoreRes.success, true, 'Restore succeeded')
      // Roll collision was automatically resolved to a higher unassigned roll
      assert.ok(restoreRes.newRollNumber && restoreRes.newRollNumber > 191, `New roll assigned: ${restoreRes.newRollNumber}`)

      // Verify in DB that status is active and roll is updated
      const checkEnr = await client.query(`SELECT roll_number, status FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id = $1;`, [testEnroll2])
      assert.equal(checkEnr.rows[0]?.status, 'active', 'Enrollment is active')
      assert.notEqual(checkEnr.rows[0]?.roll_number, 191, 'Roll was auto-offset to prevent duplicate key error')

    } finally {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [testEnroll1, testEnroll2])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [testStudent1, testStudent2])
      client.release()
    }
  })

  await t.test('7. permanentPurgeTrashAction: Safely purges zero-history student from Recycle Bin', async () => {
    const client = await pool.connect()
    const dummyStudentId = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099'
    const dummyEnrollId = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000098'

    try {
      // 1. Seed an accidental zero-history student in trash
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, is_active, archived_at, archive_reason)
        VALUES ($1, 'DUMMY-PURGE-99', 'Accidental Trash Student', false, NOW(), 'Mistake creation');
      `, [dummyStudentId])

      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (id, academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, '2083', '12eng', $2, 99, 'archived');
      `, [dummyEnrollId, dummyStudentId])

      // 2. Call permanent purge
      const purgeRes = await permanentPurgeTrashAction({
        studentId: dummyStudentId,
        enrollmentId: dummyEnrollId,
        internalBypassScopeCheck: true,
      })

      assert.equal(purgeRes.success, true, 'permanentPurgeTrashAction succeeded for zero-history student')

      // 3. Verify student and enrollment are deleted from database
      const enrCheck = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id = $1;`, [dummyEnrollId])
      assert.equal(enrCheck.rows.length, 0, 'Enrollment was permanently removed')

      const stuCheck = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [dummyStudentId])
      assert.equal(stuCheck.rows.length, 0, 'Student person record was permanently removed')

    } finally {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id = $1;`, [dummyEnrollId])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [dummyStudentId])
      client.release()
    }
  })

  await t.test('8. restoreInfrastructureItemAction: Reactivates lab facility and incident category', async () => {
    const client = await pool.connect()
    const testLabId = 'test-inactive-lab'

    try {
      // 1. Seed inactive lab
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.labs (id, name, code, capacity, type, status, is_active)
        VALUES ($1, 'Test Inactive Lab', 'INACT-01', 30, 'computer_lab', 'Inactive', false)
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'Inactive', is_active = false;
      `, [testLabId])

      // 2. Restore lab
      const restoreRes = await restoreInfrastructureItemAction({
        itemType: 'lab',
        itemId: testLabId,
        internalBypassScopeCheck: true,
      })

      assert.equal(restoreRes.success, true, 'restoreInfrastructureItemAction succeeded')

      // 3. Verify in DB
      const checkLab = await client.query(`SELECT status, is_active FROM public.labs WHERE id = $1;`, [testLabId])
      assert.equal(checkLab.rows[0]?.status, 'Operational', 'Lab is operational')
      assert.equal(checkLab.rows[0]?.is_active, true, 'is_active is true')

    } finally {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.labs WHERE id = $1;`, [testLabId])
      client.release()
    }
  })

  await t.test('9. permanentPurgeTrashAction: HARD-BLOCKS purge if student has recorded practical attendance logs', async () => {
    const client = await pool.connect()
    const studentWithLogs = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000055'
    const enrollWithLogs = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000056'
    const dummyLogId = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000057'
    const dummyAttendanceId = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000058'

    try {
      // 1. Seed student with archived status
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, is_active, archived_at, archive_reason)
        VALUES ($1, 'TEST-ATT-55', 'Student With Real Logs', false, NOW(), 'Soft deleted test');
      `, [studentWithLogs])

      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (id, academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, '2083', '12eng', $2, 55, 'archived');
      `, [enrollWithLogs, studentWithLogs])

      // 2. Fetch a valid class_subject_id
      const csRes = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.class_subjects LIMIT 1;`)
      const classSubjectId = csRes.rows[0]?.id || null

      // 3. Seed a practical log and attendance record
      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.practical_logs (id, lab_id, date, period_label, subject_name, batch_group, practical_title, total_students, present_students, absent_students, status, class_subject_id, academic_year_id)
        VALUES ($1, 'comp', CURRENT_DATE, 'Period 1', 'Computer Science', 'Batch A', 'Safety Test Log', 1, 1, 0, 'conducted', $2, '2083');
      `, [dummyLogId, classSubjectId])

      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.log_attendance (id, log_id, enrollment_id, student_id, roll_number, is_present)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 55, true);
      `, [dummyAttendanceId, dummyLogId, enrollWithLogs, studentWithLogs])

      // 3. Attempt permanent purge - MUST FAIL and roll back
      const purgeAttempt = await permanentPurgeTrashAction({
        studentId: studentWithLogs,
        enrollmentId: enrollWithLogs,
        internalBypassScopeCheck: true,
      })

      assert.equal(purgeAttempt.success, false, 'Permanent purge MUST be blocked')
      assert.match(purgeAttempt.error || '', /Permanent purge blocked: Student has \d+ recorded practical attendance logs/i, 'Error message warns about NEB compliance and preserved logs')

      // 4. Verify student and enrollment are still preserved in database
      const enrCheck = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id = $1;`, [enrollWithLogs])
      assert.equal(enrCheck.rows.length, 1, 'Enrollment remains preserved')

      const stuCheck = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [studentWithLogs])
      assert.equal(stuCheck.rows.length, 1, 'Student record remains preserved')

    } finally {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.log_attendance WHERE id = $1;`, [dummyAttendanceId])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.practical_logs WHERE id = $1;`, [dummyLogId])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id = $1;`, [enrollWithLogs])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [studentWithLogs])
      client.release()
    }
  })
})

import test from 'node:test'

test('Institutional Audit Presenter & Intelligence Engine Suite', async (t) => {
  await t.test('1. Internal System Keys Filter properly separates DB plumbing from business data', () => {
    assert.equal(isInternalSystemKey('span'), true)
    assert.equal(isInternalSystemKey('is_merged'), true)

    assert.equal(nullFmt.isInitial, true)
    assert.equal(nullFmt.display, 'Unassigned (Initial)')

    // 3b. Lab ID mapping

    assert.equal(opFmt.badgeStyle, 'emerald')

    // 3d. Metadata object unfolding

      labName: 'Chemistry Laboratory',
      teacher: 'CHEM12-Teacher',
      studentsCount: 38,
      is_multi_lab: false,

    assert.equal(guidance.headline, 'Facility Under Maintenance')

FILE: tests\audit-trail.test.mjs

import test, { describe } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import pg from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';
import { computeStructuredDiff } from '../lib/audit-diff.ts';

// Extract database connection string from .env.local
const env = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf-8');
let dbUrl = '';
for (const line of env.split('\n')) {
  if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = line.substring('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
  }
}

if (dbUrl.includes('db.') && dbUrl.includes('.supabase.co')) {
  const match = dbUrl.match(/postgresql:\/\/([^:]+):(.+)@db\.([a-z0-9]+)\.supabase\.co(?::\d+)?\/(.+)$/)
  if (match) {
    const [, , pass, ref, db] = match
    dbUrl = `postgresql://postgres.${ref}:${encodeURIComponent(pass)}@aws-0-ap-southeast-1.pooler.supabase.com:5432/${db}`
  }
}

describe('Institutional Audit Trail Engine & Security Suite', () => {
  test('Secret and credential redaction scrubs sensitive fields', () => {
    const beforeState = {
      user_id: 'u-123',
      email: 'teacher@rrl.edu.np',
      password: 'OldPlaintextPassword123!',
      token: 'jwt-secret-token-abc',
      role: 'teacher',
    };

    const afterState = {
      user_id: 'u-123',
      email: 'teacher@rrl.edu.np',
      new_password: 'NewPlaintextPassword456!',
      token: 'jwt-secret-token-xyz',
      role: 'super_admin',
    };

    const diff = computeStructuredDiff(beforeState, afterState);
    assert.ok(diff);
    assert.ok(diff.before);
    assert.ok(diff.after);

    // Ensure role change is captured
    assert.equal(diff.before.role, 'teacher');
    assert.equal(diff.after.role, 'super_admin');

    // Ensure secrets are strictly redacted
    assert.equal(diff.before.password, '[REDACTED]');
    assert.equal(diff.after.new_password, '[REDACTED]');
    assert.equal(diff.before.token, '[REDACTED]');
    assert.equal(diff.after.token, '[REDACTED]');

    // Unchanged email should be stripped from diff
    assert.equal(diff.before.email, undefined);
    assert.equal(diff.after.email, undefined);
  });

  test('Bulk payload safeguard caps changes exceeding 50 keys', () => {
    const bigBefore = {};
    const bigAfter = {};
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      bigBefore[`prop_${i}`] = `old_${i}`;
      bigAfter[`prop_${i}`] = `new_${i}`;
    }

    const diff = computeStructuredDiff(bigBefore, bigAfter);
    assert.ok(diff);
    assert.equal(diff.bulk_overflow, true);
    assert.ok(diff.summary.includes('Bulk operation modified 60 properties'));
    assert.equal(diff.count, 60);
  });

  test('Database schema integrity: public.audit_logs exists with correct columns', async () => {
    const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } });
    try {
      const res = await pool.query(`
        SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'audit_logs' AND table_schema = 'public'
        ORDER BY ordinal_position;
      `);

      const colNames = res.rows.map((r) => r.column_name);
      assert.ok(colNames.includes('id'), 'Missing id column');
      assert.ok(colNames.includes('created_at'), 'Missing created_at column');
      assert.ok(colNames.includes('actor_id'), 'Missing actor_id column');
      assert.ok(colNames.includes('actor_name'), 'Missing actor_name column');
      assert.ok(colNames.includes('actor_role'), 'Missing actor_role column');
      assert.ok(colNames.includes('action'), 'Missing action column');
      assert.ok(colNames.includes('entity_type'), 'Missing entity_type column');
      assert.ok(colNames.includes('entity_id'), 'Missing entity_id column');
      assert.ok(colNames.includes('entity_label'), 'Missing entity_label column');
      assert.ok(colNames.includes('changes'), 'Missing changes column');
      assert.ok(colNames.includes('metadata'), 'Missing metadata column');
    } finally {
      await pool.end();
    }
  });

  test('Append-only ledger insert and verification', async () => {
    const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } });
    const testEntityId = `test-lab-${Date.now()}`;
    try {
      const insertRes = await pool.query(
        `
        INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (
          actor_id, actor_name, actor_role, action, entity_type, entity_id, entity_label, changes, metadata
        ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
        RETURNING id;
        `,
        [
          null,
          'Test Suite Admin',
          'super_admin',
          'UPDATE',
          'lab',
          testEntityId,
          'Test Physics Lab',
          JSON.stringify({ before: { status: 'Operational' }, after: { status: 'Under Maintenance' } }),
          JSON.stringify({ test_suite: true }),
        ]
      );

      assert.ok(insertRes.rows[0]?.id);

      const fetchRes = await pool.query(
        `SELECT * FROM public.audit_logs WHERE id = $1;`,
        [insertRes.rows[0].id]
      );

      assert.equal(fetchRes.rows.length, 1);
      const row = fetchRes.rows[0];
      assert.equal(row.actor_name, 'Test Suite Admin');
      assert.equal(row.action, 'UPDATE');
      assert.equal(row.entity_type, 'lab');
      assert.equal(row.entity_id, testEntityId);
      assert.equal(row.changes.before.status, 'Operational');
      assert.equal(row.changes.after.status, 'Under Maintenance');
    } finally {
      await pool.end();
    }
  });
});

FILE: tests\chronological-sorting-and-seating-snapshot.test.mjs

import { describe, it } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

// Load .env.local into process.env before DB clients initialize
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const key = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const val = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[key]) {
        process.env[key] = val
      }
    }
  }
}

const { sortSessionsChronologically, parseTimeToMinutes } = await import('../lib/utils.ts')
const { createPracticalLog } = await import('../app/actions/logs.ts')
const { getPgPool } = await import('../lib/db.ts')

describe('Chronological Sorting, Session Lifecycle & Universal Seating Snapshot', () => {
  it('1. Chronological Sorting: Morning sessions (10:10 AM CHEM & COMP) precede afternoon sessions (01:45 PM COMP)', () => {
    // Recreate the exact scenario from user Image 2 where string sorting put 01:45 ahead of 10:10
    const unsortedSessions = [
      { id: 's-145', startTime: '01:45', endTime: '02:30', slotId: 't7', subjectName: 'DBMS-10', lab_id: 'comp', lab: 'Computer Lab' },
      { id: 's-230', startTime: '02:30', endTime: '03:15', slotId: 't8', subjectName: 'COA-11', lab_id: 'comp', lab: 'Computer Lab' },
      { id: 's-315', startTime: '03:15', endTime: '04:05', slotId: 't9', subjectName: 'VP-12', lab_id: 'comp', lab: 'Computer Lab' },
      { id: 's-1010-comp', startTime: '10:10', endTime: '11:00', slotId: 't2', subjectName: 'DDMP-10', lab_id: 'comp', lab: 'Computer Lab' },
      { id: 's-1010-chem', startTime: '10:10', endTime: '11:00', slotId: 't2', subjectName: 'CHEM-12', lab_id: 'chem', lab: 'Chemistry Laboratory' },
      { id: 's-1100-chem', startTime: '11:00', endTime: '11:45', slotId: 't3', subjectName: 'CHEM-12', lab_id: 'chem', lab: 'Chemistry Laboratory' },
      { id: 's-1230-comp', startTime: '12:30', endTime: '01:15', slotId: 't5', subjectName: 'COMP-7AB', lab_id: 'comp', lab: 'Computer Lab' },
    ]

    const sorted = sortSessionsChronologically(unsortedSessions)

    // Verify 10:10 AM slots are at the very top (indexes 0 and 1)
    const morningSlots = sorted.slice(0, 2).map((s) => s.startTime)
    assert.deepEqual(morningSlots, ['10:10', '10:10'], 'Morning 10:10 AM slots must appear first')

    // Verify Chemistry Lab session at 10:10 AM is present in morning fold alongside Computer Lab
    const morningSubjects = sorted.slice(0, 2).map((s) => s.subjectName).sort()
    assert.deepEqual(morningSubjects, ['CHEM-12', 'DDMP-10'], 'Both CHEM-12 and DDMP-10 morning slots must be in the top fold')

    // Verify 11:00 AM comes before 12:30 PM and afternoon slots
    assert.equal(sorted[2].startTime, '11:00', '11:00 AM CHEM-12 must be 3rd')
    assert.equal(sorted[3].startTime, '12:30', '12:30 PM must be 4th')
    assert.equal(sorted[4].startTime, '01:45', '01:45 PM afternoon slot must appear AFTER morning/midday slots')
    assert.equal(sorted[5].startTime, '02:30', '02:30 PM must follow 01:45 PM')
    assert.equal(sorted[6].startTime, '03:15', '03:15 PM must follow 02:30 PM')
  })

  it('2. Session Timing Lifecycle: At 09:52 AM, a 10:10 AM session is UPCOMING (Starts in 18m), not LIVE', () => {
    const currentMinutes = 9 * 60 + 52 // 09:52 AM = 592 minutes
    const sessionStartTime = '10:10'
    const sessionEndTime = '11:00'

    const startMin = parseTimeToMinutes(sessionStartTime) // 610 minutes
    const endMin = parseTimeToMinutes(sessionEndTime)     // 660 minutes

    const isUpcoming = currentMinutes < startMin
    const startsInMins = startMin - currentMinutes
    const isLive = currentMinutes >= startMin && currentMinutes < endMin
    const isPast = currentMinutes >= endMin

    assert.equal(isUpcoming, true, '09:52 AM must be classified as upcoming for 10:10 AM class')
    assert.equal(startsInMins, 18, 'Starts in minutes must be exactly 18m')
    assert.equal(isLive, false, '09:52 AM must NOT be classified as live for 10:10 AM class')
    assert.equal(isPast, false, '09:52 AM is not past')
  })

  it('3. Universal Seating Snapshot Invariant: Creating a Computer Lab practical log auto-constructs and persists seating_snapshot in DB', async () => {
    const pool = getPgPool()
    if (!pool) {
      console.log('Skipping DB write test: Direct connection pool not available.')
      return
    }

    const testDate = '2026-10-07' // Active Wednesday
    const testLogId = `TEST-LOG-${Date.now()}`

    try {
      const res = await createPracticalLog({
        id: testLogId,
        lab_id: 'comp',
        date: testDate,
        period_label: '10:10 – 11:00',
        subject_name: 'TEST - Computer Science Practical',
        batch_group: '12 Eng',
        practical_title: 'Verification of Seating Snapshot Persistence',
        total_students: 35,
        present_students: 34,
        absent_students: 1,
        absent_rolls: [5],
        status: 'conducted',
      })

      assert.equal(res.success, true, `Log creation should succeed: ${res.error}`)

      // Query database directly to verify seating_snapshot JSONB is stored
      const checkRes = await pool.query(
        'SELECT id, lab_id, seating_snapshot FROM public.practical_logs WHERE id = $1',
        [testLogId]
      )

      assert.equal(checkRes.rows.length, 1, 'Practical log row must exist in database')
      const row = checkRes.rows[0]
      assert.equal(row.lab_id, 'comp', 'Lab ID must be comp')
      assert.ok(row.seating_snapshot, 'seating_snapshot must not be null or undefined')
      assert.ok(Array.isArray(row.seating_snapshot), 'seating_snapshot must be a JSON array')
      assert.ok(row.seating_snapshot.length > 0, 'seating_snapshot must contain workstation entries')

      // Verify roll 5 is marked as is_present: false
      const roll5Entry = row.seating_snapshot.find((s) => s.roll_number === 5)
      if (roll5Entry) {
        assert.equal(roll5Entry.is_present, false, 'Roll 5 absent student must be marked is_present: false')
      }
    } finally {
      // Clean up test row
      await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.practical_logs WHERE id = $1', [testLogId]).catch(() => {})
    }
  })
})

FILE: tests\holiday-and-recess-guard.test.mjs

import { describe, it } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

// Load .env.local into process.env before DB clients initialize
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const key = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const val = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[key]) {
        process.env[key] = val
      }
    }
  }
}

const { evaluateDateSuspension } = await import('../lib/calendar-policy.ts')

FILE: tests\lab-status.test.mjs
================================================================================
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {
  VALID_LAB_STATUSES,
  validateLabStatus,
  isValidLabStatus,
  deriveLabIsActive,
} from '../lib/lab-status.ts';

test('Lab Facility Status Domain Validation Suite', async (t) => {
  await t.test('VALID_LAB_STATUSES contains exact allowed values', () => {
    assert.deepEqual(Array.from(VALID_LAB_STATUSES), [
      'Operational',
      'Under Maintenance',
      'Inactive',
    ]);
  });

  await t.test('isValidLabStatus accurately recognizes valid and invalid statuses', () => {
    assert.equal(isValidLabStatus('Operational'), true);
    assert.equal(isValidLabStatus('Under Maintenance'), true);
    assert.equal(isValidLabStatus('Inactive'), true);

    // Case sensitivity and invalid variations
    assert.equal(isValidLabStatus('operational'), false);
    assert.equal(isValidLabStatus('Maintenance'), false);
    assert.equal(isValidLabStatus('under maintenance'), false);
    assert.equal(isValidLabStatus('foo'), false);
    assert.equal(isValidLabStatus(''), false);
    assert.equal(isValidLabStatus(null), false);
    assert.equal(isValidLabStatus(undefined), false);
    assert.equal(isValidLabStatus(123), false);
  });

  await t.test('validateLabStatus returns valid statuses and throws on invalid inputs', () => {
    assert.equal(validateLabStatus('Operational'), 'Operational');
    assert.equal(validateLabStatus('Under Maintenance'), 'Under Maintenance');
    assert.equal(validateLabStatus('Inactive'), 'Inactive');

    assert.throws(
      () => validateLabStatus('Maintenance'),
      /Invalid lab status: "Maintenance"/
    );
    assert.throws(
      () => validateLabStatus('operational'),
      /Invalid lab status: "operational"/
    );
    assert.throws(
      () => validateLabStatus('foo'),
      /Invalid lab status: "foo"/
    );
    assert.throws(
      () => validateLabStatus(null),
      /Invalid lab status: "null"/
    );
  });

  await t.test('deriveLabIsActive accurately derives active lifecycle flag and rejects invalid strings', () => {
    // Both 'Operational' and 'Under Maintenance' represent active facilities in the institution
    assert.equal(deriveLabIsActive('Operational'), true);
    assert.equal(deriveLabIsActive('Under Maintenance'), true);

    // 'Inactive' represents decommissioned/soft-deleted facility
    assert.equal(deriveLabIsActive('Inactive'), false);

    // Untrusted or malformed strings throw error for defense-in-depth
    assert.throws(
      () => deriveLabIsActive('Maintenance'),
      /Invalid lab status: "Maintenance"/
    );
    assert.throws(
      () => deriveLabIsActive('operational'),
      /Invalid lab status: "operational"/
    );
    assert.throws(
      () => deriveLabIsActive('foo'),
      /Invalid lab status: "foo"/
    );
  });

  await t.test('server-side booking guard validates lab availability accurately', () => {
    function evaluateLabBookingAllowed(lab) {
      if (lab.status === 'Under Maintenance') {
        return { allowed: false, reason: 'Under Maintenance' };
      }
      if (!lab.is_active || lab.status === 'Inactive') {
        return { allowed: false, reason: 'Inactive' };
      }
      return { allowed: true };
    }

    assert.deepEqual(evaluateLabBookingAllowed({ status: 'Under Maintenance', is_active: true }), {
      allowed: false,
      reason: 'Under Maintenance',
    });
    assert.deepEqual(evaluateLabBookingAllowed({ status: 'Inactive', is_active: false }), {
      allowed: false,
      reason: 'Inactive',
    });
    assert.deepEqual(evaluateLabBookingAllowed({ status: 'Operational', is_active: true }), {
      allowed: true,
    });
  });
});

FILE: tests\merge-unmerge-schedule.test.mjs
================================================================================
import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { computeCombinedTimeRange } from '../lib/master-data.ts'
import { parseSlotTimeRange } from '../lib/utils.ts'

test('Schedule Merge & Unmerge Engine Invariants', async (t) => {
  await t.test('1. Time Span Calculation: Merging slot t2 (10:10 - 11:00) with span 2 computes end_time 11:45', () => {
    const range = computeCombinedTimeRange('t2', 2)
    assert.equal(range, '10:10 - 11:45', 'Combined time range must cover both periods')
    const { startTime, endTime } = parseSlotTimeRange(range)
    assert.equal(startTime, '10:10')
    assert.equal(endTime, '11:45')
  })

  await t.test('2. Title Deduplication: Merging identical subjects deduplicates title and code', () => {
    function cleanMergedSubjectName(name, fallbackPrimary, fallbackSecondary) {
      if (name) {
        const trimmed = name.trim()
        const parts = trimmed.split(/\s*(?:&|\+)\s*/).map((p) => p.trim()).filter(Boolean)
        if (parts.length > 1 && new Set(parts).size === 1) {
          return parts[0]
        }
        return trimmed
      }
      if (fallbackPrimary && fallbackSecondary) {
        if (fallbackPrimary.trim() === fallbackSecondary.trim()) {
          return fallbackPrimary.trim()
        }
        return `${fallbackPrimary.trim()} & ${fallbackSecondary.trim()}`
      }
      return fallbackPrimary || ''
    }

    const test1 = cleanMergedSubjectName('CHEM-12 - Chemistry Lab & CHEM-12 - Chemistry Lab')
    assert.equal(test1, 'CHEM-12 - Chemistry Lab', 'Should deduplicate concatenated identical names')

    const test2 = cleanMergedSubjectName(undefined, 'CHEM-12 - Chemistry Lab', 'CHEM-12 - Chemistry Lab')
    assert.equal(test2, 'CHEM-12 - Chemistry Lab', 'Should not join duplicate fallback names')

    const test3 = cleanMergedSubjectName('COMP-11 - Programming & DDMP-10 - Digital Design')
    assert.equal(test3, 'COMP-11 - Programming & DDMP-10 - Digital Design', 'Should preserve distinct subject names')
  })
})

FILE: tests\navigation-and-compression.test.mjs

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'

test('Navigation Safety & Open-Redirect Protection Suite', async (t) => {
  // Simulating the BackButton resolution logic:
  function resolveBackDestination(fromParam, historyLength, fallbackHref = '/records') {
    if (fromParam && fromParam.startsWith('/') && !fromParam.startsWith('//')) {
      return { action: 'push', destination: fromParam }
    } else if (historyLength > 2) {
      return { action: 'back' }
    } else {
      return { action: 'push', destination: fallbackHref }
    }
  }

  await t.test('Respects legitimate internal from parameter', () => {
    const res = resolveBackDestination('/records?view=compact', 1, '/records')
    assert.deepEqual(res, { action: 'push', destination: '/records?view=compact' })
  })

  await t.test('Rejects malicious protocol-relative open-redirect URLs', () => {
    // //evil.com must not be treated as a valid internal path
    const res = resolveBackDestination('//evil.com', 1, '/records')
    assert.deepEqual(res, { action: 'push', destination: '/records' })
  })

  await t.test('Rejects external URLs passed via from parameter', () => {
    const res = resolveBackDestination('https://phishing.site', 1, '/records')
    assert.deepEqual(res, { action: 'push', destination: '/records' })
  })

  await t.test('Invokes router.back() when history length > 2 and no from param', () => {
    const res = resolveBackDestination(null, 3, '/records')
    assert.deepEqual(res, { action: 'back' })
  })

  await t.test('Safely falls back to fallbackHref when history <= 2 (direct bookmark/link access)', () => {
    const res = resolveBackDestination(null, 1, '/records')
    assert.deepEqual(res, { action: 'push', destination: '/records' })
  })
})

test('Supabase Storage Bucket & Attachment Constraint Suite', async (t) => {
  const BUCKET_CONFIG = {
    bucketName: 'incident-attachments',
    allowedMimeTypes: ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'],
    fileSizeLimit: 5242880, // 5MB post-compression ceiling
  }

  function validateUploadConstraint(mimeType, sizeBytes) {
    if (!BUCKET_CONFIG.allowedMimeTypes.includes(mimeType)) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid MIME type: ${mimeType}`)
    }
    if (sizeBytes > BUCKET_CONFIG.fileSizeLimit) {
      throw new Error(`File size ${sizeBytes} exceeds limit of ${BUCKET_CONFIG.fileSizeLimit}`)
    }
    return true
  }

  function generateScopedStoragePath(incidentId, uuid) {
    assert.match(incidentId, /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/, 'Incident ID must be alphanumeric')
    assert.match(uuid, /^[a-f0-9-]+$/, 'Must be valid UUID')
    return `${incidentId}/${uuid}.jpg`
  }

  await t.test('Enforces allowed MIME types (JPEG, PNG, WebP)', () => {
    assert.ok(validateUploadConstraint('image/jpeg', 1024 * 500))
    assert.ok(validateUploadConstraint('image/png', 1024 * 500))
    assert.ok(validateUploadConstraint('image/webp', 1024 * 500))
    assert.throws(() => validateUploadConstraint('application/pdf', 1024))
    assert.throws(() => validateUploadConstraint('application/x-msdownload', 1024))
  })

  await t.test('Enforces 5MB file size ceiling', () => {
    assert.ok(validateUploadConstraint('image/jpeg', 5 * 1024 * 1024))
    assert.throws(() => validateUploadConstraint('image/jpeg', 5 * 1024 * 1024 + 1))
  })

  await t.test('Generates secure scoped folder path scoped to incidentId', () => {
    const path = generateScopedStoragePath('inc-12345', 'e3b0c442-98fc-1c14-9afb-4c760667c5e3')
    assert.equal(path, 'inc-12345/e3b0c442-98fc-1c14-9afb-4c760667c5e3.jpg')
  })
})

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { validatePasswordPolicy } from '../lib/auth-policy.ts'

test('Institutional Password Policy Validator - Comprehensive Invariant Tests', async (t) => {
  await t.test('enforces minimum length of 8 characters', () => {
    const resShort = validatePasswordPolicy('Aa1!bcd')
    assert.strictEqual(resShort.isValid, false)
    assert.strictEqual(resShort.criteria.minLength, false)
    assert.ok(resShort.errors.some((e) => e.includes('8 characters')))

    const resValidLen = validatePasswordPolicy('Aa1!bcde')
    assert.strictEqual(resValidLen.criteria.minLength, true)
  })

  await t.test('enforces uppercase letter requirement', () => {
    const resNoUpper = validatePasswordPolicy('pass1234!')
    assert.strictEqual(resNoUpper.isValid, false)
    assert.strictEqual(resNoUpper.criteria.hasUpper, false)

    const resWithUpper = validatePasswordPolicy('Pass1234!')
    assert.strictEqual(resWithUpper.criteria.hasUpper, true)
  })

  await t.test('enforces lowercase letter requirement', () => {
    const resNoLower = validatePasswordPolicy('PASS1234!')
    assert.strictEqual(resNoLower.isValid, false)
    assert.strictEqual(resNoLower.criteria.hasLower, false)

    const resWithLower = validatePasswordPolicy('PASS1234a!')
    assert.strictEqual(resWithLower.criteria.hasLower, true)
  })

  await t.test('enforces numeric digit requirement', () => {
    const resNoNum = validatePasswordPolicy('Password!')
    assert.strictEqual(resNoNum.isValid, false)
    assert.strictEqual(resNoNum.criteria.hasNumber, false)

    const resWithNum = validatePasswordPolicy('Password1!')
    assert.strictEqual(resWithNum.criteria.hasNumber, true)
  })

  await t.test('enforces special character / symbol requirement', () => {
    const resNoSpecial = validatePasswordPolicy('Password123')
    assert.strictEqual(resNoSpecial.isValid, false)
    assert.strictEqual(resNoSpecial.criteria.hasSpecial, false)

    const resWithSpecial = validatePasswordPolicy('Password123#')
    assert.strictEqual(resWithSpecial.criteria.hasSpecial, true)
    assert.strictEqual(resWithSpecial.isValid, true)
  })

  await t.test('calculates accurate strength scores and ratings', () => {
    const weak = validatePasswordPolicy('abc')
    assert.strictEqual(weak.score <= 1, true)
    assert.strictEqual(weak.strength, 'weak')

    const fair = validatePasswordPolicy('Password')
    assert.strictEqual(fair.score, 3)
    assert.strictEqual(fair.strength, 'fair')

    const good = validatePasswordPolicy('Password12')
    assert.strictEqual(good.score, 4)
    assert.strictEqual(good.strength, 'good')

    const strong = validatePasswordPolicy('G00gle!DeepM!nd#2026')
    assert.strictEqual(strong.score, 5)
    assert.strictEqual(strong.strength, 'strong')
    assert.strictEqual(strong.isValid, true)
  })
})

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'

test('Pending User Security & Operational Lockdown Suite', async (t) => {
  // Test 1: User Scope lockdown
  await t.test('1. resolveUserScope strictly locks down pending users regardless of declared role', () => {
    const pendingTeacherScope = resolveUserScope({
      id: 'usr-pending-1',
      email: 'newbie@rrl.edu.np',
      full_name: 'Pending Teacher',
      role: 'teacher',
      approval_status: 'pending',
      is_active: true,
      permissions: {},
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })

    assert.strictEqual(pendingTeacherScope.approvalStatus, 'pending')
    assert.strictEqual(pendingTeacherScope.isPending, true)
    assert.strictEqual(pendingTeacherScope.isPrivileged, false)
    assert.deepStrictEqual(pendingTeacherScope.assignedClasses, [])
    assert.deepStrictEqual(pendingTeacherScope.assignedSubjects, [])
    assert.deepStrictEqual(pendingTeacherScope.assignedLabIds, [])
    assert.strictEqual(pendingTeacherScope.defaultViewMode, 'my_data')

    // Even if user claimed to be lab_incharge or super_admin on registration
    const pendingAdminPretenceScope = resolveUserScope({
      id: 'usr-pending-fake-admin',
      email: 'hacker@rrl.edu.np',
      full_name: 'Fake Admin',
      role: 'lab_incharge',
      approval_status: 'pending',
      is_active: true,
      permissions: {},
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })

    assert.strictEqual(pendingAdminPretenceScope.approvalStatus, 'pending')
    assert.strictEqual(pendingAdminPretenceScope.isPending, true)
    assert.strictEqual(pendingAdminPretenceScope.isPrivileged, false, 'Pending lab_incharge MUST NOT be privileged')
    assert.deepStrictEqual(pendingAdminPretenceScope.assignedClasses, [])
    assert.deepStrictEqual(pendingAdminPretenceScope.assignedLabIds, [])
  })

  // Test 2: Password requirement checked BEFORE OTP generation
  await t.test('2. generateAndSendSignupOtp strictly requires valid password policy before generating OTP', async () => {
    // Missing password
    const resNoPass = await generateAndSendSignupOtp('newbie@rrl.edu.np', 'Newbie Teacher', '')
    assert.ok(resNoPass.error, 'Must error when password is empty')
    assert.ok(resNoPass.error.includes('Password is required'))

    // Weak password failing criteria
    const resWeakPass = await generateAndSendSignupOtp('newbie@rrl.edu.np', 'Newbie Teacher', 'weak')
    assert.ok(resWeakPass.error, 'Must error when password fails criteria')
    assert.ok(resWeakPass.error.includes('Password requirement not met'))
  })

  // Test 3: Operational mutation lockdown when authenticated user is pending
  await t.test('3. Server mutations reject execution when TEST_USER_OVERRIDE represents a pending account', async () => {

      email: 'pending.mock@rrl.edu.np',
      full_name: 'Pending Mock Faculty',
      role: 'teacher',
      approval_status: 'pending',
      is_active: true,
      permissions: {},
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })

      assert.strictEqual(updateRes.success, false)
      assert.ok(updateRes.error?.includes('pending verification'))

      const deleteRes = await deletePracticalLog('log-seed-1')

        end_time: '11:45',
      })
      assert.ok(schedRes.error?.includes('pending institutional verification') || schedRes.error?.includes('pending verification'))

      const delSchedRes = await deleteSchedule('sched-mock-1')
      assert.strictEqual(delSchedRes.success, false)
      assert.ok(delSchedRes.error?.includes('pending verification'))
    } finally {
      delete process.env.TEST_USER_OVERRIDE
    }
  })
})

FILE: tests\period-slots-chronological.test.mjs
