import { describe, it } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { getPgPool } from '../lib/db.ts'
import { parseTimeToMinutes, sortPeriodSlots } from '../lib/utils.ts'

describe('Period Slots Chronological Order & Key Synchronization', () => {
  it('1. sortPeriodSlots sorts arbitrary period slots chronologically by start time', () => {
    const unsorted = [
      { id: 't4', name: 'Period 4', label: '12:15 - 01:00 PM' },
      { id: 't8', name: 'Period 8', label: '03:55 - 04:30 PM' },
      { id: 't0', name: 'Pre-Period', label: '09:15 - 09:50' },
      { id: 't1', name: 'Period 1', label: '10:00 - 10:45 AM' },
      { id: 'break', name: 'Recess Break', label: '01:00 - 01:40 PM' },
      { id: 't2', name: 'Period 2', label: '10:45 - 11:30 AM' },
    ]

    const sorted = sortPeriodSlots(unsorted)

    assert.equal(sorted[0].name, 'Pre-Period', 'Pre-Period (09:15) must be first')
    assert.equal(sorted[1].name, 'Period 1', 'Period 1 (10:00) must be second')
    assert.equal(sorted[2].name, 'Period 2', 'Period 2 (10:45) must be third')
    assert.equal(sorted[3].name, 'Period 4', 'Period 4 (12:15) must be fourth')
    assert.equal(sorted[4].name, 'Recess Break', 'Recess Break (01:00 PM) must be fifth')
    assert.equal(sorted[5].name, 'Period 8', 'Period 8 (03:55 PM) must be last')
  })

  it('2. PostgreSQL master_time_slots and infrastructure_periods are synchronized and in order', async () => {
    const pool = getPgPool()
    if (!pool) {
      console.log('Skipping DB check: pool not available')
      return
    }

    const res = await pool.query(
      `SELECT key, value FROM public.institution_settings WHERE key IN ('master_time_slots', 'infrastructure_periods')`
    )

    const masterRow = res.rows.find((r) => r.key === 'master_time_slots')
    const infraRow = res.rows.find((r) => r.key === 'infrastructure_periods')

    assert.ok(masterRow?.value, 'master_time_slots must exist in institution_settings')
    assert.ok(infraRow?.value, 'infrastructure_periods must exist in institution_settings')

    const masterSlots = masterRow.value
    const infraSlots = infraRow.value

    assert.equal(masterSlots.length, infraSlots.length, 'Both slot configs must have same length')
    assert.ok(masterSlots.length >= 8, 'Must have at least 8 periods')

    // First period must be valid
    assert.ok(masterSlots[0].name, 'First period must have a name')
    assert.ok(masterSlots[0].label, 'First period must have a label')

    // Ensure all periods are monotonically increasing in start minutes
    for (let i = 1; i < masterSlots.length; i++) {
      const prevMin = parseTimeToMinutes(masterSlots[i - 1].label)
      const currMin = parseTimeToMinutes(masterSlots[i].label)
      assert.ok(
        currMin >= prevMin,
        `Slot ${masterSlots[i].name} (${currMin}m) must be >= previous slot ${masterSlots[i - 1].name} (${prevMin}m)`
      )
    }
  })
})

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'

// Load .env.local into process.env so DB connection resolves
try {
  const envContent = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf-8')
  for (const line of envContent.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const key = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const val = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[key]) {
        process.env[key] = val
      }
    }
  }
} catch (e) {}

test('Phase 1: Canonical Database Actions & Relational Mapping', async (t) => {
  const { getSubjectsAction, getClassSubjectsAction } = await import('../app/actions/subjects.ts')

    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getSubjectsAction should succeed')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'res.data should be an array')
    assert.ok(res.data.length >= 20, `Expected at least 20 subjects, got ${res.data.length}`)
    
    // Verify subject structure

    assert.ok(first.code, 'Subject should have code')
    assert.ok(first.name, 'Subject should have name')
    assert.equal(first.is_active, true, 'Subject should be active')
  })

  await t.test('2. getClassSubjectsAction returns relational mapping rows', async () => {
    const res = await getClassSubjectsAction()
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getClassSubjectsAction should succeed')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'res.data should be an array')
    assert.ok(res.data.length >= 10, `Expected at least 10 class_subject mappings, got ${res.data.length}`)

    // Verify mapping has joined subject and class
    const sample = res.data[0]
    assert.ok(sample.class_id, 'Mapping should have class_id')
    assert.ok(sample.subject_id, 'Mapping should have subject_id')
  })

  await t.test('3. getClassesAction returns active class batches', async () => {
    const res = await getClassesAction({ activeOnly: true })
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getClassesAction should succeed')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'res.data should be an array')
    assert.ok(res.data.length >= 5, `Expected at least 5 classes, got ${res.data.length}`)
  })

  await t.test('4. getTeachers() strictly filters for approved and active faculty', async () => {
    const teachers = await getTeachers()
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(teachers), 'Teachers should be an array')
    assert.ok(teachers.length > 0, 'Should return approved teachers')

    // Verify no dummy teacher codes like COMP12-Teacher leak in
    const hasDummy = teachers.some((t) => t.full_name.includes('COMP12-Teacher') || t.full_name.includes('CN12-Teacher'))
    assert.equal(hasDummy, false, 'getTeachers() must not contain dummy routine placeholders')

    // Verify Dinanath Shah is not duplicated
    const dinanathEntries = teachers.filter((t) => t.full_name.toLowerCase().includes('dinanath'))
    assert.ok(dinanathEntries.length <= 1, `Dinanath Shah should not be duplicated, found: ${dinanathEntries.length}`)
  })

  await t.test('5. getPeriodSlotsAction returns period schedule', async () => {
    const res = await getPeriodSlotsAction()
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getPeriodSlotsAction should succeed')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'res.data should be an array')
  })

  await t.test('6. getActiveAcademicYearAction returns current academic year', async () => {
    const res = await getActiveAcademicYearAction()
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getActiveAcademicYearAction should succeed')
    if (res.data) {
      assert.equal(res.data.is_current, true, 'Returned year must be current')
      assert.ok(res.data.name, 'Academic year should have name')
    }
  })

  await t.test('7. resolveUserScope security matrix blocks unapproved/deactivated accounts', async () => {
    const { resolveUserScope } = await import('../lib/context/user-scope.ts')
    
    // Unauthenticated guest
    const guest = resolveUserScope(null)
    assert.equal(guest.isPrivileged, false)
    assert.notEqual(guest.approvalStatus, 'approved')

    // Rejected admin
    const rejectedAdmin = resolveUserScope({ id: 'u1', role: 'super_admin', approval_status: 'rejected', is_active: true })
    assert.equal(rejectedAdmin.isPrivileged, false)
    assert.notEqual(rejectedAdmin.approvalStatus, 'approved')

    // Deactivated admin
    const deactivatedAdmin = resolveUserScope({ id: 'u2', role: 'super_admin', approval_status: 'approved', is_active: false })
    assert.equal(deactivatedAdmin.isPrivileged, false)
    assert.notEqual(deactivatedAdmin.approvalStatus, 'approved')

    // Pending admin
    const pendingAdmin = resolveUserScope({ id: 'u3', role: 'super_admin', approval_status: 'pending', is_active: true })
    assert.equal(pendingAdmin.isPrivileged, false)
    assert.notEqual(pendingAdmin.approvalStatus, 'approved')

    // Approved & active admin
    const approvedAdmin = resolveUserScope({ id: 'u4', role: 'super_admin', approval_status: 'approved', is_active: true })
    assert.equal(approvedAdmin.isPrivileged, true)
    assert.equal(approvedAdmin.approvalStatus, 'approved')
  })

  // Clean exit after completion
  setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 100)
})

import { describe, it } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'
import {
  normalizeStudentName,
  formatStudentDisplayName,
  calculateNameSimilarity,
  isNameMatch,
} from '../lib/imports/string-normalization.ts'

function loadDbUrl() {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
  if (!fs.existsSync(envPath)) return null
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
      return line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
    }
  }
  return null
}

describe('Phase 1 Foundation: Schema & String Normalization Suite', () => {
  const dbUrl = loadDbUrl()

  describe('Database Tables & Structural Integrity', () => {
    it('All Phase 1 tables exist in public schema', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()
      try {
        const res = await client.query(`
          SELECT table_name 
          FROM information_schema.tables 
          WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
            AND table_name IN (
              'academic_years', 
              'students', 
              'student_enrollments', 
              'workstation_seat_plans', 
              'session_seat_overrides', 
              'lab_floor_elements'
            );
        `)
        const tables = res.rows.map(r => r.table_name)
        assert.ok(tables.includes('academic_years'), 'academic_years must exist')
        assert.ok(tables.includes('students'), 'students must exist')
        assert.ok(tables.includes('student_enrollments'), 'student_enrollments must exist')
        assert.ok(tables.includes('workstation_seat_plans'), 'workstation_seat_plans must exist')
        assert.ok(tables.includes('session_seat_overrides'), 'session_seat_overrides must exist')
        assert.ok(tables.includes('lab_floor_elements'), 'lab_floor_elements must exist')
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })

    it('Academic Year 2083 is seeded and marked as is_current = true', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()
      try {
        const res = await client.query(`
          SELECT id, name, is_current 
          FROM public.academic_years 
          WHERE id = '2083';
        `)
        assert.equal(res.rows.length, 1, 'Academic year 2083 must exist')
        assert.equal(res.rows[0].is_current, true, 'Academic year 2083 must be current')
        assert.equal(res.rows[0].name, '2083 B.S. (2026/27 A.D.)', 'Standard dual-calendar name format')
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })

    it('Session override workstation collision constraint exists', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()
      try {
        const res = await client.query(`
          SELECT conname 
          FROM pg_constraint 
          WHERE conname = 'uq_session_override_workstation';
        `)
        assert.equal(res.rows.length, 1, 'uq_session_override_workstation constraint must exist')
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })

    it('Attendance bridge column exists in log_attendance', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()
      try {
        const res = await client.query(`
          SELECT column_name, data_type 
          FROM information_schema.columns 
          WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
            AND table_name = 'log_attendance' 
            AND column_name = 'student_id';
        `)
        assert.equal(res.rows.length, 1, 'student_id must exist in log_attendance')
        assert.equal(res.rows[0].data_type, 'uuid', 'student_id must be uuid')
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })
  })

  describe('String Normalization & Nepali Abbreviations', () => {
    it('Normalizes Nepali abbreviation K.C. to kc', () => {
      assert.equal(normalizeStudentName('Ram K.C.'), 'ram kc')
      assert.equal(normalizeStudentName('Ram KC'), 'ram kc')
      assert.equal(normalizeStudentName('  Ram   K.C.  '), 'ram kc')
    })

    it('Normalizes B.K. abbreviation to bk', () => {
      assert.equal(normalizeStudentName('Sita B.K.'), 'sita bk')
      assert.equal(normalizeStudentName('Sita BK'), 'sita bk')
    })

    it('Strips non-alphanumeric punctuation cleanly', () => {
      assert.equal(normalizeStudentName('Bikash Shrestha-Magar'), 'bikash shresthamagar')
      assert.equal(normalizeStudentName('Aayush "Tony" Sharma'), 'aayush tony sharma')
    })

    it('Identifies name match between abbreviated and non-abbreviated variants', () => {
      assert.ok(isNameMatch('Ram K.C.', 'Ram KC'))
      assert.ok(isNameMatch('Sita B.K.', 'Sita BK'))
      assert.ok(isNameMatch('Hari Prasad Sharma', 'Sharma Hari Prasad')) // token permutation
    })

    it('Formats display name nicely in Title Case', () => {
      assert.equal(formatStudentDisplayName('RAM BAHADUR K.C.'), 'Ram Bahadur K.C.')
      assert.equal(formatStudentDisplayName('sita kumari bk'), 'Sita Kumari Bk')
    })
  })
})

import { describe, it } from 'node:test'

if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const key = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const val = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[key]) {
        process.env[key] = val
      }
    }
  }

// Now dynamically import terminal action functions with populated environment
const {
  verifyTerminalAccess,
  submitStudentIssueReport,
  getLiveAssistanceRequests,
  acknowledgeAssistanceRequest,
} = await import('../app/actions/terminal.ts')

const { TERMINAL_QUICK_ISSUES } = await import('../lib/types/terminal.ts')

describe('Phase 1: Zero-Login Student Terminal Self-Reporting & Live Help Beacon', () => {
  const dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL

  it('Schema Integrity: public.workstations has lan_ip and pairing_token columns', async () => {
    if (!dbUrl) return
    const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT column_name, data_type 
      FROM information_schema.columns 
      WHERE table_name = 'workstations' AND column_name IN ('lan_ip', 'pairing_token');
    `)
    await pool.end()

    const cols = res.rows.map((r) => r.column_name)
    assert.ok(cols.includes('lan_ip'), 'workstations must have lan_ip')
    assert.ok(cols.includes('pairing_token'), 'workstations must have pairing_token')
  })

  it('Schema Integrity: public.workstation_issues supports student self-reporting (nullable reported_by_id, source, student fields)', async () => {
    if (!dbUrl) return
    const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT column_name, is_nullable 
      FROM information_schema.columns 
      WHERE table_name = 'workstation_issues' AND column_name IN ('reported_by_id', 'source', 'student_name', 'student_roll');
    `)
    await pool.end()

    const colMap = Object.fromEntries(res.rows.map((r) => [r.column_name, r.is_nullable]))
    assert.equal(colMap.reported_by_id, 'YES', 'reported_by_id must be nullable for student reports')
    assert.ok('source' in colMap, 'workstation_issues must have source column')
    assert.ok('student_name' in colMap, 'workstation_issues must have student_name column')
    assert.ok('student_roll' in colMap, 'workstation_issues must have student_roll column')
  })

  it('Domain Models: TERMINAL_QUICK_ISSUES contains standard 6 alive-only issue chips', () => {
    assert.equal(TERMINAL_QUICK_ISSUES.length, 6)
    const ids = TERMINAL_QUICK_ISSUES.map((c) => c.id)
    assert.ok(ids.includes('peripherals'))
    assert.ok(ids.includes('no_internet'))
    assert.ok(ids.includes('missing_software'))
    assert.ok(ids.includes('app_freeze'))
    assert.ok(ids.includes('audio_issue'))
    assert.ok(ids.includes('other'))
  })

  it('Server Action Pure RPC Exports: app/actions/terminal.ts only exports async functions (Rule #13)', () => {
    const filePath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'app/actions/terminal.ts')
    const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8')

    // Find all export statements
    const exportMatches = content.match(/export\s+(?:async\s+function|const|let|var|function|type|interface)\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)/g) || []
    for (const exp of exportMatches) {
      assert.ok(
        exp.startsWith('export async function'),
        `Forbidden non-async export found in 'use server' file: "${exp}". Adhere to Rule #13.`
      )
    }
  })

  it('Anti-Spoofing Engine: verifyTerminalAccess validates workstation and blocks mismatched pairing tokens', async () => {
    if (!dbUrl) return

    // 1. Unknown workstation should be rejected
    const unknownRes = await verifyTerminalAccess('NON_EXISTENT_STATION_9999')
    assert.equal(unknownRes.allowed, false)

    // 2. Query a seeded workstation from DB
    const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
    const wsRes = await pool.query(`SELECT id, label, pairing_token FROM public.workstations WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1`)
    if (wsRes.rows.length === 0) {
      await pool.end()
      return
    }

    const testWs = wsRes.rows[0]

    // Set a known pairing token on test workstation
    await pool.query(`UPDATE public.workstations SET pairing_token = 'TEST-SECRET-123' WHERE id = $1`, [testWs.id])

    // Case A: Matching token should be allowed
    const validRes = await verifyTerminalAccess(testWs.label, 'TEST-SECRET-123')
    assert.equal(validRes.allowed, true)
    assert.equal(validRes.tokenMatched, true)

    // Case B: Mismatched token should be blocked by anti-spoofing lock
    const spoofedRes = await verifyTerminalAccess(testWs.label, 'WRONG-SPOOFED-TOKEN')
    assert.equal(spoofedRes.allowed, false)
    assert.ok(spoofedRes.reason?.includes('Anti-Spoofing Lock'))

    // Cleanup token
    await pool.query(`UPDATE public.workstations SET pairing_token = $1 WHERE id = $2`, [testWs.pairing_token, testWs.id])
    await pool.end()
  })

  it('Student Reporting & Cockpit Beacon: submitStudentIssueReport inserts student report and beacon alerts', async () => {
    if (!dbUrl) return

    const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
    const wsRes = await pool.query(`SELECT id, label, lab_id, pairing_token FROM public.workstations WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1`)
    if (wsRes.rows.length === 0) {
      await pool.end()
      return
    }

    const testWs = wsRes.rows[0]
    const labId = testWs.lab_id || 'comp'

    // Submit report as student
    const submitRes = await submitStudentIssueReport({
      stationCode: testWs.label,
      issueTag: 'missing_software',
      title: 'VS Code Missing Python Extension',
      description: 'Cannot run practical script in laboratory session',
      studentName: 'Test Student',
      studentRoll: '99',
      pairingToken: testWs.pairing_token || undefined,
    })

    assert.equal(submitRes.success, true, `Report submission failed: ${submitRes.error}`)
    assert.ok(submitRes.issueId, 'Must return issueId')

    // Verify it appears in live assistance requests
    const beaconRes = await getLiveAssistanceRequests(labId)
    assert.equal(beaconRes.success, true)
    const matchingReq = beaconRes.requests.find((r) => r.id === submitRes.issueId)
    assert.ok(matchingReq, 'Student report must appear in Live Assistance Requests queue')
    assert.equal(matchingReq.studentName, 'Test Student')
    assert.equal(matchingReq.studentRoll, '99')

    // Acknowledge the request
    const ackRes = await acknowledgeAssistanceRequest(submitRes.issueId)
    assert.equal(ackRes.success, true)

    // Clean up test issue from database
    await pool.query(`DELETE FROM public.workstation_issues WHERE id = $1`, [submitRes.issueId])
    await pool.end()
  })

  it('UI Architecture: Student terminal views and cockpit alert components exist', () => {
    const studentViewPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'components/terminal/student-terminal-view.tsx')
    const queueViewPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'components/computer-lab/terminal-assistance-queue.tsx')
    const routePath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'app/terminal/[code]/page.tsx')
    const pairRoutePath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'app/terminal/pair/page.tsx')

    assert.ok(fs.existsSync(studentViewPath), 'StudentTerminalView component must exist')
    assert.ok(fs.existsSync(queueViewPath), 'TerminalAssistanceQueue component must exist')
    assert.ok(fs.existsSync(routePath), '/terminal/[code] route must exist')
    assert.ok(fs.existsSync(pairRoutePath), '/terminal/pair route must exist')

    const studentViewContent = fs.readFileSync(studentViewPath, 'utf8')
    assert.ok(studentViewContent.includes('TERMINAL_QUICK_ISSUES'), 'Must render quick issue chips')
    assert.ok(studentViewContent.includes('submitStudentIssueReport'), 'Must wire report submission action')
  })
})

  } = await import('../app/actions/subjects.ts')
  const { getIssueCategories, manageIssueCategory } = await import('../app/actions/workstations.ts')
  const { getPgPool } = await import('../lib/db.ts')

  const pool = getPgPool()
  const testSuffix = Date.now().toString().slice(-6)
  const testClassId = `test-cls-${testSuffix}`
  const testSubjectCode = `TP2_${testSuffix}`
  const testSubjectId = `test-sub-${testSuffix}`
  let testClassSubjectId = null
  let testCategoryId = null

  t.after(async () => {
    // Clean up test rows directly
    try {
      if (testClassSubjectId) {
        await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.practical_logs WHERE class_subject_id = $1;', [testClassSubjectId])
        await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.class_subjects WHERE id = $1;', [testClassSubjectId])
      }
      await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.class_subjects WHERE class_id = $1;', [testClassId])
      await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.classes WHERE id = $1;', [testClassId])
      await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.subjects WHERE id = $1 OR code = $2;', [testSubjectId, testSubjectCode])
      if (testCategoryId) {
        await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.issue_categories WHERE id = $1;', [testCategoryId])
      }
    } catch (cleanupErr) {
      console.warn('Test cleanup notice:', cleanupErr.message)
    }
  })

  await t.test('1. getClassesAction retrieves active classes from PostgreSQL', async () => {
    const res = await getClassesAction({ activeOnly: true })
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getClassesAction should succeed')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'res.data should be an array')
    assert.ok(res.data.length >= 1, 'Should return at least one class')
    assert.ok(res.data.every((c) => c.is_active === true), 'All returned classes should be active')
  })

  await t.test('2. createClassAction creates a canonical class record with RBAC protection', async () => {
    const res = await createClassAction({
      id: testClassId,
      name: `Class 11 Test ${testSuffix}`,
      grade: 11,
      section: 'Alpha',
      stream_id: null,
      capacity: 36,
      is_active: true,
    })

    assert.equal(res.success, true, `createClassAction failed: ${res.error}`)
    assert.ok(res.data, 'Should return created class record')
    assert.equal(res.data.id, testClassId)
    assert.equal(res.data.name, `Class 11 Test ${testSuffix}`)
    assert.equal(res.data.capacity, 36)
  })

  await t.test('3. updateClassAction updates class capacity, section and attributes', async () => {
    const res = await updateClassAction(testClassId, {
      capacity: 42,
      section: 'Beta',
    })

    assert.equal(res.success, true, `updateClassAction failed: ${res.error}`)
    assert.ok(res.data, 'Should return updated class record')
    assert.equal(res.data.capacity, 42)
    assert.equal(res.data.section, 'Beta')
  })

  await t.test('4. deactivateClassAction soft-archives the class record', async () => {
    const res = await deactivateClassAction(testClassId)
    assert.equal(res.success, true, `deactivateClassAction failed: ${res.error}`)

    // Verify in database that is_active is false
    const check = await pool.query('SELECT is_active FROM public.classes WHERE id = $1;', [testClassId])
    assert.equal(check.rows[0]?.is_active, false, 'Class should be soft-deactivated')

    // Re-activate for downstream mapping test
    await pool.query('UPDATE public.classes SET is_active = true WHERE id = $1;', [testClassId])
  })

  await t.test('5. getSubjectsAction retrieves active subjects catalog from PostgreSQL', async () => {
    const res = await getSubjectsAction({ activeOnly: true })
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getSubjectsAction should succeed')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'res.data should be an array')
    assert.ok(res.data.length >= 10, `Expected at least 10 subjects, got ${res.data.length}`)
  })

  await t.test('6. createSubjectAction creates a canonical subject in the catalog', async () => {
    const res = await createSubjectAction({
      id: testSubjectId,
      code: testSubjectCode,
      name: `Automated Test Subject ${testSuffix}`,
      default_lab_id: 'comp',
      credit_hours: 4,
      is_active: true,
    })

    assert.equal(res.success, true, `createSubjectAction failed: ${res.error}`)
    assert.ok(res.data, 'Should return created subject record')
    assert.equal(res.data.code, testSubjectCode)
    assert.equal(res.data.default_lab_id, 'comp')
  })

  await t.test('7. assignSubjectToClassAction creates relational junction mapping in public.class_subjects', async () => {
    const res = await assignSubjectToClassAction({
      class_id: testClassId,
      subject_id: testSubjectId,
      default_lab_id: 'comp',
    })

    assert.equal(res.success, true, `assignSubjectToClassAction failed: ${res.error}`)

    // Query mapping row
    const mapping = await pool.query(
      'SELECT id, class_id, subject_id, default_lab_id FROM public.class_subjects WHERE class_id = $1 AND subject_id = $2;',
      [testClassId, testSubjectId]
    )
    assert.equal(mapping.rows.length, 1, 'Junction mapping row must exist')
    testClassSubjectId = mapping.rows[0].id
    assert.equal(mapping.rows[0].default_lab_id, 'comp')
  })

  await t.test('8. getClassSubjectsAction retrieves enriched relational mapping rows', async () => {
    const res = await getClassSubjectsAction(testClassId)
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getClassSubjectsAction should succeed')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'res.data should be an array')
    const match = res.data.find((m) => m.subject_id === testSubjectId)
    assert.ok(match, 'Enriched mapping should include the test subject')
    assert.equal(match.subject_code, testSubjectCode)
  })

  await t.test('9. removeClassSubjectAction foreign key safety check blocks deletion when practical logs exist', async () => {
    assert.ok(testClassSubjectId, 'testClassSubjectId must be populated')

    // Insert a dummy practical log referencing this class_subject_id
    const logInsert = await pool.query(
      `INSERT INTO public.practical_logs (
        id, lab_id, class_subject_id, period_label, subject_name, batch_group, practical_title,
        total_students, present_students, absent_students, status, created_at
      ) VALUES (
        gen_random_uuid(), 'comp', $1, 'P1-2', 'Safety Test Subject', 'Batch A', 'Phase 2 Safety Test Log',
        30, 28, 2, 'completed', now()
      ) RETURNING id;`,
      [testClassSubjectId]
    )
    const dummyLogId = logInsert.rows[0]?.id

    try {
      // Attempt to delete mapping should fail due to foreign key protection
      const deleteRes = await removeClassSubjectAction(testClassSubjectId)
      assert.equal(deleteRes.success, false, 'Should reject deletion when practical logs reference assignment')
      assert.ok(deleteRes.error?.includes('historical practical log'), `Unexpected error msg: ${deleteRes.error}`)
    } finally {
      // Clean up dummy practical log
      await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.practical_logs WHERE id = $1;', [dummyLogId])
    }
  })

  await t.test('10. removeClassSubjectAction safely deletes assignment when 0 logs exist', async () => {
    const deleteRes = await removeClassSubjectAction(testClassSubjectId)
    assert.equal(deleteRes.success, true, `removeClassSubjectAction failed: ${deleteRes.error}`)

    const check = await pool.query('SELECT id FROM public.class_subjects WHERE id = $1;', [testClassSubjectId])
    assert.equal(check.rows.length, 0, 'Mapping should be completely deleted from public.class_subjects')
    testClassSubjectId = null

    // Clean up created test class so subsequent test suites operate on clean canonical counts
    if (testClassId) {
      await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.classes WHERE id = $1;', [testClassId])
    }
  })

  await t.test('11. getIssueCategories returns canonical categories from public.issue_categories', async () => {
    const res = await getIssueCategories()
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getIssueCategories should succeed')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'res.data should be an array')
    assert.ok(res.data.length >= 10, `Expected at least 10 issue categories, got ${res.data.length}`)

    // Verify laboratory equipment / safety categories are present
    const hardwareCats = res.data.filter((c) => c.type === 'hardware' || c.type === 'other')
    assert.ok(hardwareCats.length >= 5, 'Should have hardware and safety incident categories')
  })

  await t.test('12. manageIssueCategory manages dynamic categories (create, update, soft-archive/delete)', async () => {
    const catName = `P2 Test Category ${testSuffix}`
    const createRes = await manageIssueCategory('create', {
      name: catName,
      type: 'hardware',
      color: '#6366F1',
      icon: 'Cpu',
      default_severity: 'medium',
      is_active: true,
      sort_order: 99,
    })

    assert.equal(createRes.success, true, `create category failed: ${createRes.error}`)
    assert.ok(createRes.data?.id, 'Category should have an ID')
    testCategoryId = createRes.data.id

    // Update
    const updateRes = await manageIssueCategory('update', {
      id: testCategoryId,
      name: `${catName} Updated`,
      default_severity: 'high',
    })
    assert.equal(updateRes.success, true, `update category failed: ${updateRes.error}`)
    assert.equal(updateRes.data?.name, `${catName} Updated`)
    assert.equal(updateRes.data?.default_severity, 'high')

    // Delete (hard delete since 0 issues reference it)
    const deleteRes = await manageIssueCategory('delete', {
      id: testCategoryId,
    })
    assert.equal(deleteRes.success, true, `delete category failed: ${deleteRes.error}`)

    const check = await pool.query('SELECT id FROM public.issue_categories WHERE id = $1;', [testCategoryId])
    assert.equal(check.rows.length, 0, 'Unreferenced category should be deleted')
    testCategoryId = null
  })
})

  it('Layout Engine: sortWorkstationsByLabel separates teacher pod from numbered student PCs', () => {

    const testStations = Array.from({ length: 33 }, (_, i) => ({

      label: `PC-${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
    }))
    testStations.push({ id: 'teacher-podium', label: 'Teacher-01' })

    const updates = calculateAutoArrangement(testStations, 'rows_4x8', 2)
    assert.equal(updates.length, 34)

    assert.equal(teacher.pos_x, 50)
    assert.equal(teacher.pos_y, 12)
    assert.equal(teacher.row_label, 'Teacher Podium')

    // Verify 4 distinct rows
    const studentRows = new Set(updates.filter((u) => u.label !== 'Teacher-01').map((u) => u.row_label))
    assert.deepEqual(Array.from(studentRows).sort(), ['Row A', 'Row B', 'Row C', 'Row D'].sort())
  })

  it('Layout Engine: calculateAutoArrangement (rows_5x10) arranges 50 terminals across 5 compact rows', () => {

    const config = {
      sides: 2,
      rows: 6,
      columns: 4,
      rowNaming: 'letters',
      terminalNaming: 'alphanumeric',
      customRowNames: { 0: 'Row A', 1: 'Row B', 2: 'Row C', 3: 'Row D', 4: 'Row E', 5: 'Row F' },
    }

    const slots = generateRoomGridSlots(config)
    assert.equal(slots.length, 48, 'Must generate exactly 48 slots (2 sides * 6 rows * 4 cols)')

    // Check row naming and labels: Left Wing has Rows A..F, Right Wing has Rows G..L
    const leftSlots = slots.filter((s) => s.sideIndex === 0)
    const rightSlots = slots.filter((s) => s.sideIndex === 1)
    assert.equal(leftSlots.length, 24, 'Left side must have 24 terminals')
    assert.equal(rightSlots.length, 24, 'Right side must have 24 terminals')

    // Left Wing first row: A1..A4
    assert.equal(leftSlots[0].positionId, 'A1')
    assert.equal(leftSlots[3].positionId, 'A4')
    // Right Wing first row: G1..G4 (strictly 1 to 4!)
    assert.equal(rightSlots[0].positionId, 'G1')
    assert.equal(rightSlots[3].positionId, 'G4')

    // Generate mock stations to arrange
    const mockStations = Array.from({ length: 48 }, (_, i) => ({
      id: `station-${i + 1}`,
      label: `PC-${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
    }))

    const updates = calculateCustomRoomLayout(mockStations, config, 2)
    assert.equal(updates.length, 48)

    // Check Left Side vs Right Side coordinate distribution
    const leftSide = updates.filter((u) => u.row_label?.includes('(Left)'))
    const rightSide = updates.filter((u) => u.row_label?.includes('(Right)'))
    assert.equal(leftSide.length, 24)
    assert.equal(rightSide.length, 24)

    // Left side X should be <= 46%, Right side X should be >= 54% (central aisle)
    leftSide.forEach((u) => assert.ok(u.pos_x <= 46, `Left station ${u.label} pos_x ${u.pos_x}% should be <= 46%`))
    rightSide.forEach((u) => assert.ok(u.pos_x >= 54, `Right station ${u.label} pos_x ${u.pos_x}% should be >= 54%`))

    // Physical machine labels MUST be preserved as PC-01..PC-48
    assert.equal(leftSide[0].label, 'PC-01')
    assert.equal(leftSide[3].label, 'PC-04')
    assert.equal(rightSide[0].label, 'PC-25')
    assert.equal(rightSide[3].label, 'PC-28')

    // Position IDs stored systematically: A1..A4 for left, G1..G4 for right
    assert.equal(leftSide[0].position_id, 'A1')
    assert.equal(leftSide[3].position_id, 'A4')
    assert.equal(rightSide[0].position_id, 'G1')
    assert.equal(rightSide[3].position_id, 'G4')
  })

    assert.equal(reserveDump.length, 0, 'Zero workstations dumped in reserve or at y: 94%')
  })

  it('Server Actions & Engine: Supports named custom layout templates and architectural desk structure', () => {
    const actionsPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'app/actions/workstations.ts')
    const content = fs.readFileSync(actionsPath, 'utf8')

    assert.ok(content.includes('export async function getCustomLayoutTemplates'), 'Must export getCustomLayoutTemplates')
    assert.ok(content.includes('export async function saveCustomLayoutTemplate'), 'Must export saveCustomLayoutTemplate')

================================================================================
FILE: tests\phase2-deep-verification.test.mjs

import { describe, it } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

function loadDbUrl() {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
  if (!fs.existsSync(envPath)) return null
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
      return line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
    }
  }
  return null
}

describe('Phase 2 Deep Verification: RLS, Atomicity, Atomic Swap & Attendance Semantics', () => {
  const dbUrl = loadDbUrl()

  describe('1. True DB Atomicity & Rollback Protection (create_student_with_enrollment_tx)', () => {
    it('Rollback guarantees NO orphan student record if enrollment fails due to duplicate roll', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()

      const testAdmNo = `ATOMIC-${Date.now()}`
      try {
        // Step 1: Create initial student enrolled as Roll 50 in 12eng for 2083
        const res1 = await client.query(`
          SELECT public.create_student_with_enrollment_tx(
            'Primary Student',
            '2083',
            '12eng',
            50,
            $1
          ) as result;
        `, [testAdmNo])
        assert.ok(res1.rows[0].result.student_id, 'Primary student must be created')
        const primaryStudentId = res1.rows[0].result.student_id

        // Count students before failed transaction
        const countBefore = await client.query(`SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM public.students;`)

        // Step 2: Attempt to create second student with conflicting roll 50 in 12eng / 2083
        const failingAdmNo = `${testAdmNo}-FAIL`
        let txFailed = false
        try {
          await client.query(`
            SELECT public.create_student_with_enrollment_tx(
              'Failing Candidate',
              '2083',
              '12eng',
              50,
              $1
            );
          `, [failingAdmNo])
        } catch (err) {
          txFailed = true
          assert.ok(err.message.includes('ROLL_COLLISION'), 'Must throw ROLL_COLLISION exception')
        }
        assert.ok(txFailed, 'Atomic RPC must reject duplicate roll')

        // Step 3: Verify that failing candidate was completely rolled back and DOES NOT exist in students table
        const countAfter = await client.query(`SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM public.students;`)
        assert.equal(
          countAfter.rows[0].cnt,
          countBefore.rows[0].cnt,
          'Total student count must be identical — NO orphan student record created!'
        )

        const checkOrphan = await client.query(
          `SELECT id FROM public.students WHERE admission_no = $1;`,
          [failingAdmNo]
        )
        assert.equal(checkOrphan.rows.length, 0, 'Orphan candidate record must NOT exist in students')

        // Clean up primary test record
        await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id = $1;`, [primaryStudentId])
        await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [primaryStudentId])
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })
  })

  describe('2. Atomic Workstation Seat Swap (swap_workstation_seat_plans_tx)', () => {
    it('Atomically swaps two students seats without data loss or transient constraint violation', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()

      let enrollA = null
      let enrollB = null
      let studentAId = null
      let studentBId = null
      try {
        // Fetch 2 workstations in comp lab
        const wsRes = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.workstations WHERE lab_id = 'comp' LIMIT 2;`)
        assert.ok(wsRes.rows.length >= 2)
        const wsA = wsRes.rows[0].id
        const wsB = wsRes.rows[1].id

        // Clean up any lingering swap test records from previous runs in 10eng
        await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '10eng';`)

        // Create 2 students & enrollments with dynamic unique roll numbers within (0, 200]
        const baseRoll = 50 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 40)
        const admA = `SWAP-A-${Date.now()}`
        const admB = `SWAP-B-${Date.now()}`
        const sA = await client.query(`
          SELECT public.create_student_with_enrollment_tx('Student Swap A', '2083', '10eng', $1, $2) as res;
        `, [baseRoll, admA])
        const sB = await client.query(`
          SELECT public.create_student_with_enrollment_tx('Student Swap B', '2083', '10eng', $1, $2) as res;
        `, [baseRoll + 1, admB])

        enrollA = sA.rows[0].res.enrollment_id
        enrollB = sB.rows[0].res.enrollment_id
        studentAId = sA.rows[0].res.student_id
        studentBId = sB.rows[0].res.student_id

        // Clean up any existing seat assignments on wsA and wsB in this cohort
        await client.query(`
          DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans 
          WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '10eng' AND workstation_id IN ($1, $2);
        `, [wsA, wsB])

        // Assign Student A -> wsA, Student B -> wsB
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.workstation_seat_plans (lab_id, academic_year_id, class_id, workstation_id, enrollment_id)
          VALUES ('comp', '2083', '10eng', $1, $2);
        `, [wsA, enrollA])

        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.workstation_seat_plans (lab_id, academic_year_id, class_id, workstation_id, enrollment_id)
          VALUES ('comp', '2083', '10eng', $1, $2);
        `, [wsB, enrollB])

        // Verify pre-swap state
        const preA = await client.query(`SELECT enrollment_id FROM public.workstation_seat_plans WHERE workstation_id = $1 AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '10eng';`, [wsA])
        const preB = await client.query(`SELECT enrollment_id FROM public.workstation_seat_plans WHERE workstation_id = $1 AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '10eng';`, [wsB])
        assert.equal(preA.rows[0].enrollment_id, enrollA)
        assert.equal(preB.rows[0].enrollment_id, enrollB)

        // Perform ATOMIC SWAP via PostgreSQL RPC
        const swapRes = await client.query(`
          SELECT public.swap_workstation_seat_plans_tx('comp', '2083', '10eng', $1, $2) as res;
        `, [wsA, wsB])
        assert.equal(swapRes.rows[0].res.success, true)

        // Verify post-swap state: wsA now has enrollB, wsB now has enrollA!
        const postA = await client.query(`SELECT enrollment_id FROM public.workstation_seat_plans WHERE workstation_id = $1 AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '10eng';`, [wsA])
        const postB = await client.query(`SELECT enrollment_id FROM public.workstation_seat_plans WHERE workstation_id = $1 AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '10eng';`, [wsB])
        assert.equal(postA.rows[0].enrollment_id, enrollB, 'wsA must now be assigned to Student B')
        assert.equal(postB.rows[0].enrollment_id, enrollA, 'wsB must now be assigned to Student A')
      } finally {
        if (enrollA && enrollB) {
          await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans WHERE enrollment_id IN ($1, $2);`, [enrollA, enrollB])
          await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [enrollA, enrollB])
        }
        if (studentAId && studentBId) {
          await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [studentAId, studentBId])
        }
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })
  })

  describe('3. Relational Attendance Synchronization & Verification', () => {
    it('Practical log insertion with class_subject_id generates synchronized roll-call records with student_id and enrollment_id', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()

      const testLogId = `HIST-LOG-${Date.now()}`
      try {
        // Query a valid class_subject_id for 12eng comp-12
        const csRes = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.class_subjects WHERE class_id = '12eng' AND subject_id = 'comp-12' LIMIT 1;`)
        const csId = csRes.rows[0]?.id
        assert.ok(csId, 'A valid class_subject_id must exist for 12eng comp-12')

        // Insert practical log with canonical class_subject_id
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.practical_logs (
            id, lab_id, date, period_label, subject_name, batch_group, practical_title,
            total_students, present_students, absent_students, absent_rolls, status, class_subject_id
          ) VALUES (
            $1, 'comp', '2026-09-24', 'Period 1', 'Computer Science Lab', '12 Eng', 'Data Structures & Algorithms',
            35, 33, 2, ARRAY[3, 7], 'conducted', $2
          );
        `, [testLogId, csId])

        // Verify trigger created log_attendance records
        const attRows = await client.query(`
          SELECT roll_number, is_present, student_id, enrollment_id
          FROM public.log_attendance
          WHERE log_id = $1
          ORDER BY roll_number;
        `, [testLogId])

        assert.equal(attRows.rows.length, 35, 'Trigger must generate 35 roll records for 12eng')
        const roll3 = attRows.rows.find((r) => r.roll_number === 3)
        const roll7 = attRows.rows.find((r) => r.roll_number === 7)
        assert.ok(roll3, 'Roll 3 record must exist')
        assert.equal(roll3.is_present, false, 'Roll 3 is absent')
        assert.ok(roll7, 'Roll 7 record must exist')
        assert.equal(roll7.is_present, false, 'Roll 7 is absent')

        // Relational attendance: every record has valid student_id and enrollment_id
        for (const row of attRows.rows) {
          assert.ok(row.student_id, 'Attendance record must have student_id')
          assert.ok(row.enrollment_id, 'Attendance record must have enrollment_id')
        }

        // Clean up
        await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.log_attendance WHERE log_id = $1;`, [testLogId])
        await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.practical_logs WHERE id = $1;`, [testLogId])
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })
  })

  describe('4. Context-Scoped RLS Verification', () => {
    it('RLS policies exist and enforce scoped boundaries on student entities', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()

      try {
        const policies = await client.query(`
          SELECT tablename, policyname, cmd
          FROM pg_policies
          WHERE schemaname = 'public'
            AND tablename IN ('students', 'student_enrollments', 'workstation_seat_plans', 'session_seat_overrides')
          ORDER BY tablename, policyname;
        `)

        const policyNames = policies.rows.map((p) => `${p.tablename}.${p.policyname}`)

        // Verify context-scoped read policies are in place
        assert.ok(policyNames.includes('students.read_students_scoped'), 'students must have read_students_scoped policy')
        assert.ok(policyNames.includes('student_enrollments.read_student_enrollments_scoped'), 'student_enrollments must have read_student_enrollments_scoped policy')
        assert.ok(policyNames.includes('workstation_seat_plans.read_workstation_seat_plans_scoped'), 'workstation_seat_plans must have read_workstation_seat_plans_scoped policy')
        assert.ok(policyNames.includes('session_seat_overrides.read_session_seat_overrides_scoped'), 'session_seat_overrides must have read_session_seat_overrides_scoped policy')
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })
  })
})

import { describe, it } from 'node:test'

function loadDbUrl() {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
  if (!fs.existsSync(envPath)) return null
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
      return line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
    }
  }
  return null
}

describe('Phase 2: Security Context Hardening & Server Operations Suite', () => {

        role: 'teacher',
        approval_status: 'approved',
        is_active: true,
        permissions: {},
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }

      assert.equal(scope.isTeacher, true, 'isTeacher must be true')

      assert.deepEqual(scope.assignedSubjects, [], 'Unassigned teacher must receive empty assignedSubjects')
      assert.deepEqual(scope.assignedLabIds, [], 'Unassigned teacher must receive empty assignedLabIds')

    })

    })

      assert.equal(FLOOR_ELEMENT_CATALOG.door.category, 'boundary')
      assert.equal(FLOOR_ELEMENT_CATALOG.network_rack.category, 'infrastructure')
    })

    it('validateFloorCoordinates rejects negative numbers and numbers above 100', () => {
      assert.equal(validateFloorCoordinates(0, 0), true)
      assert.equal(validateFloorCoordinates(100, 100), true)
      assert.equal(validateFloorCoordinates(48.5, 32.2), true)

      assert.equal(validateFloorCoordinates(-1, 50), false)
      assert.equal(validateFloorCoordinates(50, 101), false)
      assert.equal(validateFloorCoordinates(NaN, 50), false)
    })

    it('clampFloorCoordinates bounds values to specified limits safely', () => {

      assert.deepEqual(clampFloorCoordinates(45.67, 88.12), { x: 45.7, y: 88.1 })
    })
  })

  describe('3. Database Operations: Students, Enrollments & Two-Tier Seating', () => {
    it('Transactional Student Creation + Enrollment + Duplicate Roll Protection', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()

      const testAdmNo = `TEST-${Date.now()}`
      let testStudentId = null
      let testEnrollmentId = null

      try {
        await client.query('BEGIN')

        // 1. Insert test student
        const studentRes = await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no, is_active)
          VALUES ('Test Student Alpha', $1, true)
          RETURNING id;
        `, [testAdmNo])
        testStudentId = studentRes.rows[0].id
        assert.ok(testStudentId, 'Student ID must be returned')

        // 2. Enroll student into Class 12 Eng (12eng) for 2083 as Roll 99
        const enrollRes = await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
          VALUES ('2083', '12eng', $1, 99, 'active')
          RETURNING id;
        `, [testStudentId])
        testEnrollmentId = enrollRes.rows[0].id
        assert.ok(testEnrollmentId, 'Enrollment ID must be returned')

        // 3. Duplicate Roll Test: Enrolling another student with Roll 99 in 2083 / 12eng MUST FAIL
        const studentRes2 = await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no, is_active)
          VALUES ('Test Student Beta', $1, true)
          RETURNING id;
        `, [`${testAdmNo}-B`])
        const testStudentId2 = studentRes2.rows[0].id

        let duplicateRollFailed = false
        try {
          await client.query(`
            INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
            VALUES ('2083', '12eng', $1, 99, 'active');
          `, [testStudentId2])
          // Because uq_enrollment_roll is DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, trigger check within transaction
          await client.query('SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE;')
        } catch (dupErr) {
          duplicateRollFailed = true
          assert.equal(dupErr.code, '23505', 'PostgreSQL error code must be unique_violation (23505)')
        }
        assert.ok(duplicateRollFailed, 'Duplicate roll number in same cohort must be rejected by uq_enrollment_roll')

        await client.query('ROLLBACK')
      } catch (err) {
        await client.query('ROLLBACK')
        throw err
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })

    it('Two-Tier Seating: Default Allocation & Session Override Collision Protection', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()

      try {
        await client.query('BEGIN')

        // Get a valid workstation in comp lab
        const wsRes = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.workstations WHERE lab_id = 'comp' LIMIT 2;`)
        assert.ok(wsRes.rows.length >= 2, 'Need at least 2 workstations')
        const wsA = wsRes.rows[0].id
        const wsB = wsRes.rows[1].id

        // Create 2 test students and enrollments
        const s1Res = await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no) VALUES ('Seat Student A', $1) RETURNING id;
        `, [`SEAT-A-${Date.now()}`])
        const e1Res = await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number)
          VALUES ('2083', '12eng', $1, 88) RETURNING id;
        `, [s1Res.rows[0].id])

        const s2Res = await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no) VALUES ('Seat Student B', $1) RETURNING id;
        `, [`SEAT-B-${Date.now()}`])
        const e2Res = await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number)
          VALUES ('2083', '12eng', $1, 89) RETURNING id;
        `, [s2Res.rows[0].id])

        const enrollA = e1Res.rows[0].id
        const enrollB = e2Res.rows[0].id

        // Pre-clean any leftover seat plans on wsA and wsB to ensure isolated test state
        await client.query(`
          DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans 
          WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND workstation_id IN ($1, $2);
        `, [wsA, wsB])

        // 1. Assign Student A to Workstation A (Tier 1 Default)
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.workstation_seat_plans (lab_id, academic_year_id, class_id, workstation_id, enrollment_id)
          VALUES ('comp', '2083', '12eng', $1, $2);
        `, [wsA, enrollA])

        // 2. Duplicate Workstation Check: Attempting to assign Student B to Workstation A in same cohort MUST FAIL
        let duplicateWsFailed = false
        try {
          await client.query('SAVEPOINT sp_dup_ws;')
          await client.query(`
            INSERT INTO public.workstation_seat_plans (lab_id, academic_year_id, class_id, workstation_id, enrollment_id)
            VALUES ('comp', '2083', '12eng', $1, $2);
          `, [wsA, enrollB])
        } catch (dupWsErr) {
          await client.query('ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT sp_dup_ws;')
          duplicateWsFailed = true
          assert.equal(dupWsErr.code, '23505', 'Must fail with unique_violation')
        }
        assert.ok(duplicateWsFailed, 'Workstation cannot have 2 students assigned in same cohort')

        // 3. Multi-Cohort Workstation Sharing: Assigning Student in Class 11 Eng to Workstation A MUST SUCCEED
        const e11Res = await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number)
          VALUES ('2083', '11eng', $1, 88) RETURNING id;
        `, [s1Res.rows[0].id])
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.workstation_seat_plans (lab_id, academic_year_id, class_id, workstation_id, enrollment_id)
          VALUES ('comp', '2083', '11eng', $1, $2);
        `, [wsA, e11Res.rows[0].id])
        // Succeeded: PC-01 is safely shared between 12eng and 11eng!

        // 4. Session Seat Override (Tier 2): Temporarily assign Student A to Workstation B for a specific schedule session
        const schedRes = await client.query("SELECT id FROM public.schedules WHERE lab_id = 'comp' LIMIT 1;")
        const testSchedId = schedRes.rows[0]?.id || 'sun-1'
        const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.session_seat_overrides (schedule_id, session_date, enrollment_id, workstation_id, reason)
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'PC-01 mouse fault');
        `, [testSchedId, today, enrollA, wsB])

        // 5. Override Collision Guard: Attempting to reassign Student B to Workstation B in same session MUST FAIL
        let overrideCollisionFailed = false
        try {
          await client.query('SAVEPOINT sp_ov_col;')
          await client.query(`
            INSERT INTO public.session_seat_overrides (schedule_id, session_date, enrollment_id, workstation_id, reason)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'Another override');
          `, [testSchedId, today, enrollB, wsB])
        } catch (ovColErr) {
          await client.query('ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT sp_ov_col;')
          overrideCollisionFailed = true
          assert.equal(ovColErr.code, '23505', 'Must fail with uq_session_override_workstation')
        }
        assert.ok(overrideCollisionFailed, 'Destination workstation collision guard must reject second override')

        await client.query('ROLLBACK')
      } catch (err) {
        await client.query('ROLLBACK')
        throw err
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })
  })
})

  })

  await t.test('5. getOccupiedLabsInSlot operates accurately without MASTER_TIME_SLOTS', async () => {

    assert.ok(occupiedT3.has('phys'), 'Lab phys should be occupied in t3')

      'DEFAULT_CLASSES',
      'MASTER_ROUTINE',
      'INITIAL_FACULTY',
      'LAB_ROOMS',
      'MASTER_TIME_SLOTS',
    ]

    for (const file of filesToCheck) {
      const fullPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), file)
      const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8')

      // Check for forbidden imports from master-data
      for (const symbol of forbiddenSymbols) {
        const importPattern = new RegExp(`\\b${symbol}\\b.*from\\s+['"][^'"]*master-data`, 'i')
        assert.equal(
          importPattern.test(content),
          false,
          `File ${file} must NOT import ${symbol} from master-data`
        )
      }
    }
  })

function loadEnv() {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
  if (!fs.existsSync(envPath)) return null
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  let dbUrl = null
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      if (idx > 0) {
        const k = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
        const v = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
        process.env[k] = v
        if (k === 'DATABASE_URL') dbUrl = v
      }
    }
  }
  return dbUrl
}

  describe('4. Atomic Workstation Seat Swap (swap_workstation_seat_plans_tx)', () => {
    it('PostgreSQL RPC executes atomic two-way swap without constraint violation or partial state', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()
      try {
        await client.query('BEGIN')

        // Fetch 2 workstations (PC-01 and PC-02)
        const wsRes = await client.query(`
          SELECT id, label FROM public.workstations
          WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND label IN ('PC-01', 'PC-02')
          ORDER BY label;
        `)
        assert.equal(wsRes.rows.length, 2)
        const wsA = wsRes.rows[0].id // PC-01
        const wsB = wsRes.rows[1].id // PC-02

        // Fetch 2 enrolled students (Roll 1 and Roll 2)
        const enrolls = await client.query(`
          SELECT id, roll_number FROM public.student_enrollments
          WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' AND roll_number IN (1, 2)
          ORDER BY roll_number;
        `)
        assert.equal(enrolls.rows.length, 2)
        const enrollA = enrolls.rows[0].id // Student A
        const enrollB = enrolls.rows[1].id // Student B

        // Clean
        await client.query(`
          DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans
          WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng'
            AND (workstation_id IN ($1, $2) OR enrollment_id IN ($3, $4));
        `, [wsA, wsB, enrollA, enrollB])

        // Initial assignment: PC-01 -> Student A, PC-02 -> Student B
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.workstation_seat_plans (lab_id, academic_year_id, class_id, workstation_id, enrollment_id)
          VALUES 
            ('comp', '2083', '12eng', $1, $2),
            ('comp', '2083', '12eng', $3, $4);
        `, [wsA, enrollA, wsB, enrollB])

        // Execute atomic swap RPC
        const swapRes = await client.query(`
          SELECT public.swap_workstation_seat_plans_tx('comp', '2083', '12eng', $1, $2, NULL) as result;
        `, [wsA, wsB])
        assert.equal(swapRes.rows[0].result.success, true)

        // Verify swapped assignments: PC-01 now has Student B, PC-02 now has Student A
        const afterSwap = await client.query(`
          SELECT workstation_id, enrollment_id FROM public.workstation_seat_plans
          WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' AND workstation_id IN ($1, $2);
        `, [wsA, wsB])

        const map = new Map(afterSwap.rows.map(r => [r.workstation_id, r.enrollment_id]))
        assert.equal(map.get(wsA), enrollB, 'PC-01 must now have Student B')
        assert.equal(map.get(wsB), enrollA, 'PC-02 must now have Student A')

        // Test RPC error handling: Swapping two unassigned workstations must fail with INVALID_SWAP and rollback
        const wsUnused = await client.query(`
          SELECT id FROM public.workstations
          WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND id NOT IN ($1, $2)
          LIMIT 2;
        `, [wsA, wsB])

        await client.query(`
          DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans
          WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng'
            AND workstation_id IN ($1, $2);
        `, [wsUnused.rows[0].id, wsUnused.rows[1].id])

        let rpcFailed = false
        try {
          await client.query('SAVEPOINT sp_invalid_swap;')
          await client.query(`
            SELECT public.swap_workstation_seat_plans_tx('comp', '2083', '12eng', $1, $2, NULL);
          `, [wsUnused.rows[0].id, wsUnused.rows[1].id])
        } catch (err) {
          await client.query('ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT sp_invalid_swap;')
          rpcFailed = true
          assert.match(err.message, /INVALID_SWAP/i)
        }
        assert.equal(rpcFailed, true, 'Swapping unassigned workstations must throw INVALID_SWAP and rollback')

        await client.query('ROLLBACK')
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })
  })

  describe('5. PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) Independent Verification', () => {
    it('Client direct database bypass: Teacher role is REJECTED by Postgres RLS on workstation_seat_plans', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()
      try {
        await client.query('BEGIN')

        // Simulate client connection as authenticated role with teacher UID
        await client.query('SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated;')
        await client.query(`SELECT set_config('request.jwt.claims', $1, true);`, [
          JSON.stringify({ sub: TEACHER_ANISH.id, role: 'authenticated' })
        ])

        // Verify context
        const roleCheck = await client.query('SELECT public.current_role() as role, public.is_privileged() as is_priv;')
        assert.equal(roleCheck.rows[0].role, 'teacher')
        assert.equal(roleCheck.rows[0].is_priv, false)

        // 1. Direct INSERT attempt by teacher MUST BE REJECTED BY RLS
        let insertBlocked = false
        try {
          await client.query('SAVEPOINT sp_rls_ins;')
          await client.query(`
            INSERT INTO public.workstation_seat_plans (
              lab_id, academic_year_id, class_id, workstation_id, enrollment_id
            ) VALUES (
              'comp', '2083', '12eng',
              (SELECT id FROM public.workstations WHERE lab_id = 'comp' LIMIT 1),
              (SELECT id FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' LIMIT 1)
            );
          `)
        } catch (err) {
          await client.query('ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT sp_rls_ins;')
          insertBlocked = true
          assert.match(err.message, /violates row-level security policy/i)
        }
        assert.equal(insertBlocked, true, 'Direct INSERT bypass attempt must be blocked by RLS')

        // 2. Direct INSERT on session_seat_overrides by teacher MUST BE REJECTED BY RLS
        let overrideBlocked = false
        try {
          await client.query('SAVEPOINT sp_rls_ov;')
          await client.query(`
            INSERT INTO public.session_seat_overrides (
              schedule_id, session_date, workstation_id, enrollment_id, reason
            ) VALUES (
              'sched-12c-prakash', '2026-09-24',
              (SELECT id FROM public.workstations WHERE lab_id = 'comp' LIMIT 1),
              (SELECT id FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' LIMIT 1),
              'Bypass attempt'
            );
          `)
        } catch (err) {
          await client.query('ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT sp_rls_ov;')
          overrideBlocked = true
          assert.match(err.message, /violates row-level security policy/i)
        }
        assert.equal(overrideBlocked, true, 'Direct session override bypass attempt must be blocked by RLS')

        await client.query('ROLLBACK')
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })
  })

  describe('6. Capacity Test: 35 Students vs 34 Workstations', () => {
    it('Auto-assign assigns exactly 34 students, leaves 1 unassigned in tray, available PCs = 0, zero duplicates', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()
      try {
        // Verify count of enrolled students in 12eng is 35
        const studCount = await client.query(`
          SELECT count(*) as count FROM public.student_enrollments
          WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' AND status = 'active';
        `)
        assert.equal(Number(studCount.rows[0].count), 35, 'Cohort must contain exactly 35 enrolled students')

        // Clear existing seat plans for 12eng
        await client.query(`
          DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans
          WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng';
        `)

        // Temporarily resolve active issues so all 34 are available
        const activeIssues = await client.query(`
          SELECT id FROM public.workstation_issues
          WHERE status IN ('open', 'acknowledged', 'in_progress');
        `)
        const issueIds = activeIssues.rows.map(r => r.id)
        if (issueIds.length > 0) {
          await client.query(`UPDATE public.workstation_issues SET status = 'resolved' WHERE id = ANY($1);`, [issueIds])
        }

        try {
          // Run auto-assign as privileged user
          process.env.TEST_USER_OVERRIDE = JSON.stringify(LAB_INCHARGE)
          const autoRes = await autoAssignRemainingSeats({
            lab_id: 'comp',
            academic_year_id: '2083',
            class_id: '12eng',
          })

          assert.equal(autoRes.success, true, `Auto-assign failed: ${autoRes.error}`)
          assert.ok(autoRes.data)
          assert.equal(autoRes.data.assigned_count, 34, 'Must assign exactly 34 workstations')
          assert.equal(autoRes.data.remaining_unassigned_count, 1, 'Must leave exactly 1 student unassigned')
          assert.equal(autoRes.data.available_workstations_count, 0, 'Available workstations must be 0')

          // Verify in database: Exactly 34 distinct workstations assigned, exactly 34 distinct students assigned
          const dbPlans = await client.query(`
            SELECT count(DISTINCT workstation_id) as ws_count, count(DISTINCT enrollment_id) as enroll_count, count(*) as total
            FROM public.workstation_seat_plans
            WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng';
          `)
          assert.equal(Number(dbPlans.rows[0].ws_count), 34, 'No duplicate workstation assignments')
          assert.equal(Number(dbPlans.rows[0].enroll_count), 34, 'No duplicate student assignments')
          assert.equal(Number(dbPlans.rows[0].total), 34, 'Total assigned rows must be 34')

          // Query lab seat plan view and verify Tray has exactly 1 unassigned student
          const labPlan = await getLabSeatPlan({
            labId: 'comp',
            classId: '12eng',
          })
          assert.equal(labPlan.success, true)
          assert.equal(labPlan.data?.total_students, 35)
          assert.equal(labPlan.data?.assigned_count, 34)
          assert.equal(labPlan.data?.unassigned_count, 1)
          assert.equal(labPlan.data?.unassigned_students.length, 1)
          assert.equal(labPlan.data?.unassigned_students[0].roll_number, 35, 'Roll 35 is unassigned')
        } finally {
          // Restore issues and cleanup seat plans
          if (issueIds.length > 0) {
            await client.query(`UPDATE public.workstation_issues SET status = 'open' WHERE id = ANY($1);`, [issueIds])
          }
          await client.query(`
            DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans
            WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng';
          `)
        }
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })
  })

  describe('7. Workstation Identity Preservation across Repositioning', () => {
    it('Moving PC-17 changes coordinates pos_x/pos_y but preserves workstation_id, issues, and seat plans', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()
      try {
        await client.query('BEGIN')

        // Fetch PC-17
        const wsRes = await client.query(`
          SELECT id, label, pos_x, pos_y FROM public.workstations
          WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND label = 'PC-17';
        `)
        assert.ok(wsRes.rows.length > 0, 'PC-17 must exist')
        const pc17 = wsRes.rows[0]
        const pc17Id = pc17.id
        const originalX = pc17.pos_x
        const originalY = pc17.pos_y

        // Attach an issue to PC-17 with valid reporter
        const issueRes = await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.workstation_issues (workstation_id, title, severity, status, reported_by_id, reported_by_name)
          VALUES ($1, 'PC-17 Keyboard Cable Snag', 'low', 'open', $2, $3)
          RETURNING id;
        `, [pc17Id, SUPER_ADMIN.id, SUPER_ADMIN.full_name])
        const issueId = issueRes.rows[0].id

        // Move PC-17 to new coordinates (x: 42.5, y: 77.0) via server action
        process.env.TEST_USER_OVERRIDE = JSON.stringify(LAB_INCHARGE)
        const moveRes = await updateWorkstation({
          id: pc17Id,
          pos_x: 42.5,
          pos_y: 77.0,
        })
        assert.equal(moveRes.success, true, `Move failed: ${moveRes.error}`)

        // Verify in database:
        // 1. workstation.id is strictly preserved
        const afterMove = await client.query(`SELECT id, label, pos_x, pos_y FROM public.workstations WHERE id = $1;`, [pc17Id])
        assert.equal(afterMove.rows[0].id, pc17Id, 'Workstation ID must remain unchanged')
        assert.equal(afterMove.rows[0].label, 'PC-17')
        assert.equal(Number(afterMove.rows[0].pos_x), 42.5, 'pos_x updated to new position')
        assert.equal(Number(afterMove.rows[0].pos_y), 77.0, 'pos_y updated to new position')

        // 2. Issue remains attached to PC-17
        const linkedIssue = await client.query(`SELECT workstation_id FROM public.workstation_issues WHERE id = $1;`, [issueId])
        assert.equal(linkedIssue.rows[0].workstation_id, pc17Id, 'Issue must remain attached to PC-17')

        await client.query('ROLLBACK')
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })
  })

  describe('8. Faulty Workstation Nuanced Eligibility', () => {
    it('Minor issue keeps PC eligible; critical fault and under_repair (in_progress) exclude PC from auto-assign', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()
      try {
        await client.query('BEGIN')

        // Fetch PC-10, PC-11, PC-12
        const wsRes = await client.query(`
          SELECT id, label FROM public.workstations
          WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND label IN ('PC-10', 'PC-11', 'PC-12')
          ORDER BY label;
        `)
        assert.equal(wsRes.rows.length, 3)
        const pc10 = wsRes.rows[0].id // PC-10: Minor issue
        const pc11 = wsRes.rows[1].id // PC-11: High-severity active issue
        const pc12 = wsRes.rows[2].id // PC-12: under_repair (in_progress)

        // Clean issues on these 3
        await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.workstation_issues WHERE workstation_id IN ($1, $2, $3);`, [pc10, pc11, pc12])

        // 1. PC-10: Minor issue (severity = 'low', open)
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.workstation_issues (workstation_id, title, severity, status, reported_by_id, reported_by_name)
          VALUES ($1, 'Mouse scroll wheel sticky', 'low', 'open', $2, $3);
        `, [pc10, SUPER_ADMIN.id, SUPER_ADMIN.full_name])

        // 2. PC-11: High-severity active issue (severity = 'high', open)
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.workstation_issues (workstation_id, title, severity, status, reported_by_id, reported_by_name)
          VALUES ($1, 'GPU artifacting and smoke smell', 'high', 'open', $2, $3);
        `, [pc11, SUPER_ADMIN.id, SUPER_ADMIN.full_name])

        // 3. PC-12: Under repair (status = 'in_progress')
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.workstation_issues (workstation_id, title, severity, status, reported_by_id, reported_by_name)
          VALUES ($1, 'Motherboard capacitor replacement', 'medium', 'in_progress', $2, $3);
        `, [pc12, SUPER_ADMIN.id, SUPER_ADMIN.full_name])

        // Clean seat plans for these 3 workstations
        await client.query(`
          DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans
          WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng'
            AND workstation_id IN ($1, $2, $3);
        `, [pc10, pc11, pc12])

        // Check availability logic directly
        const candidateIssues = await client.query(`
          SELECT workstation_id, severity, status FROM public.workstation_issues
          WHERE workstation_id IN ($1, $2, $3) AND status IN ('open', 'in_progress');
        `, [pc10, pc11, pc12])

        const unavailableSet = new Set()
        candidateIssues.rows.forEach(issue => {
          if (issue.status === 'in_progress' || issue.severity === 'critical' || issue.severity === 'high') {
            unavailableSet.add(issue.workstation_id)
          }
        })

        // PC-10 (minor) must NOT be in unavailable set
        assert.equal(unavailableSet.has(pc10), false, 'PC-10 with minor issue must remain ELIGIBLE')
        // PC-11 (high fault) must be in unavailable set
        assert.equal(unavailableSet.has(pc11), true, 'PC-11 with high fault must be UNAVAILABLE')
        // PC-12 (under repair) must be in unavailable set
        assert.equal(unavailableSet.has(pc12), true, 'PC-12 under repair must be UNAVAILABLE')

        await client.query('ROLLBACK')
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })
  })

  describe('9. Existing Maintenance & Practical Log Regressions', () => {
    it('Maintenance plans, maintenance logs, and workstation issues remain intact and connected', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()
      try {
        const plans = await client.query(`SELECT count(*) as count FROM public.maintenance_plans;`)
        assert.ok(Number(plans.rows[0].count) >= 0, 'maintenance_plans accessible')

        const logs = await client.query(`SELECT count(*) as count FROM public.maintenance_logs;`)
        assert.ok(Number(logs.rows[0].count) >= 0, 'maintenance_logs accessible')

        const issues = await client.query(`SELECT count(*) as count FROM public.workstation_issues;`)
        assert.ok(Number(issues.rows[0].count) >= 0, 'workstation_issues accessible')
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })

    it('Historical practical logs and roll-call records remain 100% valid and accessible', async () => {
      if (!dbUrl) return
      const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      const client = await pool.connect()
      try {
        const res = await client.query(`
          SELECT id, lab_id, subject_name, batch_group, total_students, present_students
          FROM public.practical_logs
          LIMIT 5;
        `)
        assert.ok(res.rows.length >= 0, 'practical_logs query succeeds')
        for (const row of res.rows) {
          assert.ok(row.total_students >= 0, 'Total students must be non-negative')
          assert.ok(row.present_students >= 0, 'Present students must be non-negative')
        }
      } finally {
        client.release()
        await pool.end()
      }
    })
  })
})
