import { describe, it, after } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

// Load .env.local into process.env if present
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const key = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const val = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[key]) {
        process.env[key] = val
      }
    }
  }
}

import { getPgPool } from '../lib/db.ts'

describe('Phase 3: Dynamic Seating, Displaced Student Triage & Forensic Audit', () => {
  // 1. Natural Alphanumeric Workstation Sorting
  it('Workstation Natural Alphanumeric Sort: orders stations logically (PC-01 .. PC-10, PC-50)', () => {
    const rawStations = [
      { id: '1', label: 'PC-10' },
      { id: '2', label: 'PC-02' },
      { id: '3', label: 'PC-01' },
      { id: '4', label: 'PC-20' },
      { id: '5', label: 'PC-03' },
      { id: '6', label: 'Teacher-01' },
    ]

    const sorted = [...rawStations].sort((a, b) =>
      a.label.localeCompare(b.label, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' })
    )

    const labels = sorted.map((s) => s.label)
    assert.deepEqual(labels, ['PC-01', 'PC-02', 'PC-03', 'PC-10', 'PC-20', 'Teacher-01'])
  })

  // 2. Auto-Assign Sorting Strategy (Roll vs Alphabetical)
  it('Auto-Assign Strategies: sorts students by roll_asc or alphabetical A-Z', () => {
    const mockStudents = [
      { id: 'e1', roll_number: 14, students: { full_name: 'Kaustuv Thapa' } },
      { id: 'e2', roll_number: 3, students: { full_name: 'Aayush Poudel' } },
      { id: 'e3', roll_number: 22, students: { full_name: 'Binod Sharma' } },
      { id: 'e4', roll_number: 7, students: { full_name: 'Zack Gurung' } },
    ]

    // Strategy A: roll_asc
    const byRoll = [...mockStudents].sort((a, b) => (a.roll_number || 0) - (b.roll_number || 0))
    assert.deepEqual(
      byRoll.map((s) => s.roll_number),
      [3, 7, 14, 22]
    )

    // Strategy B: alphabetical A-Z
    const byAlpha = [...mockStudents].sort((a, b) =>
      (a.students?.full_name || '').localeCompare(b.students?.full_name || '')
    )
    assert.deepEqual(
      byAlpha.map((s) => s.students.full_name),
      ['Aayush Poudel', 'Binod Sharma', 'Kaustuv Thapa', 'Zack Gurung']
    )
  })

  // 3. Displaced Student Detection Engine
  it('Displaced Student Detection: accurately flags students on broken/servicing stations', () => {
    const mockWorkstations = [
      { id: 'ws-1', label: 'PC-01', status: 'operational', active_issues: [] },
      {
        id: 'ws-2',
        label: 'PC-02',
        status: 'under_repair',
        active_issues: [{ id: 'iss-1', title: 'PSU Smoke', severity: 'critical', status: 'in_progress' }],
      },
      {
        id: 'ws-3',
        label: 'PC-03',
        status: 'flagged',
        active_issues: [{ id: 'iss-2', title: 'Blue Screen of Death', severity: 'high', status: 'open' }],
      },
      {
        id: 'ws-4',
        label: 'PC-04',
        status: 'flagged',
        active_issues: [{ id: 'iss-3', title: 'Sticky Mouse Wheel', severity: 'low', status: 'open' }],
      },
      { id: 'ws-5', label: 'PC-05', status: 'operational', active_issues: [] },
    ]

    const mockSeatPlan = {
      'ws-1': { studentId: 's1', enrollmentId: 'e1', rollNumber: 1, fullName: 'Student One', isOverride: false },
      'ws-2': { studentId: 's2', enrollmentId: 'e2', rollNumber: 2, fullName: 'Student Two', isOverride: false },
      'ws-3': { studentId: 's3', enrollmentId: 'e3', rollNumber: 3, fullName: 'Student Three', isOverride: false },
      'ws-4': { studentId: 's4', enrollmentId: 'e4', rollNumber: 4, fullName: 'Student Four', isOverride: false },
      'ws-5': { studentId: 's5', enrollmentId: 'e5', rollNumber: 5, fullName: 'Student Five', isOverride: true },
    }

    const wsMap = new Map(mockWorkstations.map((w) => [w.id, w]))
    const displaced = []

    for (const [wsId, student] of Object.entries(mockSeatPlan)) {
      if (student.isOverride) continue
      const ws = wsMap.get(wsId)
      if (!ws) continue

      const isBroken =
        ws.status === 'under_repair' ||
        ws.status === 'flagged' ||
        (ws.active_issues &&
          ws.active_issues.some(
            (i) => i.status !== 'resolved' && (i.severity === 'critical' || i.severity === 'high')
          ))

      if (isBroken) {
        const primaryIssue = ws.active_issues?.[0]
        displaced.push({
          rollNumber: student.rollNumber,
          studentName: student.fullName,
          originalWsLabel: ws.label,
          issueTitle: primaryIssue?.title,
          severity: primaryIssue?.severity,
        })
      }
    }

    // Student 2 (PC-02, under_repair) and Student 3 (PC-03, high) and Student 4 (PC-04, flagged)
    // Student 1 (operational) and Student 5 (isOverride = true) must NOT be displaced
    assert.equal(displaced.length, 3)
    assert.deepEqual(
      displaced.map((d) => d.rollNumber),
      [2, 3, 4]
    )
    assert.equal(displaced.find((d) => d.rollNumber === 2)?.issueTitle, 'PSU Smoke')
  })

  // 4. Seating Snapshot Serialization & Schema Conformance
  it('Seating Snapshot Serialization: builds complete station map with presence & override flags', () => {
    const mockSnapshot = [
      {
        workstation_id: 'ws-01',
        workstation_label: 'PC-01',
        row_label: 'Row A',
        student_id: 's-101',
        enrollment_id: 'e-101',
        student_name: 'Kaustuv Thapa',
        roll_number: 14,
        is_present: true,
        is_override: false,
        original_workstation_label: null,
        notes: null,
      },
      {
        workstation_id: 'ws-02',
        workstation_label: 'PC-02',
        row_label: 'Row A',
        student_id: 's-102',
        enrollment_id: 'e-102',
        student_name: 'Rohan Shrestha',
        roll_number: 22,
        is_present: true,
        is_override: true,
        original_workstation_label: 'PC-14',
        notes: 'Session relocation override',
      },
      {
        workstation_id: 'ws-03',
        workstation_label: 'PC-03',
        row_label: 'Row A',
        student_id: null,
        enrollment_id: null,
        student_name: null,
        roll_number: null,
        is_present: false,
        is_override: false,
        original_workstation_label: null,
        notes: null,
      },
    ]

    const serialized = JSON.stringify(mockSnapshot)
    const parsed = JSON.parse(serialized)

    assert.equal(parsed.length, 3)
    assert.equal(parsed[0].student_name, 'Kaustuv Thapa')
    assert.equal(parsed[0].is_present, true)
    assert.equal(parsed[1].is_override, true)
    assert.equal(parsed[2].student_id, null)
  })

  // 5. Practical Usage Forensic Timeline Query Extraction
  it('Forensic Timeline: extracts student seating chronology for a target workstation', () => {
    const mockHistoricalLogs = [
      {
        log_id: 'LOG-01',
        date: '2026-10-05',
        period_label: '10:00 - 11:30',
        subject_name: 'Computer Science Practical',
        batch_group: 'Class 11 Science A',
        practical_title: 'HTML Forms & CSS Flexbox',
        topic_learned: 'Responsive Layouts',
        seating_snapshot: [
          {
            workstation_id: 'target-ws-12',
            workstation_label: 'PC-12',
            student_name: 'Kaustuv Thapa',
            roll_number: 14,
            is_present: true,
            is_override: false,
          },
          {
            workstation_id: 'other-ws-13',
            workstation_label: 'PC-13',
            student_name: 'Aayush Poudel',
            roll_number: 5,
            is_present: true,
            is_override: false,
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        log_id: 'LOG-02',
        date: '2026-10-04',
        period_label: '12:00 - 01:30',
        subject_name: 'Computer Science Practical',
        batch_group: 'Class 12 Science B',
        practical_title: 'C++ Pointers & Memory Management',
        topic_learned: 'Dynamic Allocation',
        seating_snapshot: [
          {
            workstation_id: 'target-ws-12',
            workstation_label: 'PC-12',
            student_name: 'Rohan Shrestha',
            roll_number: 22,
            is_present: true,
            is_override: true,
          },
        ],
      },
    ]

    const targetWsId = 'target-ws-12'
    const timeline = []

    for (const log of mockHistoricalLogs) {
      const entry = log.seating_snapshot.find((s) => s.workstation_id === targetWsId)
      if (entry) {
        timeline.push({
          log_id: log.log_id,
          date: log.date,
          period_label: log.period_label,
          batch_group: log.batch_group,
          student_name: entry.student_name,
          roll_number: entry.roll_number,
          is_override: entry.is_override,
          topic_learned: log.topic_learned,
        })
      }
    }

    assert.equal(timeline.length, 2)
    assert.equal(timeline[0].student_name, 'Kaustuv Thapa')
    assert.equal(timeline[0].roll_number, 14)
    assert.equal(timeline[1].student_name, 'Rohan Shrestha')
    assert.equal(timeline[1].is_override, true)
  })

  // 6. PostgreSQL Database Schema Invariant: seating_snapshot column check
  it('Database Schema: public.practical_logs has column seating_snapshot of type jsonb', async () => {
    const pool = getPgPool()
    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT column_name, data_type 
      FROM information_schema.columns 
      WHERE table_name = 'practical_logs' 
        AND column_name = 'seating_snapshot';
    `)

    assert.equal(res.rows.length, 1, 'Column seating_snapshot must exist in public.practical_logs')
    assert.equal(res.rows[0].data_type, 'jsonb', 'seating_snapshot data_type must be jsonb')
  })

  after(async () => {
    try {
      await getPgPool().end()
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  })
})

import { test, describe, before, after } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

// Load DATABASE_URL from .env.local
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

if (!dbUrl) {
  throw new Error('DATABASE_URL not found in .env.local')
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

describe('Phase 4.5: Academic Relationship Reconciliation & Relational Integrity Invariants', () => {
  let client
  const testStudentId = '00000000-0000-4000-a000-000000000001'
  const testStudent2Id = '00000000-0000-4000-a000-000000000002'
  const testEnrollment1Id = '00000000-0000-4000-b000-000000000001'
  const testEnrollment2Id = '00000000-0000-4000-b000-000000000002'
  const testScheduleId = 'test-phase45-sched-01'
  const testLogId = 'test-phase45-log-01'
  const teacherAnishId = '4911cee7-dae4-48a2-90de-9b039712de35'
  const teacherPrakashId = 'e5e3628a-2a76-4db1-8fe1-b6d1fb58037e'

  before(async () => {
    client = await pool.connect()
    // Cleanup any lingering test fixtures
    await client.query('DELETE FROM public.log_attendance WHERE log_id = $1;', [testLogId])
    await client.query('DELETE FROM public.practical_logs WHERE id = $1;', [testLogId])
    await client.query('DELETE FROM public.schedules WHERE id = $1;', [testScheduleId])
    await client.query('DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id IN ($1, $2);', [testEnrollment1Id, testEnrollment2Id])
    await client.query('DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);', [testStudentId, testStudent2Id])
  })

  after(async () => {
    // Teardown test fixtures
    await client.query('DELETE FROM public.log_attendance WHERE log_id = $1;', [testLogId])
    await client.query('DELETE FROM public.practical_logs WHERE id = $1;', [testLogId])
    await client.query('DELETE FROM public.schedules WHERE id = $1;', [testScheduleId])
    await client.query('DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id IN ($1, $2);', [testEnrollment1Id, testEnrollment2Id])
    await client.query('DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);', [testStudentId, testStudent2Id])
    client.release()
    await pool.end()
  })

  // 1. Student Identity Independence
  test('01. Student Identity Independence: students table has global scope without academic year columns', async () => {
    const colRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns 
      WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'students' AND column_name = 'academic_year_id';
    `)
    assert.equal(colRes.rows.length, 0, 'public.students must NOT have academic_year_id')

    await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, registration_no, full_name, gender, is_active)
      VALUES ($1, 'TEST-ADM-01', 'TEST-REG-01', 'Test Global Student', 'male', true);
    `, [testStudentId])

    const res = await client.query('SELECT id, full_name FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;', [testStudentId])
    assert.equal(res.rows.length, 1)
    assert.equal(res.rows[0].full_name, 'Test Global Student')
  })

  // 2. Temporal Enrollment Isolation
  test('02. Temporal Enrollment Isolation: Independent enrollments in 2083 and 2084 maintain separate roll numbers', async () => {
    // Ensure academic year 2084 exists
    await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.academic_years (id, name, start_date, end_date, is_current)
      VALUES ('2084', '2084 B.S. (2027/28 A.D.)', '2027-04-14 00:00:00+00', '2028-04-13 00:00:00+00', false)
      ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
    `)

    // Enrollment in 2083 Class 11eng, Roll 5
    await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (id, academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
      VALUES ($1, '2083', '11eng', $2, 5, 'active');
    `, [testEnrollment1Id, testStudentId])

    // Enrollment in 2084 Class 12eng, Roll 8
    await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (id, academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
      VALUES ($1, '2084', '12eng', $2, 8, 'active');
    `, [testEnrollment2Id, testStudentId])

    const enrRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT academic_year_id, class_id, roll_number 
      FROM public.student_enrollments 
      WHERE student_id = $1 
      ORDER BY academic_year_id ASC;
    `, [testStudentId])

    assert.equal(enrRes.rows.length, 2)
    assert.equal(enrRes.rows[0].academic_year_id, '2083')
    assert.equal(enrRes.rows[0].class_id, '11eng')
    assert.equal(enrRes.rows[0].roll_number, 5)

    assert.equal(enrRes.rows[1].academic_year_id, '2084')
    assert.equal(enrRes.rows[1].class_id, '12eng')
    assert.equal(enrRes.rows[1].roll_number, 8)
  })

  // 3. Class Cohort Single Source of Truth
  test('03. Class Cohort Single Source of Truth: Cohort section is read from classes.section', async () => {
    const classRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT id, name, grade, section FROM public.classes WHERE id = '12eng';
    `)
    assert.equal(classRes.rows.length, 1)
    assert.equal(classRes.rows[0].grade, 12)
    assert.equal(classRes.rows[0].section, 'Computer Engineering')
  })

  // 4. Teaching Assignment NOT NULL Enforcement
  test('04. Teaching Assignment NOT NULL: Inserting class_subjects without academic_year_id fails', async () => {
    await assert.rejects(
      async () => {
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.class_subjects (class_id, subject_id, teacher_id, academic_year_id)
          VALUES ('12eng', 'sep-12', $1, NULL);
        `, [teacherAnishId])
      },
      /null value in column "academic_year_id"/i
    )
  })

  // 5. Co-Teaching Uniqueness Support
  test('05. Co-Teaching Uniqueness Support: Two teachers assigned to same (year, class, subject) succeeds', async () => {
    // Both Anish and Prakash assigned to 12eng sep-12 in 2084
    const res1 = await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.class_subjects (academic_year_id, class_id, subject_id, teacher_id)
      VALUES ('2084', '12eng', 'sep-12', $1)
      ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
      RETURNING id;
    `, [teacherAnishId])

    const res2 = await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.class_subjects (academic_year_id, class_id, subject_id, teacher_id)
      VALUES ('2084', '12eng', 'sep-12', $1)
      ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
      RETURNING id;
    `, [teacherPrakashId])

    // Query both assignments
    const countRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT count(*) as count FROM public.class_subjects
      WHERE academic_year_id = '2084' AND class_id = '12eng' AND subject_id = 'sep-12';
    `)
    assert.equal(parseInt(countRes.rows[0].count, 10), 2, 'Co-teaching must allow both teachers')

    // Clean up temporary 2084 class_subjects
    await client.query(`
      DELETE FROM public.class_subjects 
      WHERE academic_year_id = '2084' AND class_id = '12eng' AND subject_id = 'sep-12';
    `)
  })

  // 6. Teaching Assignment Duplicate Prevention
  test('06. Teaching Assignment Duplicate Prevention: Duplicate (year, class, subject, teacher) is rejected', async () => {
    await assert.rejects(
      async () => {
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.class_subjects (academic_year_id, class_id, subject_id, teacher_id)
          VALUES ('2083', '12eng', 'sep-12', $1);
        `, [teacherAnishId])
      },
      /duplicate key value violates unique constraint|uq_class_subject/i
    )
  })

  // 7. Schedule class_subject_id NOT NULL Enforcement
  test('07. Schedule class_subject_id NOT NULL: Inserting schedule without class_subject_id fails', async () => {
    await assert.rejects(
      async () => {
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.schedules (
            id, lab_id, subject_name, batch_name, start_time, end_time, slot_id, day_key, class_subject_id
          ) VALUES ('temp-bad-sched', 'comp', 'Test', '12', '10:00', '11:00', 't1', 'sun', NULL);
        `)
      },
      /null value in column "class_subject_id"/i
    )
  })

  // 8. Session Teacher Preservation Invariant
  test('08. Session Teacher Preservation Invariant: Schedule retains its specific session teacher_id', async () => {
    // Find an existing schedule and verify teacher_id is preserved
    const sched = await client.query(`
      SELECT s.id, s.teacher_id, s.class_subject_id, cs.teacher_id as regular_teacher_id
      FROM public.schedules s
      JOIN public.class_subjects cs ON cs.id = s.class_subject_id
      LIMIT 1;
    `)
    assert.ok(sched.rows.length > 0)
    assert.ok(sched.rows[0].class_subject_id, 'Schedule must have class_subject_id')
    assert.ok(sched.rows[0].teacher_id, 'Schedule retains valid teacher_id')
  })

  // 9. Exact Schedule Collision Detection
  test('09. Exact Schedule Collision Detection: Exact cohort collision is caught without false substring matches', async () => {
    // Verify that class '11eng' and '12eng' are treated as distinct cohorts (no false collision)
    const cs11 = await client.query(`SELECT id, class_id FROM public.class_subjects WHERE class_id = '11eng' LIMIT 1;`)
    const cs12 = await client.query(`SELECT id, class_id FROM public.class_subjects WHERE class_id = '12eng' LIMIT 1;`)
    assert.notEqual(cs11.rows[0].class_id, cs12.rows[0].class_id)
  })

  // 10. Practical Log Academic Anchor Enforcement
  test('10. Practical Log Academic Anchor: Inserting practical log without class_subject_id fails', async () => {
    await assert.rejects(
      async () => {
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.practical_logs (
            id, lab_id, teacher_id, date, period_label, subject_name, batch_group, practical_title,
            total_students, present_students, absent_students, class_subject_id
          ) VALUES ('temp-bad-log', 'comp', $1, '2026-09-24', 'Period 1', 'Test', '12', 'Title', 30, 30, 0, NULL);
        `, [teacherAnishId])
      },
      /null value in column "class_subject_id"/i
    )
  })

  // 11. Schedule Deletion Cascade Invariant
  test('11. Schedule Deletion Cascade: Deleting timetable slot sets practical_logs.schedule_id = NULL without deleting log', async () => {
    // Fetch a valid class_subject_id for sep-12
    const csRow = (await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.class_subjects WHERE class_id = '12eng' AND subject_id = 'sep-12' LIMIT 1;`)).rows[0]

    // Create a temporary schedule
    await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.schedules (
        id, lab_id, teacher_id, subject_name, batch_name, start_time, end_time, slot_id, day_key, class_subject_id
      ) VALUES ($1, 'comp', $2, 'SEP-12 Lab', '12 Eng', '10:00', '11:00', 't1', 'sun', $3);
    `, [testScheduleId, teacherAnishId, csRow.id])

    // Create a practical log referencing this schedule
    await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.practical_logs (
        id, schedule_id, lab_id, teacher_id, date, period_label, subject_name, batch_group, practical_title,
        total_students, present_students, absent_students, class_subject_id
      ) VALUES ($1, $2, 'comp', $3, '2026-09-24', 'Period 1', 'SEP-12 Lab', '12 Eng', 'Test Cascading', 30, 30, 0, $4);
    `, [testLogId, testScheduleId, teacherAnishId, csRow.id])

    // Delete the schedule
    await client.query('DELETE FROM public.schedules WHERE id = $1;', [testScheduleId])

    // Verify practical_logs record still exists with schedule_id = NULL
    const logRes = await client.query('SELECT id, schedule_id FROM public.practical_logs WHERE id = $1;', [testLogId])
    assert.equal(logRes.rows.length, 1, 'Practical log must NOT be deleted')
    assert.equal(logRes.rows[0].schedule_id, null, 'practical_logs.schedule_id must be set to NULL')
  })

  // 12. Composite Attendance Mismatch Prevention
  test('12. Composite Attendance Mismatch Prevention: Inserting mismatched (enrollment_id, student_id) is rejected by composite FK', async () => {
    // Insert student 2
    await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, registration_no, full_name, gender, is_active)
      VALUES ($1, 'TEST-ADM-02', 'TEST-REG-02', 'Test Student Two', 'female', true);
    `, [testStudent2Id])

    // testEnrollment1Id belongs to testStudentId, NOT testStudent2Id
    await assert.rejects(
      async () => {
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.log_attendance (id, log_id, enrollment_id, student_id, roll_number, is_present)
          VALUES ('test-att-bad', $1, $2, $3, 999, true);
        `, [testLogId, testEnrollment1Id, testStudent2Id])
      },
      /violates foreign key constraint|fk_log_attendance_enrollment_student/i
    )
  })

  // 13. Composite Attendance Success
  test('13. Composite Attendance Success: Inserting correctly paired (enrollment_id, student_id) succeeds', async () => {
    await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.log_attendance (id, log_id, enrollment_id, student_id, roll_number, is_present)
      VALUES ('test-att-ok', $1, $2, $3, 5, true)
      ON CONFLICT (log_id, roll_number) DO UPDATE SET
        enrollment_id = EXCLUDED.enrollment_id,
        student_id = EXCLUDED.student_id,
        is_present = EXCLUDED.is_present;
    `, [testLogId, testEnrollment1Id, testStudentId])

    const attRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT id, log_id, enrollment_id, student_id, is_present 
      FROM public.log_attendance 
      WHERE log_id = $1 AND student_id = $2;
    `, [testLogId, testStudentId])

    assert.equal(attRes.rows.length, 1)
    assert.equal(attRes.rows[0].enrollment_id, testEnrollment1Id)
    assert.equal(attRes.rows[0].student_id, testStudentId)
  })

  // 14. Historical Snapshot Immutability
  test('14. Historical Snapshot Immutability: Mutating subjects.name does not alter practical_logs.subject_name snapshot', async () => {
    const originalSnapshot = (await client.query('SELECT subject_name FROM public.practical_logs WHERE id = $1;', [testLogId])).rows[0]?.subject_name
    assert.equal(originalSnapshot, 'SEP-12 Lab')

    // Temporarily mutate subjects.name
    await client.query(`UPDATE public.subjects SET name = 'MUTATED NAME FOR AUDIT TEST' WHERE id = 'sep-12';`)

    // Verify practical_logs.subject_name did NOT change
    const checkSnapshot = (await client.query('SELECT subject_name FROM public.practical_logs WHERE id = $1;', [testLogId])).rows[0]?.subject_name
    assert.equal(checkSnapshot, 'SEP-12 Lab', 'Historical snapshot must remain immutable')

    // Restore subjects.name
    await client.query(`UPDATE public.subjects SET name = 'Software Engineering & Project Lab' WHERE id = 'sep-12';`)
  })

  // 15. Canonical Multi-Hop Relational Query
  test('15. Canonical Multi-Hop Relational Query: 100% clean relational join without string heuristics', async () => {
    const multiHopQuery = `
      SELECT 
        ay.id AS academic_year,
        c.name AS class_name,
        c.grade AS class_grade,
        s.code AS subject_code,
        s.name AS subject_name,
        p.full_name AS curriculum_teacher,
        pl.practical_title,
        pl.date AS session_date,
        st.admission_no,
        st.full_name AS student_name,
        la.roll_number,
        la.is_present AS attendance_is_present
      FROM public.practical_logs pl
      JOIN public.class_subjects cs ON cs.id = pl.class_subject_id
      JOIN public.academic_years ay ON ay.id = cs.academic_year_id
      JOIN public.classes c ON c.id = cs.class_id
      JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id = cs.subject_id
      JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = cs.teacher_id
      JOIN public.log_attendance la ON la.log_id = pl.id
      JOIN public.student_enrollments se ON se.id = la.enrollment_id AND se.student_id = la.student_id
      JOIN public.students st ON st.id = se.student_id
      WHERE pl.id = $1 AND st.id = $2;
    `

    const res = await client.query(multiHopQuery, [testLogId, testStudentId])
    assert.equal(res.rows.length, 1)
    const row = res.rows[0]
    assert.equal(row.academic_year, '2083')
    assert.equal(row.class_grade, 12)
    assert.equal(row.class_name, '12 Eng')
    assert.equal(row.subject_code, 'SEP-12')
    assert.equal(row.curriculum_teacher, 'Er. Anish Karki')
    assert.equal(row.student_name, 'Test Global Student')
    assert.equal(row.admission_no, 'TEST-ADM-01')
    assert.equal(row.roll_number, 5)
    assert.equal(row.attendance_is_present, true)
  })
})

import test, { describe, it, after } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'
import {
  calculateFleetProgressSummary,
  sortWorkstationLabels,
  groupWorkstationLabelsByRow,
} from '../lib/types/maintenance-fleet.ts'
import * as maintenanceFleetActions from '../app/actions/maintenance-fleet.ts'

// Load environment variables for remote PostgreSQL verification
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
let dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL || ''
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const envContent = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of envContent.split('\n')) {
    if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
      dbUrl = line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    }
  }
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({
  connectionString: dbUrl,
  ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
})

after(async () => {
  await pool.end()
})

describe('Phase 4: Multi-PC Maintenance Routine Checklists & Fleet Operations', () => {
  it('Summary Calculation: computes exact completion, pending, blocked metrics and percentage', () => {
    const stations = [
      'PC-01', 'PC-02', 'PC-03', 'PC-04', 'PC-05',
      'PC-06', 'PC-07', 'PC-08', 'PC-09', 'PC-10',
    ]

    const progress = {
      'PC-01': { status: 'completed', updated_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00Z' },
      'PC-02': { status: 'completed', updated_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00Z' },
      'PC-03': { status: 'completed', updated_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00Z' },
      'PC-04': { status: 'blocked', updated_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00Z', notes: 'Bad RAM' },
      'PC-05': { status: 'blocked', updated_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00Z', notes: 'No network link' },
    }

    const summary = calculateFleetProgressSummary(stations, progress)

    assert.equal(summary.total, 10)
    assert.equal(summary.completed, 3)
    assert.equal(summary.blocked, 2)
    assert.equal(summary.pending, 5)
    assert.equal(summary.percentage, 30)
  })

  it('Summary Calculation: edge case with 0 target machines returns zeroed metrics', () => {
    const summary = calculateFleetProgressSummary([], {})
    assert.deepEqual(summary, {
      total: 0,
      completed: 0,
      pending: 0,
      blocked: 0,
      percentage: 0,
    })
  })

  it('Workstation Natural Alphanumeric Sort: orders PC-01 to PC-50 and positions teacher podium', () => {
    const unorganized = [
      'PC-10',
      'TEACHER-PODIUM',
      'PC-02',
      'PC-01',
      'PC-20',
      'PC-09',
      'PC-05',
    ]

    const sorted = sortWorkstationLabels(unorganized)

    assert.equal(sorted[0], 'PC-01')
    assert.equal(sorted[1], 'PC-02')
    assert.equal(sorted[2], 'PC-05')
    assert.equal(sorted[3], 'PC-09')
    assert.equal(sorted[4], 'PC-10')
    assert.equal(sorted[5], 'PC-20')
    assert.equal(sorted[6], 'TEACHER-PODIUM')
  })

  it('Row Grouping: organizes terminal fleet into logical rows and podium', () => {
    const stations = [
      'PC-01', 'PC-05', 'PC-10',
      'PC-11', 'PC-15', 'PC-20',
      'PC-25', 'PC-30',
      'PC-35', 'PC-40',
      'TEACHER-01',
    ]

    const groups = groupWorkstationLabelsByRow(stations)

    assert.ok(groups.length >= 4)
    const rowA = groups.find((g) => g.rowLabel.includes('Row A'))
    assert.ok(rowA)
    assert.deepEqual(rowA.items, ['PC-01', 'PC-05', 'PC-10'])

    const teacherGroup = groups.find((g) => g.rowLabel.includes('Teacher Pod'))
    assert.ok(teacherGroup)
    assert.deepEqual(teacherGroup.items, ['TEACHER-01'])
  })

  it('Database Schema Verification: public.maintenance_plans has affected_machines and fleet_progress columns', async () => {
    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT column_name, data_type 
      FROM information_schema.columns 
      WHERE table_name = 'maintenance_plans' 
        AND column_name IN ('affected_machines', 'fleet_progress');
    `)

    assert.equal(res.rows.length, 2, 'Both affected_machines and fleet_progress must exist in maintenance_plans')

    const cols = Object.fromEntries(res.rows.map((r) => [r.column_name, r.data_type]))
    assert.equal(cols.affected_machines, 'ARRAY')
    assert.equal(cols.fleet_progress, 'jsonb')
  })

  it('Server Action Pure RPC Exports: app/actions/maintenance-fleet.ts only exports async functions (Rule #13)', () => {
    const exportedKeys = Object.keys(maintenanceFleetActions)
    assert.ok(exportedKeys.includes('getFleetRoutineProgress'))
    assert.ok(exportedKeys.includes('updateFleetTerminalStatus'))
    assert.ok(exportedKeys.includes('batchUpdateFleetTerminalStatus'))
    assert.ok(exportedKeys.includes('resetFleetRoutineProgress'))
    assert.ok(exportedKeys.includes('archiveFleetRoutineToLog'))

    for (const key of exportedKeys) {
      const fn = maintenanceFleetActions[key]
      assert.equal(typeof fn, 'function', `Export ${key} must be a function`)
      assert.equal(
        fn.constructor.name,
        'AsyncFunction',
        `Export ${key} must be an AsyncFunction per Rule #13`
      )
    }
  })
})

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

// Load environment variables for database connection
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const k = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const v = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[k]) process.env[k] = v
    }
  }
}

process.env.NODE_ENV = 'test'
process.env.TEST_USER_OVERRIDE = JSON.stringify({
  id: '17d03665-dfaa-4edc-ab54-585057315a0b',
  email: 'admin@rrl.edu.np',
  full_name: 'System Administrator',
  role: 'super_admin',
  is_active: true,
  permissions: { all: true },
})

test('Phase 4: Multi-Year Historical Audit & Print Synchronization Test Suite', async (t) => {
  const {
    getPracticalRecords,
    getAcademicYearsForFilterAction,
    exportPracticalRecordsAction,
  } = await import('../app/actions/records.ts')
  const { filtersToSearchParams, searchParamsToFilters } = await import(
    '../lib/report-spec/filter-codec.ts'
  )
  const { getPgPool } = await import('../lib/db.ts')
  const pool = getPgPool()

  let knownYears = []
  let activeYearId = null

  await t.test('1. getAcademicYearsForFilterAction: Returns live academic cycles', async () => {
    const res = await getAcademicYearsForFilterAction()
    assert.equal(res.success, true, 'getAcademicYearsForFilterAction succeeded')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(res.data), 'Returns an array of academic cycles')
    assert.ok(res.data.length > 0, 'Database contains at least one academic year')

    knownYears = res.data
    const currentYear = res.data.find((y) => y.isCurrent)
    assert.ok(currentYear, 'One cycle is flagged as current (isCurrent = true)')
    activeYearId = currentYear.id

    for (const cycle of res.data) {
      assert.ok(cycle.id, 'Cycle has an id')
      assert.ok(cycle.name, 'Cycle has a formatted name')
      assert.equal(typeof cycle.isCurrent, 'boolean', 'isCurrent is boolean')
    }
  })

  await t.test('2. Filter Codec: Bidirectional URL search params preserve academic_year_id', async () => {
    // Serialization
    const searchParams = filtersToSearchParams({
      academic_year_id: activeYearId,
      lab_id: 'comp',
      status: 'conducted',
    })
    assert.equal(
      searchParams.get('academic_year_id'),
      activeYearId,
      'filtersToSearchParams includes academic_year_id'
    )

    // Deserialization with primary key
    const parsed = searchParamsToFilters(searchParams)
    assert.equal(
      parsed.academic_year_id,
      activeYearId,
      'searchParamsToFilters decodes academic_year_id'
    )

    // Deserialization with legacy alias key 'year'
    const legacyParams = new URLSearchParams('year=2082&lab_id=phys')
    const parsedLegacy = searchParamsToFilters(legacyParams)
    assert.equal(
      parsedLegacy.academic_year_id,
      '2082',
      'searchParamsToFilters supports legacy alias ?year=2082'
    )
  })

  await t.test('3. getPracticalRecords: Scopes queries and metrics to specified academic year', async () => {
    // Query for active year
    const resActive = await getPracticalRecords(
      {
        academic_year_id: activeYearId,
        page: 1,
        pageSize: 10,
      },
      'none'
    )

    assert.equal(resActive.success, true, 'Query for active year succeeded')
    assert.ok(resActive.metrics, 'Summary metrics returned')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(resActive.academicYears), 'Academic years list returned to caller')
    assert.equal(resActive.activeAcademicYearId, activeYearId, 'Active academic year id identified')

    // Verify all records returned belong to the requested year
    const flatRecords = resActive.sections.flatMap((s) => s.records)
    for (const record of flatRecords) {
      if (record.academic_year_id) {
        assert.equal(
          record.academic_year_id,
          activeYearId,
          'Record academic_year_id matches filter'
        )
      }
    }

    // Query for all years (consolidated)
    const resAll = await getPracticalRecords(
      {
        academic_year_id: 'all',
        page: 1,
        pageSize: 10,
      },
      'none'
    )

    assert.equal(resAll.success, true, 'Query for consolidated all cycles succeeded')
    assert.ok(resAll.totalCount >= flatRecords.length, 'Consolidated count >= single year count')
  })

  await t.test('4. exportPracticalRecordsAction: Excel and CSV exports include year metadata', async () => {
    // Excel export
    const xlsxRes = await exportPracticalRecordsAction(
      {
        academic_year_id: activeYearId,
      },
      'none',
      'xlsx',
      {
        visibleColumns: ['date', 'period', 'facility', 'class_batch', 'subject', 'attendance', 'status'],
      }
    )

    assert.equal(xlsxRes.success, true, 'Excel export succeeded')
    assert.ok(xlsxRes.base64, 'Base64 buffer returned')
    assert.ok(
      xlsxRes.filename.includes(`ay-${activeYearId}`),
      `Filename contains academic year tag: ${xlsxRes.filename}`
    )

    // CSV export
    const csvRes = await exportPracticalRecordsAction(
      {
        academic_year_id: activeYearId,
      },
      'none',
      'csv',
      {
        visibleColumns: ['date', 'period', 'facility', 'class_batch', 'subject', 'attendance', 'status'],
      }
    )

    assert.equal(csvRes.success, true, 'CSV export succeeded')
    assert.ok(csvRes.base64, 'Base64 text returned')
    assert.ok(
      csvRes.filename.includes(`ay-${activeYearId}`),
      `Filename contains academic year tag: ${csvRes.filename}`
    )
  })

  await t.test('5. Foreign Key Protection Invariant: practical_logs reference academic_years', async () => {
    const fkeyCheck = await pool.query(`
      SELECT
        tc.constraint_name,
        tc.table_name,
        kcu.column_name,
        ccu.table_name AS foreign_table_name,
        rc.delete_rule
      FROM information_schema.table_constraints AS tc
      JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage AS kcu
        ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
      JOIN information_schema.referential_constraints AS rc
        ON tc.constraint_name = rc.constraint_name
      JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage AS ccu
        ON rc.unique_constraint_name = ccu.constraint_name
      WHERE tc.table_name = 'practical_logs'
        AND kcu.column_name = 'academic_year_id';
    `)

    assert.ok(fkeyCheck.rows.length > 0, 'Foreign key constraint exists on practical_logs.academic_year_id')
    assert.equal(
      fkeyCheck.rows[0].foreign_table_name,
      'academic_years',
      'Foreign key targets academic_years table'
    )
    assert.equal(
      fkeyCheck.rows[0].delete_rule,
      'RESTRICT',
      'Foreign key delete rule is RESTRICT (protecting historical log records from cascade deletion)'
    )
  })
})

import { describe, it, before, after } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

import { generateBlankRosterTemplate } from '../lib/roster-ingestion/template.ts'
import { parseRosterFile } from '../lib/roster-ingestion/parser.ts'
import { validateParsedRoster, formatAutoAdmissionNo } from '../lib/roster-ingestion/validator.ts'
import { resolveUserScope } from '../lib/context/user-scope.ts'

function loadDbUrl() {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
  if (!fs.existsSync(envPath)) return null
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
      return line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
    }
  }
  return null
}

const dbUrl = loadDbUrl()

async function buildDbValidationContext(client, academicYearId, classId) {
  const classRes = await client.query(`SELECT id, name FROM public.classes WHERE id = $1;`, [classId])
  const yearRes = await client.query(`SELECT id, name FROM public.academic_years WHERE id = $1;`, [academicYearId])

  const studRes = await client.query(`SELECT id, full_name, admission_no, registration_no FROM public.students WHERE is_active = true;`)
  const existingStudentsByAdmissionNo = new Map()
  const existingStudentsByRegistrationNo = new Map()
  const allActiveStudents = []
  for (const s of studRes.rows) {
    allActiveStudents.push({ id: s.id, full_name: s.full_name, admission_no: s.admission_no })
    if (s.admission_no) existingStudentsByAdmissionNo.set(s.admission_no.toLowerCase().trim(), s)
    if (s.registration_no) existingStudentsByRegistrationNo.set(s.registration_no.toLowerCase().trim(), s)
  }

  const enrollRes = await client.query(`
    SELECT se.id, se.student_id, se.roll_number, s.full_name
    FROM public.student_enrollments se
    JOIN public.students s ON s.id = se.student_id
    WHERE se.academic_year_id = $1 AND se.class_id = $2 AND se.status = 'active';
  `, [academicYearId, classId])
  const existingEnrollmentsByStudentId = new Map()
  const existingEnrollmentsByRoll = new Map()
  for (const e of enrollRes.rows) {
    existingEnrollmentsByStudentId.set(e.student_id, { id: e.id, roll_number: e.roll_number })
    existingEnrollmentsByRoll.set(e.roll_number, { id: e.id, student_id: e.student_id, full_name: e.full_name })
  }

  return {
    targetAcademicYearId: academicYearId,
    targetAcademicYearName: yearRes.rows[0]?.name || academicYearId,
    targetClassId: classId,
    targetClassName: classRes.rows[0]?.name || classId,
    existingStudentsByAdmissionNo,
    existingStudentsByRegistrationNo,
    allActiveStudents,
    existingEnrollmentsByStudentId,
    existingEnrollmentsByRoll,
  }
}

function buildMockValidationContext(academicYearId = '2083', classId = '12eng') {
  return {
    targetAcademicYearId: academicYearId,
    targetAcademicYearName: '2083-2084 BS',
    targetClassId: classId,
    targetClassName: 'Class 12 Science (Eng)',
    existingStudentsByAdmissionNo: new Map(),
    existingStudentsByRegistrationNo: new Map(),
    allActiveStudents: [],
    existingEnrollmentsByStudentId: new Map(),
    existingEnrollmentsByRoll: new Map(),
  }
}

describe('Phase 4: Student Roster & Safe Excel Ingestion Engine', () => {
  let pool
  let client

  before(async () => {
    if (dbUrl) {
      pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
      client = await pool.connect()
      // Clean up any lingering test records from previous runs
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans 
        WHERE enrollment_id IN (
          SELECT id FROM public.student_enrollments 
          WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' AND roll_number >= 130
        );
      `)
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments 
        WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' AND roll_number >= 130;
      `)
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.students 
        WHERE admission_no LIKE 'SUCCESS-%' 
           OR admission_no LIKE 'FAIL-ATOMIC-%' 
           OR admission_no LIKE 'IDEM-%'
           OR admission_no LIKE 'ID-ADM-%'
           OR registration_no LIKE 'ID-REG-%';
      `)
    }
  })

  after(async () => {
    if (client) {
      client.release()
    }
    if (pool) {
      await pool.end()
    }
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. TEMPLATE GENERATION & PARSER MULTI-FORMAT COMPATIBILITY
  // =========================================================================
  describe('1. Template Generation & Spreadsheet Parser', () => {
    it('generates a valid 4-column blank XLSX template with standard headers', async () => {
      const buffer = await generateBlankRosterTemplate()
      assert.ok(buffer instanceof Buffer, 'Template must be a Buffer')
      assert.ok(buffer.length > 0, 'Buffer must not be empty')

      // Parse the generated template back to ensure zero roundtrip corruption
      const parsed = await parseRosterFile(buffer, 'LabSync_Class_Roster_Template.xlsx')
      assert.ok(Array.isArray(parsed), 'Parsed result must be an array')
      assert.ok(parsed.length > 0, 'Parsed rows should contain sample/template rows')
    })

    it('parses CSV data with variations in header naming and casing', async () => {
      const csvContent = `Roll No,Full Name,Adm No,Reg No
1,Aarav Sharma,ADM-2083-001,REG-001
2,Bikash Thapa,ADM-2083-002,
3,Chirag KC,,REG-003
4,Deepa Shrestha,ADM-2083-004,REG-004`

      const buffer = Buffer.from(csvContent, 'utf-8')
      const parsed = await parseRosterFile(buffer, 'test_roster.csv')

      assert.equal(parsed.length, 4)
      assert.equal(parsed[0].roll_number, 1)
      assert.equal(parsed[0].full_name, 'Aarav Sharma')
      assert.equal(parsed[0].admission_no, 'ADM-2083-001')
      assert.equal(parsed[0].registration_no, 'REG-001')

      assert.equal(parsed[1].roll_number, 2)
      assert.equal(parsed[1].full_name, 'Bikash Thapa')
      assert.equal(parsed[1].registration_no, null)

      assert.equal(parsed[2].roll_number, 3)
      assert.equal(parsed[2].admission_no, null)
      assert.equal(parsed[2].registration_no, 'REG-003')
    })

    it('gracefully handles empty lines, whitespace, and strips extra spaces', async () => {
      const csvWithWhitespace = `
      
Roll Number, Student Name , Admission Number , Registration Number 
  10  ,   Elena Subedi   ,  ADM-999  ,   REG-999   

`
      const buffer = Buffer.from(csvWithWhitespace, 'utf-8')
      const parsed = await parseRosterFile(buffer, 'spaced.csv')

      assert.equal(parsed.length, 1)
      assert.equal(parsed[0].roll_number, 10)
      assert.equal(parsed[0].full_name, 'Elena Subedi')
      assert.equal(parsed[0].admission_no, 'ADM-999')
      assert.equal(parsed[0].registration_no, 'REG-999')
    })
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // 2. PRE-FLIGHT SYNTACTIC & INVARIANT VALIDATION
  // =========================================================================
  describe('2. Pre-flight Syntactic Validation & Conflict Rules', () => {
    it('flags duplicate roll numbers in the incoming file as blocking errors', () => {
      const rawRows = [
        { row_index: 2, roll_number: 5, full_name: 'Student One', admission_no: 'ADM-T1', registration_no: null },
        { row_index: 3, roll_number: 5, full_name: 'Student Two', admission_no: 'ADM-T2', registration_no: null },
      ]

      const ctx = buildMockValidationContext()
      const report = validateParsedRoster(rawRows, ctx)

      assert.equal(report.can_commit, false, 'Pre-flight must fail on duplicate roll numbers')
      assert.equal(report.error_count, 2, 'Both duplicate rows must be flagged as error')
      assert.ok(report.rows.some(r => r.error_message?.includes('Duplicate roll number 5')))
    })

    it('flags missing full name and roll > 200 as blocking errors', () => {
      const rawRows = [
        { row_index: 2, roll_number: 1, full_name: '   ', admission_no: null, registration_no: null },
        { row_index: 3, roll_number: 250, full_name: 'Over Roll Student', admission_no: null, registration_no: null },
        { row_index: 4, roll_number: 0, full_name: 'Zero Roll Student', admission_no: null, registration_no: null },
      ]

      const ctx = buildMockValidationContext()
      const report = validateParsedRoster(rawRows, ctx)

      assert.equal(report.can_commit, false)
      assert.equal(report.error_count, 3)
      assert.ok(report.rows.some(r => r.error_message?.includes('Student full name is required')))
      assert.ok(report.rows.some(r => r.error_message?.includes('out of valid range (1–200)')))
    })

    it('generates advisory name similarity warning without blocking import', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      // Pre-seed an existing student in db for advisory test
      const testAdm = `SIM-TEST-${Date.now()}`
      const seedRes = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no)
        VALUES ('Nabin Silwal', $1)
        RETURNING id;
      `, [testAdm])
      const sId = seedRes.rows[0].id

      try {
        const ctx = await buildDbValidationContext(client, '2083', '12eng')
        const rawRows = [
          // Slightly different spelling, no identifier
          { row_index: 2, roll_number: 99, full_name: 'Nabin Silwal', admission_no: null, registration_no: null },
        ]

        const report = validateParsedRoster(rawRows, ctx)
        const rowPreview = report.rows[0]
        assert.ok(rowPreview.warning_message, 'Should have name similarity warning message')
        assert.ok(rowPreview.warning_message.includes('Similar name to existing student'))
        assert.ok(rowPreview.status === 'warning' || rowPreview.status === 'review_needed', 'Should have advisory review or warning status')
      } finally {
        await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [sId])
      }
    })

    it('auto-synthesizes standard institutional admission number ADM-[YEAR]-[CLASS]-[ROLL] when empty', () => {
      assert.equal(formatAutoAdmissionNo('2083', '12eng', 1), 'ADM-2083-12ENG-01')
      assert.equal(formatAutoAdmissionNo('2083', '12eng', 35), 'ADM-2083-12ENG-35')
      assert.equal(formatAutoAdmissionNo('2083', '11sci', 105), 'ADM-2083-11SCI-105')

      const rawRows = [
        { row_index: 2, roll_number: 1, full_name: 'Prajwal Karki', admission_no: null, registration_no: null },
        { row_index: 3, roll_number: 2, full_name: 'Suman Thapa', admission_no: 'CUSTOM-ADM-002', registration_no: null },
      ]

      const ctx = buildMockValidationContext()
      const report = validateParsedRoster(rawRows, ctx)

      assert.equal(report.rows[0].admission_no, 'ADM-2083-0001')
      assert.equal(report.rows[0].is_auto_admission_no, true)
      assert.equal(report.rows[1].admission_no, 'CUSTOM-ADM-002')
      assert.equal(report.rows[1].is_auto_admission_no, false)
    })
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // 3. STRONG IDENTIFIER MATCHING & IDENTITY CONFLICT BLOCKING
  // =========================================================================
  describe('3. Strong Identifier Matching & Identity Conflict Protection', () => {
    it('detects IDENTITY_CONFLICT when admission_no and registration_no point to two different students', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      const admKey = `ID-ADM-${Date.now()}`
      const regKey = `ID-REG-${Date.now()}`

      // Create Student A with admKey
      const resA = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no)
        VALUES ('Student Alpha', $1)
        RETURNING id;
      `, [admKey])
      const idA = resA.rows[0].id

      // Create Student B with regKey
      const resB = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, registration_no)
        VALUES ('Student Beta', $1)
        RETURNING id;
      `, [regKey])
      const idB = resB.rows[0].id

      try {
        // Preflight with conflicting pair in same row
        const ctx = await buildDbValidationContext(client, '2083', '12eng')
        const rawRows = [
          { row_index: 2, roll_number: 140, full_name: 'Conflicted Candidate', admission_no: admKey, registration_no: regKey },
        ]

        const report = validateParsedRoster(rawRows, ctx)

        assert.equal(report.can_commit, false, 'Preflight must fail due to IDENTITY_CONFLICT')
        assert.ok(report.rows.some(r => r.error_message?.includes('Identity conflict')), 'Must report identity conflict')

        // Direct test of RPC: verify RPC also blocks IDENTITY_CONFLICT independently
        let rpcBlocked = false
        try {
          await client.query(`
            SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
              '2083',
              '12eng',
              $1::jsonb
            );
          `, [JSON.stringify([{
            roll_number: 140,
            full_name: 'Conflicted Candidate',
            admission_no: admKey,
            registration_no: regKey,
          }])])
        } catch (err) {
          rpcBlocked = true
          assert.ok(err.message.includes('IDENTITY_CONFLICT'), 'RPC must throw IDENTITY_CONFLICT')
        }
        assert.ok(rpcBlocked, 'RPC must independently reject conflicting strong identifiers')
      } finally {
        await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [idA, idB])
      }
    })
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // 4. ATOMIC DATABASE RPC COMMIT & ROLLBACK VERIFICATION
  // =========================================================================
  describe('4. PostgreSQL RPC Atomic Ingestion & Zero-Partial Writes', () => {
    it('aborts entire batch and writes 0 records when an invalid roll is encountered in payload', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      const runTag = `FAIL-ATOMIC-${Date.now()}`
      const payload = [
        { roll_number: 141, full_name: 'Valid Student 1', admission_no: `${runTag}-1`, registration_no: null },
        { roll_number: 142, full_name: 'Valid Student 2', admission_no: `${runTag}-2`, registration_no: null },
        { roll_number: 999, full_name: 'Invalid Student 3', admission_no: `${runTag}-3`, registration_no: null }, // Roll > 200
      ]

      let txErrored = false
      try {
        await client.query(`
          SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
            '2083',
            '12eng',
            $1::jsonb
          );
        `, [JSON.stringify(payload)])
      } catch (err) {
        txErrored = true
        assert.ok(
          err.message.includes('out of valid bounds') || err.message.includes('VALIDATION_ERROR'),
          'Must raise VALIDATION_ERROR for out of bounds roll'
        )
      }
      assert.ok(txErrored, 'Transaction must fail')

      // Verify ZERO records written from this batch
      const checkRows = await client.query(`
        SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM public.students WHERE admission_no LIKE $1;
      `, [`${runTag}%`])
      assert.equal(parseInt(checkRows.rows[0].cnt, 10), 0, 'Zero partial writes guaranteed on failure')
    })

    it('successfully commits valid roster batch in an atomic statement', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      const runTag = `SUCCESS-${Date.now()}`
      const payload = [
        { roll_number: 145, full_name: 'Batch Student Alpha', admission_no: `${runTag}-A`, registration_no: null },
        { roll_number: 146, full_name: 'Batch Student Beta', admission_no: `${runTag}-B`, registration_no: null },
      ]

      const res = await client.query(`
        SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
          '2083',
          '12eng',
          $1::jsonb
        ) as result;
      `, [JSON.stringify(payload)])

      const result = res.rows[0].result
      assert.equal(result.processed_rows, 2)
      assert.equal(result.students_created, 2)
      assert.equal(result.enrollments_created, 2)

      // Cleanup
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments
        WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' AND roll_number IN (145, 146);
      `)
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.students WHERE admission_no LIKE $1;
      `, [`${runTag}%`])
    })
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // 5. RE-IMPORT IDEMPOTENCY & ROLL MISMATCH CONFLICT DETECTION
  // =========================================================================
  describe('5. Idempotent Re-import & Roll Discrepancy Protection', () => {
    it('re-importing the identical roster retains existing records without duplicates', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      const runTag = `IDEM-${Date.now()}`
      const payload = [
        { roll_number: 151, full_name: 'Idempotent Student 1', admission_no: `${runTag}-1`, registration_no: null },
        { roll_number: 152, full_name: 'Idempotent Student 2', admission_no: `${runTag}-2`, registration_no: null },
      ]

      // First Import
      const firstRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
          '2083',
          '12eng',
          $1::jsonb
        ) as result;
      `, [JSON.stringify(payload)])
      assert.equal(firstRes.rows[0].result.students_created, 2)
      assert.equal(firstRes.rows[0].result.enrollments_created, 2)

      // Second Import: EXACT SAME ROSTER
      const secondRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
          '2083',
          '12eng',
          $1::jsonb
        ) as result;
      `, [JSON.stringify(payload)])
      const r2 = secondRes.rows[0].result
      assert.equal(r2.students_created, 0, 'No duplicate students created')
      assert.equal(r2.enrollments_created, 0, 'No duplicate enrollments created')
      assert.equal(r2.enrollments_retained, 2, 'Both enrollments retained idempotently')

      // Roll Shift Resolution: Same student (identified by admission_no) updates roll from 151 to 153 cleanly
      const rollShiftRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
          '2083',
          '12eng',
          $1::jsonb,
          'sync'
        ) as result;
      `, [JSON.stringify([
        { roll_number: 153, full_name: 'Idempotent Student 1', admission_no: `${runTag}-1`, registration_no: null },
      ])])
      const rShift = rollShiftRes.rows[0].result
      assert.equal(rShift.enrollments_updated, 1, 'Roll shifted cleanly from 151 to 153 without error')

      // Cleanup
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments
        WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' AND roll_number IN (151, 152, 153);
      `)
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE admission_no LIKE $1;`, [`${runTag}%`])
    })
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // 6. NON-DESTRUCTIVE COHORT TRANSFERS
  // =========================================================================
  describe('6. Non-Destructive Student Transfer & Enrollment History', () => {
    it('transfers student to a new cohort while preserving previous enrollment as transferred', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      const admTag = `XFER-${Date.now()}`
      // Create student & enrollment in 11eng
      const seedRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT public.create_student_with_enrollment_tx(
          'Transfer Student',
          '2083',
          '11eng',
          160,
          $1
        ) as res;
      `, [admTag])
      const studentId = seedRes.rows[0].res.student_id
      const initialEnrollId = seedRes.rows[0].res.enrollment_id

      try {
        // Perform transfer to 12eng as roll 160
        // Update previous enrollment to 'transferred'
        await client.query(`
          UPDATE public.student_enrollments
          SET status = 'transferred'
          WHERE id = $1;
        `, [initialEnrollId])

        // Insert new active enrollment in 12eng
        const newEnrollRes = await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (student_id, academic_year_id, class_id, roll_number, status)
          VALUES ($1, '2083', '12eng', 160, 'active')
          RETURNING id;
        `, [studentId])
        const newEnrollId = newEnrollRes.rows[0].id

        // Verify history
        const enrollments = await client.query(`
          SELECT id, class_id, status FROM public.student_enrollments
          WHERE student_id = $1
          ORDER BY created_at ASC;
        `, [studentId])

        assert.equal(enrollments.rows.length, 2, 'Must have exactly 2 enrollment records')
        assert.equal(enrollments.rows[0].class_id, '11eng')
        assert.equal(enrollments.rows[0].status, 'transferred')
        assert.equal(enrollments.rows[1].class_id, '12eng')
        assert.equal(enrollments.rows[1].status, 'active')
      } finally {
        await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id = $1;`, [studentId])
        await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [studentId])
      }
    })
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // 7. TEACHER AUTHORIZATION & SESSION-SCOPED READ-ONLY VISIBILITY
  // =========================================================================
  describe('7. Teacher Authorization & Roster Security Boundaries', () => {
    it('restricts teacher role to session-only read access and prevents roster administrative operations', () => {
      const teacherProfile = {
        id: '4911cee7-dae4-48a2-90de-9b039712de35',
        email: 'a.karki@rrl.edu.np',
        full_name: 'Er. Anish Karki',
        role: 'teacher',
        approval_status: 'approved',
        is_active: true,
        permissions: {},
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }

      const scope = resolveUserScope(teacherProfile)
      assert.equal(scope.isPrivileged, false, 'Teacher must not be privileged')
      assert.equal(scope.isTeacher, true)
    })
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // 8. DECOUPLED CAPACITY & VISUAL SEAT PLANNER INTEGRATION
  // =========================================================================
  describe('8. Decoupled Capacity (35 Students vs 34 Workstations)', () => {
    it('handles cohort where student count exceeds workstation count, staging excess in unassigned tray', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      // In computer lab 'comp', there are 34 workstations (PC-01 to PC-34)
      const wsCountRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM public.workstations WHERE lab_id = 'comp';
      `)
      const wsCount = parseInt(wsCountRes.rows[0].cnt, 10)
      assert.equal(wsCount, 34, 'Computer lab must have exactly 34 workstations')

      // Query active enrollments for 12eng in 2083
      const enrollRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM public.student_enrollments
        WHERE academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng' AND status = 'active';
      `)
      const enrollCount = parseInt(enrollRes.rows[0].cnt, 10)
      assert.ok(enrollCount >= 34, 'Cohort has 34+ active students')

      // Verify that unassigned students are properly handled without crash
      const seatPlansRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM public.workstation_seat_plans
        WHERE lab_id = 'comp' AND academic_year_id = '2083' AND class_id = '12eng';
      `)
      const assignedCount = parseInt(seatPlansRes.rows[0].cnt, 10)
      assert.ok(assignedCount <= wsCount, 'Assigned seats cannot exceed physical workstation count')
    })
  })
})

import { test, describe, before, after } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

// Load DATABASE_URL from .env.local
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
let dbUrl = null

for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
    dbUrl = trimmed.slice('DATABASE_URL='.length).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
    break
  }
}

if (!dbUrl) {
  throw new Error('DATABASE_URL not found in .env.local')
}

const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: dbUrl, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })

    assert.equal(roll101.student_id, testStudent1Id)
    assert.equal(roll101.enrollment_id, testEnrollment1Id)

    assert.ok(roll102, 'Roll 102 must exist in attendance')
    assert.equal(roll102.is_present, false)
    assert.equal(roll102.student_id, testStudent2Id)
    assert.equal(roll102.enrollment_id, testEnrollment2Id)

  // 6. Time-Boxed 24-Hour Post-Session Edit Window
  test('06. Post-Session Edit Window: Session < 24 hrs is unlocked; session > 24 hrs locks non-admins', async () => {
    const csRes = await client.query('SELECT class_subject_id FROM public.schedules WHERE id = $1;', [testAdHocSchedId])
    const classSubjectId = csRes.rows[0].class_subject_id

    // Insert a stale log (30 hours old)
    await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.practical_logs (
        id, schedule_id, lab_id, teacher_id, date, period_label, subject_name, batch_group,
        practical_title, total_students, present_students, absent_students, absent_rolls,
        class_subject_id, academic_year_id, logged_by, created_at
      ) VALUES (
        $1, $2, 'phys', $3, '2026-09-23', 'Period 3', 'C Programming Lab', '11 Eng',
        'Stale Practical Session', 2, 2, 0, ARRAY[]::integer[],
        $4, '2083', $3, NOW() - INTERVAL '30 hours'
      );
    `, [testStaleLogId, testAdHocSchedId, teacherAnishId, classSubjectId])

    // Query both logs and evaluate edit window logic
    const logsRes = await client.query(`
      SELECT 
        id, 
        created_at,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - created_at)) / 3600.0 AS age_hours
      FROM public.practical_logs
      WHERE id IN ($1, $2);
    `, [testLiveLogId, testStaleLogId])

    const freshLog = logsRes.rows.find((l) => l.id === testLiveLogId)
    const staleLog = logsRes.rows.find((l) => l.id === testStaleLogId)

    assert.ok(freshLog.age_hours < 24, 'Live log must be less than 24 hours old')
    assert.ok(staleLog.age_hours > 24, 'Stale log must be older than 24 hours')

    // Evaluate 24-hr edit window predicate
    const canTeacherEditFresh = freshLog.age_hours <= 24
    const canTeacherEditStale = staleLog.age_hours <= 24

    assert.equal(canTeacherEditFresh, true, 'Teacher must have active edit window within 24 hours')
    assert.equal(canTeacherEditStale, false, 'Teacher must be locked out after 24 hours')
  })

  // 7. Tier 2 Temporary Session Override vs Tier 1 Baseline Invariance
  test('07. Two-Tier Seating Invariance: Tier 2 override reassigns student for today without altering Tier 1 baseline', async () => {
    // 1. Establish Tier 1 Baseline Seat Plan: PHYS-99 assigned to Aarav (Enrollment 1)
    await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.workstation_seat_plans (
        workstation_id, lab_id, academic_year_id, class_id, enrollment_id, assigned_by
      ) VALUES (
        $1, 'phys', '2083', '11eng', $2, $3
      );
    `, [testWsId, testEnrollment1Id, teacherAnishId])

    // 2. Teacher moves Bishal (Enrollment 2) to PHYS-99 for today's session only (Tier 2 Session Override)
    await client.query(`
      INSERT INTO public.session_seat_overrides (
        schedule_id, session_date, workstation_id, enrollment_id, created_by
      ) VALUES (
        $1, '2026-09-25', $2, $3, $4
      );
    `, [testAdHocSchedId, testWsId, testEnrollment2Id, teacherAnishId])

    // 3. Verify Tier 1 baseline remains Aarav (Enrollment 1)
    const tier1Res = await client.query(`
      SELECT enrollment_id FROM public.workstation_seat_plans WHERE workstation_id = $1;
    `, [testWsId])
    assert.equal(tier1Res.rows[0].enrollment_id, testEnrollment1Id, 'Tier 1 baseline must remain assigned to Aarav')

    // 4. Verify Tier 2 session override resolves Bishal (Enrollment 2) for today's live session
    const tier2Res = await client.query(`
      SELECT enrollment_id FROM public.session_seat_overrides 
      WHERE schedule_id = $1 AND session_date = '2026-09-25' AND workstation_id = $2;
    `, [testAdHocSchedId, testWsId])
    assert.equal(tier2Res.rows[0].enrollment_id, testEnrollment2Id, 'Tier 2 session override must resolve to Bishal for today')
  })

  // 8. Architectural Separation of Concerns Invariants
  test('08. Architectural Separation: Clean boundaries between /maintenance, /computer-lab, and /admin', () => {
    // Verify /maintenance has 2 clean tabs and zero embedded workstation board
    const maintenancePath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'components/maintenance/maintenance-client-page.tsx')
    const maintenanceCode = fs.readFileSync(maintenancePath, 'utf8')
    assert.ok(maintenanceCode.includes("'tasks' | 'history'"), 'Maintenance must strictly define 2 tabs (tasks and history)')
    assert.ok(!maintenanceCode.includes("import { WorkstationBoard }"), 'Maintenance must NOT import WorkstationBoard')

    // Verify /computer-lab workspace exists with Live Cockpit
    const computerLabPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'components/computer-lab/computer-lab-workspace.tsx')
    assert.ok(fs.existsSync(computerLabPath), 'Computer Lab Workspace component must exist')
    const compLabCode = fs.readFileSync(computerLabPath, 'utf8')
    assert.ok(compLabCode.includes('LiveCockpitBar'), 'Computer Lab Workspace must include LiveCockpitBar')
    assert.ok(compLabCode.includes('StartAdHocSessionModal'), 'Computer Lab Workspace must include StartAdHocSessionModal')
    assert.ok(compLabCode.includes("mode === 'baseline' && isSlideDrawerOpen"), 'Slide drawer must be strictly locked to baseline mode only')

    // Verify /admin houses Floor Designer and Student Rosters
    const adminPagePath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'app/(dashboard)/admin/page.tsx')
    const adminCode = fs.readFileSync(adminPagePath, 'utf8')

    assert.ok(adminCode.includes('AdminFloorDesigner'), 'Admin page must mount AdminFloorDesigner')
  })

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

// Native environment variables loader for direct PostgreSQL connection
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const k = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const v = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[k]) process.env[k] = v
    }
  }
}

        testSubjectCode,

        "DELETE FROM public.maintenance_logs WHERE remarks LIKE '%Pipeline%' OR remarks LIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR work_performed LIKE '%' || $1 || '%';",
        [suffix]

      // Direct PostgreSQL verification: Issue is marked 'resolved'

        'SELECT status, resolved_by_name, resolution_notes, linked_maintenance_log_id FROM public.workstation_issues WHERE id = $1;',
        [testIssueId]
      )
      assert.equal(checkResolved.rows.length, 1)
      const issueRow = checkResolved.rows[0]
      assert.equal(issueRow.status, 'resolved', 'Fault ticket status must transition to resolved')
      assert.ok(issueRow.resolution_notes.includes('Thermal Paste MX-4'))
      assert.ok(issueRow.linked_maintenance_log_id, 'linked_maintenance_log_id must be populated')
      testMaintenanceLogId = issueRow.linked_maintenance_log_id

      // Direct PostgreSQL verification: Certified service log was inserted into maintenance_logs
      const checkMaintLog = await pool.query(
        'SELECT id, asset_identifier, work_performed, parts_replaced FROM public.maintenance_logs WHERE id = $1;',
        [testMaintenanceLogId]
      )
      assert.equal(checkMaintLog.rows.length, 1, 'Certified maintenance log must exist in PostgreSQL')
      assert.equal(checkMaintLog.rows[0].parts_replaced, 'Thermal Paste MX-4')
      assert.ok(checkMaintLog.rows[0].work_performed.includes('Issue Resolved'))
    })

    await p3.test('3.3 Lab In-Charge verifies submitted practical log in /records and faculty audit ledger reflects verification', async () => {
      process.env.TEST_USER_OVERRIDE = JSON.stringify(LAB_INCHARGE_USER)

      // Verification stamp applied by Lab In-Charge
      const updateRes = await updatePracticalLog(testLogId, {

      assert.ok(checkLog.rows[0].remarks.includes('Verified'), 'Practical log remarks must contain Verified stamp')

      // Query Faculty Practical Ledger to verify verified session tally
      const ledgerRes = await getFacultyPracticalLedger({ academicYearId: currentYearId })
      assert.equal(ledgerRes.success, true, 'getFacultyPracticalLedger should succeed')
      assert.ok(Array.isArray(ledgerRes.data), 'Ledger data must be an array')

      // Downstream query verification in getPracticalRecords

      assert.ok(recordsRes.records[0].remarks.includes('Verified'))

    await p3.test('3.4 Confirm NEB Board Compliance Report and Export data payload are 100% complete', async () => {
      process.env.TEST_USER_OVERRIDE = JSON.stringify(LAB_INCHARGE_USER)

      // 3.4.1 Board Compliance Report Query
      const compRes = await getStudentBoardComplianceReport({
        academicYearId: currentYearId,
        classId: '12eng',
      })
      assert.equal(compRes.success, true, `getStudentBoardComplianceReport failed: ${compRes.error}`)
      assert.ok(compRes.data, 'Report payload must be returned')
      assert.ok(compRes.data.class_name, 'Class name must be returned')
      assert.ok(compRes.data.academic_year_name, 'Academic year name must be returned')
      assert.ok(Array.isArray(compRes.data.records), 'Must return student compliance records array')
      assert.ok(typeof compRes.data.total_students === 'number', 'total_students must be a number')
      assert.ok(typeof compRes.data.eligible_students === 'number', 'eligible_students must be a number')
      assert.ok(typeof compRes.data.barred_students === 'number', 'barred_students must be a number')
      assert.ok(typeof compRes.data.cohort_avg_rate_pct === 'number', 'cohort_avg_rate_pct must be a number')

      // 3.4.2 Official NEB Board Excel Export Action
      const exportRes = await exportStudentBoardComplianceAction({
        academicYearId: currentYearId,
        classId: '12eng',
      })
      assert.equal(exportRes.success, true, `exportStudentBoardComplianceAction failed: ${exportRes.error}`)
      assert.ok(exportRes.base64, 'Export must return base64 binary payload')
      assert.ok(exportRes.base64.length > 200, 'Base64 string must represent valid non-empty spreadsheet')
      assert.ok(exportRes.filename?.endsWith('.xlsx'), 'Filename must end with .xlsx')
      assert.equal(
        exportRes.contentType,
        'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
        'Content type must be openxmlformats spreadsheet'
      )

      // 3.4.3 Bulk Maintenance Export Action
      const maintExportRes = await exportMaintenanceRecordsAction('comp', 'xlsx')
      assert.equal(maintExportRes.success, true, `exportMaintenanceRecordsAction failed: ${maintExportRes.error}`)
      assert.ok(maintExportRes.base64, 'Maintenance export must return base64 binary payload')
      assert.ok(maintExportRes.base64.length > 200, 'Maintenance export base64 must be non-empty')
      assert.ok(maintExportRes.filename?.endsWith('.xlsx'))
    })

    await p3.test('3.5 Spotless Database Cleanup: Verify all temporary test rows are completely purged', async () => {
      // Execute explicit deletion of all test records
      if (testIssueId) {
        await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.workstation_issues WHERE id = $1;', [testIssueId])
      }
      if (testMaintenanceLogId) {
        await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.maintenance_logs WHERE id = $1;', [testMaintenanceLogId])
      }
      if (testLogId) {
        await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.log_attendance WHERE log_id = $1;', [testLogId])
        await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.practical_logs WHERE id = $1;', [testLogId])
      }
      if (testClassSubjectId) {
        await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.class_subjects WHERE id = $1;', [testClassSubjectId])
      }
      await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.class_subjects WHERE class_id = $1 OR subject_id = $2;', [
        testClassId,
        testSubjectId,
      ])
      await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.classes WHERE id = $1;', [testClassId])
      await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.subjects WHERE id = $1 OR code = $2;', [
        testSubjectId,
        testSubjectCode,
      ])
      if (testCategoryId) {
        await pool.query('DELETE FROM public.issue_categories WHERE id = $1;', [testCategoryId])
      }

      // Assert that 0 test records remain
      const checkSubject = await pool.query('SELECT id FROM public.subjects WHERE id = $1;', [testSubjectId])
      assert.equal(checkSubject.rows.length, 0, 'Test subject must be purged')

      const checkClass = await pool.query('SELECT id FROM public.classes WHERE id = $1;', [testClassId])
      assert.equal(checkClass.rows.length, 0, 'Test class must be purged')

      const checkCategory = await pool.query('SELECT id FROM public.issue_categories WHERE id = $1;', [testCategoryId])
      assert.equal(checkCategory.rows.length, 0, 'Test category must be purged')

      const checkLog = await pool.query('SELECT id FROM public.practical_logs WHERE id = $1;', [testLogId])
      assert.equal(checkLog.rows.length, 0, 'Test practical log must be purged')

      const checkIssue = await pool.query('SELECT id FROM public.workstation_issues WHERE id = $1;', [testIssueId])
      assert.equal(checkIssue.rows.length, 0, 'Test workstation issue must be purged')
    })
  })
})

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

// Load .env.local into process.env if needed
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const key = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const val = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[key]) {
        process.env[key] = val
      }
    }
  }
}

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

// Load .env.local into process.env if needed
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const key = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const val = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[key]) {
        process.env[key] = val
      }
    }
  }
}
