FILE: tests\phase6-cockpit-elevation.test.mjs
================================================================================
import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'

test('Phase 6: Sprint 1 — Workstation Cockpit Elevation & Interactive Canvas Suite', async (t) => {
  await t.test('1. CAD Viewport Zoom Clamping & Focal Pan Math Invariants', () => {
    const minZoom = 0.5
    const maxZoom = 1.6

    const clampZoom = (val) => Math.min(maxZoom, Math.max(minZoom, Math.round(val * 100) / 100))

    assert.equal(clampZoom(0.2), 0.5, 'Clamps zoom below minimum (0.5)')
    assert.equal(clampZoom(2.5), 1.6, 'Clamps zoom above maximum (1.6)')
    assert.equal(clampZoom(1.154), 1.15, 'Rounds zoom to 2 decimal places')

    // Focal Zoom Invariance:
    // When zooming at mouse position (mx, my), point (cx, cy) remains stable under the cursor
    const mx = 400
    const my = 250
    const zoomBefore = 1.0
    const panBefore = { x: 0, y: 0 }

    const focalX = (mx - panBefore.x) / zoomBefore
    const focalY = (my - panBefore.y) / zoomBefore

    const zoomAfter = 1.25
    const panAfter = {
      x: mx - focalX * zoomAfter,
      y: my - focalY * zoomAfter,
    }

    // New screen position of (focalX, focalY) under zoomAfter and panAfter:
    const newScreenX = panAfter.x + focalX * zoomAfter
    const newScreenY = panAfter.y + focalY * zoomAfter

    assert.equal(newScreenX, mx, 'Cursor X remains fixed on the exact same world coordinate after zoom')
    assert.equal(newScreenY, my, 'Cursor Y remains fixed on the exact same world coordinate after zoom')
  })

  await t.test('2. Workstation Center-Focus Pan Calculation Invariant', () => {
    // Container is 1000px x 600px
    const containerW = 1000
    const containerH = 600
    const targetZoom = 1.25

    // Workstation is located at pos_x = 75%, pos_y = 40% of the canvas
    const posXPercent = 75
    const posYPercent = 40

    const targetXInCanvas = (posXPercent / 100) * containerW // 750px
    const targetYInCanvas = (posYPercent / 100) * containerH // 240px

    const centerX = containerW / 2 // 500px
    const centerY = containerH / 2 // 300px

    const targetPanX = Math.round(centerX - targetXInCanvas * targetZoom)
    const targetPanY = Math.round(centerY - targetYInCanvas * targetZoom)

    // Verify: when targetPan is applied, the workstation's screen position equals center
    const renderedScreenX = targetPanX + targetXInCanvas * targetZoom
    const renderedScreenY = targetPanY + targetYInCanvas * targetZoom

    assert.ok(Math.abs(renderedScreenX - centerX) <= 1, 'Target workstation X is centered within 1px')
    assert.ok(Math.abs(renderedScreenY - centerY) <= 1, 'Target workstation Y is centered within 1px')
  })

  await t.test('3. Three-Tier Attendance Semantic Standard Verification', () => {
    function getAttendanceTier(rate) {
      if (rate >= 85) {
        return { tier: 'Optimal', isWarning: false, isDanger: false }
      } else if (rate >= 75) {
        return { tier: 'Normal', isWarning: false, isDanger: false }
      } else {
        return { tier: 'Low Rate', isWarning: false, isDanger: true }
      }
    }

    // 90% attendance: Optimal (Emerald)
    const tier90 = getAttendanceTier(90)
    assert.equal(tier90.tier, 'Optimal')
    assert.equal(tier90.isDanger, false)

    // 78% attendance: Normal (Slate - ZERO false amber alarm!)
    const tier78 = getAttendanceTier(78)
    assert.equal(tier78.tier, 'Normal')
    assert.equal(tier78.isWarning, false)
    assert.equal(tier78.isDanger, false)

    // 65% attendance: Low Rate (Rose)
    const tier65 = getAttendanceTier(65)
    assert.equal(tier65.tier, 'Low Rate')
    assert.equal(tier65.isDanger, true)
  })

  await t.test('4. Minimap Radar Viewport Bounding Box Calculation Invariant', () => {
    const mapW = 176
    const mapH = 99
    const containerW = 1000
    const containerH = 562.5
    const zoom = 1.0
    const pan = { x: 0, y: 0 }

    // At 1.0x zoom with 0 pan, bounding box covers 100% of minimap
    const boxW = Math.min(mapW, Math.max(16, (containerW / (containerW * zoom)) * mapW))
    const boxH = Math.min(mapH, Math.max(12, (containerH / (containerH * zoom)) * mapH))

    assert.equal(boxW, mapW, 'Bounding box width covers entire map at 1.0x')
    assert.equal(boxH, mapH, 'Bounding box height covers entire map at 1.0x')

    // At 2.0x zoom, bounding box covers exactly 50%
    const zoom2 = 2.0
    const boxW2 = Math.min(mapW, Math.max(16, (containerW / (containerW * zoom2)) * mapW))
    assert.equal(boxW2, mapW / 2, 'Bounding box scales proportionally with zoom factor')
  })

  await t.test('5. Printable Wall Seating Chart Data Grouping & Ordering Invariant', () => {
    const workstations = [
      { id: 'ws-1', label: 'PC-09', row_label: 'Row B', pos_x: 20, pos_y: 35 },
      { id: 'ws-2', label: 'PC-01', row_label: 'Row A', pos_x: 20, pos_y: 20 },
      { id: 'ws-3', label: 'PC-10', row_label: 'Row B', pos_x: 30, pos_y: 35 },
      { id: 'ws-4', label: 'PC-02', row_label: 'Row A', pos_x: 30, pos_y: 20 },
      { id: 'ws-5', label: 'Teacher-01', row_label: 'Teacher', pos_x: 50, pos_y: 5 },
    ]

    const groups = {}
    workstations.forEach((ws) => {
      const row = ws.row_label || 'Other'
      if (!groups[row]) groups[row] = []
      groups[row].push(ws)
    })

    // Sort within row
    Object.keys(groups).forEach((key) => {
      groups[key].sort((a, b) => a.label.localeCompare(b.label, undefined, { numeric: true }))
    })

    assert.deepEqual(
      groups['Row A'].map((w) => w.label),
      ['PC-01', 'PC-02'],
      'Row A sorted numerically'
    )
    assert.deepEqual(
      groups['Row B'].map((w) => w.label),
      ['PC-09', 'PC-10'],
      'Row B sorted numerically'
    )
    assert.equal(groups['Teacher'].length, 1)
  })
})

import { getPgPool } from '../lib/db.ts'
import {
  checkSchedulingConflicts,
  getSlotRange,
  slotRangesOverlap,
  timeRangesOverlap,
} from '../lib/scheduling/conflict-engine.ts'
import {
  recordAuditEvent,
  recordAttendanceOverrideAudit,
  recordSeatSwapAudit,
  recordWorkstationIssueStatusAudit,
  recordScheduleModificationAudit,
  queryAuditLedger,
  getAuditHistoryForEntity,
} from '../lib/audit/audit-ledger.ts'

test('Phase 6: Sprint 3 — Triple-Collision Defense Engine & Immutable Audit Ledger Suite', async (t) => {
  const pool = getPgPool()

  // Setup test schedule for collision verification
  const testSchedId = `test-sched-c3-${Date.now()}`
  let testTeacherId = ''
  let testTeacherName = 'Prof. Test Instructor'

  await t.before(async () => {
    // Resolve a valid teacher profile
    const teacherRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, full_name FROM public.profiles WHERE role IN ('teacher', 'lab_incharge', 'hod') LIMIT 1`
    )
    if (teacherRes.rows.length > 0) {
      testTeacherId = teacherRes.rows[0].id
      testTeacherName = teacherRes.rows[0].full_name || 'Prof. Test Instructor'
    }

    // Resolve a valid class_subject_id
    const csRes = await pool.query(`SELECT id FROM public.class_subjects LIMIT 1`)
    const testCsId = csRes.rows[0]?.id || 'cs-12eng'

    // Insert baseline schedule for Monday Period 3 (t3)
    await pool.query(
      `INSERT INTO public.schedules (
         id, lab_id, teacher_id, subject_name, batch_name, slot_id, span, 
         start_time, end_time, day_key, status, metadata, class_subject_id
       ) VALUES ($1, 'comp', $2, 'Advanced Computing Practical', 'Class 12 Science A', 't3', 1, '11:45', '12:30', 'mon', 'scheduled', $3, $4)
       ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING`,
      [testSchedId, testTeacherId, JSON.stringify({ teacher: testTeacherName }), testCsId]
    )
  })

  await t.after(async () => {
    // Cleanup test schedule and test audit entries
    await pool.query(`DELETE FROM public.schedules WHERE id = $1`, [testSchedId])
    await pool.query(`DELETE FROM public.audit_logs WHERE entity_id LIKE 'test-%'`)
    await pool.end()
  })

  await t.test('1. Slot Range & Time Window Overlap Computation', () => {
    // t1 is index 0, span 2 covers indices 0, 1 (t1, t2)
    const r1 = getSlotRange('t1', 2)
    assert.deepEqual(r1, { start: 0, end: 1 })

    // t2 is index 1, span 1 covers index 1
    const r2 = getSlotRange('t2', 1)
    assert.deepEqual(r2, { start: 1, end: 1 })

    // r1 and r2 overlap at index 1
    assert.equal(slotRangesOverlap(r1, r2), true, 't1 (span 2) and t2 must overlap')

    // t3 is index 2, should NOT overlap with r1
    const r3 = getSlotRange('t3', 1)
    assert.equal(slotRangesOverlap(r1, r3), false, 't1 (span 2) and t3 must not overlap')

    // Time window overlap
    assert.equal(timeRangesOverlap('10:00', '11:30', '11:00', '12:00'), true)
    assert.equal(timeRangesOverlap('10:00', '11:00', '11:00', '12:00'), false)
  })

  await t.test('2. Triple-Collision Engine: Room / Facility Collision Detection', async () => {
    // Attempt to book same lab (comp) at same day (mon) and slot (t3)
    const result = await checkSchedulingConflicts({
      labId: 'comp',
      dayKey: 'mon',
      slotId: 't3',
      span: 1,
      batchName: 'Class 11 Science B',
      teacherName: 'Other Teacher',
    })

    assert.equal(result.hasConflict, true, 'Room collision must be detected')
    assert.equal(result.conflictType, 'room', 'Conflict type must be room')
    assert.ok(result.message?.includes('Facility Collision'), 'Message must indicate facility collision')
    assert.ok(result.message?.includes('comp'), 'Message must mention conflicting lab')
  })

  await t.test('3. Triple-Collision Engine: Faculty Double-Booking Detection', async () => {
    // Attempt to book different lab (phys) at same day (mon) and slot (t3) with SAME teacher
    const result = await checkSchedulingConflicts({
      labId: 'phys',
      teacherId: testTeacherId,
      teacherName: testTeacherName,
      dayKey: 'mon',
      slotId: 't3',
      span: 1,
      batchName: 'Class 11 Physics',
    })

    assert.equal(result.hasConflict, true, 'Faculty double-booking must be detected')
    assert.equal(result.conflictType, 'faculty', 'Conflict type must be faculty')
    assert.ok(result.message?.includes('Faculty Collision'), 'Message must indicate faculty collision')
    assert.ok(result.message?.includes(testTeacherName), 'Message must name conflicting teacher')
  })

  await t.test('4. Triple-Collision Engine: Student Cohort Double-Booking Detection', async () => {
    // Attempt to book different lab (chem) at same day (mon) and slot (t3) with SAME class cohort
    const result = await checkSchedulingConflicts({
      labId: 'chem',
      dayKey: 'mon',
      slotId: 't3',
      span: 1,
      batchName: 'Class 12 Science A',
      teacherName: 'Chemistry Teacher',
    })

    assert.equal(result.hasConflict, true, 'Cohort collision must be detected')
    assert.equal(result.conflictType, 'cohort', 'Conflict type must be cohort')
    assert.ok(result.message?.includes('Class Batch Collision'), 'Message must indicate cohort collision')
    assert.ok(result.message?.includes('Class 12 Science A'), 'Message must name conflicting cohort')
  })

  await t.test('5. Triple-Collision Engine: Clean Free Slot Passes Without Conflict', async () => {
    // Attempt to book an unoccupied slot (e.g. Wednesday Period 5)
    const result = await checkSchedulingConflicts({
      labId: 'comp',
      dayKey: 'wed',
      slotId: 't5',
      span: 1,
      batchName: 'Class 11 Biology',
      teacherName: 'Dr. Available Faculty',
    })

    assert.equal(result.hasConflict, false, 'No conflict on free slot')
    assert.equal(result.conflictType, 'none')
    assert.equal(result.conflicts.length, 0)
  })

  await t.test('6. Immutable Audit Trail: Structured Diff Logging & Query Retrieval', async () => {
    const testEntityId = `test-entity-${Date.now()}`

    // 1. Record Attendance Override Audit
    const attAudit = await recordAttendanceOverrideAudit({
      practicalLogId: testEntityId,
      studentName: 'Aayush Adhikari',
      rollNumber: 101,
      beforePresent: false,
      afterPresent: true,
      reason: 'Late arrival verified by gate record',
    })
    assert.equal(attAudit.success, true, 'Attendance audit logged successfully')

    // 2. Record Workstation Issue Status Audit
    const wsAudit = await recordWorkstationIssueStatusAudit({
      issueId: testEntityId,
      workstationLabel: 'PC-07',
      beforeStatus: 'open',
      afterStatus: 'resolved',
      resolutionNotes: 'RAM module reseated and tested OK',
    })
    assert.equal(wsAudit.success, true, 'Workstation issue status audit logged successfully')

    // 3. Query Audit Ledger filtered by entity_type 'attendance'
    const queryRes = await queryAuditLedger({
      entityType: 'attendance',
      search: 'Aayush Adhikari',
      limit: 10,
    })
    assert.ok(queryRes.logs.length >= 1, 'Found at least 1 attendance audit record')
    const foundLog = queryRes.logs.find((l) => l.entity_id === testEntityId)
    assert.ok(foundLog, 'Found specific test attendance log')
    assert.equal(foundLog.action, 'OVERRIDE')
    assert.equal(foundLog.entity_type, 'attendance')
    assert.ok(foundLog.changes?.after?.is_present, 'After state captures is_present = true')

    // 4. Retrieve Audit History for specific entity
    const history = await getAuditHistoryForEntity('workstation_issue', testEntityId)
    assert.ok(history.length >= 1, 'History for test issue retrieved')
    assert.equal(history[0].changes?.before?.status, 'open')
    assert.equal(history[0].changes?.after?.status, 'resolved')
  })
})

import { describe, it, before, after } from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

import {
  validateParsedRoster,
  formatAutoAdmissionNo,
  isExactNormalizedNameMatch,
} from '../lib/roster-ingestion/validator.ts'

function loadDbUrl() {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
  if (!fs.existsSync(envPath)) return null
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    if (line.startsWith('DATABASE_URL=')) {
      return line.split('=')[1].trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
    }
  }
  return null
}

const dbUrl = loadDbUrl()

      if (!client) return

      if (!client) return

      const testYear = '2083'
      const testClass = '11mgt'
      const tag = `CS-TEST-${Date.now()}`

      // Pre-cleanup in case a previous run terminated prematurely
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans 
        WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2;
      `, [testYear, testClass])
      await client.query(`

      await client.query(`

      // 1. Seed dummy students and enrollments with ZERO practical logs
      const s1 = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no) VALUES ('Dummy One', '${tag}-D1') RETURNING id;
      `)
      const s2 = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no) VALUES ('Dummy Two', '${tag}-D2') RETURNING id;
      `)
      const s1Id = s1.rows[0].id
      const s2Id = s2.rows[0].id

      const enr1 = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ('${testYear}', '${testClass}', '${s1Id}', 191, 'active')
        RETURNING id;
      `)
      const enr2 = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ('${testYear}', '${testClass}', '${s2Id}', 192, 'active')
        RETURNING id;
      `)
      const enr1Id = enr1.rows[0].id
      const enr2Id = enr2.rows[0].id

      // Seed dummy CAD seat plan on workstation ws-01 if available
      const wsCheck = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.workstations WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1;`)
      if (wsCheck.rows.length > 0) {
        const wsId = wsCheck.rows[0].id
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.workstation_seat_plans (academic_year_id, class_id, enrollment_id, workstation_id, lab_id)
          VALUES ('${testYear}', '${testClass}', '${enr1Id}', '${wsId}', 'comp');
        `)
      }

      // 2. Perform Clean Slate Ingestion with fresh real students (Rolls 191..193)
      const cleanSlatePayload = [
        { roll_number: 191, full_name: 'Real Student Alpha', admission_no: null, registration_no: null },
        { roll_number: 192, full_name: 'Real Student Beta', admission_no: null, registration_no: null },
        { roll_number: 193, full_name: 'Real Student Gamma', admission_no: null, registration_no: null },
      ]

      const commitRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
          $1,
          $2,
          $3::jsonb,
          'clean_slate'
        ) as result;
      `, [testYear, testClass, JSON.stringify(cleanSlatePayload)])

      const result = commitRes.rows[0].result
      assert.equal(result.success, true)
      assert.equal(result.mode, 'clean_slate')
      assert.equal(result.processed_rows, 3)
      assert.equal(result.enrollments_created, 3)

      // 3. Verify old dummy seat plans are wiped
      const seatCheck = await client.query(`
        SELECT count(*) as count FROM public.workstation_seat_plans
        WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2;
      `, [testYear, testClass])
      assert.equal(Number(seatCheck.rows[0].count), 0, 'Clean slate must wipe old seat plans')

      // 4. Verify orphaned dummy students were cleanly deleted
      const dummyCheck = await client.query(`
        SELECT count(*) as count FROM public.students
        WHERE id IN ($1, $2);
      `, [s1Id, s2Id])
      assert.equal(Number(dummyCheck.rows[0].count), 0, 'Clean slate must delete orphaned dummy students')

      // 5. Verify incoming students have standard auto-generated admission numbers
      const newEnrolls = await client.query(`
        SELECT se.roll_number, s.full_name, s.admission_no
        FROM public.student_enrollments se
        JOIN public.students s ON s.id = se.student_id
        WHERE se.academic_year_id = $1 AND se.class_id = $2
        ORDER BY se.roll_number ASC;
      `, [testYear, testClass])

      assert.equal(newEnrolls.rows.length, 3)
      assert.equal(newEnrolls.rows[0].full_name, 'Real Student Alpha')
      assert.equal(newEnrolls.rows[0].admission_no, 'ADM-2083-11MGT-191')
      assert.equal(newEnrolls.rows[1].admission_no, 'ADM-2083-11MGT-192')
      assert.equal(newEnrolls.rows[2].admission_no, 'ADM-2083-11MGT-193')

      // 6. Cleanup test records
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments
        WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2 AND roll_number IN (191, 192, 193);
      `, [testYear, testClass])
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.students
        WHERE admission_no LIKE 'ADM-2083-11MGT-19%';
      `)
    })

    it('Contextual Roll Shift Resolution: Student shifts from Roll 12 to Roll 14 without roll collision', async () => {
      if (!client) return

      const testYear = '2083'
      const testClass = '11mgt'
      const shiftTag = `SHIFT-${Date.now()}`

      // Create student enrolled at Roll 181
      const studentRes = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (full_name, admission_no) VALUES ('Shifting Student', '${shiftTag}') RETURNING id;
      `)
      const studentId = studentRes.rows[0].id

      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ('${testYear}', '${testClass}', '${studentId}', 181, 'active');
      `)

      // Sync import with roll updated to 182
      const shiftPayload = [
        { roll_number: 182, full_name: 'Shifting Student', admission_no: shiftTag, registration_no: null },
      ]

      const shiftRes = await client.query(`
        SELECT public.commit_roster_ingestion_tx(
          $1,
          $2,
          $3::jsonb,
          'sync'
        ) as result;
      `, [testYear, testClass, JSON.stringify(shiftPayload)])

      const res = shiftRes.rows[0].result
      assert.equal(res.success, true)
      assert.equal(res.enrollments_updated, 1, 'Roll shifted cleanly from 181 to 182')

      const verifyRoll = await client.query(`
        SELECT roll_number FROM public.student_enrollments
        WHERE student_id = $1 AND academic_year_id = $2 AND class_id = $3;
      `, [studentId, testYear, testClass])

      assert.equal(verifyRoll.rows[0].roll_number, 182)

      // Cleanup
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id = $1;`, [studentId])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [studentId])
    })
  })
})

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import pg from 'pg'

// 1. Load environment variables from .env.local
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const k = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const v = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[k]) process.env[k] = v
    }
  }
}

process.env.NODE_ENV = 'test'

const dbUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL
assert.ok(dbUrl, 'DATABASE_URL must be defined in .env.local for roster lifecycle integration tests')

test('Phase 6: Unified Roster Lifecycle, Archival & Governance Test Suite', async (t) => {

      email: 'p.adhikari@rrl.edu.np',

      is_active: true,

    })
  }

  })

  // =========================================================================
  // SUBTEST 1: getStudentsByClass Status Filtering & Derived Workstation Fields
  // =========================================================================
  await t.test('1. getStudentsByClass: Multi-status segmentation & derived workstation metadata', async () => {
    setAdminUser()

    const activeRes = await getStudentsByClass({
      classId: '12eng',
      academicYearId: '2083',
      statusFilter: 'active',
    })

    assert.equal(activeRes.success, true, 'getStudentsByClass active succeeded')
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(activeRes.data), 'Returns array of students')
    assert.ok(activeRes.data.length > 0, 'Class 12 Eng has active students')

    for (const student of activeRes.data) {
      assert.equal(student.enrollment_status, 'active', 'Student enrollment status must be active')
      assert.ok('assigned_workstation_label' in student, 'Includes assigned_workstation_label property')
      assert.ok('is_unseated' in student, 'Includes is_unseated boolean property')
      if (student.assigned_workstation_label) {
        assert.equal(student.is_unseated, false, 'Seated student has is_unseated === false')
      } else {
        assert.equal(student.is_unseated, true, 'Unseated student has is_unseated === true')
      }
    }

    const allRes = await getStudentsByClass({

    })

  })

  // =========================================================================

    // 2a. Reject unprivileged access
    setTeacherUser()
    const unprivRes = await restoreStudentEnrollmentAction('some-enrollment-id')
    assert.equal(unprivRes.success, false, 'Unprivileged teacher call rejected')
    assert.match(unprivRes.error || '', /Access denied: Only administrators can restore archived students/i)

    // Setup clean test cohort in 11mgt
    setAdminUser()
    const testYear = '2083'
    const testClass = '11mgt'
    const studentIdA = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
    const studentIdB = 'b0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'

    try {

      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans WHERE class_id = $1 AND academic_year_id = $2;`, [testClass, testYear])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE class_id = $1 AND academic_year_id = $2;`, [testClass, testYear])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [studentIdA, studentIdB])

      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, is_active)
        VALUES

          ($2, 'TEST-RESTORE-B', 'Deepak Shrestha', false);
      `, [studentIdA, studentIdB])

        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 15, 'active');
      `, [testYear, testClass, studentIdA])

      const enrB = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 14, 'archived')
        RETURNING id;
      `, [testYear, testClass, studentIdB])

      const enrollmentBId = enrB.rows[0].id

      // 2b. Restore Student B requesting Roll 15 (which is currently occupied by Student A)
      // The restore action detects Roll 15 is occupied in 11mgt, auto-assigns next available roll (15 + 1 = 16)
      const restoreRes = await restoreStudentEnrollmentAction(enrollmentBId, 15)
      assert.equal(restoreRes.success, true, `Restore should succeed: ${restoreRes.error}`)
      assert.equal(restoreRes.newRollNumber, 16, 'Auto-assigned next available roll (15 + 1 = 16)')

      // Verify Student B enrollment in DB is active at Roll 16
      const checkEnr = await client.query(`SELECT roll_number, status FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE id = $1;`, [enrollmentBId])
      assert.equal(checkEnr.rows[0]?.status, 'active', 'Enrollment is active')
      assert.equal(checkEnr.rows[0]?.roll_number, 16, 'Roll is 16')

      // Verify Student B person record is reactivated
      const checkStd = await client.query(`SELECT is_active FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [studentIdB])
      assert.equal(checkStd.rows[0]?.is_active, true, 'Student person record is marked is_active = true')

    } finally {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id IN ($1, $2);`, [studentIdA, studentIdB])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [studentIdA, studentIdB])
    }
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // SUBTEST 3: resequenceClassRollsAlphabeticallyAction Guards & Execution
  // =========================================================================
  await t.test('3. resequenceClassRollsAlphabeticallyAction: Guards logbook integrity & sorts A-Z', async () => {
    // 3a. Rejects unprivileged caller
    setTeacherUser()
    const unprivRes = await resequenceClassRollsAlphabeticallyAction({ classId: '12eng', academicYearId: '2083' })
    assert.equal(unprivRes.success, false, 'Unprivileged resequence rejected')

    const blockedRes = await resequenceClassRollsAlphabeticallyAction({ classId: '12eng', academicYearId: '2083' })
    assert.equal(blockedRes.success, false, 'Blocked resequence when practical attendance logs exist')

    const s3 = 'c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003'

  // =========================================================================
  // SUBTEST 4: updateStudentDetailsAction Friendly Collision Handling
  // =========================================================================
  await t.test('4. updateStudentDetailsAction: Pre-save duplicate roll & admission guards', async () => {
    setAdminUser()
    const testYear = '2083'
    const testClass = '11mgt'
    const s1 = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
    const s2 = 'd0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'

    try {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2;`, [testYear, testClass])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [s1, s2])

      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, is_active)
        VALUES 
          ($1, 'TEST-ADM-COLL-1', 'Gaurav Karki', true),
          ($2, 'TEST-ADM-COLL-2', 'Nabin Bhatta', true);
      `, [s1, s2])

      const enr1Res = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 10, 'active')
        RETURNING id;
      `, [testYear, testClass, s1])

      const enr2Res = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 11, 'active')
        RETURNING id;
      `, [testYear, testClass, s2])

      const enr2Id = enr2Res.rows[0].id

      // 4a. Attempt to change Student 2's roll to Roll 10 (already held by Gaurav Karki)
      const rollCollRes = await updateStudentDetailsAction({
        studentId: s2,
        enrollmentId: enr2Id,
        fullName: 'Nabin Bhatta',
        rollNumber: 10,
        admissionNo: 'TEST-ADM-COLL-2',
      })

      assert.equal(rollCollRes.success, false, 'Roll collision rejected')
      assert.match(
        rollCollRes.error || '',
        /Roll 10 is already occupied by Gaurav Karki\. Please choose an unassigned roll number\./i
      )

      // 4b. Attempt to assign Student 1's admission number to Student 2
      const admCollRes = await updateStudentDetailsAction({
        studentId: s2,
        enrollmentId: enr2Id,
        fullName: 'Nabin Bhatta',
        rollNumber: 11,
        admissionNo: 'TEST-ADM-COLL-1',
      })

      assert.equal(admCollRes.success, false, 'Duplicate admission number rejected')
      assert.match(
        admCollRes.error || '',
        /Admission number "TEST-ADM-COLL-1" is already assigned to Gaurav Karki\./i
      )

      // 4c. Valid update succeeds
      const validRes = await updateStudentDetailsAction({
        studentId: s2,
        enrollmentId: enr2Id,
        fullName: 'Nabin Bhatta (Updated)',
        rollNumber: 12,
        admissionNo: 'TEST-ADM-COLL-2-UPDATED',
        gender: 'male',
      })

      assert.equal(validRes.success, true, `Valid update succeeds: ${validRes.error}`)

      const verifyRow = await client.query(`SELECT full_name, admission_no FROM public.students WHERE id = $1;`, [s2])
      assert.equal(verifyRow.rows[0]?.full_name, 'Nabin Bhatta (Updated)')
      assert.equal(verifyRow.rows[0]?.admission_no, 'TEST-ADM-COLL-2-UPDATED')

    } finally {
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE student_id IN ($1, $2);`, [s1, s2])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [s1, s2])
    }
  })

  // =========================================================================
  // SUBTEST 5: wipeClassCohortDataAction Danger Zone Execution & Receipt
  // =========================================================================
  await t.test('5. wipeClassCohortDataAction: Danger zone access guard & atomic cohort purge', async () => {
    // 5a. Access guard: rejects non-super_admin
    setTeacherUser()
    const unprivRes = await wipeClassCohortDataAction({
      classId: '11mgt',
      academicYearId: '2083',
      confirmPhrase: 'WIPE 11MGT',

    assert.equal(unprivRes.success, false, 'Unauthorized non-super_admin rejected')
    assert.match(unprivRes.error || '', /restricted exclusively to Super Administrators/i)

    setAdminUser()

    const mismatchRes = await wipeClassCohortDataAction({
      classId: '11mgt',
      academicYearId: '2083',
      confirmPhrase: 'DELETE PLEASE',
    })
    assert.equal(mismatchRes.success, false, 'Confirmation phrase mismatch rejected')
    assert.match(mismatchRes.error || '', /Confirmation phrase mismatch/i)

    // 5c. Atomic wipe execution on test class cohort
    const testYear = '2083'
    const testClass = '11mgt'
    const s1 = 'e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
    const s2 = 'e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'

    try {
      await client.query(`
        DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans 
        WHERE enrollment_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2);
      `, [testYear, testClass])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.student_enrollments WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2;`, [testYear, testClass])
      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [s1, s2])

      await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.students (id, admission_no, full_name, is_active)
        VALUES 
          ($1, 'TEST-WIPE-1', 'Purge Candidate 1', true),
          ($2, 'TEST-WIPE-2', 'Purge Candidate 2', true);
      `, [s1, s2])

      const enr1Res = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 101, 'active')
        RETURNING id;
      `, [testYear, testClass, s1])

      const enr2Res = await client.query(`
        INSERT INTO public.student_enrollments (academic_year_id, class_id, student_id, roll_number, status)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 102, 'active')
        RETURNING id;
      `, [testYear, testClass, s2])

      const enr1Id = enr1Res.rows[0].id

      // Seed dummy seat plan
      const wsCheck = await client.query(`SELECT id FROM public.workstations WHERE is_active = true LIMIT 1;`)
      if (wsCheck.rows.length > 0) {
        await client.query(`
          INSERT INTO public.workstation_seat_plans (academic_year_id, class_id, enrollment_id, workstation_id, lab_id)
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'comp');
        `, [testYear, testClass, enr1Id, wsCheck.rows[0].id])
      }

      // Execute wipe action with exact confirmation phrase
      const wipeRes = await wipeClassCohortDataAction({
        classId: testClass,
        academicYearId: testYear,
        confirmPhrase: `WIPE ${testClass.toUpperCase()}`,
        reason: 'Automated Test Suite Verification',
      })

      assert.equal(wipeRes.success, true, `Wipe should succeed: ${wipeRes.error}`)
      assert.ok(wipeRes.receipt, 'Returns receipt object')
      assert.ok(wipeRes.receipt.enrollmentsDeleted >= 2, 'Deleted at least 2 test enrollments')
      assert.ok(wipeRes.receipt.studentsDeleted >= 2, 'Deleted orphaned test students')

      // Verify enrollments are purged from DB
      const enrCheck = await client.query(`
        SELECT count(*) FROM public.student_enrollments 
        WHERE academic_year_id = $1 AND class_id = $2;
      `, [testYear, testClass])
      assert.equal(parseInt(enrCheck.rows[0].count), 0, 'Zero enrollments remain for this class')

      // Verify orphaned test students are deleted
      const stdCheck = await client.query(`SELECT count(*) FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [s1, s2])
      assert.equal(parseInt(stdCheck.rows[0].count), 0, 'Orphaned test students completely removed')

      // Verify audit log entry exists in public.audit_logs
      const auditCheck = await client.query(`
        SELECT action, entity_type, entity_label 
        FROM public.audit_logs 
        WHERE metadata->>'action' = 'WIPE_CLASS_COHORT'
        ORDER BY created_at DESC

      `)

      assert.equal(auditCheck.rows[0]?.entity_type, 'roster')

        DELETE FROM public.workstation_seat_plans

      `, [s1, s2])

      await client.query(`DELETE FROM public.students WHERE id IN ($1, $2);`, [s1, s2])

import { describe, it, before, after } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import pg from 'pg';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { resolveDatabaseUrl } from '../lib/db.ts';
import { validatePasswordPolicy } from '../lib/auth-policy.ts';

function loadEnv() {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local');
  if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
    const lines = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8').split('\n');
    for (const line of lines) {
      const trimmed = line.trim();
      if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue;
      const eqIdx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
      if (eqIdx !== -1) {
        const key = trimmed.slice(0, eqIdx).trim();
        const val = trimmed.slice(eqIdx + 1).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
        if (!process.env[key]) {
          process.env[key] = val;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

loadEnv();

describe('Institutional Credentials & Dual-OTP Email Change Suite', () => {
  let pool;
  const testUserId = crypto.randomUUID();
  const testOldEmail = `test.faculty.${Date.now()}@rrl.edu.np`;
  const testNewEmail = `test.migrated.${Date.now()}@rrl.edu.np`;
  const initialPassword = 'LabSyncPassword2026!#';
  const updatedPassword = 'NewStrongLabPassword2026!#';

  before(async () => {
    const rawUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
    const connectionString = resolveDatabaseUrl(rawUrl);
    const isSupabase = connectionString && (connectionString.includes('supabase.co') || connectionString.includes('supabase.com'));

    pool = new pg.Pool({
      connectionString,
      ssl: isSupabase ? { rejectUnauthorized: false } : undefined,
    });

    // Seed temporary test user in auth.users and public.profiles
    await pool.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO auth.users (id, email, encrypted_password, email_confirmed_at, raw_app_meta_data, raw_user_meta_data, created_at, updated_at)
      VALUES (
        $1::uuid,
        $2,
        crypt($3, gen_salt('bf', 10)),
        now(),
        '{"provider":"email","providers":["email"]}'::jsonb,
        '{"full_name":"Test Credential Faculty"}'::jsonb,
        now(),
        now()
      );
      `,
      [testUserId, testOldEmail, initialPassword]
    );

    await pool.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO auth.identities (id, user_id, identity_data, provider, provider_id, last_sign_in_at, created_at, updated_at)
      VALUES (
        $1::uuid,
        $2::uuid,
        jsonb_build_object('sub', $2::text, 'email', $3::text, 'email_verified', true),
        'email',
        $2::text,
        now(),
        now(),
        now()
      );
      `,
      [crypto.randomUUID(), testUserId, testOldEmail]
    );

    await pool.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, email, role, approval_status, created_at)
      VALUES ($1::uuid, 'Test Credential Faculty', $2, 'teacher', 'approved', now())
      ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET email = $2;
      `,
      [testUserId, testOldEmail]
    );
  });

  after(async () => {
    if (pool) {
      // Clean up test artifacts
      await pool.query(`DELETE FROM public.email_otps WHERE email IN ($1, $2);`, [testOldEmail, testNewEmail]);
      await pool.query(`DELETE FROM public.profiles WHERE id = $1::uuid;`, [testUserId]);
      await pool.query(`DELETE FROM auth.identities WHERE user_id = $1::uuid;`, [testUserId]);
      await pool.query(`DELETE FROM auth.users WHERE id = $1::uuid;`, [testUserId]);
      await pool.end();
    }
  });

  it('1. Enforces institutional password policy correctly', () => {
    // Too short
    assert.equal(validatePasswordPolicy('Ab1!').isValid, false);
    // Missing number
    assert.equal(validatePasswordPolicy('Abcdefgh!@#').isValid, false);
    // Missing uppercase
    assert.equal(validatePasswordPolicy('abcdefgh123!').isValid, false);
    // Missing special char
    assert.equal(validatePasswordPolicy('Abcdefgh1234').isValid, false);
    // Valid institutional password
    assert.equal(validatePasswordPolicy(updatedPassword).isValid, true);
  });

  it('2. Verifies current password authentication against crypt()', async () => {
    // Wrong password check
    const wrongRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT (encrypted_password = crypt($1, encrypted_password)) AS is_valid FROM auth.users WHERE id = $2::uuid;`,
      ['WrongPassword123!', testUserId]
    );
    assert.equal(wrongRes.rows[0].is_valid, false, 'Wrong password must be rejected');

    // Correct password check
    const correctRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT (encrypted_password = crypt($1, encrypted_password)) AS is_valid FROM auth.users WHERE id = $2::uuid;`,
      [initialPassword, testUserId]
    );
    assert.equal(correctRes.rows[0].is_valid, true, 'Correct initial password must pass');
  });

  it('3. Atomically updates password with bcrypt hash', async () => {
    await pool.query(
      `
      UPDATE auth.users
      SET encrypted_password = crypt($1, gen_salt('bf', 10)),
          updated_at = now()
      WHERE id = $2::uuid;
      `,
      [updatedPassword, testUserId]
    );

    // Old password should now fail
    const oldPassRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT (encrypted_password = crypt($1, encrypted_password)) AS is_valid FROM auth.users WHERE id = $2::uuid;`,
      [initialPassword, testUserId]
    );
    assert.equal(oldPassRes.rows[0].is_valid, false, 'Old password must no longer work');

    // New password should now succeed
    const newPassRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT (encrypted_password = crypt($1, encrypted_password)) AS is_valid FROM auth.users WHERE id = $2::uuid;`,
      [updatedPassword, testUserId]
    );
    assert.equal(newPassRes.rows[0].is_valid, true, 'New password must verify successfully');
  });

  it('4. Simulates Dual-OTP generation for old and new email addresses', async () => {
    const otpOld = '123456';
    const otpNew = '654321';

    // Invalidate prior
    await pool.query(
      `
      UPDATE public.email_otps 
      SET is_verified = TRUE 
      WHERE (email = $1 AND purpose = 'email_change_old')
         OR (email = $2 AND purpose = 'email_change_new');
      `,
      [testOldEmail, testNewEmail]
    );

    // Insert Dual-OTPs
    await pool.query(
      `
      INSERT INTO public.email_otps (email, otp_code, purpose, expires_at, created_at)
      VALUES 
        ($1, $2, 'email_change_old', now() + interval '10 minutes', now()),
        ($3, $4, 'email_change_new', now() + interval '10 minutes', now());
      `,
      [testOldEmail, otpOld, testNewEmail, otpNew]
    );

    // Verify OTP records exist in public.email_otps
    const oldOtpRow = await pool.query(
      `SELECT * FROM public.email_otps WHERE email = $1 AND purpose = 'email_change_old' AND is_verified = FALSE;`,
      [testOldEmail]
    );
    assert.equal(oldOtpRow.rows.length, 1);
    assert.equal(oldOtpRow.rows[0].otp_code, otpOld);

    const newOtpRow = await pool.query(
      `SELECT * FROM public.email_otps WHERE email = $1 AND purpose = 'email_change_new' AND is_verified = FALSE;`,
      [testNewEmail]
    );
    assert.equal(newOtpRow.rows.length, 1);
    assert.equal(newOtpRow.rows[0].otp_code, otpNew);
  });

  it('5. Rejects mismatched OTPs during Dual-OTP handshake', async () => {
    // Check old OTP with invalid code
    const oldOtpRow = await pool.query(
      `SELECT * FROM public.email_otps WHERE email = $1 AND purpose = 'email_change_old' AND is_verified = FALSE;`,
      [testOldEmail]
    );
    assert.notEqual(oldOtpRow.rows[0].otp_code, '999999', 'Mismatch must be detectable');
  });

  it('6. Atomically confirms Dual-OTP email migration across auth.users, auth.identities, and public.profiles', async () => {
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');

      // Mark OTPs verified
      await client.query(
        `UPDATE public.email_otps SET is_verified = TRUE WHERE email IN ($1, $2) AND purpose IN ('email_change_old', 'email_change_new');`,
        [testOldEmail, testNewEmail]
      );

      // Update auth.users
      await client.query(
        `UPDATE auth.users SET email = $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2::uuid;`,
        [testNewEmail, testUserId]
      );

      // Update auth.identities
      await client.query(
        `
        UPDATE auth.identities
        SET identity_data = jsonb_build_object('sub', $2::text, 'email', $1::text, 'email_verified', true, 'phone_verified', false),
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE user_id = $2::uuid AND provider = 'email';
        `,
        [testNewEmail, testUserId]
      );

      // Update public.profiles
      await client.query(
        `UPDATE public.profiles SET email = $1 WHERE id = $2::uuid;`,
        [testNewEmail, testUserId]
      );

      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (err) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      throw err;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }

    // Verify all 3 stores now reflect testNewEmail
    const userRes = await pool.query(`SELECT email FROM auth.users WHERE id = $1::uuid;`, [testUserId]);
    assert.equal(userRes.rows[0].email, testNewEmail, 'auth.users email must be migrated');

    const identityRes = await pool.query(`SELECT identity_data->>'email' AS id_email FROM auth.identities WHERE user_id = $1::uuid;`, [testUserId]);
    assert.equal(identityRes.rows[0].id_email, testNewEmail, 'auth.identities email must be migrated');

    const profileRes = await pool.query(`SELECT email FROM public.profiles WHERE id = $1::uuid;`, [testUserId]);
    assert.equal(profileRes.rows[0].email, testNewEmail, 'public.profiles email must be migrated');
  });
});

import { register } from 'node:module'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

process.env.NODE_ENV = 'test'
process.env.LABSYNC_TEST_RUNNER = 'true'

// Pre-load .env.local into process.env for all test suites
const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local')
if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8')
  for (const line of content.split('\n')) {
    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (trimmed && !trimmed.startsWith('#') && trimmed.includes('=')) {
      const idx = trimmed.indexOf('=')
      const key = trimmed.slice(0, idx).trim()
      const val = trimmed.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
      if (!process.env[key]) {
        process.env[key] = val
      }
    }
  }
}

register('./tests/resolve-hook.mjs', pathToFileURL('./'))

import {

test('Shared Record Report Specification & Filter Architecture Suite', async (t) => {

  await t.test('1. Filter Codec: Bidirectional Serialization & Zero Filter Drift', () => {
    const originalFilters = {
      lab_id: 'comp',
      date_from: '2026-03-01',
      date_to: '2026-03-31',
      status: 'skipped',
      search: 'Ohm',
      batch_group: 'Class 11 Science A',
      subject_name: 'Physics',
      teacher_id: 't-101',
      groupBy: 'batch_group',
      severity: 'major_critical',
      incident_type: 'breakage',
      asset_identifier: 'PC-14',
      plan_category: 'hardware',
      technician_id: 'tech-02',
      maintenance_status: 'completed',
      density: 'compact',
    }

    // 1. Encode to URLSearchParams
    const params = filtersToSearchParams(originalFilters)

    // Ensure NO filters were dropped (fixes the critical bug where status and search were dropped)
    assert.equal(params.get('lab_id'), 'comp')
    assert.equal(params.get('status'), 'skipped')
    assert.equal(params.get('search'), 'Ohm')
    assert.equal(params.get('batch_group'), 'Class 11 Science A')
    assert.equal(params.get('severity'), 'major_critical')
    assert.equal(params.get('incident_type'), 'breakage')
    assert.equal(params.get('asset_identifier'), 'PC-14')
    assert.equal(params.get('plan_category'), 'hardware')
    assert.equal(params.get('technician_id'), 'tech-02')
    assert.equal(params.get('maintenance_status'), 'completed')
    assert.equal(params.get('density'), 'compact')

    // 2. Decode back from URLSearchParams
    const roundtrip = searchParamsToFilters(params)
    assert.deepEqual(roundtrip, originalFilters)
  })

  await t.test('2. Word-Boundary Truncation: Never Cuts Mid-Word & Trims Trailing Punctuation', () => {
    const narrative = 'Workstation 14 SMPS power surge and capacitor burnout; quarantined on bench 4.'

    // Truncating at 40 chars:
    // Raw slice(0, 40) is "Workstation 14 SMPS power surge and capa"
    // Word boundary should cleanly cut before "capa" to "Workstation 14 SMPS power surge and"
    const res = truncateAtWordBoundary(narrative, 40)
    assert.equal(res.truncated, true)
    assert.equal(res.text, 'Workstation 14 SMPS power surge and')
    assert.ok(!res.text.endsWith('capa'), 'Must not truncate mid-word')

    // Clean trailing punctuation:
    const withPunct = 'Severe thermal throttle, overheating;'
    const punctRes = truncateAtWordBoundary(withPunct, 26) // "Severe thermal throttle,"
    assert.equal(punctRes.truncated, true)
    assert.equal(punctRes.text, 'Severe thermal throttle')
    assert.ok(!punctRes.text.endsWith(','), 'Must strip trailing comma')

    // Short text stays untruncated:
    const shortText = 'Normal routine check'
    const shortRes = truncateAtWordBoundary(shortText, 50)
    assert.equal(shortRes.truncated, false)
    assert.equal(shortRes.text, 'Normal routine check')
  })

  await t.test('3. Column Specification Constraints: Width Summation & Headroom Invariance', () => {
    // 1. practical_logs
    const practicalDetailedSum = practicalReportSpec.columns.reduce(
      (sum, col) => sum + col.print.detailed.widthPercent,
      0
    )
    const practicalCompactSum = practicalReportSpec.columns.reduce(
      (sum, col) => sum + col.print.compact.widthPercent,
      0
    )
    assert.ok(
      practicalDetailedSum <= 100,
      `practical_logs detailed sum (${practicalDetailedSum}%) must be <= 100% to avoid print page horizontal overflow`
    )
    assert.equal(practicalDetailedSum, 99, 'practical_logs detailed sum is calibrated to 99% (1% safety margin)')
    assert.ok(practicalCompactSum <= 100, 'practical_logs compact sum must be <= 100%')

    // 2. lab_incidents
    const incidentDetailedSum = incidentReportSpec.columns.reduce(
      (sum, col) => sum + col.print.detailed.widthPercent,
      0
    )
    const incidentCompactSum = incidentReportSpec.columns.reduce(
      (sum, col) => sum + col.print.compact.widthPercent,
      0
    )
    assert.ok(incidentDetailedSum <= 100, 'incident detailed sum must be <= 100%')
    assert.equal(incidentDetailedSum, 100, 'incident detailed sum must equal exactly 100%')
    assert.ok(incidentCompactSum <= 100, 'incident compact sum must be <= 100%')

    // 3. maintenance_logs
    const maintenanceDetailedSum = maintenanceReportSpec.columns.reduce(
      (sum, col) => sum + col.print.detailed.widthPercent,
      0
    )
    const maintenanceCompactSum = maintenanceReportSpec.columns.reduce(
      (sum, col) => sum + col.print.compact.widthPercent,
      0
    )
    assert.ok(maintenanceDetailedSum <= 100, 'maintenance detailed sum must be <= 100%')
    assert.ok(maintenanceCompactSum <= 100, 'maintenance compact sum must be <= 100%')

    // 4. Export alwaysFullText invariant
    for (const col of practicalReportSpec.columns) {
      assert.equal(col.export.alwaysFullText, true, `Column ${col.id} must have alwaysFullText: true`)
    }
    for (const col of incidentReportSpec.columns) {
      assert.equal(col.export.alwaysFullText, true, `Column ${col.id} must have alwaysFullText: true`)
    }
    for (const col of maintenanceReportSpec.columns) {
      assert.equal(col.export.alwaysFullText, true, `Column ${col.id} must have alwaysFullText: true`)
    }
  })

  await t.test('4. Footnote Allocation: Independent Sequential Numbering for Multiple Narrative Fields on Same Row', () => {
    // Simulate a record where BOTH topic_learned and remarks exceed the cutoff
    const row = {
      id: 'rec-001',
      date: '2026-03-12',
      labs: { name: 'Comp Lab 01' },
      topic_learned: 'Demonstrated advanced transistor biasing and circuit simulation on breadboards with multi-meter telemetry analysis.',
      remarks: 'Workstation 14 SMPS power surge and capacitor burnout; quarantined on bench 4 awaiting warranty replacement parts from vendor.',
    }

    const notes = []
    const rowId = `Row #1 (${row.date} | ${row.labs.name})`

    // Topic truncation
    const topicTrunc = truncateAtWordBoundary(row.topic_learned, 40)
    let topicIdx = null
    if (topicTrunc.truncated) {
      topicIdx = notes.length + 1
      notes.push({
        index: topicIdx,
        rowIdentifier: rowId,
        fieldName: 'Topic Learned',
        fullText: row.topic_learned,
      })
    }

    // Remarks truncation
    const remarksTrunc = truncateAtWordBoundary(row.remarks, 40)
    let remarksIdx = null
    if (remarksTrunc.truncated) {
      remarksIdx = notes.length + 1
      notes.push({
        index: remarksIdx,
        rowIdentifier: rowId,
        fieldName: 'Remarks',
        fullText: row.remarks,
      })
    }

    // Verify independent sequential numbers
    assert.equal(topicIdx, 1, 'First narrative on row gets index [1]')
    assert.equal(remarksIdx, 2, 'Second narrative on row gets index [2]')
    assert.equal(notes.length, 2)
    assert.equal(notes[0].fieldName, 'Topic Learned')
    assert.equal(notes[1].fieldName, 'Remarks')
    assert.equal(notes[0].rowIdentifier, rowId)
    assert.equal(notes[1].rowIdentifier, rowId)
    assert.equal(notes[0].fullText, row.topic_learned)
    assert.equal(notes[1].fullText, row.remarks)
  })

  await t.test('5. formatClassCode: Formats historical variants, canonical classes and guarantees verbatim fallback', () => {
    // Canonical Admin Panel classes
    assert.equal(formatClassCode('12 Eng'), '12 Eng')
    assert.equal(formatClassCode('12 Eng - Computer Engineering'), '12 Eng')
    assert.equal(formatClassCode('11 Eng - Computer Engineering'), '11 Eng')

    assert.equal(formatClassCode('11 Mgt - General Science Stream'), '11 Mgt')
    assert.equal(formatClassCode('8A - General Science'), '8A')
    assert.equal(formatClassCode('8A'), '8A')

    // Historical variants

    assert.equal(formatClassCode('12C - Tech Stream Sec A'), '12C-A')
    assert.equal(formatClassCode('11 Sc - Science Stream Sec B'), '11Sc-B')
    assert.equal(formatClassCode('Grade 11 - Sci A'), '11-SciA')
    assert.equal(formatClassCode('11C - Computer Tech Sec A'), '11C-A')
    assert.equal(formatClassCode('Class 10'), 'Class 10')
    assert.equal(formatClassCode('Class 11'), 'Class 11')
    assert.equal(formatClassCode('12C'), '12C')
    // Unrecognized pattern -> Verbatim fallback
    assert.equal(formatClassCode('Vocational Electrical Evening Section'), 'Vocational Electrical Evening Section')
    assert.equal(formatClassCode(''), '—')
    assert.equal(formatClassCode(null), '—')
    assert.equal(formatClassCode(undefined), '—')
  })

  await t.test('6. sanitizeSubjectTitle: Strips redundant stuttering course code prefixes', () => {

    assert.equal(sanitizePostgrestSearch(null), '')
  })

  await t.test('8. resolveExportPrintScope: Validates precedence rules and audit traceability note formatting', () => {
    // 1. Explicit ID selection override
    const explicitScope = resolveExportPrintScope({
      selectedIds: ['p-1', 'p-2', 'p-3'],
      isAllMatchingSelected: false,
      totalCount: 45,
      filters: { lab_id: 'comp', status: 'completed' },
      sortKey: 'date',
      sortDirection: 'desc',
    })
    assert.equal(explicitScope.mode, 'SELECTED_EXPLICIT')
    assert.deepEqual(explicitScope.selectedIds, ['p-1', 'p-2', 'p-3'])
    assert.match(explicitScope.traceabilityNote, /3 selected records/)
    assert.match(explicitScope.traceabilityNote, /Sorted by: date \(desc\)/)

    // 2. Select-all matching filters override
    const allMatchingScope = resolveExportPrintScope({
      selectedIds: ['p-1', 'p-2'],
      isAllMatchingSelected: true,
      totalCount: 88,
      filters: { lab_id: 'phys', search: 'lens' },
      sortKey: 'facility',
      sortDirection: 'asc',
    })
    assert.equal(allMatchingScope.mode, 'ALL_MATCHING_EXPLICIT')
    assert.equal(allMatchingScope.selectedIds, undefined)
    assert.match(allMatchingScope.traceabilityNote, /88 records \(All Matching Selected\)/)
    assert.match(allMatchingScope.traceabilityNote, /Facility: PHYS/)
    assert.match(allMatchingScope.traceabilityNote, /Search: "lens"/)

    // 3. Normal unselected full dataset scope
    const normalScope = resolveExportPrintScope({
      selectedIds: [],
      isAllMatchingSelected: false,
      totalCount: 15,
      filters: { batch_group: 'Class 12 Sci B' },
    })
    assert.equal(normalScope.mode, 'FILTERED_DEFAULT')
    assert.match(normalScope.traceabilityNote, /15 records/)
    assert.match(normalScope.traceabilityNote, /Class: Class 12 Sci B/)
  })

  await t.test('9. WYSIWYG Transport Parameters: Bidirectional serialization of cols, selected, selKey, selectedAll', () => {
    const params = filtersToSearchParams({
      lab_id: 'chem',
      cols: 'date,period,facility,class_batch,subject',
      selected: 'id-1,id-2,id-3',
      selKey: 'psel_abc12345',
      selectedAll: true,
    })

    assert.equal(params.get('cols'), 'date,period,facility,class_batch,subject')
    assert.equal(params.get('selected'), 'id-1,id-2,id-3')
    assert.equal(params.get('selKey'), 'psel_abc12345')
    assert.equal(params.get('selectedAll'), 'true')

    const decoded = searchParamsToFilters(params)
    assert.equal(decoded.cols, 'date,period,facility,class_batch,subject')
    assert.equal(decoded.selected, 'id-1,id-2,id-3')
    assert.equal(decoded.selKey, 'psel_abc12345')
    assert.equal(decoded.selectedAll, true)
  })
})

FILE: tests\resolve-hook.mjs
================================================================================
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'

export async function resolve(specifier, context, nextResolve) {
  if (specifier === 'next/cache') {
    return {
      url: 'data:text/javascript,export function revalidatePath(){}; export function revalidateTag(){}; export function unstable_cache(fn){return fn};',
      shortCircuit: true,
    }
  }
  if (specifier === 'next/navigation') {
    return {
      url: 'data:text/javascript,export function redirect(){}; export function useRouter(){return {}}; export function usePathname(){return ""}; export function useSearchParams(){return new URLSearchParams()};',
      shortCircuit: true,
    }
  }
  if (specifier === 'next/headers') {
    return {
      url: 'data:text/javascript,export async function cookies(){ return { getAll: () => [], get: () => null, set: () => {} } }; export async function headers(){ return new Headers() };',
      shortCircuit: true,
    }
  }
  if (specifier === 'next/server') {
    return {
      url: 'data:text/javascript,export function after(fn){ if(typeof fn==="function") fn(); }; export class NextResponse {};',
      shortCircuit: true,
    }
  }

  try {
    return await nextResolve(specifier, context)
  } catch (err) {
    if (err.code === 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND') {
      // Handle relative imports
      if (specifier.startsWith('.')) {
        const parentPath = context.parentURL ? fileURLToPath(context.parentURL) : process.cwd()
        const parentDir = path.dirname(parentPath)
        const basePath = path.resolve(parentDir, specifier)
        for (const ext of ['.ts', '.tsx', '.mjs', '.js', '/index.ts', '/index.js']) {
          const testPath = basePath + ext
          if (fs.existsSync(testPath) && fs.statSync(testPath).isFile()) {
            return nextResolve(pathToFileURL(testPath).href, context)
          }
        }
      }
      // Handle @/ alias
      if (specifier.startsWith('@/')) {
        const relativePart = specifier.slice(2)
        const basePath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), relativePart)
        for (const ext of ['', '.ts', '.tsx', '.mjs', '.js', '/index.ts', '/index.js']) {
          const testPath = basePath + ext
          if (fs.existsSync(testPath) && fs.statSync(testPath).isFile()) {
            return nextResolve(pathToFileURL(testPath).href, context)
          }
        }
      }
    }
    throw err
  }
}

import { describe, it, before, after } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import pg from 'pg';
import { resolveDatabaseUrl } from '../lib/db.ts';

function loadEnv() {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local');
  if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
    const lines = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8').split('\n');
    for (const line of lines) {
      const trimmed = line.trim();
      if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue;
      const eqIdx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
      if (eqIdx !== -1) {
        const key = trimmed.slice(0, eqIdx).trim();
        const val = trimmed.slice(eqIdx + 1).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
        if (!process.env[key]) {
          process.env[key] = val;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

loadEnv();

describe('Staff & Faculty Profile Pictures Test Suite', () => {
  let pool;
  let testProfileId = null;
  let originalProfileState = null;

  before(async () => {
    const rawUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
    const connectionString = resolveDatabaseUrl(rawUrl);
    const isSupabase = connectionString && (connectionString.includes('supabase.co') || connectionString.includes('supabase.com'));

    pool = new pg.Pool({
      connectionString,
      ssl: isSupabase ? { rejectUnauthorized: false } : false,
    });

    // Find an existing faculty/staff profile
    const existing = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, full_name, role, photo_url, avatar_url FROM public.profiles LIMIT 1;`
    );

    if (existing.rows.length > 0) {
      testProfileId = existing.rows[0].id;
      originalProfileState = existing.rows[0];
    }
  });

  after(async () => {
    if (testProfileId && originalProfileState) {
      await pool.query(
        `UPDATE public.profiles SET photo_url = $1, avatar_url = $2, role = $3 WHERE id = $4::uuid`,
        [originalProfileState.photo_url, originalProfileState.avatar_url, originalProfileState.role, testProfileId]
      );
    }
    await pool.end();
  });

  it('1. Verifies public.profiles schema includes photo_url and avatar_url columns', async () => {
    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT column_name, data_type 
      FROM information_schema.columns 
      WHERE table_name = 'profiles' AND column_name IN ('photo_url', 'avatar_url')
      ORDER BY column_name;
    `);

    assert.equal(res.rows.length, 2, 'Expected both photo_url and avatar_url columns to exist');
    const colNames = res.rows.map(r => r.column_name);
    assert.ok(colNames.includes('photo_url'), 'Expected photo_url in profiles');
    assert.ok(colNames.includes('avatar_url'), 'Expected avatar_url in profiles');
  });

  it('2. Verifies updating staff profile photo_url and avatar_url', async () => {
    assert.ok(testProfileId, 'Expected at least one profile in database');

    const mockPhotoDataUrl = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQEASABIAAD/2wBDAP...mockStaffAvatarData';

    await pool.query(
      `
      UPDATE public.profiles
      SET photo_url = $1, avatar_url = $1
      WHERE id = $2::uuid;
      `,
      [mockPhotoDataUrl, testProfileId]
    );

    const queryRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, full_name, photo_url, avatar_url FROM public.profiles WHERE id = $1::uuid`,
      [testProfileId]
    );

    assert.equal(queryRes.rows.length, 1);
    const profile = queryRes.rows[0];
    assert.equal(profile.photo_url, mockPhotoDataUrl);
    assert.equal(profile.avatar_url, mockPhotoDataUrl);
  });

  it('3. Verifies photo updates across institutional roles (Teacher, Lab Incharge, HOD, Super Admin)', async () => {
    assert.ok(testProfileId, 'Expected at least one profile in database');
    const roles = ['teacher', 'lab_incharge', 'hod', 'super_admin'];

    for (const role of roles) {
      const updatedPhotoUrl = `data:image/jpeg;base64,mockUpdatedPhotoFor_${role}`;

      await pool.query(
        `
        UPDATE public.profiles
        SET role = $1, photo_url = $2, avatar_url = $2
        WHERE id = $3::uuid;
        `,
        [role, updatedPhotoUrl, testProfileId]
      );

      const checkRes = await pool.query(
        `SELECT role, photo_url, avatar_url FROM public.profiles WHERE id = $1::uuid`,
        [testProfileId]
      );

      assert.equal(checkRes.rows[0].role, role);
      assert.equal(checkRes.rows[0].photo_url, updatedPhotoUrl);
      assert.equal(checkRes.rows[0].avatar_url, updatedPhotoUrl);
    }
  });

  it('4. Verifies photo removal (clearing back to null)', async () => {
    assert.ok(testProfileId, 'Expected at least one profile in database');

    await pool.query(
      `
      UPDATE public.profiles
      SET photo_url = NULL, avatar_url = NULL
      WHERE id = $1::uuid;
      `,
      [testProfileId]
    );

    const checkRes = await pool.query(
      `SELECT photo_url, avatar_url FROM public.profiles WHERE id = $1::uuid`,
      [testProfileId]
    );

    assert.equal(checkRes.rows[0].photo_url, null);
    assert.equal(checkRes.rows[0].avatar_url, null);
  });
});

FILE: tests\storage-and-stream-export.test.mjs

import test from 'node:test'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import pg from 'pg'
import fs from 'fs'
import { parseBase64Image, uploadImageToStorage } from '../lib/storage/supabase-storage.ts'

const env = fs.readFileSync('.env.local', 'utf8')
const match = env.match(/DATABASE_URL=["']?([^"'\r\n]+)/)

test('Storage & Streaming Export Suite', async (t) => {
  await t.test('1. parseBase64Image extracts buffer and mimeType accurately', () => {
    const webpDataUrl = 'data:image/webp;base64,UklGRhoAAABXRUJQVlA4TA0AAAAvAAAAEAcQERGIiP4HAA=='
    const parsedWebp = parseBase64Image(webpDataUrl)
    assert.ok(parsedWebp, 'Parsed WebP result should not be null')
    assert.equal(parsedWebp.mimeType, 'image/webp')
    assert.ok(Buffer.isBuffer(parsedWebp.buffer))

    const jpegDataUrl = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQEASABIAAD/'
    const parsedJpeg = parseBase64Image(jpegDataUrl)
    assert.ok(parsedJpeg, 'Parsed JPEG result should not be null')
    assert.equal(parsedJpeg.mimeType, 'image/jpeg')
    assert.ok(Buffer.isBuffer(parsedJpeg.buffer))

    assert.equal(parseBase64Image(''), null)
    assert.equal(parseBase64Image(null), null)
  })

  await t.test('2. uploadImageToStorage returns existing HTTP URLs without re-uploading', async () => {
    const existingUrl = 'https://ygnhtwdsioeuybmlrvgj.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/avatars/students/test-123.webp'
    const result = await uploadImageToStorage({
      bucket: 'avatars',
      path: 'students/test-123.webp',
      imageData: existingUrl,
    })
    assert.equal(result, existingUrl)
  })

  await t.test('3. uploadImageToStorage falls back gracefully on storage failure without throwing', async () => {
    const mockClient = {
      storage: {
        from: () => ({
          upload: async () => ({ data: null, error: new Error('Network error') }),
          getPublicUrl: () => ({ data: { publicUrl: '' } }),
        }),
      },
    }

    const base64 = 'data:image/webp;base64,UklGRhoAAABXRUJQVlA4TA0AAAAvAAAAEAcQERGIiP4HAA=='
    const result = await uploadImageToStorage({
      bucket: 'avatars',
      path: 'students/test-fail.webp',
      imageData: base64,
      supabaseClient: mockClient,
    })

    assert.equal(result, base64, 'Should return original string on failure as safe fallback')
  })

  await t.test('4. Live PostgreSQL database contains ZERO Base64 image records', async () => {
    if (!match) return

    const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: match[1], ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } })
    const client = await pool.connect()

    try {
      const studentBase64 = (
        await client.query(`SELECT count(*) FROM public.students WHERE photo_url LIKE 'data:image%';`)
      ).rows[0].count

      const profileBase64 = (
        await client.query(
          `SELECT count(*) FROM public.profiles WHERE avatar_url LIKE 'data:image%' OR photo_url LIKE 'data:image%';`
        )
      ).rows[0].count

      const incidentBase64 = (
        await client.query(`SELECT count(*) FROM public.lab_incidents WHERE photo_url LIKE 'data:image%';`)
      ).rows[0].count

      assert.equal(studentBase64, '0', 'students.photo_url must contain 0 Base64 strings')
      assert.equal(profileBase64, '0', 'profiles.avatar_url must contain 0 Base64 strings')
      assert.equal(incidentBase64, '0', 'lab_incidents.photo_url must contain 0 Base64 strings')

      const sampleStudent = await client.query(
        `SELECT photo_url FROM public.students WHERE photo_url IS NOT NULL AND photo_url != '' LIMIT 1;`
      )
      if (sampleStudent.rows.length > 0) {
        assert.ok(
          sampleStudent.rows[0].photo_url.startsWith('https://'),
          `Student photo_url should start with https://, got: ${sampleStudent.rows[0].photo_url}`
        )
      }
    } finally {
      client.release()
      await pool.end()
    }
  })
})

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { parsePhotoFilename, doNamesMatch, matchPhotosToStudents } from '../lib/student-photos/matcher.ts';

test('Student Photo Filename Parser & Two-Factor Matcher Suite', async (t) => {
  await t.test('1. parsePhotoFilename correctly extracts roll and candidate names', () => {
    const res1 = parsePhotoFilename('8_kaustuv_thapa.jpg');
    assert.equal(res1.extractedRoll, 8);
    assert.equal(res1.extractedNameCandidate, 'kaustuv thapa');
    assert.equal(res1.extension, 'jpg');

    const res2 = parsePhotoFilename('08-kaustuv-thapa.png');
    assert.equal(res2.extractedRoll, 8);
    assert.equal(res2.extractedNameCandidate, 'kaustuv thapa');
    assert.equal(res2.extension, 'png');

    const res3 = parsePhotoFilename('14 aarav sharma.jpeg');
    assert.equal(res3.extractedRoll, 14);
    assert.equal(res3.extractedNameCandidate, 'aarav sharma');

    const res4 = parsePhotoFilename('8.jpg');
    assert.equal(res4.extractedRoll, 8);
    assert.equal(res4.extractedNameCandidate, null);

    const res5 = parsePhotoFilename('kaustuv_thapa.webp');
    assert.equal(res5.extractedRoll, null);
    assert.equal(res5.extractedNameCandidate, 'kaustuv thapa');
  });

  await t.test('2. doNamesMatch identifies normalized token overlaps', () => {
    assert.equal(doNamesMatch('kaustuv thapa', 'Kaustuv Thapa'), true);
    assert.equal(doNamesMatch('kaustuv thapa', 'Kaustav Thapa'), true); // surname match
    assert.equal(doNamesMatch('aarav sharma', 'Bibek Karki'), false);
  });

  await t.test('3. matchPhotosToStudents assigns high confidence on exact roll + name match', () => {
    const mockStudents = [
      { student_id: 's-1', roll_number: 8, full_name: 'Kaustuv Thapa', admission_no: 'ADM-008', registration_no: null },
      { student_id: 's-2', roll_number: 14, full_name: 'Aarav Sharma', admission_no: 'ADM-014', registration_no: null },
      { student_id: 's-3', roll_number: 22, full_name: 'Dipen Gurung', admission_no: '1641052469', registration_no: null },
    ];

    // Mock File object
    const mockFiles = [
      { name: '8_kaustuv_thapa.jpg' },
      { name: '14.jpg' },
      { name: '1641052469.png' },
      { name: '99_unknown_student.jpg' },
    ];

    // Node mock URL.createObjectURL
    globalThis.URL = globalThis.URL || {};
    if (!globalThis.URL.createObjectURL) {
      globalThis.URL.createObjectURL = () => 'blob:mock-url';
    }

    const matches = matchPhotosToStudents(mockFiles, mockStudents);
    assert.equal(matches.length, 4);

    // File 1: 8_kaustuv_thapa.jpg
    assert.equal(matches[0].matchedStudentId, 's-1');
    assert.equal(matches[0].confidence, 'high');
    assert.match(matches[0].matchReason, /Roll 8 \+ Name Verified/);

    // File 2: 14.jpg
    assert.equal(matches[1].matchedStudentId, 's-2');
    assert.equal(matches[1].confidence, 'high');

    // File 3: 1641052469.png (RFID)
    assert.equal(matches[2].matchedStudentId, 's-3');
    assert.equal(matches[2].confidence, 'high');

    // File 4: Unmatched
    assert.equal(matches[3].matchedStudentId, null);
    assert.equal(matches[3].confidence, 'unmatched');
  });
});

FILE: tests\teacher-preferences-and-profile.test.mjs

import { describe, it, before, after } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import pg from 'pg';
import { resolveDatabaseUrl } from '../lib/db.ts';

function loadEnv() {
  const envPath = path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.env.local');
  if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
    const lines = fs.readFileSync(envPath, 'utf8').split('\n');
    for (const line of lines) {
      const trimmed = line.trim();
      if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue;
      const eqIdx = trimmed.indexOf('=');
      if (eqIdx !== -1) {
        const key = trimmed.slice(0, eqIdx).trim();
        const val = trimmed.slice(eqIdx + 1).trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '');
        if (!process.env[key]) {
          process.env[key] = val;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

loadEnv();

describe('Teacher Profile & Preferences Persistence Suite', () => {
  let pool;

  before(async () => {
    const rawUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL;
    const connectionString = resolveDatabaseUrl(rawUrl);
    const isSupabase = connectionString && (connectionString.includes('supabase.co') || connectionString.includes('supabase.com'));

    pool = new pg.Pool({
      connectionString,
      ssl: isSupabase ? { rejectUnauthorized: false } : undefined,
    });
  });

  after(async () => {
    if (pool) {
      await pool.end();
    }
  });

  it('1. Verifies honorific, phone, bio, and teaching_preferences columns exist on public.profiles', async () => {
    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT column_name, data_type 
      FROM information_schema.columns 
      WHERE table_name = 'profiles' 
      AND column_name IN ('honorific', 'phone', 'bio', 'teaching_preferences')
    `);
    const colNames = res.rows.map((r) => r.column_name);
    assert.ok(colNames.includes('honorific'), 'honorific column must exist');
    assert.ok(colNames.includes('phone'), 'phone column must exist');
    assert.ok(colNames.includes('bio'), 'bio column must exist');
    assert.ok(colNames.includes('teaching_preferences'), 'teaching_preferences column must exist');
  });

  it('2. Verifies updating teacher preferences and bio in database', async () => {
    const profileRes = await pool.query(`SELECT id FROM public.profiles WHERE role = 'teacher' LIMIT 1`);
    if (profileRes.rows.length === 0) {
      assert.ok(true, 'No teacher profile found to test update, skipping');
      return;
    }

    const testId = profileRes.rows[0].id;
    const testPrefs = {
      specializations: ['Physics Practical', 'Computer Science'],
      notifyScheduleConflicts: true,
      notifyUpcomingLabs: false,
    };

    await pool.query(`
      UPDATE public.profiles
      SET 
        honorific = 'Er.',
        phone = '+977 9841234567',
        bio = 'Computer Systems & Lab In-Charge Test Bio',
        teaching_preferences = $1
      WHERE id = $2
    `, [JSON.stringify(testPrefs), testId]);

    const verifyRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT honorific, phone, bio, teaching_preferences 
      FROM public.profiles 
      WHERE id = $1
    `, [testId]);

    const row = verifyRes.rows[0];
    assert.strictEqual(row.honorific, 'Er.');
    assert.strictEqual(row.phone, '+977 9841234567');
    assert.strictEqual(row.bio, 'Computer Systems & Lab In-Charge Test Bio');
    assert.deepStrictEqual(row.teaching_preferences.specializations, ['Physics Practical', 'Computer Science']);
    assert.strictEqual(row.teaching_preferences.notifyScheduleConflicts, true);
    assert.strictEqual(row.teaching_preferences.notifyUpcomingLabs, false);
  });
});
